tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 6 gsung 'bum/_'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma/(si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /)

tei:div.tei:p: ra / /mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rdo grub chen 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i gsung 'bum legs bshad nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs/si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

pod 6྾—྾྾ ྾4྾ sngon 'gro'i gtam/gna' rtsom ni mi rib/sa srol rgyun ris gnas kyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin cing / krung hwa mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rib/ banas shul bzhag khrod kyi rin chen nor bu zhig yin/ de 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig tho 'god/ par skrun bcas byed rgyu ni rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab kyis mi rigs phul byung rig gnas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin pas/ rang rgyal mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims sogs bca' khrims dang srid jus su gsal bor gtan la phab yod cing / rim pa khag gi mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'di phyogs kyi bya ba 'bor chen bsgrubs shing / grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs/ nye ba'i lo shas ring / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom nang du 'dus pa'i rang rgyal mi rigs bana' rtsom 'tshol sbud dang /dag sgrig tho 'god sogs byed pa'i thad ched du yig cha phud de gtan phab gsar ba mdzad cing / blang bya gsar ba ngaton/ spyi khyab hru'u ci nas kyang6‘gna' rtsom dag sgrig par skrun sgos mes rgyal kyi phul byung rig gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byas te/ krung go'i 1

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 6khri — kyi ce sgri ྾྾ mas dar rgyas — gsung rtsom ga sa ba gas〉sogs snga gzhus tu deb lnga drug tsam par skrun byas te/ rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan sngar rim par bstar bas/ kun gyi gdeng 'jos legs po byung zhing /bya ba de la 'brel yod sde khag gis mthong gzigs gnang ste/ ched gnyer las khungs dang mi sna sogs la zhing chen rim pa'i gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud myur skyob kyi bya dasa' dang gzengs bstod kyi dadugs dbyung rbengs du mar gnang /nye lam rgyal khab mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis〈krung bo/'i grangs nyung mi rigs kana' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i shar rlung gi 'gros dang brdun zhing / rang skyong khul gyi srid dbang btsugs nas lo 'khor lnga bcu 'khor bar sngon bsu zhu ba'i sta gon rtsom pa dang 'brel/ khul sana' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis sngar gyi rmang gzhi'i steng rim pa spaṭa shing gzhi rgya bskyed de/ sgar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun bcas byed pa'i jus gzhi gsar ba bzos pa ltar nga tshos bya ba 'di da lha dngos su lag star byed 'go brtsams pa yin/de yang nga tshos bya ba 'di nyid sgrub pa'i mdzub ston bsam blo ni tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod mdzub 3

parang nga rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'abum/ nga yod/de sngon gyi srid jus legs po'i go skabs ma shor bar byas te/cha rkyen zhan cing dka' tshegs che ba la ma ltos par mthun rkyen sasar gtod sgos 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig myur skyob kyi las la rang rtogs ngang zhugs nas sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag rtsa chen dag chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i ched du 'bad pa yun ring bsten pa'i ched las don gnyer mi sna dag gis don mthan gyi bya ༄ba mang po bsgrubs songabs/ ngas 'dir khong tshor dka' las myang song zhes zhu zhing / kho bo rang ngos kyis bya ba de la rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen sbyor ba'ang ldog med kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis yod/'on kyang rang khul gyi gna' rtsom ma lus par yongs su myur skyob byed rgyu ni da dung dus yun ring zhing dka' khag che ba'i bya ba zhig yin pas/ grub 'bras kyi rmang gzhi'i steng mu 'thud nas rgyun 'khyongs lhod med kyi bya ba 'bor chen zhib bsgrub pa la rag las yod/mjug mthar mgo los gna' rtsom bya ba legs 'grub yong zhing / grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa'i smon 'dun zhu//zhes pad ma rnam rgyal nas2003 1 1la bris/0

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor basprus/rdo grub chen kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po ni/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi las a lcags 'bri yi rigs las mched pa gnubs lcags mo'i rgyud du/yab rtsod zal dus babs kyi sprul ba'i gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa spis li gter ston zhes yongs su grags pa de dang / yum mtshan ldan ḍā ki'i rigs gyur bsod nams mtsho gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing mo gling lor(spyi lo1865)ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas 'bros sgang zhes grags pa'i ri zhol da lta'i mgo log pad ma rdzong gi rdzong grong gi nye 'dabs su sku bltams/ snga ma'i bag chags sad pas sbu chung ngu'i dus nas yi ge dang brda sprod sogs gzisas pa tsam gyis thogs med du mkhyen/ rdzogs sprul bzhi ba mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i lung bstan lhar/ grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po rdo grub kun bzang 1

sgyur zug ba sgyu sgyu 11cad zugacadadapa nga da/bka/ 'bab nga /bache'i zhal nas/ rdo grub byis pa lo brgyad pas chos 'khor 'di 'dra bskor nus pa'i tshul la dpag na/ da dung lung gi bstan pa'i gnas tshad rdzogs ran mi 'dug ces thugs dgyes pa chen pos bsngags brjod kyi me tog yang yang 'thor/ snga phyir o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po dang / rdzogs sprul mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje/ rgya rong nam sprul kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyag bla gter chen/ 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho sogs dam pa mang du bsten nas/ 'dul ba dbu tshad phar phyin sogs gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i zab chos spyi dang / mdo sgyu sems gsum/ bka' dgongs phar gsum/ snying thig kong 'og ༄sogs snga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bka' gter smin grol gyi dbang lung khrid gsum/ mdo smad rdi tsha dgon gyi mgo log sprul sku 'gya ba a lags sogs las kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig chas gtso byas ri bo dase/ ldan pa ltar gyi gzhung bka' pod lnga sogs mdor na mdo sngags gsar rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi lta grub kun la khengs pa dang skyo ngal med par thugs 'dris gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa ches cher rgyas/13

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 6'i ko 3 — gzugs sku ba —da pa chos da—ngas su bsdus so//lung gis zin pa'i thugs sras mgar ba mkhan po 'jigs med 'od zer dang / ser shul mkhan po/ klu shul mkhan po/ mkhan po dam chos bcas mkhan chen bzhis gtso'i rnyiḥphi dug tsha sogs yul gru kun nas slob ma mang du 'dus kyang / 'khor slob rgya cher bsdu ba sogs thun mong gi mnga' thang dang gzi byin gyi spros pa rtag tu bsgyungs te bzhugs/gsung rtsom la〈rgyud ma hā yo ga'i tan+d+ra gsang ba'i snying bo de kho na nyid rnam par nges pa la zur lugs ltar gyi dgongs 'grel spyi don rin chen mdzod kyi lde mig〉dang / 〈mdo las byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs kyi rgyan rnam par bshad pa rgyal yum lus bzang mdzes byed legs bshad phreng ba〉sogs mdo sngags gzhung 'grel gyi skor dang / sgrub thabs skyed rdzogs kyi skor/lo rgyus gtam tshogs kyi skor/ gsung mgur snyan ngag gi skor/ zhal gdams man ngag gi skor sogs gang la'ang thun mong min pa'i khyad chos rtsal du thon pa'i gsung chos pod chen bcu phrag lhag cis bzhugs pa las/gong smras〈gsang snying spyi don〉dang / 〈gzungs kyi rnam bshad〉〉〈gter gyi nom bshad〉sogs la shes nas smra ba'i mkhas pa du mas bstod bsngags kyi me tog mang du 'thor/ gzungs kyi skor la rnam 5
sdus pa'i spyo

pod/ 6྾4 ྾ ྾྾4ba༄/ /bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam dge ba'i lo hog spel byed dbyar skyes sprun chen zal ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bathugs so/ /mabon po snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rgyal byed 'khor lo'i mtshan ma yis/ /bris pa'i 'od snang li khri'i dog pa sasar/ /thub rnams mgo la cod pan bzhin mdzes pa//'od mdzad zhabs pad dang bas lan brgyar mchod/ /blo gsar thar 'dod re ba'i ljon shing rtser/ /legs bshad glu dbyangs len mkhas khu byug cig /yongs dag zhing gi 'byor ba brda sprod kyis/ /gtan bde'i dga' ston 'dod rnams gus pas nyon/ /'dir blo rab 'bring tha ma'i gdul bya rnams kyi spyad bya thun mong ngar gyur cing / thos na dga' ba rmad du byung ba skyed par byed pa/ bde ba ca na gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam gyi sbyor ba cung zad mdo sde'i rjes su 'brangs te bya ba la gsum/ dgos pa bstan nas bde ba can gyi zhing du skye ba 'dzin pa la spro ba bskyed pa/ zhing der skye ba la zhum pa skye ba'i sgo dgag pa/ der skye ba'i rgyu tshosas sgrub tshul 1

bde bcan gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / yongs su dri bar bya ba'i phyir 'jig rten kyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la blta bas ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dpe dang / zhing dang 'khor gyi phun tshogs mthong ste dad pa'i shugs skye ba dang 'phel bar byed de/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyes par byed pa'i gzhi'o/ /phyag dang bsnyen bkur bya ba ni rnyed pa dang bkur snyi dang rim gro'i sgo nas bsten tshul yin la/ yongs su dri bas gdams pa'i gnad la the tshom chod par byed pa ni gdams don ma nor bar nyams su len pa'i ched yin pas sgrub pa'i nan tan gyis mnyes par byed pa yang sbud do/ /de ltar na mdo 'dis mchog gi sprul sku mngon sum du mnyes par byed tshul gyi khongs su bshes gnyen bsten pa'i man ngas cha tshang zhig bstan no/ /de'ang 'og tu 'chad pa ltar yul ston pa dang rten zhing de'i 'gro ba banyis ka tshe dpag tu med pa'i phyir/ der skyes na gdul bya thun mong ba yang lam mthon por sleb sleb tu rang gi ston pa dngos la mi 'bral bar bsten du yod pas dge chos las mi nyams shing yon tan gyi tshogs kyis nyin re bzhin du rgyas par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gzhan yang zhing der rgyal sras mtha chen mang po skye tshul ston pa'i ༄mdo de nyid kyi 'phror/ mi pham pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 3

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6྾ ྾ 4྾pa rnams las ches cher gtsang bas der song nas bsgrub na lam gyi sa chod shin tu che ba yin te/ mi 'khrub/sa pa'i zhing bkod kyi mdo las rgyal po'i sbas tshal dang / mtha' 'khob kyi grong gi dpe sasungs pa dang phyogs mtshungs pa yin no/ /yang zhing bkod kyi mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' mang po de dag gis/ /mchod pa byas te dpag med 'od zhabs la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas nas 'di skad du/ / ngas rgyas zhing ni ngo mtshar mdzes zhes 'dzer//dga' zhing mgu ba'i sems ni gzhal yas kyis/ /de dag gis ni me tog snyim gtor nas/ /'dren pa de yi spyan sngar 'di skad du/ /bdag cag zhing yang 'di 'drar gyur zhes smras/ /zhes phyogs bcu nas lhabs pa'i byang sems rnams kyis zhing de'i snod bcud kyi 'byor ba'i khyad par phun sum tshogs pa mthong nas rang nyid kyang de ltar yongs su dag pa'i zhing sgrub pa la 'jug par gsungs te/tshul 'di ni 'jam dpal zhing bkod las kyang / shā ri'i bu gzhan yang 'di la byang sems sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par skye bar smon cing / de tshal khrims yongs sa dag par 'gyar ༄ ༄ ༄ba ste/ de tshul khrims yongs su das pas gang dang bang du smon pa de dang der skyes te/ de der skyes nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa la sems shing rtog ste/ nyan thos kyi phun sum tshobs 6

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigasamed bstan nyi'i sasung 'bum྾ — —she —྾4pa'am/ byang chub sems dpa'i phun sum tshogs pa'am/ longs spyod dang kun tu spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa mtshan mar 'dzin te/des de dag mtshan mar bzung nas gus pa dang bcas/ zhe sa dang bcas shing thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thad du song ste/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas ji ltar sbyang na sangs rgyas kyi zhing blu yon tan gyi rgyan bkod pa rgya chen po yongs su 'dzin ces kun tu zhus nas de bzhin gshegs pa des kyang de'i lhag pa'i bsam pa ma.o nas bang rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa rgya chen po yongs su 'grub par 'gyur ba'i gnas de dag ston cing yang dag par rab tu 'chad de/ des de thos nas de bzhin du nan tan byed pa'o/ /zhes shin tu bsal bar sasungs so/ /tshe phyi ma la zhing dag par skye ba'i sgo nas dgos pa de sgrub pa bzhin du/ tshe 'dir dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa dang /de dag gi rgyu tshosas rnams gzhan las rgya cher nyan pa dang / don de tshul bzhin goms par byed pa'i sgo nas kyang sgrub tu yod de/'di ni 'jam dpal zhing bkod kyi lung de'i gong nyid du gsungs shing / 'od dpag med kyi bkod pa'i mdo las/ dbe slong chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis ston pa 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po'i spyan sngar lo bye ba srid du de bzhin gshegs pa mang po'i zhing gi phun 6

bde ba can byi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6— ྾pa dang / dad pa rnams phyir zhing 'phel bar byed pa dang / sngon sanas dran pa'i mngon shes kyis rang nyid kyis 'dul ba'i rgyu sngon song can gyi sems can shes par byed cing / rang dang gzhan gyi sngon bde sdug ji lhar myong ba bstan nas skyo ba skyed pa dang / lha 'i mig gi mngon shes kyis gdul bya gar yod rtogs pa dang / lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes kyis de dag gis gsol ba 'debs pa'i sgra la sogs pa shes pa dang / pha rol sems shes kyis gdul bya'i bsam pa mchog dman sobs kyi khyad par shes nas de dag dang 'tshams par chos sto na nus pa la sogs pa'o/ /des na ma dag pa'i zhing gi 'gro ba la 'phral dang yun gyi bde bas phan 'dogs par 'dod na'ang dang por rang nyid bde ba can du skye ba blangs pa'i sgo nas zhing dag pa'i rgyal sras rnams dang skal ba mnyam par sgrub pa 'di nyid de'i thabs rmad du byung bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /der ma zad zhing der skyes pa'i rgyal sras rnams snga dro re rer sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir zhing rab 'byams su 'jug cing / de dag gi spyan sngar mang du thos pa'i mdzod tshad med pa bsags pa'i sgo nas rang gi dge tshogs gong 'phel du 'gro bar sasungs pa'ang mngon shes la brten nas byed pa yin no/ /'di 'dra ba'i don gyi 9

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbang la gzigs nas 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod mnyan pa'i phyir stong gsum me 'obs kyis gang ba brgal te 'gro dgros pa byung yang mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus kyi go cha gyon dgos par gsungs pa yin te/ 'di la nges pa brtan po btsal dkos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar don chen po dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye ba 'dzin pa de'ang sa mtshams dma' mo'i ring la mi 'grub na ni/ bde ba can gyi zhing du lam sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen nyung ba dang / mthun rkyen khyad par can bde blag rnyed pa'i dbang gis ma dab pa'i zhing du skyes pa rnams las lam gyi bgrod pa ches myur ba'i yon tan yang las dang po pa la 'ong sa med pas/ de'i ched du smon lam btab pa'ang lam mthon po'i ched du smon lam btab pa dang 'dra bar 'gyur la/ rtobs pa mthon po dang khyad par du byang sems mthon pos ni yon tan de gnyis dag pa'i zhing du skyes pa la mi ltos par yang bde blag tu kho nas 'thob par nus so/ /'on kyang 'di ni de ltar ma yin te/ gsung rab las so so'i skye bo lam mthon por ma slebs pa yang zhing der skye ba'i dbang du mdzad nas gsungs pa du ma zhig snang la/ tshul de rnam pa gzhan du 'dren pa'i lung rigs kyang med pa'i phyir dang /mdo'i don 'grel ba'i skyes bu chen po dag gis kyang de kho na'i 10

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6phyogs ltar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gsung rab las de ltar gsungs pa'ang yin te/ mdo sde dang rtog pa du mar rgyu 'di lta bu zhig bsgrub na bde ba can gyi zhing du skye ba 'dzin nus zhes pa ni gsal bar gsungs la/ de dag kyang las dang po pas sgrub tu mi nus par mi snang ba'i phyir dang / 'od mdo dang snying rje pad dkar las de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi mtshan thos nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bde ba can du skye bar bsngos na chos spang dang mtshams med byas pa ma gtogs zhing der skye bar bshad pa'ang rgyud tshod mthon por ma slebs bar du zhing der skye mi nus na de 'dra'i rnam dbye mdzad don med pa'i phyir dang / 'od mdor rgyal ba 'od dpag med rjes su dran par byed pa'i sems can rnams shi 'phos nas zhing der skye bar ma zad/ tshe 'dir yang sangs rgyas mthong bar ston pa na rmi lam du mthong ba dang / 'chi khar sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa mthong ba gnyis gsungs shing / de dag kyang gzhan rkyen de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam gyi dbang gis yin par gsungs kyi de las lhag pa ma bshad pa'ang chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin ma thob pa'i so skyes la dgongs par snang ba'i phyir dang / snying rje pad+ma dkar por/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med 'khor sgyur rtsibs kyi mu khyud du 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ dpal shākya thub pa mdun 11

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ྾ba ྾ba — ba ba ba —ba ba ྾4 ba ba ba ba ba —na 'don gyi gtso bor gyur pas byang chub kyi thugs dang por 'dzin du bstsal tshul bshad pa'i skabs su/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bram ze de bzhin gshegs pa 'di ni skye dgu tshe lo brgyad khri pa rnams kyi nang du 'jig rten du byung na de bzhin gshegs nga/sa ngan song thams cad zhi bar mdzad ma spyod de zhes pa nas/ sems can rnams rang rang gi dge ba dang mi dbe ba'i las rnams kyis 'phyan par gyur pas na 'di ltar sems can sacig tsam gyi sdub balngal yang rab tu zhi bar ma mdzad na bcom ldan 'das kyis btul ba'i sems can gang zhig yin/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku ni zhing du gyur pa 'ba' zhig tu zad kyi/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa'i sems can rnams sdug balngal las thar bar ni mi mdzad do zhes pa nas/ gal te gang bi tshe khoXbo bla na med pa'i byang chub la reg par 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing der kho bos sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing zhig 'thob par 'gyur ba lta na/ de'i tshe kho bo byang chub tu sems bskyed cing kho bos byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yang spyad par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / sngar drangs pa'i 'od mdo'i lung / sems can dadul mang nor mang bstsal bar ma gyur la/ /zhes sogs kyiXdon yang de dang 'dra ba'i 1 2

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ paradab ma param par ma zhes gsungs shing / 'phags pa ting 'dzin rgyal po dang / za ma tog bkod pa dang / sman mdo brgyad brgya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis sems can la gzigs shing kun tu ston pa dang / gtsug tor gdugs dkar dang / rnam rgyal ma'i rtob pa dang / tshe dang ye shes dpas tu med pa'i gzungs mdo sobs mdo sde dang rtog pa mang por bde ba can du skye ba'i phan yon gsungs pa dang / lhas bsam bsgul bar sems bskyed pa rnam pa bcus zhing der skye ba sgrub tshul dang /yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po'i mdor/ bdag ni 'gum pa'i dus bgyid tshe/ /phyin ci ma log yid kyis su/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med mthong nas/ 'di nas bde ba can du mchi/ /zhes dang / sdong po bkod pa las/ bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ /sgrib pa thams cad dag ni phyir bsal te/ /mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de mthong nas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro/ /zhes sogs zhing der skye ba 'dzin pa la smon lam 'debs tshul mang du bka' bstsal pa dang / de dag dang mthun par rgyud bla mar yang /des ni 'gro 'di mtha' yas 'od mnga' drang srong tshe dpag med mthong zhing / /zhes dang / bshags bstod las/ 'gro kun bde ba can du phyin par shog /ces sogs bstan bcos las kyang du 16

pod/ 6 rdo gruba'ajibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/r+yā྾ —྾4so sor go rim bzhin sbyar nas bshad pa bzhin no/ /phyi ma ni der skyes nas las nyon gyis skye ba gnyis pa brgyud mi dkos par mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyogs su skal ba nges pa tsam la de ltar btags sam snyam ste/ theg pa chen po'i gzhung spyi skad la byang sems skye ba gcig thogs zhes pa sa bcu ba pa kho na yin la/ mdo 'dir bde ba can gyi byang sems thams cad smon lam gyi dbang ma gtogs par bla med byang chub la skye ba gcig bis thogs pa sha stas tu gsungs kyang / der skyes pa'i byang sems la sa bcu ba pas khyab pa su yang mi 'dod pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang thub pa'i ༷ dbang po'i dgongs pa bdag 'dra ba rnams kyis shes par dka' bas da dung mkhas pa dag gis dpyad par mdzod cig /gsum pa la/ rgyu sgrub tshul spyir bstan pa dang / rtsa ba dad pa sbyang tshul bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ston pa 'od dpag med kyi tshogs gnyis kyi 'bras bu'i zhing dang / chos kyi longs spyod la dngos su spyod pa la ni rten gyi ngos nas kyang tshogs de'i cha gcig nges par sgrub dgos te/ gzhan du na de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje dang mthu la phyogs lhung med pas dag pa'i zhing grub pa tsam nas sems can thams cad der phyin par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /sngar drangs pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin ba/shegs pas 18

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6—྾྾4 ྾ ྾ ྾'gro ba spyi mthun gyi sdug bsngal sel ba'i mdzad pa ma dag pa'i zhing du mi ston par gsungs pa'ang / sems can dge rtsa chung zhing las sgrib shas che ba rnams kyi nang du mdzad pa de bsgrubs ma byung ba'i rgyu mtshan nyid kyis yin no/ /de la rgyu'i khyad par ci tsam zhig bsgrub na don de 'grub pa ni tshu rol mthong ba'i mngon sum dang / dngos stobs kyi tshad mas rtogs mi nus pas drang srong chen po'i lung kho na la brten nas shes dbos so/ /de yang 'od mdo las/ kun dga' bo sems can gang dag kha cig ni de bzhin gshegs pa de rnam pas yang dang yang du yid la byed pa dang / dbe ba'i rtsa ba mang po dpag tu med pa bskyed pa dang /byang chub tu sems yongs su bsngos te/ 'jig rten gyi khams der skye bar smon lam 'debs pa de dag 'chi ba'i dus nye bar gnas pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med de dge slong gi tshogs du mas yongs su bskor zhing mdun gyis bltas nas bzhugs par 'gyur te/ de dab gis bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med de mthong nas rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis shi 'phos te 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de nyid du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / kun dga' bo gang dag yang de bzhin gshegs pa de yang yid la byed cing dge ba'i rtsa ba 9

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i bsung 'bum/—ba ba ba ྾ ba ba ba —bar྾ma ba ma ba ———྾——4 —ba ba 4ba 4ba —mang po dpag tu med pa rgyun du bskyed la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing der sems yang dag par gtod pa de dag 'chi ba'i dus nye bar gnas pa na de bzhin gathegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dab/ par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa de'i kha dog dang /dbyibs dang chu zheng dang / zhabs 'bring ba dbe slong gi dge 'dun ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dag mdun du gnas par 'gyur te/ de dag de bzhin gshegs nga1 mthong bas rab tu dang ba la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin de dang / brjed pa med pa'i dran pas shi 'phos nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nyid du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung snga mas rgyu bzhi dang / phyi mas gsum gsungs so/ /bzhir gsungs pa'i skabs su byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dgos par gsungs pa ni/ de'i 'khor gyi gadzu bor skye ba'i dbang du mdzad pa ste/ zhing der skye ba bzung ba'i dgos pa sngar bshad pa rnams tshang bar 'thob pa la sems bskyed dgos zhes pa yin gyi/ der skye ba tsam la ni ma yin te/ de na nyan thos kyi 'khor yang mtha' yas pa yod par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang der skye ba tsam 'thob pa la'ang sems bskyed yod med gnyis la tshegs che chung gis 'thob pa'i khyad par ni yod par mngon no/ /zhing der bye brab tu skye ba'i rgyu ston thog bi/ sa bon lta 20

bde ba can gyi 'ing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6 ma du ni der skye bar smon lam 'debs pa yin la/ smon lam de rgyun ring la shugs drag pa yod na zhing der skye ba'ang de'i tshod tsam sla zhing / de 'a sa bzlog na dka' ba yin no/ /smon lam gyi ngo bo ni 'dun pa yin cing / de'i rtsa ba dad pas byed par gsungs pas/ smon lam de ltar 'ong ba ni/ rgyal ba'i dbang po 'od dpag med rnam pas yang dang yang du yid la byed pa'i dad pa sbyangs pa la ltos te/ de ni rgyu dang po yin no/ /'dir skyob pa 'od dpag med ni yid la bya rgyu dang / de yid la byed pa'i tshul ni rnam pas zhes pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyi rnam pa dang / chos ston pa dang / spyod lam gyi rnam pa dang / nyan thos dang byang sems kyi 'khor gyi rnam pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rnam pa dang / sngon gyi rgyu'i rnam pa sogs rnam pa du ma'i sgo nas sems par mdo gzhan dang gzhan las gsungs pa bzhin te/ 'di ni dad pa sgo du ma nas rgya pa'i ched do/ /de'ang lan re zung tsam ma yin par sgo ma dgos pa ni yang dang yang du zhes pas bstan te/'dis ni dad pa rgyun ring la brtan pa sgrub par byed do/ /bshad ma thag pa'i rnam pa de dag la mkhas na de dag gi sgo nas sangs rgyas yid la byed tshul med pas/ zhing bkod kyi mdo sde rin po che 'bad pa du mas nyan dgos par gsungs te/ stobs bcu mnga' 21

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6྾ —grangs 'di gzung ba dang / kun chub par bya ba dang / bcang bar bya ba dang / yi ger bri ba dang / bsgom pa'i phyir brtson 'grus rlabs po che chen po brtsam par bya'o/ /tha na ba bcig 'jo ba de sred du gzhan dag la brjod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing /de'i 'phro zhig na/ tha na yi ger bris te mchod pa byed pa de dag kyang bsod nams mang du skyed par 'gyur te/ zhes mchod pa byed pa yang gsungs so/ /dam pa lnga ma dag smon lam 'grub pa'i rgyur dbe rtsa skyed pa'i sgo rnams phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun du bsdu bar bzhed de/ sdong po bkod pa sosas kyi mdo'i rjes su 'azangs pa'o/ /'od mdor rgyu gnyis pa ston pa'i skabs su/ ji skad smros pa'i khyad par de 'dra ba yang dang yang du sbyar bas1/ lus 'di bor nas skye srid gzhan bar du mi brgyud par zhing der 'gro ba la dge rtsa shin tu shas che ba dgos par ba/sal la/de'ang tshul khrims dang ldan pa la 'ong gis/ rgyud nyes par spyod pas zil gyis mnan pa la ches cher dka' ba'i phyir/ mi dge bcu spong la ma mtha' byas pa'i tshul khrims la mang du gnas pa dang / sdig ltung byung yang bshags bsdam 'bad nas byed pa cig gal shin tu che bar snang ste/ bsdus don dang po'i thad du drangs pa'i 'jam dpal zhing bkod kyi lung gis kyang tshul khrims dang 23

bab ba cab ba nga nga 'a sa bad zungab pang ba tam / parang da ba / nga la brten nas bsam pa phun tshogs ji lta bu brnyes pa dang /bsam pa de thog mar bskyed dus nas ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i ltas rgya chen po 'jib rten du byung tshul rnam dpyod can gyi 'dun kyisar gleng bar 'os pa du ma zhig zhing bkod kyi mdo nyid steng nas shod par snang yang mang bas 'jigs nas ma spros so/ /snying rje pad+ma dkar po las ni/ bcom ldan 'das des sangs rgyas kyi zhing bzung ba'i sku tshe'ithog ma 'khor sgyur rtsibs kyi mu khyud du 'khrungs pa de yin par gsungs te/ des lo bdun du g.yeng ba thams cad spangs te nang du yang dag 'jog la gnas pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i snying po'i byin rlabs kyis phyogs bcu'i phyogs re rer yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams stong gi rdu' snyed rnams kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyan dag mthong bar gyur nas de dag la lta zhing gang du rang nyid 'tshang rgya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yon tan phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba'i smon lam gyi tshul la mkhas par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar smon lam rgya cher btab tshul rnams bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar smon pa tsam gyis chog shes par yang ma mdzad de/ ji ltar smon pa'i don de nyid bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir/dus kyi khyad par bskal pa mtha' yas par/ slob tshul gyi khyad 29

bde ba can gyi zhingalasabartsamasapa'i gtam / pod/ (brdo'i snying po'i ljon shing gi bar bdun dang / rin po che sna bdun las grub tshul la/ rtsa ba/ sdong po/ yal ga lo ma/ 'dab ma/me tog 'bras bu rnams so sor rin po che gzhan dang gzhan las grub pa dang / de bdun re re yang rin po che sna bdun ka las grub pa'i tshal gnyis gsungs shing / de'i snga ma la'ang dbye ༄ba bdun gsungs so/ /shing ljon pa de dag thams cad kyang 'jam zhing reg na bde la dri zhim pa ste/ de dag rlung gis bskyod pa na snyan cing yid du 'ong la mnyan pas chog mi shes pa'i sgra dbyangs das 'byung ngo / /shing so so'i kha dog so so dang / shing re re yang kha dog mi 'dra ba du mas phye ba de dab gis sa gzhi rnam par bkra ba yin no/ /chu'i rgyan la/ 'bab chu dang / rdzing bu'i rgyan gnyis las/ 'bab chu ni kha zheng dpag tshad gcig pa nas dpag tshad brgya sto nga pa'i bar du yod la/ zabs su ni thams cad kyang dpag tshad bcu gnyis par mtshungs te/ de dag tu ro' rtsed la 'jug pa'i sems can rnams kyi bsam pa'i dbang gis chu long bu nub tsam nas/ mid pa nub tsam gyi bar gyi ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du 'gyur ba ni ma gtogs so/ /chu klung de dag ni 'bab stegs bde ba/ 'dam rdzab med pa/ gser gyi bye ma brdal ba/dri rab tu zhim pa'i lha rdzas kyi sbos kyis bsgos pa/ lha'i me tog gi 3ku

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6—4 ྾ — ྾bsungs te/ zhing mdo chung ba las/ de dag nyin re zhing dus gsum du 'dus nas bgro ba byed cing rang rang gi skad dag gis smra ste/ de ltar smra ba na dbang po dang / stobs dang byang chub kyi yan lag gi sgra 'byung bar gsungs so/ /pad+ma'i rgyan ni/ rin po che sna bdun gyi pad+ma tshon sna tshogs can dpag tshad phyed kyi tshad tsam dang / dpag tshad gcig gi tshad tsam nas dpag tshad bcu'i tshad kyi bar du yod de/ de thams cad las kyang 'od zer bye ba stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug drub dang / 'od zer de rnams kyi rtse las kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs dpal dang bzi brjid kyis 'bar ba bye ba stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug drug 'byung ste/ de dka phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams bgrang ba las 'das pa dag tu gathe/gas nas sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /gnyis pa la'ang zas kyi yo byad ni/ sems can de dag khams kyi za ba rags pa'i zas ni mi za mod/ 'on kyang kha zas kyi bye brag ji lta bu 'dod kyang de nyid de'i mod la rnyed par 'gyur te/ rnyed ma thag tu lus tshim par gyur nas zas kyi 'dod pa de dang 'azal bar bshad do/ /spos la sogs pa'i yo byad ni/ spos dang / phreng ba dang / byugs pa dang phye ma dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan rnams kyang 'dod pa tsam gyi mod la rnyed de/37

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾ —྾྾de'ang yo byad de dang de'i khyad par ci 'dra zhig yid la 'thad pa de kho na bzhin du rnyed pa dang / des sangs rgyas kyi zhing de khyad par 'gyur ba de ltar zad mi shes par rnyed par 'gyur te/ yo byad de dab/ mngon par mi 'dod pa rnams la ni snang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gos dang rgyan gyi yo byad ni/ gos kha dog tha dad pa/rin thang gzhal du med pa dag kyang bsam ma thas tu snga ma ltar rnyed cing / lus la rang bgos par 'gyur ba dang / rgyan gyi bye zag ci lta bu 'dod pa yang skad cig de la rin po che'i shing ljon pa rnams las rnyed de/ de dag gis bdag nyid brgyan par shes pa'o/ /gnas khang gi rgyan ni/ gzhal med khang rin po che sna tshogs kyi ba gam brgya stong gis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i khri lha'i ras bcos du sna tshogs bting ba/ sngas khra bo bzhab pa dang ldan pa/ dbyibs dang / kha dog dang / chu zheng dang / mtshan ma ji lta bu 'dod pa de 'dra ba rnams sems can de dag gi mdun gyi sa gzhir rang 'byung ste/ de dag gzhal med khang de rnams su lha'i bu mo bdun stong bdun stong dang lhan cig 'dug nas rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /gnyis pa la/ rlung gi 'byor ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing der snga dro'i dus su phyogs bzhi nas rlung ldang ste/ de das gis rin po 38

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6 — che'i shing ljon pa kha dog bkra zhing lha'i sbos dri rab tu zhim pa sna tshogs kyis bsgos pa de das bskyod cing bskrul bas lha'i me tog rnam pa mang po'i dri yid du 'ong ba can/ blta na sbus la ka tsa lin da'i gos ltar reg na bde ba dag brul nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de mi 'greng bdun srid tsam du mnyam par khebs par byed de/de la rkang pa 'jog pa dang 'degs pa na sor bzhi tsam gyis dma' ba dang mtho bar 'gyur ro/ /spos dri sna tshogs kyis bsgos pa'i rlung de dag sems can de dag la phog na dge slong 'ayog pa la snyoms par zhugs pa lta bu'i bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /snga dro 'das ma thag me tog rnying pa de dag ma lus pa med par 'gyur te/ de'i 'og tu zhing de dben pa dang / nyams dga' dang / dag par 'gyur la de nas yang sngon bzhin du me tog 'grem pa'i rlung gsar pa dag ldang ste/ snga dro ji lta bar nyi ma'i gung dang / phyi dro dang / srod dang / nam gung dang / tho rangs kyang de bzhin no/ /char gyi 'byor ba ni/ dus dang dus su lha'i spos chu'i sprin gyi char dang / lha'i me tog kha dog thams cad dang ldan pa dag dang / lha'i rin po che sna bdun dang / lha'i tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / lha'i gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gyi char mngon par 'bab pa dang / lha'i bla re dag dang / lha'i rin — 39

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6pa'i gnas/ sku dang 'od kyi khyad par/ mdzad pa'i gtso bo 'jug tshul/ sku tshe phun sum tshogs pa/ snyan grags rgya che ba'i yon tan dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ zhing de'i sa gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na ston pa 'od dpag med kyi byang chub kyi shing yod de/de'i ming ni rin po che'i pad+mo rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba dang /de'i drung na pad+ma'i gdan yod pa'i ming ni/ dag cing bzang la bkra ba'i 'od zer can zhes bya ba yin par 'chi med rnga sgra las bshad cing / tshad ni dkon brtsegs las byang chub kyi shing 'phang dang rgya tshad dpag tshad stong drug brgya bar mnyam pa dang / rtsa ba'i sbom dang khru na dpag tshad lnga brgya yod par bshad la/ snying rje pad dkar las dpag tshad khrir gsungs te/ pad+ma'i gdan yang de dang 'tshams pa yin no/ /dkon brtsegs las tshad de ltar gsungs pa de'ang byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba chung shos yan chad kyis mthong tshod thun mong ba'i dbang du mdzad pa yin gyi/ khyab mtha' bzung ba min pa mdo rang gi chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi smon lam bstan pa'i thad nas shes shing / spyir de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gi byang chub kyi shing la yang rgya tshad mi 'dra ba du ma 'ong ba mi 'gal ba ni 'jug pa rtsa 'grel dang /dus 'khor 'grel chen sogs las rgya cher bshad pa'i rigs pas 43

bde ba can byi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6thugs ni rgya mtsho bzhin/ /des kyang ston la khengs pa mi mnga' ste/ /tha ba zhe sdang spangs nas pha mthar sgrol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar zhib tu bsam par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ba ni/ lus can rgud pa sna tshogs kyis rgyun du gtse ba rnams la thugs rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur nas/ rgad pa de las skyob pa'i sgo bla na med pa rang gis gang zhig brnyes pa'i rtogs pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi de nyid so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams par bgo bsha' mdzad pa'i ched du yin la/ de ltar mdzad pa'ang lung gi chos bstan pa la nges par rag las par gzigs nas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten rnams yan lag drug cu rtsa bzhi dang ldan pa'i legs par bshad pa'i dbyangs kyi bdud rtsis rgyun mi 'chad du tshim par mdzad de/ 'di ltar gdul bya theg dman gyi rigs can rnams la ni thob bya thar ba tsam dang / thob byed rten bzhi nges 'byung gi bsam pa dang / brten pa tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /shes rab kyi bslab pa mdor bsdus pa las brtsams te chos ston cing / theg pa mchog gi rigs can rnams la ni thob bya bla na med pa'i byang chub dang / thob byed byang chub kyi sems rin po che snying rje chen po'i rtsa ba can gyi bsam pa dang / des drangs pa'i sbyor ba 47

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ 'grub ste/ lhag chad med par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / dkon brtsegs las kyang / kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can na mi dge ba'i ming yang med do/ /sgrib pa'i sgra yang med do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa la lnga brgya phrag bcu'i rnam dbye byas pa lta bu'i bstan pa dwangs snyigs kyi rim pa'ang med pa 'dra'o/ /bstan pa gnas pa'i yun tshad ni/ bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gnyis kyi bye ma snyed du 'ga' zhig bzhed de/ snying rje pad dkar las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying pos rje btsun spyan ras gzigs byang chub mchog tu lung bstan pa'i thad na/ rigs kyi bu khyod ni 'od dpag med yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas bskal pa grangs med pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed gnyis pa lus pa na 'tshang rgya bar 'gyar te/ zhes gsungs pa 'di la bsam par snang yang ༄mdo de'i don de ltar 'chad rgyu yin min dpyad dgos so/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las ni/ rgyal ba de mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhir dam pa'i chos gnas par gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa de'i skru che'i tshad ni bskal pa 'di snyed dang / bskal pa brgya phrag 'di snyed nas/ bskal pa 60

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ ngo da/ 6ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag 'di snyed cig tu bzhugs so zhes pa'i bar du brtsi tshul rgya che chung ji lta bu'i sgo nas gzhal kyang mtha' mi rtosas par 'od mdo las gsungs shing / sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdor/ de'i sku che'i tshad kyi mtha' bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong bi/ bar du bshad kyang rtogs par sla ba ma yin zhes brtsi ba'i yun tshad kyi sgo nas gsungs te/ mdor na dpag tu med pa yin no/ /de'i phyir rgyal ba'i dbang po de'i mtshan yang tshe dpag med ces bya'o/ /zhing der byang chub brnyes pa'i mdzad pa bstan nas da lta yun ji tsam 'das pa ni/ mi mjid kyi 'jig rten 'di ba'i lugs kyi bskal pa bcu lon par 'od mdo las sasungs te/ phal chen che'i le'ur mi mjed kyi zhing gi bskal pa gcig gi yun tshad de bde ba can gyi nyin zhag gcig tu byed par gsungs pas/ zhing de pa rnams kyi ngor ni nyin zhag bcu las ma song bar gsal te/ dbyar gyi lang tsho thog ma la babs pa'i dga' ba lta bu'i tshod du snang ngo / /ston pa'i sku tshe dpag tu med pa 'di ni zhing gi 'byor ba ches mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ zhing rab 'byams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyun mi 'chad par 'du ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul sngon ma mthong ba mthong ba dang / byang sems lung ston pa la sogs pa'i 5

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/r+yā ྾྾྾ 4 4khyad par 'phags chos su sgom par ni mi bya ste/ de lhar byed pa ni dam pa rnams kyi mdun sar bzhad ba/da kyi phyir du rang gis rang la tho 'tshams pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das de'i nyan thos kyi 'khor ni yongs su dag cing grangs mang bas 'phabs te/ 'di ltar/ de na so skye'i nyan thos khyem gyi yongs su bzung ba la chags nas mngon par mi 'byung ba ni ye med de/ nga yir bya ba med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su skye ba'i phyir te/ sngar bshad zin to/ /thub pa'i bcas mtshams 'dral bar byed pa yang med de/ snyigs ma med pa'i zhing gi nyan thos yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni dkon brtsegs kyi drug par mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing la sbyar nas gsungs pa rigs pa 'dra'o/ /brtson 'grus chung bas lam sgrub tu mi nus pa yang med de/ thams cad yang dag pa nyid la nges par sasungs pa'i phyir ro//zhing de'i byang sems kyi 'khor rnams skye ba gcig thosas su gsungs pa'i rigs pas/ nyan thos la yang lan bdun pa dang rigs nas rigs skye sogs med dam brtag go /nyan thos kyi dge 'dun yod kyang rigs skye sosas kyi rnam gzhag byar med pa mi 'gal ba ni mi 'khrugs pa'i 'khor gyi nyan thos thams cad mthong chos zhir gsungs pa bzhin no/ /nyan thos de das gi grangs ni/5‘

bde ba can byi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6stong gsum gyi sems can thams cad rang sangs rgyas sha stag tu gyur pas bskal ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi bar du bgrangs kyang mtha' mi rnyed par gsungs te/ de'ang gcig gis gang bgrang ba de gnyis pas ma bgrang / gnyis pas gang bgrang ba de gsum pas ma bgrang ba de 'dra ba'i tshul gyis bgrang ba la dgongs so/ /der ma zad 'phags pa mo 'gal gyi bu chen pos stong gsum na skar ma'i gzugs ji snyed yod pa thams cad nyin zhag gcis gis bgrang bar nus te/ de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong snyed kyis lo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du las gzhan mi byed par bcom ldan 'das de'i nyan thos 'dus pa dang po gcig pu bgrangs kyang bye ba brgya'i cha tsam yang rtsis kyis mi chod par gsungs so/ /de dag thams cad kyang 'od 'dom gang ba dang ldan pa sha stag ste/ dul ba dang nye bar zhi ba'i dpal gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dgod pa bzhin du byed do/ /gsum pa la byang sems 'khor gyi gtso bo dang / rgyal sras kyi 'khor spyir bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ston pa 'od dpag med las rgyal tshab kyi cod pan blangs pa dpal spyan ras sazigs dbang phyug dang / mthu chen thob gnyis te/ bo rim bzhin du sems can rnams la snying rje chen po'i lta stangs sbyangs pa 66

nga nga/ nga nga nga rdo grub 'ji~Xng med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dang / rlabs po che'i thugs stobs mnga' ba'i cha nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i snying pos mtshan de lhar btasas ngar snying rje pad dkar las so/ /de gnyis kyi sku'i 'od kyis ni 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de ma lus par bkang ste gnas la/ byang sems kyi 'khor gang dag de gnyis las zhag bdun du 'dri ba'i lan nyan pa de dag de'i mod kho nar sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de ni skyes ba dam pa 'di ༄gnyis las sgyu ma lta bu'iting nge 'dzin thob pa'i rgyal sras kyi tshogs kyis gang bar mdo gzhan las gsungs so/ /de'i phyir de dag ni mnyam pa med pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa ste/ rgyal ba'i dbang po 'od dpag med bzhugs pa dang yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i gnas skabs kun tu dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa rnams kyi nang na rab mchob tu bsngags pa yin no//gnyis pa ni/ zhing de'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyi grangs ni thams cad macan pa'i ye shes ma gtogs pa gzhan sus kyang bgrang ba'i rngo mi thogs par snying rje pad dkar las gsungs shing / zhing bkod kyi mdo las/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig tu brtsis kyang grangs kyi mtha' mi mngon pa de snyed kyi de bzhin 66

bab ba can byung da nga ba sa babyungab ba pad ba tam / da ba / (ba gshegs pa rnams kyi drung nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dag bde ba can du skye ba 'dzin par 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i drung nas kyang byang sems bye ba phrag du ma 'gro bar gsungs so/ /de ni zhing gzhan nas shi 'phos te 'gro ba'i dbang du mdzad la/ mngon shes kyi mthu thob pa'i rgyal sras chen po rnams zhing dag pa'i 'byor ba gzigs pa dang / chos kyi dga' ston la rtse ba'i phyir rdzu 'phrul gyis 'du ba'i grangs ni de bas kyang ches mang ste/ ji ltar bdag cag gi ston pas blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa'i mdo gsungs pa na gling bzhi ba'i 'jig rten 'di na rdzu 'phrul gyis chos nyan du lha gas pa'i byang sems kho nas gang bar ma gyur pa'i sa phyogs 'khar ba 'dzugs sa tsam yang med par gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de la zhing der skyes pa'i byang sems rnams kyi lus kyi bongs tshod ni dpag tshad stong yin par snying rje pad dkar las te/thams cad kyang 'od dpag tshad bye ba brgya stong pa 'ba' zhig tu zhing bkod kyi mdo las gsangs so/ /sngon the tshom zos pa'i nyes ༄pas bsgribs pa rnams ma gtogs pa thams cad rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus rnam par rtse ba kho na yin te/ de dab snga dro re rer sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag mang por de bzhin gshegs 67

da ba / pa rje da ba ba da ba ba ma ba brta ba ba da ba da nga ba pa /pa rnams la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur byed du 'gro ste/ nam mkha' ltar yangs shing tshad med pa'i mchod pa/ 'jig rten thams cad ngo mtshar bar byed pa dab gis bsnyi stangs byed do/ /der de bzhin gshesas pa de rnams so so nas sngon gyi smon lam dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang / chos bshad pa'i rnam grangs dang / mdzad pa'i sgo sna tshogs kyis khams dbang mos pa mi 'dra ba'i sems can ji ltar 'dul ba'i tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams mthong zhing legs par khong du chud nas zang zing med pa'i dga' ba rgya che zhing gya nom pa ches rmad du byung ba thob ste/ slarayang snga dro de nyid la rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing bde ba can nyid du phyin par 'gyur ro/ /'di'i thad kyi 'od mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med de'i sngon gyi smon lam gyi byin gyis rlabs kyis yongs su zin pa dang / sngon chos mnyan pa byin pa dang /sngon gyi rgyal ba la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang / sngon gyi smon lam 'byor zhing yongs su rdzogs pa dang / mi nyung ba dang / shin tu rnam par phye ba dang / shin tu bsgoms pas smon lam btab pa 'grub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ zhing de'i byang sems kyi 'khor phal cher de lta ba'i mtha ma thob pa med pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa ra da de'i sngon smon dang dge ba'i rtsa ba'i mthu yin zhes ston par mngon 68

sgyu bad/ ( da shā nga pa jigab ba da ba nga da zung pa mi ba da nga ba da che /pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad pa spyod pa'i sems dang /sems kyi rgyud sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la blo rab tu zhugs pa/ shes rab rgya mtsho chen po dang mnyam pa/ blo ri rab dang mtshungs pa/yon tan du ma bsags pa/ zhes pa nas/ 'jig rten thams cad kyis mi kos pa'i phyir pad+ma dang 'dra ba/ chos dang chos ma yin pa mngon par sgrog pas dus kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i 'brug chen po dang mtshungs pa/ chos kyi chu'i char mngon par 'bebs pas char pa chen po dang 'dra ba/ tshogs chen po zil gyis gnon pas khyu mchos dang mtshungs pa/ sems shin tu mchog tu dul bas glang po che chen po dang 'dra ba/ shin tu dul bas rta cang shes bzang po dang mtshungs pa/ rtsal dang mi 'jibs pas skrag pa med pa'i phyir ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge dang 'dra ba/ sems can thams cad yongs su skyob pas shing gi rgyal po n+ya gro dha dang mtshangs pa phas ༄kyi rgol ba thams cad kyis mi g.yo bas ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang 'dra ba/ byams pa tshad med pa bsgom pas nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/ dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi dbang du bya ba'i sngon du 'gro bas tshangs pa chen po dang 'dra ba/ gnas su gsog pa med pas bya dang mtshungs pa/ phas kyi rgol ba thams cad rnam par 'joms pas bya'i rgyal po nam mkha' lding dang 'dra ba/ 'byung 60

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾ gis 'od mdzad 'jig rten mgon/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mthong nas ni/ /gus dang bcas pas chos thos pa/ /de dag dga' ba dam pa 'thob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i legs tshogs mtha' dag zlaXb yar gyi ngo bzhin du rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye ba 'dzin pa'i man ngag legs par bshad zin to/ /thub pa'i legs bshad nor bu'i gter kha dang / /zhing mchog bgrod pa'i lam srang ma 'khrugs pa/ /lhan cig dus mtha'i mun rum stug por yang / /'gro 'dis gsal por mthong ba bdas/ gis byas/ /tshul 'dir mdo don ji bzhin min bshad pa'i//nongs pa gang mchis rgyal la snying nas 'chags/ /dbe bas lus can sdug bsngal chu gter las/ /'thon te 'od dpag med kyi gnas bgrod shog /bdag kyang mgo la sangs rgyas cod pan thogs/ /yid ni rnal 'byor dam pa'i bdud rtsis gang / /rab 'byams zhing du 'gro la mchog sbyin phyir/ /thogs med rgyu ba spyan ras gzigs 'drar shog /bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam dbe ba'i lo thog spel byed dbyar skyes sprin chen glal ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'dini/byang chub shing gi bshad pa yan chad gser 'phyang gi lor bris kyang / 'phra rnams snyoms 6 2

bde ba can gyi zhingaXlas brtsams pa'iXgatam/ pod/ 6las kyi ngang la yun ring por lus pa las/ slar rang lo so bdun pa 'phar ba'i lo'i ston ka bkra shis kyi dpal dang ldan pa'i tshes la yongasaXsu rdzogs par byas te/ theg pa mchog gi gsung rab la dad pa cung zad skyes pa'i skal bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas/ bkra legs mdangs chen gyi ri bo'i ngos/ nags tshal dga' baXcan gyi mthongs/ dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba 'dis kyang sems can rnams kyi rgyud la 'od dpag med kyi smon lam ma lus pa bde blag tu smin par gyur cig /63

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mab me tog pod/ 6— ྾ ྾྾ sbu dang zhing gi rnam rol mtha' yas te/ /de ltar chos dbyings rgya mapho zhing rnams su/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi dkyil 'khor mu mtha' med/ /ye shes sgyu ma mkha' ltar rab zhi yang / /rgya chen smon lam thugs rje dam pa'i mthu/ /rim dang rim min sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/ /sems can khams la chu zla bzhin du snang / /de 'dra'i yon tan mchog tshogs mgon po rnams/ /mnyam pa'i chos nyid gcig tu dgyes rol bas/ /mkhas pa gang gis rnam 'dren gcig mchod pa/ /des ni thub chen kun la bya ba byas/ /de ltar rgyal ba de dag rjes dran zhing / /de snyed lus rnams rgya mtshor byin brlabs te/ /bsngags 'os rgyal kun dgyes pa'i mchod sprin gyis//bzang po spyod pa'i rnam thar rgyas par bgyi/ /zhes brjod cing don yid la dran par bya'o/ /de nas yan lag bdun pa'i dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rdul bral bsod nams brgya ba'i ye shes sku/ /phra rags phung po'i bdud las rnam grol zhing / /thub dka' sred med bu yi shugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje'i skru mchog brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yan lag rgya mtsho tshangs pa rnga sgra'i dbyangs/ /zil gyis mi non sgra kun rjes 'jug cing / /gsung gi gdangs rer chos phung kun rdzogs pa'i/ /yon tan dpag med dbyangs la phyab 'tshal lo/ /zhi ba'i chos nyid rnam thar sgo gsum dbyings/ /shes dang shes bya ro mnyam 66

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ tshul gzigs kyang / /ji snyed chos kun mkhyen pa'i skabs mnga' ba//stobs bcu'i rgyal thabs gnon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag dang ma dag gdul bya'i zhing rnams su/ /mtshan dang sku yi rnam 'gyur tha dad kyang / /sems can gdul ba'i dbang du tshul gcig pa/ /zla med gzhan phan brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba kun gyi sras rnams dang / /rang rgyal slob ma dul ba'i dge 'dun tshos/sa/ /phyag 'os yon tan du mas mngon 'phags pa/ /de dag kun la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa mchod pa ni skabs 'dir sa bcad bco lngar bye ste rim bzhin/ 'chi ba med pa'i lam nas lding ba yi/ /sna tshogs mdzes sprin pad+mo'i sbubs 'gying ba/ /dag byed bum bzang 'dzin pa'i me na kas/ /sangs rgyas bsod nams phung por sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya bhā ye hūṃ/oṃ kā ya bi shā dha na ye swā hā/ badz+ra wasta hūṃ/ lha rdzas yid bzhin drwa ba'i pad+mo mchog /'od zer me tog sprin gyi char 'bebs pas/ /ma lus zhing rnams rgya mtsho'i khron 'geng ba/ /bsod nams sprin gyi rol mor cir yang 'jo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wa ra paṣ+pe ༄pu tsa me gha sa myu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ rgya che dpag bsam spos kyi ljon pa mchog /kun nas dga' ba rgya mtsho'i dri bsung can/ /spos rdul phye ma sna tshogs sprin 'phro ba/ /dpal ldan ngo mtshar 66

pod/ 6 — rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'gum/྾ 4྾ ྾྾ba 4྾rgyas gtsug tor mdzes pa'i ngo mtshar rdzogs/ /bi tā ne+e / sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra ba/ /rnam mang lha rdzas dar gyi lda ldi can/ /phyobs bcu zhing kun bsgreng ba'i rgyal mtshan sprin/ /chos dbyings mu mtha' med par 'byams su klas/ /rnya dza༅/ lha rdzas reg na bde ba'i gos mchog sprin/ /gzi ldan sgron me'i tshogs ltar rab 'bar ba/ /'dres dang ma 'dres rgya mapho kha dob can/ /mtshan dpe sgyu ma mchog gi 'khor lor sim/ /wasta /gdu bu cod pan rna kor phreng ba sogs/ /sna tshogs nor bu bkod pa'i rgyan mang po/ /rin chen me tog rgya mapho char 'bebs shing //kun bzang mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor rab snang byed/ /a lo ka ra /rnam mang dpag bsam ljon pa'i dga' tshal dang / /yid 'ong zla ba nor bu'i brag skyibs can/ /dka' thub gnas rnams rgya mtsho rnam phye ba/ /bsam gtan bde ba'i dga' ston sbyin pa'i dpyid/ /ba na ṣa dzā / gzhal med khang brtsegs rin chen drwa ba can/ /glu gar sil snyan bstod dbyangs char 'bebs shing / /mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs sprin 'phro ba/ /kun bzang smon lam rgya mapho rol mor 'bar/ /pra sā da / rlabs chen bsod nams sprin gyi 'jug pa can/ /srid zhi'i dge mtshan 'khyel ba'i dum pa bzang bsam yas 'dod dgu'i gru char rnam 'bebs pa/ /'og min sprul 68

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mapho me tog pod/ 6྾྾ — —྾—྾ba'i zhing kun bkrag pa'i rgyan/ /ni dhi kā la sha / de nas mchod pa'i mjug bsdu ba ni/ mdor na bskal mang rgya mapho 'khor lo can/ /dus gsum rgya mtsho blo yis mi thug par/ /byung dang 'byung 'gyur mchod sprin rgya mtsho kun/ /ma lus yongs rdzogs rnam thar rgya mapho rgyan/ /zhing rnams thams cad 'gro 'ong med pa'i dbyings//rten cing 'brel 'byung zab mo'i tshul 'jug pas/ /bde gshegs mchod pa'i 'dun khang re rer yang / /zhing rnams rgya mtsho mig 'phrul bzhin du snang / /lus rnams thams cad sgyu ma sprul pa'i rgyan/ /bri dang bang ba med pa'i tshul 'jug pas/ /gtsug gi bla ma rim gro'i gangs chen mtsho/ /ye shes me tos rgyal la lhag par mos /rdul rnams thams cad rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /snang dang stong pa mnyam pa'i tshul 'jug pas/ /sgyu ma'i rdul rer nam mkha' rgyas 'gengs pa'i/ mchod sprin bkod pa'i rgya mtsho bsam mi khyab//sgrib bral ma.o pa gnyis ldan ye shes che/ /dmigs med byams pa'i stobs mchog mtha' yas pas/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /phun tshogs ris dang brtse ba'i dga' ston ༅/ /bi shā / da ni yan lag lhag ma lnga'i nang tshan phung posasum gyi tshigs su bcad pa bco lngar phye ba las dang po bshags pa ni/ thal mo sbyar te/ gang sngon tshe yi rgyud rnams rgya mtsho ru/ /kun rmongs nyes pa'i 'ching ba brtan 69

da ba / ( da da ba pa ba ba sa ba nga ba da na 'i da ba da nga pa da na /pa gyur pas/ /sdig to'i nongs pa mi bzad sa/nga bgyis pa/ /de kun snying nas 'alhod pa mthol zhing 'chags/ /gang zhig/ spang na 'dren pa kun spong zhing / /bsten na byang chen lag rtser sbyin pa yi//mkhas pa'i bshes gnyen yon tan mig gcig pu/ /tshul bzhin mnyes par ma bgyis mthol zhing 'chags/ /bstan pa kun gyi nang nas snying po mchog /byang chub spyod pa rgya mtsho'i lam snang ba/ /don zab shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod chos/ /spangs pa'i nyes spyod che rnams mthol zhing 'chags/ /thub rnams bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid gsungs te/ /sems can zhing rnams rgyal ba ltar bsngags na//bdag gis de dag yongs 'dzin ma bgyis shing / /'khrugs dang gdung ba bskyed rnams mthol zhing 'chasas/ /brtan pa rnams kyi pha rol phyin drug dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan snang rnam bzhi sogs/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho la/ /sgrib par gyar ༄ba'i las kun snying nas 'chags/ /gnyis pa yi rang ni/ ngan 'gro log par nges pa'i phung po rnams/ /spangs pa'i mtho ris ngal 'tsho la sbyor ba/ /chos dkar dge ba'i brtul zhugs mngon spyod pa'i/ /legs smon tshul khrims rgya mtshor rjes yi rang 'phasas pa'i bden pa bzhi yi 'jug ldog la/ /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab kyis/ /srid las rnam grol zhi ba mchog sgrub pa'i/ /70

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6nges 'byin thar lam rgya mtshor rjes yi rang / /bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas chos rtogs nas/ /sems can rgya mtsho rnam par dgrol slad du/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rab gsog pa'i/ /theg mchog brtul zhugs rgya mtshor rjes yi rang / /grangs med rgyal la blta dang chos nyan sogs/ /'phags pa'i lam gyi khyad par du ma yis/ /sgrib pa med pa'i gnas rab snang byed pa/ /sa bcu'i yongs sbyong rgya mtshor rjes yi rang / /bdag don dag pa gnyis ldan sa brnyes nas/ /'bad rtsol spros pa'i 'jug ldang nyer zhi ba'i/ /gzhan phan srid pa ji srid mi 'argong ba/ /sangs rgyas spyod pa'i rgya mtshor rjes yi rang / /gsum pa bslul zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/sang yang phyogs bcu'i zhing mang rgya mtsho ru/ /'jig rten sgron ma basbul ba'i sar gzhes pa/ /de dag rnams la bdud rtsi'i sgo dbye zhing / /chos rnga'i sgra chen 'byin pa'i bskrul ma 'debs/ /shing rgyal drung na rigs gsum mngon mdzad de/ /mi smra'i brtul zhugs la dgyes mgon po rnams/ /lha ra bcas 'jig rten kun la sman slad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med bskor bar bskul/ /bdag rtog mtshan ma'i spros pa rab gcod cing / /yang dag bden don rtogs pa'i snang ba can/ /rmad byung 'phags lam rgya mtsho'i chos 'khor che/ /rigs gsum mos pa'i nam mkhar rab snang mdzod/ /71

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6nga gcig rnam g.yeng med pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /lus sems las su rung ba'i mchog grub ste/ /'dod nyon 'ching ba ngang gis zhi bar shog /nyes kun rtsa ba 'gog pa'i thabs kyi mchog /stong dang rten 'byung zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas/ /sgrib pa lnga las 'das pa'i lhag mthong gi /rtogs pa'i nyi ma nang nas 'char gyur cig /chos la chos mig rdul bral rab skyes nas/ /byang chub don dam zab mo'i sems ldan zhing / /grangs med 'bum phrag bcu yi smon lam gyis/ /'phags pa'i sa nas sa mtho gnon gyur cig /de mthus rgyal ba'i sras kyi ting 'dzin mdzod/ /gzungs stobs mngon par shes dang yang dag rig /bsam yas brjod du med pa'i rnam par thar/ /grub nas lam gyi bgrod pa rdzogs gyur cig /mthar thug bla na med pa'i ye shes sgu/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs rgya mtsho'i mdzod brnyes te/ /rdzogs smin sbyang gsum mthar phyin bden pa yis/ /don gnyis 'dod dgu yid bzhin 'byor gyur cig /ces 'dun pa rtse gcig tu bya'o/ /'di ni theg pa chen po'i mdo sde phal po che'i snying po bsdus pa yin pas don ji lha ba bzhin du bsam na rgyal ba'i sras kyi lam mtha' dag la nyams len byas par 'gro zhing gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi legs tshogs tshad med pa'i sangs chen mtshor 'gyur pa'i tshul la bsams te skal bzang rnams kyis yi dam du bya bar rikas so/ /zhes pa'ang gzhonanu 'jigs med bstan rgyam du 'bod pa'i ban de stoms las pas rang lo nyer gcig pa sa skyong gi lo khrum stod zla ba'i yar tshes zla ba gro7 3

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga bzhin gyi dga' ma dang rtse zhing drang srong ri k+ṣa 'char ba'i tshe bris shing spel ba ma d+ma lo/gang zag gzu bor gnas shing mdo sde mthong ba'i rnam dpyod canaXkyis dpyad na tshigs su bcad pa re re la'ang mkhas pa dga' ba bskyed pa'i tshul mang po zhig yod pa ra shes par byis shib /sarba dā ka lha shā bha ba tu/ /༄ / /'jam pa'i rdo rje la na mo/ mchod sprin me tog rab 'byung gi 'phyong zur du bkol ba ni/ dang po kanas khangaXbyi dor gyi tshe/ sems kyi rnyogs pa bgrungs shing lha rnams dga'/ /mdzes pa'i lang tsho rab 'thob mtho ris skye/ /rdul bral zhi ba'i mchog kyang 'dis sbyin te/ /las 'dir ngal ba bsten rnams don yod yin/ /zhes brjod de dkon mchog bla mar bya ba'i 'du shes bskyed nas bsang shing gi dud pas rdu' mnan te phyag dar dngos la 'jug /de'i 'og tu spos chab dri zhim pos brlan la me tob si' ma bkram ste gud du mchod pa'iXstegs bang rim can bla bre dang 'phan gdusas sogs kyis mdzes par dkonaXmachog gi rten bzhugs su gsol zhing mtha' bskoraXdu sgos dang mar me sogs mchod pa'i yo byad rgya cher bstar/ rang nyid stan bde ba la spyod lam zhi bas 'khod de/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lta bus skyabs sems bya/ tshosas zhing gsal gdab/phyag 'tshal gyi tshig shā lo ka lnga po gang nus bskyar zhing phyab bya/ mchod pa'i sprin ༷gzungs dang rten 'brel snying pos gnas yo byin gyis brlabs te rol mo 'akrol/ khrus gsol kyi tshe bzed zhal du zhabs bsil spreng zhing shabha'i skabs 'a sogs par rol mo spel bas kyang mchod/ mchod paXgrangs gsog lha bur maṇ+ḍal kho nas don 'grub pas don bsdus rjes su tshom bu so bdun ma 'di nyid 'bul bar bya ste/ blog maraXmaṇ+ḍal gyi gzhi byi dor legasaXpar bya zhingaXb byung gi dri lngas byugs bzhin du/ oṃ badz+ra dhu mi ā hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas me tog gi tshom bu zhig dkyil 'khor gyi dadus su bzhag ste/ oṃ badz+ra re khā+e ā hūṃ/ zhes byin byis brlabs la/ dbyig mchog brgya las legs bris sa yi gzhir/ /ri rab rin chen lhun po lus 74

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6'phags gling / /dzam bu na rā'i gling dang ba lang spyod/ /sgra mi snyan gling bzhi yis rab brgyan pa/ /lus dang lus 'phags rnga yab rnga yab gzhan/ /g.yo ldan lam mchog 'gro dang sgra mi snyan/ /sgra mi snyan zla zhes bya'i nye gling bcas/ /rin chen ri bo dpag bsam ljon pa'i phreng / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang ma rmos lo tog tshal//gser sbyangs 'khor lo dri med nor bu'i mchog /bde sbyin bud med khyim bdag lha mig grub/ /cang shes glang po shugs 'chang dul ba'i rta/ /dmag mi rin chen 'dod 'byung gter gyi bum/ /phas rgol zil gnon ral gri pags pa 'jam/ /rab dga'i nags tshal yid rjes 'gro ba'i gos/ /mthu ldan mchil lham gzhal med khang ba bzang / /bde ba'i mal stan mtshan ma bzang po'i dung / /nyi ma zla ba nor bu'i gdugs mchog dang / /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan sogs/ /lha mi'i 'byor tshogs yid bzhin sprin phung can/ /'dzad pa'i pha mtha' yong ye mi dmigs pa/ /lhag par mos so ting 'dzin yid kyi 'phrul/ /thukas rjes bzhes shig mgon po sras dang bcas/ /bzhes nas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /i rda gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal kai nid+ma ta ya mi/ zhesaza bu rnams gsal zhing mdzes par bkod la phul/ spro ba bskyed pa'i yan lag tu phan yon gyi tshigs su bcad pa ni za ma tog lta du'i gtam dang sems rin po che rnam par sbyang 76

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾ baba'i phrin yig sogs nas 'byung ba rnams don la khyad mi snang zhing / de nyid mthong ba'i lam las lhag po gcig kyang gsungs pas 'dir de rnams bsdom na/ ba yi lci ba zur bcas sbyin pa yang dag byi dor s+dzawī khrims dang / /srog chags phra mo'ang bsal ba bzod pa bya ba nyer gnas brtson 'grus te/ /skad cig de'i sems rtse gcika bsam gtan ri mo mdzes 'bar shes rab nyid/ /thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal bgyis pas pha rol phyin drug 'di dag thob 'gyur la/ /kha dog gser du 'gyur zhing nad kun las ni rnam par grol bar 'gyur/ /lha dang mi las ches lhag 'gyur dang zla ba lha bur mdzes pa 'bar /'byor ldanaXrgyal rigs gser gyi tshogs mang bde gshegs mchod pa'i khyim du skye/ /rdul dang thal ba shin tu rnam spangs sangs rgyas zhing mang 'dzin par 'akyur/ /'es pa'i rkang pa phyi ma gnyis la 'phri bsnon cung zad bgyis pa tsam ma gtogs gzhan rnams slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen gyi 'jam dpal mchod chog nas byung ba'i tshig yin la/'di dag maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i rjes su klog par dze ta ris bshad cing / 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir sngon du btang yang mi 'gal lo/ /gzhan yang rgyas par skyed na yan lag bdun po re re nas gzhung tshig dang bzang po spyod pa'i tshigasaXbacad spel mar bya bas mtshon te shes nus so/ /zhes snga sor rang lo nyer gcig par mchod sazhung dkyus ma tsam bris pa las slar yang kha skong maṇ+ḍal gyi 'phyong 'di me phag zla 3pa'i nyer gsum la spel ba'o// //༄/ /bde ba can du skye ba 'dzin pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa zhing mchog bgrod pa'i bde lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru/ bde chen zhing chog mdor bsdus byed na/ bde bar kashegs pa'i snang brnyan dang 'od mdo'i glegs bam sogs rten gsum pri mdun/ 'byor ba dang ༷bstun pa'i mchod pa gang 'byor bshams/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ sras 76

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gi dkyil 'khor 'geng bzhin du/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i yan lag yongs rdzogs pa/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis sgra kun zil mnan nas/ /spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob pa ste/ /rgyal sras 'khor gyi gtso bo rnam gnyis sogs/ /zhing der pad+mo'i skye gnas bzung ba dang / /sangs rgyas zhing mang dag nas lhags pa yi/ /dag pa'i 'khor la gdams ngag ston cing bzhugs/ /gzusas sku bde chen zhing nas mi sayo bzhin/ /mkhyen brtse ris med gdul bya'i rjes zhugs pa'i/ /rgyal dang de sras spyod yul bsam mi khyab/ /dpang du bgyis nas gsol 'dir brtse bas dgongs/ /zhes tshogs zhing mngon du byas pa rtse gcig tu bsgom/ de nas langs lakha nub tu blta bar 'od mdo las gsungs pa bzhin byas nas phyag 'tshal bzhin du/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thugs rje can/ /'od dpag med mgon zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing / /byang chub snying po ji srid skyabs su mchi/ /lan bdun brjod/snying rje'i mnga' bdag rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /mthu chen thob sogs rgyal sras rgya mtsho dang / /bgrang yas slob ma dul ba'i dge 'dun la/ /gus pa chen pos phyaka/ 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ lan bdun nam gsum brjod/ mchod yon me tob bdug pa mar me dri/ /zhal zas sil snyan la sogs dngos bshams dang / /gzungs rig 78

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6mos pa las byung mchod pa'i sprin/ /nam mkha' gang bar dmigs te gus pas mchod/ /'khor tshe thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /rang bzhin bcas pa'i sdig ltung bgyis so 'tshal/ /gnong 'gyod draka/ pos mthol bshags slan chad kyang / /mi bgyid sdom sems brtan po yang dag bzung / /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das rang gzhan gyi/ /dus gsum dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma gang bzhugs rnams/ /bla med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /lhar bcas skye rgu'i mgon por yun ring du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /'dis mtshon dge bas ma rgan sems can kun/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen ye shes la 'god shog /ces tshogs bsags/ slar yang snyim pa me tog dang bcas te/ 'od mdzad stobs bcu mnga' ba sras bcas kyi/ /mtshan mchog brjod dang phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i mthus/ /gang zhabs dran pas byang chub mtha' bar du/ /dbang po tshang zhing rigs mthor skye ba dang / /bud med mi 'gyur 'jig rten kun gyis bkur/ /'chi tshe bde gshegs 'khor bcas mdun bzhugs shing / /skye ba kun tu tshangs spyod dngos po thob/ /rtag par byang chub spyod la dga' ba dang / /gzungs dang ting 'dzin bzod la yang das/ sbyor/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa bon 'jos pa 79

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/ma ba sogs/ /mdor na rgyal sras chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis/ /bcom ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po'i drung / /zhal bzhes smon lam 'gyur ba mi mnga' dang / /gzhan yang rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang sogs/ /rgyal sras so so'i sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang / /bden gzigs nyan thos che rnams bden pa dang / /gzungs dang mdo sde'i phan yon tshad med pa'i/ /dbang du mdzad nas deng 'dir bdag cag rnams/ /gnas skabs tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med cing / /mi dang mi min 'jigs pa kun las grol/ /dpal 'byor snyan grags gang gā'i rgyun ltar 'phel/ /shugs draka bcos ma min pa'i thar 'dod dang / /gzhan phan snying rjes drangs pa'i sems bskyed dang / /'khrul med nges don rtogs pa'i lha ba sogs/ /theg mchog lam gnad rdzogs par rnyed pa dang / /tshe 'phos bde ldan zhing du skye bas mtshon/ /ji ltar smon pa'i re 'bras yid bzhin du/ /gegs med 'phral du thob par byin gyis zadabs/ /zhes me toganub phyogs su 'thor/ de nas sems bskyed blang ba ni/ ji ltar bde gshegs khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /yongs dag zhing dang 'khor dang mdzad pa dang / /mtshan dang sku tshe dpag med ci 'dra ba/ /bdag kyang ma 'ongs de 'drar 'gyur bgyis nas/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i mar gyur rigs drug 'gro/ /'jigs rung srid 80

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6pa'i chu bor bying ba rnams/ /zhi 'gog bdud rtsi'i dbyings su dbugs 'byin pa'i/ /sems mchog bskyed do mi nyams 'phel gyur cig /ces lan gsum/ sems bskyed 'dzin lugs 'di ni las dang po pas kyang byar rung bas 'jug pa bde ba zhig yin no/ /skabs 'dir 'od dpag med kyi gzungs ring thung ci rigs pa bzla zhing / spro na 'phags pa 'od dpag med kyis bkod pa'i mdo'ang klog /rtse gcig bzlas pas rgyal ba 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul sku las 'od zer byung / /rang gzhan sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi byas nas/ /smon don yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /gzungs bum yod na 'od zer bsdu 'bebs kyi dmigs pa dngaXsprags nas/ slar yang gzungs ci nus bzla zhing rang gzhan la khrus bya/ gang ltar yang rjes la/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ sho lo ka gnyis po tshar reXdang / yan lag bdun pa sngar bzhin btang mthar/ gdan 'dzoms rgyal ba sras bcas spyan snga ru/ /phyag mchod thugs dam bskul sogs bgyis pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs banas skabs bsam pa kun 'grub cing / /mthar thug rdzogs byang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / gzhan yang ris med rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas/ /bstan dgra nag phyogs rgol ba mtha' dag zhi/ /bstan 'dzin dam pa'i mgon rnams zhabs pad brtan/ /bstan rtsa dge 'dun 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de mthus yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde zhing skyid/ /81

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skye rga thams cad legs lam dpal la spyod/ /phun tshogs rdzogs ldan zla ba gsar 'char ba'i/ /dge mtshan sa gsum snang bar byin kyis rlobs/ /zhes gsolaXb btab/ gang 'dir bdag cag sbyor ba dman pa dang / /de bzhin rdzas dang bsam pa ma dag sos/sa/ /nongs zhing 'khrul pa ci dang ci mchis pa/ /brtse ldan rnams kyi spyan sngar snying nas 'chags/ /zhes nongs bshags dang / de ltar lesas gsung mdo yi rjes 'brangs te/ /zhing mchog sbyong ba'i cho ba tshul bzhin du/ /bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams zla ltar dkar ba des/ /'gro kun bde chen zhing du skye bar shog /nam zhig tshe 'di'i 'du byed sdud pa'i tshe/ /bde gshegs sku yi snang ba legs shar nas/ /de mthus na gcod sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing / /dga' dang spro ba'i ngang la 'pho bar shog /shi 'phos skye srid gzhan gyis ma chod par/ /bde ldan zhing du pad+ma'i snying po las/ /brdzus te skyes nas rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ /dus kun mthong ba'i rab dgas 'tsho bar shog /de las zab dang rgya che'i gdams ngag gi /bdud rtsi thob nas rgyal sras mchog rnams dang / lhan cig theg mchog bgro ba la dbang bas/ /thos pa'i chu gter nyin bzhin 'phel bar shog/skyes ma thag par mngon shes stobs thob ste/ /bsam yas zhing du sangs rgyas blta ba dang / /bsnyen bkur bya phyir thogs pa med rgyu 82

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6zhing / /rgyal ba kun gyi chos mdzod 'dzin par shog /rlabs chen zhing gi 'byor ba mthong nas su/ /rnam dag smon lam de 'dra'i rjes slob cing / /ma dag zhing du rgud pas nyen pa yi/ /'gro kun sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dren par shog /mdor na sa bcu lam lnga'i spangs rtogs kun/ /phul byung zhing bi khyad par la bsten nas/ /mthong ba'i chos la mig 'phrul bzhin bgrod de/ /zla med mgon po khyod 'drar 'gyur bar shog /ces dang smon lam gzhan yang bklag par bya'o/ /tshar grangs gsogan tshorgas bsags dang gsol 'debs kho na la tshar grangs bzung yang rung mod/ cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa la grangs bzung na bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyu bzhi cha tshang ba'i steng nas nus pa thon par snang bas shin tu legs/ de lhar zhag bdun la sogs par rtse gcig tu 'bad na nges par bde ba can du skye ba'i tshul ni dri ma med pa'i lung dang rigs pa las shes par mdzod cig /ces tshig nyung la 'dril bas khyer bde/ don 'dus la gsal bas go gla/ gdul bya mchog dman med pas sgo yangs/ khungs mdo sde dang 'brel bas byin rlabs che/ phyag len balhas chog tu bkod pas 'jug pa bde ba'i 'od chog 'di yang blo gsal bstan 'dzid gyis dar dkar gyi skyes dang bcas te bskul ba lhar/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas lcags stag dbyug pa'i nya ba'i thun gseng du bris pa dge zhing bkra shis// //༄ / /bde ldan das/ pa'i zhing mchog bde ba can/ /smon lam dpung pas 'dzin bzod 'odaXdapag med/ /mos pa'iXyid la mngon sum rab byas te/ /bde chen zhing gi cho ga'i tshul 'di dbye/ /de'ang 'phags pa da ltaraXgyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting ngeX'adzin byi mdo las bshad pa'i rjes su 'brang ste/ bde ba can byi zhing khams yid la bya ba'i tshul chog khrigs dang bcas pa 'akod pa la/ thog mar mdun du — 83

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'abum/྾ ྾ r+yā 'od dpag med kyi sku gzugs bris 'bur ci ltar rigs pa bshams pa'i spyan sngar mar me sogs mchod pa'i rdzas sna tshogs bstar legs su bkod/ de nas bdag nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sems can thams cad la zhe 'gras pa med pa'i byams pa chen po mngon du bzhag cing de bzhin gshegs pa de yid la byas te tshig 'di skad ces/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong bi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la byang chub snying po'i bar du rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan gsum/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang rin po che mngon du bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs kyis brten pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yid la byas te byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho yongs su bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ de nas mchod rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho grangs med pa mnga' ba rnams kyi rnam par grol ba'i phung po lnga shin tu mthar phyin pa'i bden pa dang /84

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mabame tog pod/ 64྾྾྾ —bden pa'i tshika 'dis deng bdag gis mchod rdzas su bstar ba'i mchod yon la sogs pa 'di dag 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i sprin bkod pa bzhin du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu khyab cing zad pa'i mtha' mi mngon pa yid bzhin rin po che'i gter du 'byung bar gyur cig ces brjod cing /mchod pa'i sprin gzungs gsum mam bdun brjod/ /de nas zhing khams brten par bcas pa yid la bya ba'i tshul dngos ni/ oṃ sā bhā wa sogs/ chos thams cad rang bzhin rnam par dag pa de bzhin nyid kyi klong las ma g.yos bzhin du dag chen rten 'byung gi snang char de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam las sprul pa'i zhing khams rmad du byung ba bde chen pad+mo bkod pa shin tu tshad med cing smon lam mtha' yas pas mngon par 'phags pa/ bde ba'i rgyu'i tshogs grangs med pa dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal dang mi khom pa'i sgra thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa/ gzhi kun tu mnyam zhing rin po che rnam pa du mas yongs su gang ba/ lha'i spos kyi chu dri rab tu zhim pas phyogs thams cad legs par bgos pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing sna tshogs pas brgyan cing gser gyi dra bas khebs pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi rgyu las grub pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa kun tu rgyas pa/ pad+ma de dag las kyang 'od zer kha dog tha dad pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya 86

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾྾྾— ྾stong du ma 'tsher ba/ phyogs tha dad pa dag nas 'bab pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu klung yan lag brgyad dang ldan pas gang ba1 chu klung de dag gi sgra dbyangs lha'i rol mo chen po'i sgra skad las kyang mngon par 'phags shing chos zab mo rab tu 'byung ba/ jes pa chen po mchos gi gtam ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i bya'i tshogs dpag tu med pa nam mkha'i lam nas lding zhing 'gro ba/bsod nams kyi gzi brjid chen pos khyad par 'phags pa'i lha dang mi'i tshosas kyis rnam par brten pa/ de'i dbus su de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsod nams las byung ba'i byang chub kyi shing 'phangs su dpag tshad stong dang drug brgyas spasas shing / 'dab ma dpag tshad brgyad brgyar 'phyangs pa/ lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshobs pa rtag tu chags shing kha dog tha dad pa bkra ba/nor bu rin po che'i drwa bas bres pa/ dar gyi lda ldi dang lho tig/ gi rgyan phreng du mas 'phyang ba/ lus dang sems dga' ba bskyed pa'i 'od zer grangs med pa phyobs bcur 'phro ba/ sangs rgyas kyi seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rang bzhin can gyi nye losas na gnas pa/de'i 'gram na ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin sashegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpas tu med pa mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan zhing bsod nams chen po'i dpal 86

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tob pod/ 6gyis lhang nge lhan ne lham mer 'phags pa/ nor bu rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po ltar gzi brjid kyi dpal rab tu 'bar ba/'dzum zhing bzhad pa'i zhal kyi dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab ma brgya ba ltar rgyas pa dri ma med cing shin tu rnam par dab pa'i phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag pa/ zhabs zung mnyam pa'i skyil krung gis rin po che seṅge'i khri la bzhugs shing chos gos rnam pa gsum gyis mdzes par klubs pa/ lus dang sems dga' ba bskyed cing chos kyi snang ba chen po kun tu ster ba'i 'od zer bye ba phrag 'bum du 'phro ba/zab cing rgya che ba'i tshul las brtsams pa'i gtam gyi rgyud zad mi shes pas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'dun par mdzad pa/ de'i 'khor du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dang / mthu chen thob pa la sogs pa 'phags pa'i gang zag tshad med cing dpag tu med pa/de dag kun kyang sgyu ma lta du'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas shing rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa la mnga' dbang 'byor ba/ blo ri rab ltar brtan zhing shes rab nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/sems can gyi khams smin par byed pa'i thabs la mkhas pa tshad med pa'i pha rol tu son pa/ yon tan mtha' yas shing nu med pa sha stag ko /de ltar bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'od dpas med 87

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6 byin brlabs pa'i/ /khyod mtshan rna bar lan gcig grasas pas kyang / /mtho ris bdud rtsi'i sgo mo rnam dbye ba/ /'dren pa 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsol dang rtob pa'i 'ching ba brtul zin kyang / /rtsol med lhun grub chen po'i phrin las kyis/ /nam mkha' ji sred 'gro ba'i don spyod pa/ /mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen sems de sogs/ spyod 'jug las byung ba'i mchod phreng snyan la dal bar brjod/ de nas 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs/bzang spyod kyi yan lag phyi ma lnga'ang 'don/ de nas mtshan sngags bzla bar 'dod pas/phul byung ye shes rgya mtsho'i ngo bo nyid/ /mtha' klas gzabs sku'i ༄rol mor snang mdzad pa/ /bde gshegs 'od dpag med pa rjes dran gyis/ /bdag yid 'phags pa'i lam la bsgyur du sasol/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i blo bzhag ste/ /lha khyod mos pa'i yul du rab byed na/ /snying la ye shes snang ba 'bum stsol zhing / /byin rlabs mchog gi dus ston sbyin mdzod cig /'gro la bdud rtsi'i chos char ngas ster zhes/ /khyod kyis sngon smon phul byung gang btab pa/ /de dag de ring bdag la mngon sum du/ /snang ba'i 'phrul chen myur bar 'du mdzod cig /ye shes nyi ma 'bar ba'i byin rlabs gzis/ /bdag yid sgrib pa'i nun nag bsal mdzad de/ /'phags lam yan lan brgyad kyi me tog tshal/ /'dzum pa'i 89

ngo da/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga dga' ston cir yang snang bar mdzod/ /cesabarjod/ o a mi dhe wa trīḥ zhes ci nus bzla/ thun mthar/ mchod bstod 'bul ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing rnams kun/ /phul byung mchod pa'i sprin gyis rab bkang ste/ /bla ma 'od dpag med pa sras bcas mchod/ /'gro kun bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shog /o sarba ta thā ga ta mahā bo dhe satwa ar+ghaṃ sogs/ shabha pū tsa ho/ mtha' yas zhing na rgyal dang rgyal sras tshogs/ /gang gi yon tan bsngags pa lhur bzhes pa'i/ /'dren pa stobs bcu'i dbang phyug 'od dpagaXmed/ /'phags tshogs 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /cesabarjod nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdul bral shin tu rnam par dab pa sogs/ bde ba can byi smon 'a ma sadab/ de rjesaXbakra shis brjod pas mtha' bsdu ba tsam ma gtogs bsdu rim sogs mi dgos te/ de ni da ltar gyi zhing khams bde ba can yid la byas pa tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhing mchogabade ba can du bgrod pa'i thabs/ /don zab mdo yi rjes su 'brang ba 'dis/ /srid na bkra shis snang ba stong stsol zhing / /sa gsum dge legs mchog gis khyab byed shog /ces pa'ang btsun patshe phyug gi ngor/ sprang spyon 'jigs med pas gang dran mgyogasaXbris su byas pa'o/ /dge'o// //ra / /bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang yang dran no zhing khams bde ba can/ /snying nas dran no 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /rtse gcig dran no rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 90

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6ba 'khor/ /byin gyis zlobs shig skyabs med skyob pa'i tshogs/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid mgon po khyed rnams la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /sdig ltung kun ngashags dbe la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor bzhin mya ngan mi 'da' gsol/ /bdag gis mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don sbad du/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams yongs su sbyong ba yi/ /rnam thar smon lam rgya mtsho rdzogs gyur cig /'dis mtshon dge bas bdag sogs yid can kun/ /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can/ /rmad byung ngo mtshar bkod pas rab mdzes par/ /skyes nas theg mchog dga' ston sbong bar shog /ces pa'ang dge ba'i bshes banyen yo ṭi ya na'i ngor 'jigs med pas so//ra / /bcom ldan 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang mtshan grags pa dkar po'i ga dur rdul/ /mtha' yas zhing khams rgya mtsho'i khyon yangs por/ /rna lung dpyangs pa'i mod la srid pa'i smag /skrag mdzad 'od mtshan stong 'bar la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gis grangs med bskal ba'i sngon rol nas/ /bgrang yas byang chub spyod pa'i khur bzung nas/ /'phags pa'i smon lam rgya mtsho'i mthar son pas/ /bde ldan zhing khams bzung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /91

'phasas tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me toka pod/ 6yas/ /blo mchog sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba/ /lta ba'i skal bzang snang ba rnyed gyur cig /kun shes bzod pa thob cing rigs pa brgyas/ /chos nyid zhi ba rtogs pa'i ye shes can/ /rgyal sras tshogs mchog 'dus pa'i lha gral du/ /bsod nams gzi brjid chen po'i mthus gnas shog /mdor na kun bzang spyod pa rmad byung bas/ /'od dpag med pa'i gnas rab thob nas slar/ /rdzogs smin sbyangs pa'i yon tan mi zad pas/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang don gnyer can blo ldan dang lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma dag gi ngor sprang spyon 'jigs med pas gang dran rdol thabs su spras pa'i yi ge pa ni shākya'i btsun pa 'jigs med bzang pos bgyis pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig / 93

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾ ྾༄/ /bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam ngashad blo gsal dga' ba'i rol mo zhes bya ba ba'ugs/brtan ma bcu gnyis bzhi tshan bsum du byed tshul la/ mi 'dra ba cung zad yod kyang grags che ba ni/ bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma/ /dpal ldan lha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong / /gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang / /'brob chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ /bdud mo chen mo o bzhi yang / /zhes dang /gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu bun ma/ /kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal kyi yum/ /gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang / /rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /sanod sbyin chen mo o bzhi yang / /zhes dang / kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyo nga / /btsan la la ro rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /sman btsun ugs chos rdo rje g.yar mo gsil/ /bayu yi dril bu rdo rje gzugs legs ma/ /sman mo chen mo o bzhi yang / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de dag sga cho dang 'brang smos na/ lugs mang yang / grabs can bcis bshad na/pha banam gyi rdzi skan dang / ma nag mo bzhin mi sbug gi bu mo bdud 9sgyu1

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6mo bzhi/ pha gnam gyi glog chen dang / ma dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin mo bzhi/ pha gnam gyi skya 'od dang / ma dkar sham bzhin bzang ma'i bu mo sman mo bzhi ste mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi zab gter sogs nas bstan no/ /'di dag spyi'i gtso mo ni bkra shis tshe ring ma yin par nyang gter brtan ma'i mdos chog sogs las bshad/ 'di dag ni bod kyi yul bdag ches che ba ste/gter bdag gling pas brtan ma'i dbang bshad du/ ngo bo ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro/ /rnam pa dam tshig bi ma mo/ phrin las myur mgyogs kyi pho nyar grub pa/ dam can brtan ma bcu banyis su grags pa 'di nyid/ nges pa'i don du dpal chen po te ru ka'i bka' 'khor du gnas shing / dkyil 'khor yongs kyi srung ma/zhes pa nas/ spyir bod khams sde dang bcas pa mtha' dag dang /khyad par gsang chen bstan pa'i snying po de 'dzin dang bcas pa gces pa'i bu bzhin du skyong zhing / phrin las rnam pa bzhi la thogs pa med pa'i mthu can/ nang du snying nye la bkra shis pa/ phyi ru rno myur tshan che ba/ rig 'dzin sgrub pa po rnams kyi re ba yid bzhin du skong ba'i dbang gi rgyal po lta du/ zhes dang / tshul bzhin du mchod na/ snyigs ma'i dus su bod yul gyi ljongs 'dir thub bstan spyi dang khyad par o rgyan chen po'i sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa 96
