pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs medab sta nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga nga nga nga rnams gces par skyong ba dang / chos bzhin spyod pa rnams kyi 'dod pa'i phrin las sgrub pa la/ rang gi dam tshig srog tu gyur pa nyid kyis mthu dang byin rlabs gzhan las myur ba'i phyir nan tan du bslab bo/ /zhes gsungs shing / bla ma sa chen gyis/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyis 'di dab la mchod gtor byed pa mnal lam du gzigs nas/ de phyin gtor 'bul ma chabs par mdzad ces 'byung ngo / /gnas nyer bzhi na brtson 'grus chen mo la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs kyis/de dag sngags rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gnas chen du 'dod pa ltar/ bod kyi yul 'dir rtag chags su bzhugs pa'i sngags bla med kyi rnal 'byor ma chen mo ni 'di dag yin te/ bter phyogs khungs ldan ches mang por 'di rnams phyi nang bi dus sbyor dag pa dang / bden don bcu gnyis kyi ngo bo nyid dang sman mo'am dkar mo rnams shā na ma/ bdud mo'am nag mo ba'i bdag nyid ma/ gnod sbyin mo'am dmar mo bzhi bse mo ste phur srung bcu gnyis kyang 'di dag go) bde mchog gi ma mo bcu gnyis gzugs gzhan du bsgyur bar bshad cing / rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ bod yul du ni lhan skyes te/ /zhi zhing gsal ba'i gzugs can ma/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan lag na thogs/ /brag gi khyem la brten te gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa de'ang 'di dag gi 96

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ bcol gtad mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs kyis dpags na 'di ltar mngon te/ srid pa'i lha chen gzhan la gtad kyang btsan phyug dang 'phan dar sobs 'byung ba yod kyang / 'di dag la btso bor gtad na (yul 'di gsang sngags sgrub pa rnams la bkra shis par bya ba dang /'dir gsang sngags spyod pa'i skal ldan mang po 'byung bar bya ba dang / yul mi thams cad kyang sngagasaXbastan la dad cing ri mor byed pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i nying khu ring du gnas par bya ba dang / spub po rnams la bde ba chen po'i dngos grub myur zhing mang bar bya ba'i ched yin/ des na bod brtan ma la gtadapa ni slob dpon rin po ches bod du sngags bstan 'dzugs pa'i cha lag tu rtogs so /)gsang sngasas snying po'i bstan pa mi nub cing 'phel rgyas su 'gyar ba'i gnad than da da mong ma yin pa yod pas/ slob dpon pad+ma rten 'brel gyi gnad mkhyen pa des/ rgya bal gyi sa mtshams a su ra'i brag phug tu ma mo 'di rnams zhing lpags kyi stan la bkod/ lag tu rdo rje gtad/ rdo rje bod khams skyong sogs rdo rje'i ming gis dbang bskrur nas bsil ljongs 'di'i snod bcud gnyis ka gnyer gtad mdzad pa yin no/ /de 'dra'i rten 'brel las phyogs 'dir gsang sngags 'grub pa'i gnas chen mang po byung zhing / paṇa grub dbang po rnams kyi drin las sngags kyi rgyud sde dang / rgyud sde'i man ngag mang po dang / de dag las dngos grub brnyes pa'ang brgyud mar 98

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6byon/ mtsho dang gangs brag thams cad kyang rdo rje jeg pa'i chos gter gyis gang bar gyur te/ dpal nā len+d+rar me dgra byung ba na/nang rgyud sde lnga'i byin rlabs kyis gsung rab bco lnga cha gcis ma nub par grags pa dang / rdzogs chen gyi rgyud du bstan pa'i btsas gsum gyi che ba gsungs pa ltar/ sa gter 'di rnams bstan pa gnas pa'i rtod phur du bzhugs(rgya gar du nu stegs yod kyang sangs rgyas pa rnams dad pa dang shes rab che bas rang tshugs thub cing / bod de las ldog cing gsar ngas che ba dang / bod na sngags mkhan yod kyang myu stegs kyi rig sngags zil gyis gnon nus su sgrub nus mkhan nyung zhing myu stegs kyi sngags sgrub blaba'i dbang gis/ nu stegs nus pa can bod du zhugs na bstan pa spyi dang khyad pa ra sngags bstan gyi phrin las la gnod tshabs che bas nu stegs kyi rgyu srang bkas par ga/sung pa red dam dpyad dgos/ ) pa'ang yin no/ /de 'dra ba ni 'dzam gling 'di'i rgyal bstan gar yod du yod pa'ang min te/ rgya nag gi yul du chos byung ba na/ nyan thos dgra bcom sogs bdag nyid chen po mang du byon kyang / sngags kyi rgyud sde ni da lta'i bar du yang ma byon pa bzhin no/ /brtan ma 'di dab ni bde chen gyi ye shes ster sa byin rlabs dang dngos grub che zhing / rnam pa 'jig rten gyi ma mo'i tshul du bzhugs pas bkol yang bde/ rgyal ba klong chen pa dang / rje thang stong zhabs/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa/ rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang sogs rig 'dzin brgyud pa 99

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—4 ྾ 4rnams la dngos su phrin las bsgrubs pa'i lo rgyus nges tig can yang shin tu mang ngo / /brtan ma gcig bsnyen na gzhan rnams kyang nye bar 'gyur ba ni/ byang sater brtan ma'i lo rgyus las/lo sgrub cing mchod pa'i tshe: brtan ma thams cad grogs su bos la ci bcol ba'i las gyis shig: ces gsungs shing / mid la'i dbyangs 'dum las kyang gsa' te/ zhar byung ngo / /de ltar na bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad rtsad mi chod cing / rang yul gyi bzhi bdag la phyogs zhen byas pa'i mchod bstod phal cher yang don chung bas/ de kun gyi tshab tu brtan ma mchod pa la 'bad par bya'o/ / 'di kho nas dgos pa mang po byed tshul yang / brtan gsol las/ bod du mu stegs rtag chad kyi/ /chos log ma btang o kyis srungs/ /gsang lngags sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /bar chad ma gtong lo kyis srungs/ /gnas chen byin gyis brlabs pa'i gter/ /ma nyams smon lam btsan par gyis/ /dmag dang 'khrugs pa zhi bar mdzod/ /nad dang nu ge ma btang zhig /sad sel btsa' dang 'bu srin srungs/ /gtsug lag khang dang mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dben pa'i gnas dang sgrub pa po/ /ma lus bu bzhin skyong ba dang / /dgra bgegs gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ /zhes 100

bodaskyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6 khyad par gyi las bcol 'byung ba ltar/ yon tan sater mdzod du'ang / bod yul bstan pa srung ba dang: mtha' yi dmag dpung phyir la zlogs: nad gdon gnod pa srung ba dang: o rgyan nga yi gter rnams srungs: khri srong lde'u btsan brgyud pa skyongs: sad ser mu ge shwa chu sdoms: btsa' dang skya yug dal yams zlogs: dmag 'khrugs byad kha phur kha zlogs: dus su char phobs 'bru phyugs spel: rigs brgyud bu nor spel ba dang: dam chos klos bshad sgrub brgyud spel: mdo rgyud bstan bcas dar ba dang: dge 'dun sde dpung thos bsam dar: 'jig rten legs dgu kun 'grub mdzod: ces dam bsgrags skabs su sasungs so/ /de 'dra la dgongs nas bod khams spyi'i bde thabs la'ang / lha srin dbang sdud dang dam bsgrags zab par spyi lung las gsungs te/ mchims phur dbang chen 'dus pa'i sgrub pa bya:bod kyi lha srin dbang sdud dam bsgrags bya: zhes rgyal dbang lnga bas drangs so/ /slob dpon rin po che'i bka' nyan yin phyin/spyir yang bod khams bde thabs la mi brtson pa med kyang /pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob gter ston gter slob brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa rnams dang / pad+ma'i bka' nyan bstan srung chen po rnams nags dang nags kyi seng ge ltar phan tshun dpung grogs 101

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾྾— ྾dang rtsa lag tu 'gyur ba yin pas/ brtan ma sogs la gsol mchod las kyi gnyer gtad byed pa'i rig 'dzin med na/ de das kyang btsan rdzong dmag mi dang bral ba lta bur 'gro bas/ sngon yang mi rabs re bzhin lha srin dam bsgrags bka' nan rab brjid/ gnas chen byin 'bebs sogs byed pa'i rig 'dzin mthu ldan re byung snang ngo / /brtan ma'i cho ga ni gtso cher gu ru zhi ba dang sbrel bar gsungs te shin tu grags che/ rta mchog rol pa la'ang 'brel chags tshabs che ste/ yon tan gter mdzod las/ tsha thod mang yul dpal mo'i mtshor: dbang chen rol ba'i skur bstan nas:dam la btags pa'i dge bsnyen dang: phud bdag brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs: chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: zhes dang / grol thig gshog rgod mar/ bstan skyong rdo rje gshog rgod ma: 'khor 'das dregs pa dpag med bcas: bsam yas dpal gyi mchims phu ru: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis:rta mgrin khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor du: dbang bskur bka' dang dam la bzhag: de tshe gsang ba'i mtshan btasas pa: dpal ldan rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: zhes gsungs shing / tshe skrub ye shes 10 2

bod rdo nga brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ nga ma sgyu ba / 6'od mchog gi brtan ma'i gtor chog tu'ang / drag po dbu dgu'i dbu re re bzhin las rta zhal gyi gdengs ka phyungs te/ rta skad kyi rngam sgras brtan ma bcu gnyis so so'i 'khor 'bum 'dum dang bcas pa dbang du bsdus/ zil gyis mnan nas/ dmal bzhas par bya/ zhes gsungs pa dang / gru gu'i rta mgrin dregs sgrol las/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: brag dmar bsam yas ār+ya pa gling du: man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba bshad pa'i tshe:bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis kyis: so so'i sazugs bstan dam la btags nas kyang: bka' yi gtor ma blang bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i las rnams bya bar ma chad dam: zhes 'byung ngo / /mdo tshogs chen 'dus pa'i gtso bo dang / ma mo rbod gtong gi gtso bo gnyis ka'i srid pa ma mo dbang sdud kyi zhal ras rta mgrin gyi zhal gyi ngo bo dang rnam par bya bar gsungs pa sogs khungs shin tu mang ngo /srid pa ma mo rtsa rlung thig le'i sgo nas 'chad tshul ltar bshad na/ 'dod khams dag pa sman mo bzhi sku rdo rje sprul skru'i pho nya mor nges pa'i sgo nas gnas pa rtsa sbyong zhing dbang du sdud pa dang /lus kyi smad kyi cha'i rtsa rlung thig le rnams khyad par du sbyong ba'i rnal 'byor dang / sazags khams das/ pa sa/nod sbyin mo bzhi ༄03

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6— ྾r+yā ྾gnyis kyis brtan ma'i de nyid sto na/ de nas bcig gis brtan ma'i rnam grangs ston te/ sprul gzhiXbartan ma bcu gnyis/ de'i sprul pa skyong ma bcu gnyis/ de'i sprul pa ya ma bcu gnyis zhes 'byung / de nas gcig gis phrin las la spyan drangs pa/ de nas gnyis kyis sngon gyi tha tshig gleng ba/ de nas gcig gis gtor ma bsngo ba/ de nas gnyis kyis rnal 'byor pa'i sgos kyi las bcol ba/de nas gsum gyis bstan 'gro spyi'i don du phrin las gsol ba/de nas sngags kyis gtor ma stob pa/ thog mar srog (ma modang bh+yo gnyis gang labashad kyang nyan/ rgyu mtshan 'dra yang yod) nas drang ba dang bcas pa'o/ /bzlas pa 'dod na bh+yo bsnyen la tshang bar gsol lo/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi bdud mo bzhi snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ma rig pa sogs rten 'brel bzhi dag pa/ ye shes bzhi'i ngo bo nyid/ gnod sbyin mo bzhi kha gdong ma sogs sgo ma bzhi skye mched sogs bzhi dag pa/ dga' ba bzhi/ sman mo bzhi gshin rje brtan ma sogs mtshams ma/ len pa sogs bzhi/ tshad med bzhi/ dus sbyor bcu gnyis kyi dag pa dang sbyor tshul rang re'i bsang brngan ltar/ 'di ltar shes na ye shes mchog gi dngos grub ster la/rang rgyud par bzung na gnas skabs kyi 'dod don tsam las mi 'byung bar mnga' ris paṇa chen gsungs/ phrin las kyi sprul pa 106

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6brtan ma zer ba'i sgra bshad la/ brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten skyong ma zhes pa ra brtan gyi steng nas dang / bod du nu stegs mi satong bar rgyal bstan srung ba mo zhes sa bstan gyi bshad tshul yod ces skyabs rje gsung / ra brtan la brtan gnas pa'am zhes pa ltar rtag chags kyi yul lha zhes bshad lugs kyang yod e gsung snyam ste brjed/ brtan skyong zhes par yang / brtan ma bshal chus skyong zhes dang / brtan skyong ma mchod pa zhes bshad lugs so sor yod gsungs snang 'dra mo 'dug de'ang sa paṇa gyis/rgyal po khyod kyi bod yul 'di/ /slob dpon pad 'byung gnas kyis//mabartan ma bcu gnyis la gtad pas/ /zhes te/ sham po dang /thang lha sogs gu ru'i bka' sdod phal cher/ /gter phyogs na/ru bzhi bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ /mtho mtho dgung la reg pa dang / /sogs ltar gtso cher ru bzhi'i srung mar bshad la/brtan ma bcu gnyis ni ru bzhi kho na'i yul lha min te/ bstan gnyis skor gsum du/ bod khams mtha' dadus kun na gnas pa yi/ /brtan skyong ya ma 'bum phrag 'khor bcas rnams/ /zhes te/mnga' ris na tshe ring ma/ kong yul na de mo/ mdo smad na drag rgyal ma sogs kyis shes/ de dag gi spyi mdzad rdzong btsan pa'i/btsan rgod 'bar bas dgra srog chod/ /ces pa'i dod ni/ mtha' 107

nga da/ 6 rdo grub nga nga med bstan nyi'i gsunga'abum/nga nga nga yi dmag dang rgya 'dre'i 'tshub/ nas/ 'gong po spun dgu'i nad dal srung / /zhes dang / bodakhams srung zhing skyong ba dang / /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs bya zhes/ /ji ltar khas blang dam bcas pa'i/ /zhes te/ 'di 'drar dgongs nas smin gter rjes gsangs tshal zur bris ltar/ so so'i sgos mdzad ni/ rdo rje kun nga nga grags mas bdud dpung zlog pa dang / g.ya' ma skyong gis gza' bdud dang / kun bzang mos btsan thong 'dul ba/ kha rag khyung btsun gyis gshin rje'i gdon dang dgra dpung 'joms pa/ rdo rje klu mos rmi ltas mtshan ngan zlog pa/ drag rgyal mas glo bur sems kyi ye 'drog zhi ba/ de mos sa bdag klu'i nad gdon zhi ba/bayar mo bsil gyis dam nyams gnad la 'bebs pa/ btsan la la ros gtad zlog cing gnod sbyin gdug pa'i nad gdon zhi ba/'brog chen 'khor 'dul gyis bgegs kyi bar chad sel ba/ spyan gcig mas dgra bgegs 'gug pa/ gzugs lesas mas phung byed nag mo'i gdon zlog pa sogs te las rgya mapa'i rgyud las gsungs/'di rnams kyi phyag tu gu ru rin po ches bod yul mtha' dag gtod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ pho rgyud las myur/ mo rgyud bkra shis/klu rgyud tshan che zhes shis pa'i don du yin byas kyang byar yod mod/zer rgyu gang rnyed tsam mo/ /dgongs pa ni 'ja' tshon gter khar 08

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6yab kong btsun de mo lha srin 'dul ba'i las rgyar bzhes tshul dang /brtan ma bcu gnyis po thams cad gu ru'i gsang yum du bshad pa/sngar bshad sogs bsgrigs na/ 'di rnam dpal te ru ka'i rang snang gi phyi nang dus sbyor bcu gnyis sgrib bral du gyur pa'i rang rig gi dag ldog las sprul zhing / phyis gu ru rin po che te ru kar bzhengs te/ nyid kyi rten 'brel dus sbyor dag pa'i bde stong shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ldog cha bcu gnyis lha srin 'dul ba'i pho nya mor shar bar brlabs shing / snyoms 'jug bde ba'i rol mos bod khams thams cad zil 'og tu bcug dbang du byas nas te ru ka'i zhing khams su mdzad de/ 'di ni bde ba chen po'i brtul zhugs kyis sa gzhi btul ba'i tshul lo/ /de nyid bshad ma thag pa'i brtan ma'i de kho na nyid sher phyin gyi dbyings su rgyas btab cing sbas nas brtan par mdzad pa'i drang don rtags kyi snang char bod yul brtan ma la gtad nas mi dang mi min 'byung po'i g.yo 'khrugs gsum ldang med du mdzad pa'o/ /tshul des 'di rnams bod khams mtha' dadus kyi srung ba rdo rje'i btsan rdzong bla med du grub bo/ /sangs rgyas kyis 'phrog ma la chang bu sbyin par bcas pa ltar/ gu rus bod kyi sa btul skabs sa 'dul kyi phrin las rgyun skyong ba'i mkha' 'gro chen mo 'di rnams rgyun du mchod 09

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstananyi'i gsung 'bum/ba ma dgos zhes rjes 'jug la khrims su bcas pa'i tshod na snang ste/de ltar brtan ma mchod pa ni 'jig rten gtso mo drug cha'i dpya thang gis bkur ba'i tshul du bod khams bstan 'gro bskyang ba'i sngar byas kyi gtang rab dang / phyis mdzad kyi sanyer zan yin la/'di nyid gu ru'i zab gter kyi sgrub gzhung kun tu 'byung zhing /bod kyi lha srung gzhan su la'ang de 'dra ma bsungs pas gangs can bstan 'gro skyong ba la 'di dag dang brtson 'grus mnyam pa'i yul lha gzhan med par shes nus so/ /der yang ma zad mi dang sha za rang bzhin bskal bas sha zas mi la 'tshe nus pa skrag dang dogs pa'i 'du shes kyi mtshams sbyor sogs la ltos pa bzhin du brtan ma'i srung skyob kyi phrin las rang cag la snang nas phan thogs pa'ang /rang re'i blo ngor brtan ma'i srung mtshams kyi nang du yod par shes pa lasgyultos pas gtor 'bul las bcol sogs kyi sgo nas 'di rnams kyi srung 'og tu chud pa'i 'du shes rgyun du bzhag dgos so/ / de med na ni srung skyob kyi phrin las kyang rang bzhin bskal don du 'gro nyen yod do/ /yang 'di dag mkha' 'gro ma chen mor yang yang bshad de/de'ang drang don du/ nam mkha' stong la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /zhes pa ltar myur malhogs rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs kyis nam mkha' la rlung 110

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6ltar thogs med du rgyu zhing 'phyo ba ste/ lha mo malhogs ma zer ba lhar rbod gtong myur malhogs kyi pho nyar bsngags shing / nges don du 'od gsal chos dbyings kyi nam mkha' la gya gyur 'gro ba'am gang dgar spyod pa ste/ des na kun rtog tshun chad kyi las nyon dang / de las byung ba'i snyigs ma lnga'i rtsub 'gyur ri brag dang chu dang g.yang sa sogs kyi rnam par lta bu gang gis kyang dgag tu med pa'i spyod yul can te/ rgyu mtshan 'dis sems rig shan phyed nas rig thog nas brtan ma dang dam sre nus na me chen rlung rgod dang 'dzoms pa bzhin du gnyis ka'i phrin las kyi rtsal shugs 'ur chil gyis 'gro'o/ /lha mi dang 'dres ma thag rnal 'byor bar chad kyi 'phrang las grol ba'i sand cig der yod do/ /'khor ba la nyam nga med pa'i brtul zhugs kyi rnal 'byor de tsam mnga' na 'jig rten sman mo'i rdzu bag bzung nas ci bya zhe na/ ye shes dag pa'i sku ni 'gro ba phal ba dang rnam pa ches khyad ring bas 'khor sgyur la sprang pos 'dris dung gi mos zhen mi skye ba bzhin bsnyen dka' la/ yul lha 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung na mthun pas mthun pa 'dul zer ba ltar phal pa rnams kyang yid nye zhing bag 'bebs pas lha mi 'dris sla ba'i ched yin te/ dus mthar 'das pa'i sngags las 'jig rten pa'i sngags 'grub sla bar 'jam 111

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6྾— r+yā 4 srung ma khyad par can/ zhes gsungs/ ma mgon lcam dral las/bsung sprul mkha' 'gro chen mo lnga: zhes pa tshe ring mched lnga kho na'o/ /'di la mid las mdzad pa'i gtor chog tu/ lo kyi cho dang 'brang smos na/ /yab ni lho lha 'thing po yin/ /yum ni 'brang yum sman gcig ma/ /ming po bdun la sring mo lnga/ /lnga tshigs dbus kyi gtso mo ste/ /zhes gsungs/ mched lnga'i nang tshan mthing gi zhal bzang ma ni rdo rje g.yu sgron ma dang gcig par bshad/'di'i rten gnas mthon mthing gangs ni rje btsun mid las/rked pa yan chad rtse mo mtho/ /zur gsum dung gi bshos bzang 'dra/ /mgur chu dngul gyi dra ba la/ /nyi 'od 'char ba gzhan pas snga/ /cod pan shel gyi zur phud la/ /rgyun du sprin dkar lding ba yin/ /rked pa man chad rmang gzhi la/ /na bun skyi bun rgyun du 'thibs/ char mi drag dal bu rtag tu 'bab/ /'ja' 'od mchod sprin rtag tu 'char/ /de phyugs kyi rma g.yang 'dzoms pa'i rtags/ /ri dwags mang po rgyun du 'khor/ /me tog spang rgyan tshon tshogs bkra/ /sman nus pa can rnams de la skye/ /de lha sman gangs kyi che brjod yin/ /zhes pa ltar de bal bod kyi sa mtshams na yod/yang / lha bzang po tshe ring spun lnga de/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gtso mo yin/ /'jig rten mig bsgyur mkha' 'gro ste/ /bal bod 113

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ gnyis kyi skad bsgyur ma/ /chu bar brin gyi yul bdag mo/ /lha ru mchod na mgon skyabs byed/ /sogs dang / tshe ring dbang che bskal par gnas/ /de srog gcod spang ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /longs spyod rnam thos du dang mnyam/ /de ser sna spang ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /'khor bzang bka' bgo nyan pa de/ /bzod la nan tan bya ba byas/ /de nas dge la spro ba de/ /brtson 'grus le lo med pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di dag sga bshad pa'ang sngar smos pa'i khongs su tshang la/ dus sbyor zhes pa'i gnas su 'byung ba lnga zhes kyang sbyar bar bya'o/ /gsol kha las/ phyi ltar sman btsun mched lnga la: nang lhar rigs lnga'i ḍak+ki ni: gsang ba dbyings 'akyi yum chen mo: zhes dang / rdo grub rjes/ phyi ltar zo dor tshul 'dzin sha za lnga/ /nang ltar mkha' spyod gnas bgrod ḍā ki ni/ /gsang ba 'byung lnga gnas gyur yum chen lnga/ /zhes dang / rtsa gsum kun 'dus ye shes lha mo lnga/ /zhes gsungs shing / spyan 'dren dus/ mkha' spyod dang / rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing nas spyan 'dren par bshad pa sogs la brtags na'ang dag pa'i zhing gi dngos grub khyad par can rnams la dbang bsgyur ba'i ye shes grub pa mor go nus/ dpal chen gyi bud med rin po che ni/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 114

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6bsungs pa ltar/ 'byung ba'i dwangs snyigs/ na zla'i 'phel zad/rtsa rlung gi skyed sdud thams cad la dbang che'o/ /srog gtad las/da lta rje mo'i tshul du skrubs: sogs bsten lugs gsum gsungs pa gal che zhing / go rim yang de kho na ltar dgos/ tsi dmar dkyus mas bsten dus pha khu ltar bsten gsungs pa ltar 'dir yang pha ma la ches cher gus pa'i rigs chos can gyi bu mdzangs ma la bsnyen pa lta bu'i tshul kyis gong du 'khur ba'i rje mor bsten lugs bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma ltar sgrub pa dang / 'jig rten brtan ma ltar 'bod pa'i sngags gnyis te/ gsol kha dang srog dbang las so/ /tshe sgrub ye shes 'od mchog tu/ brtan ma rang gi sems su shes pa dang / /rten 'brel rig pa chos skur thag chod nas/ /kun bzang thig le gcig tu smin pa ni/ /mi 'gyar mi g.yo ༄brtan pa'i cho ga'o/ /zhes te brtan ma rang rig gi rtsal du thag chod nas 'gyur med rig pa'i gshis las gzhan du med par ngo 'phrod de rba rlabs mtsho la thim pa ltar klong chen dgongs pa'i dbyings su sre ba ni mkha' 'gro ma dang rang gi sros sre ba dang /dam tshig sre ba'i gnad do/ /da dung phyi nang gsang ba'i brtan ma sum sbrags kyi gnad kun mkhyen phyi ma'i thang ga'i rgyab byang dang /g.yu sgron mnga' gsol/ khyad par ye shes 'od mchog la brten 117

pong / 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'a'am/nas 'chad lugs yod de ma bris/ yul lha ltar shes pas mchod bstod byas kyang / dregs pa mchod dang bstod pas 'grub/ /ces dang / sus bsten dngos grub sna re 'thob/ /cesapas 'ako zhing sdong grogs mdzad par nges kyang / dngos bstan btso bo ni/bka' srung sman mo ltar sgrub pa'i zhes bka' srung du shes pas sgrub lugs te/ phyi ma 'di ltar bsten mkhan la srung rgyu'i bka' de 'dzin pa zhig dgos la/ snga ma tsam la de mi dgos kyang chos brgyud dang sel ma zhugs pa zhig dgos snyam/ /8

pod/ 6༄/ /dbang chen rta skad ces bya ba bzhugs/pad+ma dbang chen glu gar gyi sgo nas 'chad pa'i bshad pa rgyas shos ni bde 'dus gsang sngags bka'i tha ram yin kyang de'i dpe dag pa ma rnyed pas dngos 'bri bar ma 'bad/ bcud dril tsam ni pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa thams cad rta skad thang gsum gyi dbongs zhipar 'dus par bstan pa la/ tha ram rnam pa ba sa bshad de/jeg pa rim par bgrod pa'i rta skad rta yi 'gros dgus theg pa dgu rtser chub par bshad pa dang / sa dang lam la sbyar ba'i rta skad rta'i skad bcu gsum dang sbyar te bshad pas sa bcu lam lnga myur du bgrod par bshad pa dang / gsang sbags la shan 'byed pa'i rta skad rta mgo ljang zhur gyis dpal rta mgrin che ba'i yon tan gzhan las 'phags pa'i sgo nas bshad pa dang / gdul bya thabs kyi rta skad dpal dang ma mo 'bum brda phrad k+kong rdol dbang bsgyur ba'i sgo nas bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rta'i 'gros la/ sum las sgrog gi 'gros dang /sdom pa lcags kyi 'gros dang / pho nya srun gyi 'gros dang /1 9

〉pocad/ 6 nga rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gamangang 'am/mtshams legs gzengs kyi 'gros dang / gom bu nyol gyi 'gros dang spyang mo 'dur gyi 'gros dang / rol mo stabs kyi 'gros dang / 'jom mo dkyus kyi 'gros dang / dkyus su tshang ba'i 'gros dang dgu'o/ /de rnams don theg pa rim dgu dang sbyar ba ni/ 'gros dang po ltar lha mi'i theg pa ni/ ma skyes mnyam pa'i lta ba la ni sgrib/ dge ba bcu sogs dam pa'i chos khrims sgrog dang 'dra bas ni bsdam te/ bag yangs pa'i lta spyod kyi dbang ma thob pas sgrog tu tshud pa dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa ltar/ nyan thos kyis gang zag gi bdag med par rtogs pas snga ma las 'phags kyang /dzeg chen gyi don ma rtogs pas yob tu lci ba 'dul ba lcags dang 'dra bas bsdam pas mnyam pa nyid kyi don la bag yangs su spyod ma shes pas lta spyod kyi chos la dbang ma thob ste shin tu sdug bsngal che'o/ /gsum pa ltar rang rgyal ni gong ma gnyis las khyad par du gzugs phung bdag med pa lta bas 'phasas te/ rang byang chub kyi 'bras ba thob pa'i dus na nyan thos lhar dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ༄ mi ltos par sngon goms pa'i shugs kyis rten cing 'brel 'byung bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas 'khor ba thog ma dang tha ma med par rtogs shing rang byung thob par nus na yang rbeg pa chen po mnyam pa nyid kyi chos/ thams cad sems su 'dus par ma mthong bas gnyis su 120

da ba / nga sgo nga 'dzib sa ma ba bstan nying gab nga ba da ma/ nga pa'i zhi khro rnam gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs gzugs dang bcas pa nyid/ yi ge ma ('di skor dpyad) skyes pa'i sgo nas mtshan nyid du snang ba'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyang ma skyes pa'i sgo nas rang bzhin med pa chu zla bzhin spyod la ma chags par rtogs pa'i dus nas ye shes rdzogs te/ tshogs gnyis dus gcig la rdzogs so/ /brgyad pa ltar/ de bas kyang a nu yo ga 'phags te/rgyu dag pa'i dbyings nas 'bras bu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du snang bas so/ /de'ang gang ltar na snga ma ltar yis 'bru las bskyed mi dgos te/ phung po lnga rigs lnga/ rnam shes brgyad sems dpa' brgyad/ yul brgyad sems ma brgyad sogs su ye nas gnas te/phung khams skye mched thams cad ni rtsa ba byang chub sems su 'du la/ de chos kyi dbyings las mi gzhan pas ye nas sangs rgyas pa'o/ /dgu ba ltar/ a ti yo ga bya rtsol thams cad dang bral ba bde ba chen po'i don lhun gyis grub pa ni/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang sems sa 'du la/ sems kyi de kho na nyid ni gdod ma nas ma ༄byung ma skyes te/ ma byung ba ni 'byung ba'i rgyu med la/ ma skyes pa ni skye ba'i gnas med do/ /de'i phyir na ye shes 'byung 'jug med pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /ngang gis ma skyes pa'i thig le chen po'o/ /yongs kyis 'od gsal ba'i ye shes dang / thams cad bdag ji 122

dbang chenarta skad/ pod/ 6dbang du gyur pa'i bdag nyid chen po zhes bya'o/ /rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ rta'i skad la yon tan bcu gsum ste/ rta yi skad snyan pa dang / 'jam pa dang / gting ba dang / gsang ba dang / ring ba dang / yid du 'ong ba dang / 'brel ba dang /bar ma chad pa dang / zil che ba dang / rtsal che ba dang /gdangs che ba dang / ngar che ba dang / phul du phyin pa'o/ /dang po ltar dpal rta mgrin yang 'gro ba'i don la dga' ste/ sa dang po rab dga' dang sbyor/ lam ni tshogs lam dang sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ltar dpal rta mgrin 'gro ba'i don la thugs 'jam zhing brtse bar mdzad de/ sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa dang / lam sbyor lam dang spyar ro/ /gsum pa ltar dpal rta mgrin 'gro ba'i don la mi thos pa med par gnas pa ste/ sa 'od byed pa dang sbyor/bzhi ba ltar dpal 'gro ba'i don la thugs sangs shing 'gro don mdzad de/ sa 'od 'phro dang sbyor/ lnga ba ltar dpal 'gro ba'i don la ring pa ste/ sa spyang dka' dang sbyor/ lam ni mthong lam dang sbyor/ drug pa ltar dpal thams cad la thugs rje mnyam pa ste/sa mngon du gyur pa dang sbyar/ bdun pa ltar dpal gyi thugs rjes 'gro ba rnams la rgyun chad med par gzigs pa ste/ sa ring 123

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstananyi'i gsung 'bum/r+yā ྾ ྾4྾ ྾—4du song ba dang sbyar/ brgyad pa ltar dpal gyi thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don rgyun chad med pa ste/ sa mi g.yo ba dang sbyor/ lam ni sgom lam dang sbyor/ dgu ba ltar dpal gyis 'gro ba'i nyon mongs pa 'joms shing zil gyis gnon pa'o/ /sa legs pa'i blo gros dang sbyor/ bcu ba ltar dpal 'gro ba'i don la rtsal dang ldan pa ste/ sa chos kyi sprin dang sbyor/ lam ni mi slob lam dang sbyar ro/ /bcu gcig pa ltar dpal gyi thugs rje 'khor ba na gdangs che ba ste/sa kun tu 'od dang sbyor/ bcu gnyis pa ltar dpal gyi thugs rje 'gro ba sgrol ba la ngar dang ldan pa ste/ ma chags pad+ma can gyi sa dang sbyar/ bcu ba/sum pa ltar dpal rta mgrin gyis 'gro ba'i don phul du phyin pa ste/ sa bcu gsum pa yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa dang sbyor ro/ /de lhar dpal rta mgrin gyi rta skad thang gcib la sa bcu gsum ma bgrod par rdzogs/ lam lnga ma bgrod par bgrod do/ /bsum pa ni/ rta shugs che/ 'gro malhobs pa lhar/ 'khor ba bsgral shugs che/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'gro ba malhogs/ des na rta skad ces bya/ rta yi rang bzhin bgrod mkhas te/ /theg pa dgu dang sa lam bgrod/ /mkhas shing rtse mor phyin pas na/ /rta mgrin zhes ni de la bya/ /rta yi rang bzhin kha rtsal che/ /de bzhin rta 24

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6ba ba ma ba mchog gsang sngags 'di/ /gsang sngags gzhan pas kha rtsal che/ /rta mgrin zhes ni de la bya/ /rta ni drag po'i rngam tshul las/ /rta ni la ni byed pa'o/ /rta mgrin drag po'i ngar dang ldan/ /mgrin ni gdug pa 'dul ba'o/ /rta ni rdzu 'phrul rkang par ldan/ /mgrin ni sangs rgyas sa gnon pa'o/ /phyi ni rta mgrin khro bo'i sku/ /nang gi rta mgrin rnal 'byor sku/ /gsang ba'i rta mgrin rang sems 'di/ /sems las logs na sgrub tu med/ /sems nyid rta mgrin yin shes na/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'thob/ /yid bzhin nor bu rang la rnyed/ /cir snang cir rtog cir thos pa/ /rta mgrin nyid las gzhan ma yin/ /sku yi cho 'phrul rta mgrin sku ru bsal/ /skye 'gags med pa'i ngang du mya ngan 'das/ /bsung gi rang bzhin rta skad cir sgrogs pa/ /ma skyes mi 'gas gsung du mya ngan 'das/ /thukas kyi rang bzhin rta mgrin cir gsal yang / /chos sku mtshan med klong du mya ngan 'das/ /de ltar rtogs na rta mgrin rnal 'byor yin/ /gsang sngags la shan 'byed pa khyad par 'phags/ /ces gsungs/bzhi ba la/ dpal rta mgrin gyi rta skad thengs gsum gyis ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la brda sprad pa dang / ma mo'i 'gying skad thengs gsum gyis dpal rdo rje'i ming sring brda phrad de dgongs )26

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6par bdag cag 'theng zhing grum zhing mchi/ /'theng zhing grum zhing mi mchi ru/ /keng rus ri rab rtse mo tsha/ /bdag cag 'bog cing brgyal zhing mchis/ /'bog cing brgyal zhing mi mchi ru/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho gting re zab/ /bdag cag thang cig yud la mchi/ /thang cig yud la mi mchi ru/ /ming po rdo rje'i bka' lung gnyan/ /zhes len no/ /gsum pa ni/ thal mo dang po brdab pas/ chos la dgra byung / sangs rgyas ra mda' zlog /ces pa'i brda skad kyis dpal khrag 'thung rnams dbyings nas skul/ thal mo bar ba brdab pas phra men rnams dbyings nas skul/ thal mo tha ma brdab pas las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams las la bskul te btsud pa rnams so/ /de dag thams cad bsdu na gnyis te/ rta skad lta bar dgongs pa dang / spyod par dgongs pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ ngo bo don gyi rta skad/ /gsang sngags gnad kyi rta skad do/ /dang po ni gsum ste/ rang bzhin ngo bo don gyi rta skad snang srid thams cad ye nas ma bcos ma sbyangs lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal rta mgrin/de ltar rtogs pa'o/ /rig pa ngo bo nyid kyi rta skad rang rig pa dpal chen po'i skur ye nas ma bcos par gnas pa'o/ /gnyis su med pa ngo bo nyid kyi rta skad thabs shes gnyis su med pa'am/12 7

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6kyi brda (thal mo dang se gol sogs) ngag gi brda (bshugs pa'i gru sogs)yid kyi brda (dgongs pa gtod pa) dang gsum mo/ /dpal chen che ba'i rta skad ni/ /pad+ma khrag 'thung khros pa'i sku/ /thams cad dbang du sdud par byed/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad la/ /bsnyen pa byas pas nyer ma 'dod/ /bsgrub pa byas pas rtags ma thon/ /bsgos pas las byed ma 'dod na/ /sde brgyad srid pa dkrusas par byed/ /spyod bag shong ba'i dben gnas su/ /lus ngag yid gsum khros kyis kyang / /dmar nag gzhi gcig dmigs pa bskyed/ /yul gsum gsal bar gyur pa dang / /pad+ma dbang chen rta mgrin sku/ /ting 'dzin brtan pos basprub pa las/ /dbang chen phyag rgya byas nas ni/ /khros pa'i rta skad thengs gsum 'don/ /khros pa'i rta skad thengs gsum gyis/ /snang srid lha srid sde brgyad kyang / /'brong rgod 'drogs pa bzhin du ni/ /rang dbang med par had kyis dngangs/ /rta skad lan gsum bton pa yis/ /sha rul dong du bcug pa la/ /sha sbrang la sogs 'du ba bzhin/ /rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus/ /rta skad thengs gsum bton pa yis/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyang / /rgyal khrims dam pa'i dmangs rnams bzhin/ /rang dbang med par 'dur gyis btang / /de ni rta mgrin rnal 'byor ro/ /pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa'i tha ram bshad 129

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6ljang zhur rlung lnga ye shes ldan: rta skad rngam sgras chos kyi phang po ༄sdud: phag zhal nag mo ngur sgra phyogs bcur sgrogs: khams gsum dbang sdud phyogs bcu'i dregs pa 'dul: gnyis med trīḥhūṃ dug lnga'i rtog pa 'joms: zhes gsungs shing skyabs rjes phag mo'i khrid gnang skabs shig tu yang / phag zhal gyi ngur sgras khams gsum ma lus pa bde ba chen po'i dbyings su sdud nus pa:zhes bka' basprul pa dran no/ /pra bha ka ras mdzad pa'i rta mgrin sgrub thabs las/ pa la sha'i mdog can gyi rta gdong gsungs nas/rta'i gdong ba ni gzhan pa med pa'i sems kyi rang bzhin 'di chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa dang / lam rnam par dab/ par sazhol bar mngon par brjod do/ /zhes dang / thogs pa med pa'i ye shes kyi sems dud 'gro'i zhal du bstan to/ /zhes so/ /sangs rgyas gsang bas rnam snang mngon byang thi 'grel par/ rta mgrin zhes su grags zhes pa ni chos la 'bigs pa'i yeshes myur zhing malhogs pa rta dang 'dra ba dang / sems can gyi don bya ba la mgyogs ('dis ni thugs rje'i shugs myur bar bstan pas/ 'grub zag nye bar shes nus) pa rta dang 'dra ba'i phyir rta mgrin zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /yang de nyid las/ zhi rgyas dbang gi phrin las gsum mtshon pa'i kha dog dkar ser sngon po rnams 'dus pa'i ljang gus ni lasasna 133

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i bsung 'bum/nga tshogs kyi bdag nyid du mtshon zhes lha mo sgrol ma'i skabs su bsungs so/ /rta zhal steng phyogs ring por bstod de 'tsher bas ni/sa bla'i mthar thug pa'i dregs ldan dbang du byed par jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i rta mgrin sgrub thabs shig tu snang ngo / /('di blo 'chugs yin gyi/ rtogs pa bdun brgya pa las gsungs pa'i rta mgrin gyi spub thabs su/ rta zhal sngon po tī tī'i sgra sgrogasapa/ srid rtse'i mthar thug pa'i tshangs pa 'i sgo nga'i rtse rta zhal gyis mnan pa / zhes pa 'di las gzhan mi snang ste/ de'ang jo bo'i gzhung yin par ma bshad/ g.yas phyogs su balhas te 'tsher ba'i rtas sa chen po las rnam par rgyal bar byed par sha lo ho tras bshad pa sogs 'aka' zhig kyang chos mthun sbyor yul du yod dam snyam/ rang mchan) sa gzhi la rta'i mchog tu gyur pa rigs bzang zhing rnam 'gyur med pa ni/ ā dzā ne ya:cang shes rnams te/g.yul du mtshon chas lci bar bsnun kyang bdag po gang yin pa 'dor bar mi byed pa'o/ /zhes 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel par ༷ bshad de/ bka' gter mang por gzhan don la spro ba mi 'phrobs pa'i brtson 'grus kyi lhar mtshon pa'i phyir rta zhal 'chang bar bshad pa la mkho/ yang de nyid las/ ā dzā ne ya'i ā mngon par khyab pa ste bgrod bya'i gnas su zhon pa pos bzhon nas shugs kyis phyin par byed pa ni nges pa'i tshig go /gang du legs par khur 'khyer ba'i tshul can bde bar bzhon par byar yod pa de ni pi bhā ta:ste rnam par dul ba zhes bya'o/ /zhes bshad de chos mtshungs 134

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/྾ ྾4 ྾ tsu mtshon pa mya ngan 'das/ /rdo rje rta skad gzugs su rnam par te/ / longs spyod sku la gsal la ye shes ni/ /gsal ba rang bzhin med par mtshon pa mya ngan 'das/ /rdo rje rta skad 'du byed sasung du snang / /cir yang sprul te ye shes so sor rtog /banyis mtha' dngos med mtshon pa mya ngan 'das/ /rdo rje rta skad 'du shes phrin las grub/ /mngon par byang chub ye shes nan tan te/ /mthar phyin lhun grub mtshon pa mya ngan 'das/ /rdo rje rta skad tshor ba yon tan 'byung / /mi 'gyur sku la mnyam pa'i ye shes gsal/ /mi mnyam mnyam par mtshon pas mya ngan 'das/ /kun rdzob sgra dbyangs 'byung ba'i gnas dag ni/ /de nyid las sprul rdo rje rta yi dbu/ /mgrin pa pad+ma'i ye shes 'khor lo ste/ /thabs nyid yab ste ya mgal rtags/ /shes rab yum ste ma mgal mam/ /gnyis med lce ste jiḥnyid 'byung / /de phyir rdo rje rta yi mgrin par brjod/ /rdo rje rta skad dpe ni nam mkhar bzhag /nam mkha'i rang bzhin ma skyes ma 'gags pas/ /snang srid kun kyang mtshon pas mya ngan 'das/ /rdo rje rta skad don ni chos nyid de/ /chos nyid bde chen ma skyes mi bskyed pas/ /de phyir chos nyid kun kyang mya ngan 'das/ /rdo rje rta skad rtags ni sems nyid de/ /sems nyid rang bzhin ma skyes mi 'gag pas/ /de bzhin sems can mtshon pa mya ngan 'das//136

dbang chen rta skad/ pod1 6྾4 ྾ —de ltar gdul bya'i don du sa/sungs pa yang / /phung po khams dang skye mched ma lus pa/ /pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor ye nas yin/ /yin pa'i don la rig pa gsal bkod nas/ /bde chen byang chub sems su sangs rgyas so/ /sems dang ye shes dbyer med don bcig pas/ /rtog pa ye shes sems su kun rtogs na/ /bde chen byang chub sems su sangs rgyas so/ /'khor ba'i rgyu nyid thar pa'i lam gyi skabs/ /duḥkha'i rgyu nyid chos nyid byang chub sems/ /ma spangs lhun gyis grub pa'i don rtosas na/ /bde chen byang chub sems su sangs rgyas so/ /ye shes rta mgrin rang bzhin rta mgrin dang / /las la sogs pa mang po'i tshig brjod kyang / /bdag ni byin rlabs khro bor snang ba las/ /gzhan na khro bor grub pa ci yang med/ /bdag snang bdag 'khol las kun bdag byed de/ /bdag gis g.yos na phyi nang snod bcud g.yo/ /kun tu che btsan 'gran gyi zla med pas/ /yongs la thogs med bde 'byams rgya mtsho la/ /bde chen byang chub sems su sangs rgyas so/ /thams cad byang chub sems su rtogs pas gang yang lhun gyis grub/ /rnam rtog ming yang med pas gang bsgral ci mi ltas/ /thabs mkhas rol pa yin pas 'khor ba'i skyon ma gos/ /thugs rje byang chub yin pas thar pa bde chen thob/ /kun gyi bdag nyid yin pas mkha' 'gro 137

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/r+shangang gis 'khor/ /bde chen rgyal po yin pas 'khor kyi rje bo yin//thams cad bdag las byung bas kun gyi bdag po yin/ /nga rgyal rtab/sa su che bas 'gro drug thabs kyis 'dul/ /thugs rje'i 'brug sgras khams gsum yongs su ldir/ /thugs rje'i byams ldan nyi ma'i 'od bzhin 'char/ /rnam rtog gnyen por mi rtos ye shes che/ /'khor ba'i gnyen por rang 'byung sangs rgyas te/ /rnam rtos thabs kyi sanyen por gang rtogs na/ /mkha' 'gro 'du bar bya ba'i thabs gzhan med/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa'i don rtogs nas/ /'khor dgra bsgral zhing tshar bcad bya mi dgos/ /ye shes 'jam dpal mtshan gyis rab rdzogs nas/ /rgyal byed rtags dang phyag rgya bsgrub mi dgos/ /phrin las bya rtsol blo las ye 'das na/ /sgom grub dkyil 'khor bya ba ci yang med/ /'di ltar man ngab rtogs pa'i gdeng gyur na/ /bsgrub na skyon med ma bsgrub 'gal ba med/ /bsgral na skyon med ma bsgral 'gal ba med/ /bsam du med do chos dbyings nam mkha' 'dra/ /sgom du med do rang 'byung klong nas shar/ /bde 'byams dbyings phyug yum kyi rgyal po yin/ /ma 'gags ci bder yin gyis yab kyi mkha'/ /sems la gang yang mi rtog rang 'byung sku/ /thabs la gang yang mi 'gog ma bcos skru/ /don la gang yang mi rtog chos kyi sku/ /chos kyi sku la 138

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ྾4 — ྾r+yā—'gyur ba'i gdeng dang ldan par bya'o: nang dug lnga'i rnam rtob gang skyes kyi steng du yang brtul zhugs 'di dag btang na shin tu zab par snang / bar chad mthar phyin pa ni nang gi bar chad yin pas de 'dul ba la nan tan bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ grol tig rta mgrin dresas 'dul dang de gnyis lha sngags dang bshad tshul gcig tu 'dug pas grol tig gi lung mkhas pa'i yid 'phrogs su bris pa dang bsgrig rgyu yin no/ /rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud gcig po de nyid bka' 'dum gyi skor gnyis su bzhugs pa las snga ma zhal gdams skor pa yin la/sgrub thabs skor pa na/ brtul zhugs gsum gyi dang po gnyis sngar dang ha lam 'dra/ de nas/ sems ting nge 'dzin gyi brtul zhugs kyis mi 'jigs pa'i gdeng bca' ba ni: rang dang lha banyis dbyer med pas: sems skye med kyi rang bzhin ngar dang bcas la: gang la yang 'jigs pa'i nyam nga ba dang bag tsha ba med par gdon bgegs kyi steng du thog brdzis bya'o: skabs su rta skad 'don zhing brtul zhus/sa bya'o: lus rta mgrin gyi skrur gsal bas lus lha'i gdeng gis zin pas lha mi srin sde brgyad dbang du 'dus: ngag sngags su gsal bas dregs pa can thams cad bka' nyan gsung sdod: yid chos nyid du gsal bas 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad zil gyis non no: de lta bu'i dgongs 14 2

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6ra pa dang ldan tsa na lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'dus par 'gyur ro:byang gter gegs sel las/ gsang spyod 'di ni 'dre rdog gcig po ma yin pa'i:mdze lhog nad rims thams cad: nyam nga ba: bag tsha ba: mi gtsang ba: mi sdug pa: skyubs bro ba: nyams dma' ba: shed chung ba: ngo tsha ba la sobs mdor na rtog pa skyes tshad gong bzhin du bcad do: zhes gsungs te pad+ma'i lam rim 'grel bar yang zhu dag pher/ dregs pa can thams cad las la bkol nas bran bzhin du las byed de: sarba spru ta trig nan zhes pa sngasas la btags nas rta bro brdung ngo: bar chad thams cad rdul du 'gro'o: zhes grol tig ltar gsungs so/ /yang bka' 'bum byin rlabs sba chos las/ lha 'dre 'gyur med kyi srang la 'jug pa la gsung ste: ri rab kyi khong gseng du mnan pa dang: rgya mtsho'i gting du mnan pa dang: chu bo'i gzhung la mnan pa'o: ri rab khong seng la mnan pa ni: 'dre dang gdon rang gi sems su shes: sems stong par shes: stong pa la gnod byed ma grub pas: rang lta ba mi 'gyur ba'i gdeng dang ldan pa la lha 'dre ldang mi nus so/ /rgya mtsho'i gting du mnan pa ni: 'dre rnam rtog yin te rtog pa sems las byung: sems ngo bo stong pa yin:gsal la dwangs pa yin: stong gsal rtog med la lha 'dre ma grub pa de sgom pa yin no: chu bo'i gzhung la mnan pa ni: lha 143

pob/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsungaX'adum/ba —ma 4'dre'i rtog pa sems yin: rtog pa rgyun chad med par sems las skyes: lha'i bzang rtog dang 'dre'i ngan rtog thams cad byung yang sems las byung: grol yang sems su grol bas rang shar rang grol rgyun chad med pa ni thugs rje chen po'i spyod pa yin no: de ltar du rtogs tsa na lha 'dre 'gyur med kyi srang du tshud pa zhes bya'o: 'dre'i 'gyu srung rnam rtog yin pas/ nom rtob de ro snyom gyi gnad kyis thad kar gcod pa 'di la/ bgebs kyi lam srang gcad pa zhesasasungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ bro mnan rnams su bar chad rnam thar sgo gsum gyi klong du rgyas 'debs byed par gsungs pa dang / bong gi brtul zhugs bdun pa dang / 'di rnams lto sbyar na bro mnan gyi dkongs pa la nges pa ster ro/ /'gyur med kyi srang du 'dzud ces pa ni skor lnga'i skabs su/ bzlog sgyur yongs grub 'od gsal chen po'i dbyings: mi ldog phyag rgyas 'debs pa'i phrin las mdzod:ces pa dang don 'dra ste/ de'ang dngos 'dzin gzhir bzhag gi steng nas bar chad zlog pa'i thabs mang po 'tshol ba ni/ khyi rdo rjes su rgyug pa'i dpe ltar gnod pa gcig gnyis las thar yang da dung 'dzad med du rting mnan nas yong bas snying po chung la/'dir bshad pa'i zab gnad 'di yod na/ rmi lam du 'jibs skrag chu bo'i gnyer ma ltar 'byung bzhin pa'i 'phro la gnyid gcig 144

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba de kho na nyid kyi sbyin sreg 'jog tshul sogs la ltos dang / srung zlog mnan sreg thams cad kyi skabs su/ gadzu bo brgya'i nang nas gros thag chod nus gcig zer ba lta du ni/ dbang chen glu sar gyi de nyid bde stong dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor 'di nyid yin par nges so/ /rta mchog rol pa'i tan+t+ra le'u brgya re gcig par/ tshangs sogs zhing khams sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dbyangs drug rtogs pa'i lta bar bzhag /bro drug rdzogs pa'i spyod lam yin/ /dbyangs drug gdangs su blang ba ni/ /grub pa'i dbyangs kyis thubs dam bskang //tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis zhing khams sbyangs/ /gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis ma sring mnyes/ /las kyi dbyings kyis pho nya 'gyed/ /sgyu ma'i dbyangs kyis dgongs rgyud gsal/ /'bar ba'i dbyangs kyis bdud bzhi 'dul/ /hūṃ bi dbyangs kyis 'phro 'du 'khrugs/ /gru gu'i rta mgrin dregs sgrol gyi bro rabs las/ gru drug gsang ba'i dbyings dang sbyor:bro drug 'dul ba'i las dang sbyor: zhes gsungs/ der glu drug kyang / gru drug dbyangs su blang ba ni: tshangs pa'i glus ni zhing khams sbyong: dpal gyi glus ni 'apo 'du gsal: khro bo'i glus ni bdud bzhi 'dul: gsang ba'i glus ni ma sring bsten:hūṃ sgra'i glus ni 'phro 'du 'khrugs: dbu ma'i grus ni dgongs rgyud gsal: zhes byung /gar gyi bro brdung byin rlabs che/ /dbang gyi bro brdung dug gsal 'joms/ /pad+ma'i bro brdung chags pa med/ /khro bo'i bro brdung dregs pa 'joms/ /phra men bro ni 'gugs sbyong byed/ /rdzogs 146

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6 nga pa'i bros ni las rnams 'grub/ /ces gsungs/ gru gu yang dbang sga rta mgrin bro rabs las ni/ bro drug rdzokas par ldan par brdung: khro bo'i bro brdung drebs pa'ajoms: dpal gyi bro brdung bdudaXbazhi 'dul: ma sring bro brdung bdug pa 'du' : dbang gi bro brdung srin po 'dul: las kyi bro brdung pho nyar 'gyed:zal 'byor brobardung thugs dam bskul: 'di ni dpal gyi thugs dam yinaḥ 'di ni yum gyi gsang tshig yin: 'di ni ma sring dngos grub yin: 'di ni pho nya'i longs spyod yin: zhes bshad do/ /gzhan yang rta rgyud las/ breng nge ba dang /dung nge ba dang / sha ta pa dang / ga ta pa dang / cang ga de'u dang /pang ka de'u'i glu drug dang/ /'di drug la sgyu 'phrul lam rim 'grel par/'bring po banyis/ ring po gnyis/ thung ngu gnyis 'es bshad do/ /de das dang so sor sbyar rgyu'i bro drug so so'i yon tan dang bcas te sasungs pa rnams bde 'dus sman sgrub tu yang 'byung la/ bde 'dus kyi skabs der/ sngon gyi rgyal ba glu yis 'grub: ris 'dzin rdo rje gru yis 'dren: rnal 'byor dbang phyug glu yis 'grub: bstan pa rgya mtsho glu yis spel: sman gyi rig 'dzin glu yis 'bebs: srid pa'i bu mo glu yis bsten: bdud dang srin po glu yis 'dul: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho glu yis 'bod: dngos grub rgya mtsho glu yis thob: phrin las rgya mtsho glu yis byed: de phyir glu 'di rtag tu blangs: zhes sogs glu bro'i yon tan rgya cher bshad do/ /dbang chen yang sasang las rta mgrin gyi spyod pa'i 147

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾྾྾44྾—4— man ngag tu/ dpal rta mgrin bsgrubs nas: bar chad 'dul ba'i phyir: dur khrod kyi gnas dben par gzhan gyis ma tshor bar rta skad 'don pa'i rngam stabs bya'o: bro brdung saziraXmanan bya'o: zhes rgyun spyod kyi nang du'o/ /sgyu 'phrul las/ sgyugs pa'i 'thor rlung g.yeng ba che/ /zhes par/ 'khor sdud pa'i bshugs pa snyan pa dang / gdug pa 'dul ba'i bshusas pa drag pa dang /byin 'bebs pa'i bshugs pa byings che ba'am gdangs 'tsher la yun ring ba ste/ de gsum po'i dbugs kyis khams gsum 'thor bar byed pa'i rlung chen pos g.yeng ba 'gran zla med par che ba'o/ /zhes sgrol g.yung gnyis kyis bshad pa'ang rta skad dang tshul mthun no/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo'i bam sgrub las/ bshugs pa'i rta skad 'bod: ces kyang ngo / /nyang gter mkha' 'gro chen mo'i tshogs mchod kyi cho gar/ rta phag yab yum 'khor bcas kyi bro brdung rgyas pa/ dgra ni thal bar rlog pa'i bro: bdud ni phye mar 'thag pa'i bro: de phyir glu bro rgyun mi bcad: ces pa'i 'gres byang can zhig gsungs pa'i mthar/ byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i dus dang: bar chad 'dul ba'i dus dang: gtor gzhong gnon pa'i dus rnams su bro 'di brdung ngo: zhes bshad do/ /rta mgrin gyi gar dgu la bshad tshul bye brag pa ni/ dresas pa 48

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 64ma gnad 'bebs rgyud las/ lha chen gzhon nu gdong drug gis/ /lha min ba su ka ra bsad/ /de la dpa' bor mtshan btags pas/ /de bcom dpa' bo te ru ka /dbang phyug chen po 'khyud nyams sgegs/ /de bcom sku la yum 'khril sgegs/ /khyab 'jug phag seng 'jigs gzugs nyams/ /de bcom he ru ka 'jigs rung / / skru yi gar gsum bstan pa ni/ /sku la tshor ba bde sdug nub/ /tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs rta skad snyan/ /de bcom rtasas su zhal g.yas bzhad/ /tshogs kyi bdag po glang sna gshe /de bcom zhal sayon khro bar bshad/ /sgra gcan nyi zla khar mid rngam/ /de bcom dadus kyi zhal dmar rngam/ /gsung gi gar sum bstan pa ni/ /gsung la tshor ba bde sdug nub/ /brgya byin lab na rdo rje thogs/ /lha rnams snying rje'i sems kyis skyong / /de bcom pas ni snying rje mdzad/ /klu chen se sha tsa ra yis/ /'gre ldog byas pas sa 'gul byung / /de bcom klu brgyan ngo mtshar che/ /me lhas stong gsum me yis bshigs/ /de bcom me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /thugs kyi gar gsum bstan pa ni/ /thugs la tshor ba bde sdug nub/ /ces so/ /rngog ma le brgan las ni/ sgeg pa'i nyams kyis sgeg pa'i gar mdzod la/ /'dod chags dbang phyug gdul bar mdzod/ /khyod ni dpa' bo chen po ste/ /lha min ba su ka ra 'dul bar mdzod//1 49

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾྾྾tsu྾—4yab la'ang 'dra bar/ mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor du'i phrin las chen mo las/ spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang gu 'tsher ba las: rdzu 'phrul myur mgyogs ston pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: khro zhal dmar po cung zad bzhad pa las: bde chen las la khol ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: bdechen rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes phag gi zhal dang / kun rtob bag chags dang bcas pa za ba dme ba zaba'i don du mngon/ yab 'dod chags rta'i gdong pas lhan skyes kyi bde— ba dang / yum mi rtog phag gi gdong pas stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshon te/ thabs kyi sku mdog dmar po dang / shes rab mthing khar bstan pa'i don yang des shes/ rta zhal spyan gsum gyen la bzigs pa las:skru gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i ḍā ki 'bum: khro zhal spyan gsum thur la gzib/sa pa las: khams gsum zil gyis banon pa'i ༷ mkha' 'gro 'bum: zhes so/ /yang phag mo'i gsang skrub las:phag zhal ni: phab gti mug che zhing gtsang btsog med pa dang 'dra bar: gti nug ma spangs par rang sar dag nas thugs rje ye shes kyi brtul zhugs kyis nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa rtsad nas gcod pa'o: zhes dang / yang gsang sgrub cis las/rnam rtog grogs su khyer bas bzang ngan spong len dang gtsang btsog med pas phag zhal: zhes so/ /phag mo rigs 'dus ma'i skrub thabs las/ rnam rtog gtsang dme med pas phag gdong nag 16 2

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6— ྾ mo spyi gtsug tu 'thon pa: don dam chos nyid mi 'gyur bas nag mo: sems can don la thugs rjes 'jug pas bde bas g.yas ngos su lha ba: gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod cing 'dul bas phag skad du ngur ba: dregs pa can bdud dang dgra bgegs la sogs pa'i bar chad thams cad 'jibs par mdzad pa: bdag gi dbang du bsdus nas bka' nyan las la 'khol bar byedapa: 'jig rten 'das pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro sde lnga la sogs pa dang 'jig rten ma 'das pa'i dur khrod brgyad kyi mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dbang du sdud pas bka' nyan gsung sdod 'khor du bskor ba: zhes sasungs/ rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i cho gar yang / khro zhal dmar mo bzhad pa'i zhal: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dam la snyud:(mkha' 'gro rgya mapho 'grel bar/ thams cad 'dod chags chen mo'i bdag nyid du za bas na phag mo'o/ /zhes phung khams skye mched thams cad mchog gi dga' ba'i ngo bo nyid du za bas na phag mor bshad de/ 'di spru nang gsang ba'i phag mo gsum ka la sbyor chog pa 'dra/ yang na/ phyin ci log gi spros pa'i dme ba mtha' dag rnam dbye med par bde stong rang gi ngo bor za bas te/ phag mo shes rab kyi phyogs yin pas stong phyogs gtso snyam) spyi gtsug phag gdong ngur sgra 'don: 'jig rten dregs pa las la 'khol: zhes so/ /phag mo sngon mo'i sgrub thabs las/ phag mo'i ngur sgras gdug pa 153

pa / nga — nga da ba ba ji ba sa ba ba bad na nying gad nga ba nga ma/'dul: srid pa gsum po za bar byed: ces so/ /phrin las chen mo las: kun rdzob rang bzhin khro zhal dmar mo las: snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i ḍa ki 'bamaX don dam rang bzhin phag 'a da nu zhal nag mo las: brgyal nad thru 'bogs gtong ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: zhes so/ /de thams cad mkha' 'gro chen mo'i skor ro/ / yang phag mo sngon mo snga ma las/ khro zhal thugs la gzigs pa khams gsum sems can la kun rdzob tu thubs rjes sazigs pa'o:phag zhal sngon mo gyen la gzigs pa ni don dam mya ngan las 'das pa la 'god pa'o: zhes so/ /khros nag gi snyan brgyud 'grel par/ spyi gtsug phag zhal nam mkha'i gnas: zhes pas:spyi gtsug ral pa'i gseb nas phag zhal nas po byung nas gyen dugazigs pas rtog med nam mkha' lta bu'i dgongs pa la dus rtas tu banas pa'i brda'o: de yang phag zhal steng du ngur bas gzugs med kyi khams thams cad dbang du sbud pa: phag skad bar du ngur bas gzugs khams thams cad dbang du sdud pa:phag skad 'og tu ngur bas 'dod khams thams cad dbang du sdud pa: phas skad phyogs bzhir sgrogs pas mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi dbang du snyud pa'o: zhes gsungs/ khros ma'i mchod gzhung las/phab skad shar du bsgrags pa yis: rdo rje mkha' 'gro pho nyar 6

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6'gyed: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i brtul zhugs kyis: shar phyogs dri za'i gdon tshogs dbang du bsnyus: shar du dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gnas su/ lho ru/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ nub tu/ pad+ma/ byang du/ las kyi/ shar lhor/ dam tshig mkha' 'gro/ lho nub/ sna tshogs/ nub byang / thams cad/ byang shar/ 'jig rten/ steng du/ sangs rgyas/ 'og tu/ log 'dren mkha' 'gro/ zhes dang /shar phyogs dri za'i/ zhes par/ lho phyogs gshin rje'i/ klu dbang /byang gnod sbyin/ me lha'i/ srin po'i/ rlung lha'i/ 'byung po'i/steng lha'i/ 'og sa gdon tshogs noms dbang du sdud: ces bcug pa bshad/ dar sbu'i sgrub gzhung las/ spyi gtsug tu phag zhal nag mo tshangs pa'i dbyings su ngur ba: thengs gsum ngur bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa: thengs gsum ngur bas srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa: thengs gsum rur bas dgos 'dod thams cad char ltar 'bebs pa: zhes gsungs so/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi sgrub tshul las/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dbang du sdud mdzad pa: dpa' bo dbang chen rta mgrin rgyal po la: zhes dang / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams las la khol mdzad ma: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo rdo rje phag mo la: zhes so/ /rta mgrin hūṃ mdzad chen po'i rgyud las/ dang po gsung gi sgra 166

pod/ 6 rdo grung bang med bstan nyi'i bsung 'bum/ nga nga bsgrags pas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs dam bsgul/ /bar du gsung gi sgra bsgrags pas/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub 'bebs /tha mar dbang gi sgra bsgrags pas/ /ngan song 'khor ba gtan nas sgrol/ /bdud srin klu rnams zil gyis mnan/ /zhes sogs/sku phyag rgya/ gsung rig pa/ thugs phyag mtshan/ yon tan bcud len/ phrin las gdab kha'i las sbyor sogs las/ che mchog rin chen nyid ma'i rigs yin pas bdud rtsi'i sgrub lugs dang sbyor ba bzhin/ pad+ma gsung yang rta skad kyi sgrub lubs dang sbyor la/ nga rgyal rdo rje rgyas las la bsngags pas bdud rtsi sgrub skabs dngos grub thams cad rgyas las kyi sgrom du bcug nas sgrub pa ltar/'dod chags rdo rje bsung gi sgrub par dngos grub mtha' dag dbang gi phrin las kyi sgrom du bcub nas sgrub bo/ /che mchog gi skabs su'ang / dngos grub dbang byed la rta mgrin bsngags te/ dkyil 'khor drug dang sbyor ba brgyad las rjes chags kyi 'od zer spro ba/ des 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub kyi bdud rtsi dgub pa/ de nyid dkyil 'khor ba'i sbyor mtshams sa bskyil ba/ gsang banas kyi sgo dbye ba/༄ rdzas la dbab pa rnams grub pa'i 'og tu/ bdud rtsi'i dngos grub de nyid gzhan gyis 'phrog tu med pa dang / sgrub pa pos longs 166

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jisas med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/r+yā ྾ ྾—྾ ྾ 4྾྾pa ni med dam snyam/ nyang gter rta mgrin bde gshebs gcika dril las/ dbang chen bsgrub pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad shugs 'byung du 'grub par gsungs te/ rga shi med pa za dngos grub/ byin rlabs dbang gi dngos grub/ drag po mthu'i dngos grub/ btsan phyub/ nor gyi dngos grub/ pu tra mi'i dngos grub/ 'gro bas bkur ba'i dngos grub/ 'tsho ba zas kyi dngos grub/ thun mong du las sna tshogs 'grub pa'i dngos grub dang brgyad do/ /yul gsum gyad du gyur ces pa'i dang po yid kyi yul du gsal ba ni sla/ gnyis pa dbang po'i yul du sasal ba ni lha dngos kyi zhal mthong ba lta bu la mi byed/ sems shin tu koms pa'i dbang gis lha lam stong gzugs lta du'i lha'i snang ba mthong ba la byed gsungs te lang gshegs las ting nge 'dzin gyi rtags snang la zla ba dang nyi ma 'dra ba sogs mthong bar bsungs pa lta bu'am/rnam 'grel las 'dod 'jigs koms pa'i snang ba lta bu/ zhes pas dpogs/ gsum pa lus yul du gsal ba ni ris gzhan gyis kyang lhar mthong du btub pa zhig yin gsungs te/ 'di sgyu ma mkhan pos (nusaXpa thob tshad sgyu ma mkhan dang 'dra zer ba sogs ni gtan min no)rde shing rta glang sogs su ston pa lta bur mngon/ rta skad gtsug thon yang phyi ma (spyir rta skad gtsug thon la'ang rim pa du ma zhig yod 'dra yang /168

྾ dbangachenarta skad pod/ shā'adi ma mtha'i mtshams bshad pa'o/ /) 'di la sbyar 'dug pas bskyed rim rags pa mthar son pa na 'ong bar bzhed 'dra// //༄/ /rta dzab skor gyi dran tho dngos grub rgya mtsho'i mjod khang /gsang rdzobs rgyud las/ ye shes 'jig rten gang bsgrub kyang: srog sdom gzer bzhi ma jebs na: nam yang don med yub sa rkyang: drang don rdzun gyi 'khrul 'khor yin: yongs rdzogs dpal gyi srog 'phrog thabs: gcig shes pas ni kun sros thob: dper na sgra gcan 'dzin gyi khams: nam mkha'i nyi ma gcig zin pas: chu phran stong gi nyi ma kun: ma bzung bar yang stong srob thob: de phyir srog gi gzer bzhi gces:dben pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal bshams: dbas su mtshan ldan ka ༄rā lar: dpal chen sku gcib gsal bar dbod: bskyed rdzogs gzhung bsrang dzab rdzogs rjes: mi rtog bya bral so mar bzhag: de nas dpal gyi srog 'phrob thabs: ting 'dzin gzer dang snying po'i gzer: dgongs pa'i gzer dang 'phro 'du'i gzer: ting 'dzin gzer ni thod sku la: rtse gcig sems bzung yengs mi bya: yul gsum gyad du gyur ba dang:dpal chen he ru dngos dang mjal: bzlog pa he ru kas mi 69

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/de la bsang rdzogs kyi dzab dgongs chen mo las/ pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa la dgongs pa rnam pa bzhi ste: drag sngags bsnyen pa bskyal ba'i dkongs pa ni: bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen dpa' bo gcig par bsgom pa'i spyi gtsug gi snang ba mtha' yas kyi thubs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sku la phog pas skrus mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: sems can gyi lus kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs: tshur 'dus pas bde bar gshegs pa'i sku'i dngos grub dbyig bsdus: dadu gtsug rta mgrin gyi mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros: sa/sung la phob pas gsung mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: sems can gyi ngag la phog pas ngag gi sgrib pa sbyangs: tshur 'dus pas bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi dngos grub dbyig bsdus: pad+ma dbang chen gyi thusas ka nas 'od zer mthing kha 'phros: bde bar gshegs pa'i thags la phog pas thags mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul:dang dngapa'isems can gyi yid la phog pas yid — sgrib pa sbyangs: tshur 'dus pas thugs kyi dngos grub dbyig bsdus par bsgom mo:phar 'phros pa dang tshur 'dus pa'i dpe mgal me'i 'khor lo lta bu'o: ye shes kyi 'od zer 'phros pa'i dpe gser gyi ba thag 'dzings pa lta bu'o: drag po sngags kyi 'od zer 'phro ba'i dpe 6 2

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6pa'o: de ltar pad+ma dbang chen gyi: bsnyen pa'i sngags kyi don bstan pa: dpal gyi rta skad jengs gsum dang : ma mo'i 'gying skad thengs gsum dang : rnal 'byor brda skad rbengs gsum gyi:dang pos snang srid thams cad kun: rta mgrin dbang gi lha ru gyar: gnyis pas snang srid sha khag 'gyar: gsum pas ma sring dang ba da dbyings nas bskul: bstan pa'i mkhar spe'u brtsigs pa'o:'di lta bu yi don rtogs na: rta mgrin dbang gi rnal 'byor yin:lha srin las la 'di yis 'khol: lha 'dre'i dmag dpung 'di yis 'joms: nā ga klu rnams 'di yis thul: drag sngags bsnyen pa 'di yis skyol: gsung gi dngos grub 'di yis 'thob:dbang chen sku yang 'di yis mthong : gsang sngags zab mo'i man ngag 'di: skal med rmongs pa'i gang zag dab: kun la bstan par ma gsungs so: zhes gsungs/ 'di ni phyi ma'i phyi ma sngags kyi rgyud las kyang ji lta ba bzhin gsungs so/ /'on kyang rgyud kyi dpe 'a 'chad tshul dang por/ ta bde ba chen po: ha bdag gi skru: zhes dang 'chad tshul gsum par: hūṃ gtub sod: phaṭa skred sreg: ces snang / (gsang rdzogs gdeng brgyad kyi nang tshan klu spub kyi gdeng las/ ru lu ru lu ma mo mkha' 'gro/ hūṃ dam la sdud pa/ sgo las la 'dzud pa/ hūṃ las la rbad pa'am bskul ba zhes bshad de ha lam 'og tu 'byung 167

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs medaXbastan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ba dnga'adra/ 'di gtso sngags la mi mkho yang spyi dzab skabs sbyor rgyu'o) bde 'dus rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bzhi bar/ oṃ dz+ra ma hā gro ta tse kṛ wa (sngakas 'di la/ dbang chen gtso bo dang rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ yum pad+ma gzi ldan ma/dbang chen rigs ba'iyab yum/ zil gnon yab yum bcu drug sgo ma bzhi/khams rgya dmus long sogs pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas pa tshang bas pad+ma dbang chen yongs rdzogs kyi snying po zhes bshad par gsang rdzogs sngabs byang las gsungs) hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: thog mtha' o dang phaṭa bzhag nas: bar na bcu bzhi'i grong mdzes pa: pad+ma'i lha rgyud snying po yin: dbang gi thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing : khrag 'thung lha tshogs dgyes pa dang : rnal 'byor nyams chag sdig sgrib sbyangs: ye shes lha dang gnyis su med: bsung gi rig 'dzin thob par 'gyur: zhes gsungs so/ /bde 'dus dbang chen 'dus rgyud ltar sngags don bshad na/oṃ ye shes lnga nyid rtogs pa/ pad+ma dngos po kun la ma chags pa/ta kri ta khro bo'i gar dgu rdzogs pa/ badz+ra kro dha che btsan thams cad 'dul ba'i rdo rje khro bo/ t+ya gre wa khams gsum dbang du sdud pa rta mgrin nyid yin zhes pa/ hu lu hu lu khro bo'i tshogs kyi sprul pa 'gyed pa/ ru lu (sngon ru tras rang gi 'khor dbang du sdud pa'i sngags kyang ru luXru lu zhes pa 'di yin par bsnyen sgrub kyi ti ka las so/ /'di la dpyad na dbang 168

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6ba phyug nyer brgyad kyi 'bod sngags kyang bh+yo kho na'i nges bzung mi dgos pa 'dra/) ru lu khro bo khro mo'i tshogs kun dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dbang du snyud pa/ hūṃ dregs pa'i tshogs rnams las la 'bod pa/ bh+yo de dag las la rbad pa/ hūṃ ni dngos grub nye bar bsdu ba/ zhes bya'o/ /pad phrin rje'i rang shar rnam nges su/ hu lu hu lu 'bad pa 'bad pa zhes bsgyur cing / de'ang 'dir las kyi dbang gis 'bad cig 'bad cig ces bsgyur na legs gsung /de ni dngos grub stsol ba la brtson 'grus kyis 'bad pa mdzod cig pa'i don te/ 'dir/ chos dbang rta nag sogs las rta zhal brtson 'grus kyi shugs myur ba'i mtshan mar bshad pa dang / byang chub yan lag gi brtson 'grus rta mchog dang sbyar nas mdo rgyan du bshad pa'ang dran par bya'o/ /gur gyi 'grel par/ hu lu (hu luhu lu zhugs shig zhugs shig par bsgyur ba'ang mang bas/ dpal rta mgrin bdag gi sgo gsum la zhugs shig ces bshad na'angarung bar sems/ mnyam sbyor lasaXso/ /) hu lu zhes pa zhig mdzod cig mdzod cig par bshad/ yang dbang chen 'dus pas/ dīḥni thams cad nga yi ngang du bsam: zhes dang / trīḥdabang du sdud pa'i sgra/ zhes kyang ngo (nyang gi khros ma dīḥnag mo'i sgrub thabs las/ rdo rje phag mo khros nag gi srog sngags kyang jiraḥbashad do/ /169

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma ma gsung rta skad 'byin pa'i dus ni bzlas pa gsung gi rnal 'byor gyi skabs 'di nyid yin te/ bde 'dus dzab bsnyen las shes shing / gsang rdzogs dzab dbo/ngas kyi gsum pas kyang mtshon no/ /des na rta skad zin bris skor yang 'dir sbyar ro/ /sngon rta mchog te ru ka la rigs lnga'i de bzhin gshegs pa man chad kyi srid zhi'i gtso bo rnams kyis rang rang gi sros gi snying po phul bar dbang chen 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs te/ de ni 'di'i sgrub pa po rnams kyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad kyi dngos grub bde blag tu dbang du 'gyur ba'i ched yin te/ dzab dgongs dang po dang gsum pa la gces so/ /byed las kyi sgo nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam thams cad bsdus pa ni lhan skyes kyi ye shes yin pas/ de brjod byar blang zhing / de'i rang bzhin can gyi rta skad kyang rgyal ba'i chos mdzod mtha' dag bsdus pa yin no/ /(yo ga dang gsang 'dus sogs las bde chen sor rtog ye shes la dam pa'i chos kyi ye shes dang rdo rje gsung rab kyi ye shes su bshad yod/) des na 'di nyid dbang byed kyi dgongs pa zur ba la mi ltos par yang rtsa gsum srung ma dang bcas par rang 'khor ba'i bla rdo mthar thug tu grub ste/ mdo rgyud khyad par can rnams kyi glegs bam tsam bzhugs pa'i phyogs su yang sangs rgyas byang 170

྾ dbangachenarta skad/ pod/ 6sems dang / rig 'dzin ma mo mkha' 'gro/ sde brgyad dam tshig rnams dbyar skyes kyi sprin bzhin 'du bar gsungs na/ de ltaci smos pa'i phyir/rta skad kyis las dang ye shes kyi dngos grub rab 'byams dbang du byed pa'i mthu skye ba la ni sgrub pa po rang nyid rta mchog dbang gi rgyal por byin gyis brlabs pa zhig dbos te/ rtsa brnga ba dang / zor ba brdar ba'i rigs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar byin rlabs kyi rtsal thon pa la yang / nyer len gyi rgyur dpal gyi snang zhen brtan pa dang / lhan cig byed rkyen du thog ma med pa'i dus nas grub pa'i dpal he ru ka rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa gnyis dgos te/ de gnyis kyang phan tshun grogs su 'jug pa can no/ /de'i phyir dzab dgongs dang po'i sgo nas rdo rje gsum gyi nus pa smin par byed pa 'di ni dngos grub sgrub pa la sne gcig nas zin na kun g.yo 'ong ba'i thabs dam par gzung ngo / /rta mgrin la'ang bskyed rim pa'i rta mgrin nas mi slob zung 'jug gi rta mgrin bar dbye rgyu yod pas shes par gyis/ nyams chag skong ba'i dmigs mde'u sgyur na'ang dzab dgongs dang po 'di la sbyor/ lha sngags kyi byin rlabs g.yel ba dang zhud pa gso na'ang dzab dgongs dang po rang zab par mngon te/ rdor gtsug las thun 171

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6spyi srog dang dbos srog srog rten nyi zla'i dwangs ma dang bcas pa bskul zhing rang dbang med par drangs pas rlung gis bskyod pa'i shing lo ltar lhags par blta ba ste/ dpal chen che ba'i rta skad la sogs pa'i skabs bzhin sbyar ro/ /legs par bsnyen na (bya rgyud legs grub dang bstunan) dam can mthu bo che rnams kyis sangs rgyas dngos las dngos grub bslang ste sbyin pa'ang yod par mngon no/rta skad kyis dbang drag gi las gnyis mdzad tshul ni mi dang mi min gyi 'gro ba'i yid bdag la 'chor ba ni/ de dag gi rnam shes kyi bzhon pa'i rlung gi brtan pa 'phrog pa la thug ste/ rlung gi rta dang bral na shes pa 'bye bo dang 'dra bar gsang rdzogs dang rdzobs chen skor du gsungs pas sems 'gro 'ong ni rlung gis khrid nas byed pa'i phyir ro/ /yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas spros pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa'i bde ba'i ye shes bskul te spyan 'dren pa bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzhom med nā da'i 'tsher glus/ lus can rnams kyi srog tu gyur ba'i rlung de rang dbang med par bskul zhing brlab ste/ de'i gzhan dbang can gyi sems rnams myos pa dang /(mi'am ci'i rgyalapo ljon pa'i glus dgra bcom pa rnam thar brgyad ldan rnamasakyang rang dbang med par myos nas gar byas par gsungs pa lta bu/) 'phar ba dang /173

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ba ldeg pa dang / dkrugs pa dang / dbab pa dang / dgug cing drang ba sogs byed do/ /sgyu 'phrul las/ sgyugs pa'i 'thor rlung g.yeng ba che/ /zhes dang / mdo las lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i sgras rgya mtsho'i srog chags mang po'i snying 'gas par gsungs pa bzhin/ drag po'i nga ro mi bzad pas gdug pa can rnams kyi srog la sogs pa'i rlung drag tu skul zhing gting 'khrugs par byed la/ des lus sems gtor dkrugs rmongs reng bskrad pa sogs byed do/ /(seng lhagasakyi rgyud sgras rgyud gzhan thams cad chad 'gro ba lha du'ang yin no/ /)ma mo rbod gtong gi dzab dgongs skabs/ mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i spyi gtsug rta mgrin gyi zhal nas 'tsher skad thengs sasum bsgrags pas ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang bsdus zil gyis mnan zhing srog phrogs te las la 'dzud par gsungs pa'i skabs su/ de yang khams gsum srid pa gsum na dbang che ba ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma yin pas dbang gi ma mor byas nas dbang bsgyur ba dang : sems can gyi tshe srog ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag na mnga' bas che'i ma mor byas te tshe sgrub pa dang : nad kyi bdag mo yin pas nad ngan gcod pa dang : dmod pa drag sngags kyi bdag mo yin pas dgra la rbad pa dang : thun mong gi mthu dang 174

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6rdzu 'phrul thams cad kyi bdag mo yin pas thun mong gi las gang 'dod la sbyar ba'o: de lta bu la ma mo rbod gtong gi sgrub pa zhes bya'o: zhes bde gsang gnyis kar sasungs te dzab dgongs gsum pa la mkho'o/ /skrub lung gi bka' sgo las/ pad+ma la sgrub pa brgyad du bka' bstsal pa'i pad+ma sku'i sgrub pa ni: pad+ma sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i lus pad+ma dbang chen gyi skur gsal ba'i dus na:sku la bgres rgad mi mnga' ste: rang rig pa pad+ma dbang chen gyi skus khams gsum dbang du sdud pa la pad+ma sku'i sgrub pa zhes bya'o:ngag pad+ma dbang chen gyi gsung dri ma med pa rta skad jengs gsum gyis khams gsum dbang du sdud pa la pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa zhes bya'o: yid pad+ma dbang chen gyi thugs mi rtog pa'i ye shes chen pos snang srid kyi chos thams cad bsdus pa med par ye nas dbang du 'dus pa la pad+ma thugs kyi sgrub pa zhes bya'o: de ltar pad+ma dbang chen gyi sku gsang thags che ba'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab ༄ ༄pa la 'phel 'grib mi mnga' bas pad+ma yon tan gyi sgrub pa zhes bya'o: phrin las snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus nas chos nyid skye 'as/sas med par gsal 'debs pa la pad+ma phrin las kyi sgrub pa zhes bya'o: rdo rje'i glus dbang gi che ba bstod pa dang :'khor long ba rgyab 'brel dang : rmun long 'khor ba man chad 75

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6ni yon tan rin po che nor ba rin po che'oX phaṭa ni chos kyi da 15dbyings bde ba chen por bskur ba'o: de ni sngags kyi don dang sbyar te bstan pa'o: khrab 'thung drub cu rtsa brgyad kyi snying por bstan pa ni: oṃ ni khrag 'thung yab yum bcu'i snying po'o: ru lu gong ma gau ri brgyad: ru lu 'og ma phra men rgyad: hūṃ ni 'jigs byed khro bo bcu: bh+yo dbang phyug ma nyi shu brgyad: hūṃ sgo ma bzhi: phaṭa spro ba'o: zhes gsungs shing / khrag 'thung nga brgyad dang sbyor na gzhan de dang 'dra ba las/ hūṃ snga ma sgo ma bzhi: hūṃ phyi ma dbang du sbud par sbyar te gsungs so/ /sngar gdeng brgyad kyi gzhung sogs drangs pa ltar na/ ru lu tshang ma dam can yongs rdzogs kyi bzlas sngags su byed kyang chog pa la/'dir bh+yo rkyang ma gtogs pa sbyar du med pas ci ste mi 'gal zhe na/rdo rje'i tshig gcig la'ang don mi 'dra ba du ma zhig bstan rgyu yod pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sde spyi'i lugs la yod pas skyon med do/ /gsang rdzogs dzab dgongs las lha nga brgyad dang sbyar te/hūṃ phyi ma la thugs kar sdud pa'o zhes bshad/ yang gsang rdzogs las/ oṃ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin: ru'i ra la nges tshig gis bshad na/ ra me'i sgra las rmongs pa med pa'i mdzad spyod dang thugs rje chen pos dga' bar byed pa dang : ra ga ste chags pa:179

dbang chen rta skad/ dzad/ 6ngo / /yig 'bru so sor lha so so dang sbyar ba na/ gtso sngags kho nar yang gtso 'khor thams cad tshang mod kyi/ de rnams 'dus pa la btags pa'i sngags de gtso sngags nyid du byas nas/ spyi dril zur du bshad pa ni lha'i skabs su/ gtso bo'i ye shes kyi cha rnams dkyil 'khor ba gzhan rnams kyi ngo bor gnas pas/ lha de thams cad gtso bo'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du 'du mod kyi cha de rnams tshogs pa la btags pa'i gtso bo nyid mtshan dang rnam 'gyur dang rigs sogs kyi sgo nas 'khor rnams las tha dad pa mi 'gal ba dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor pa rab la ni rgyu mtshan snga ma de nyid kyis/ 'khor rnams gtso bo'i yan lag phyir/ /tha dad par ni bzla mi bya/ /zhes sa ra ha'i zhabs kyis ba/sungs pa bzhin du'ang 'gyur ro/ /'di'i zhi khro gnyis ka dang / 'phags ma'i snying tig sogs mang po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum nang gi sgrub pa dang / 'di'i bla ma zhi ba'i sgrub chen skabs sogs su snang srid thams cad lha sngags ye shes kyi 'khor lor khyad par du dmigs tshul gsungs pa ni/ bzlas brjod myur du 'grub pa'i thabs zab mo'ang yin te/ 'di ltar des ni gsung rig sngags kyi snang zhen gnyis las snang ba rgyas par 'gyur zhing / de ji ltar rgyas pa de ltar zhen pa rgyas par 'gyur te/ snang bas zhen pa'i grogs byed 81

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6la yin/ de kun kyang sngags pa lam mthon po pa la bsam pa min no/ /gzhan yang rkang pa gnyis po 'dir sems can gyi don byed pa'i dzab dmigs ('di ni gzhung 'di ga'i bla ma drag po'i dzab dgongasalas kyang shin tu gsal lo/ /'di la gzhan phan phrin las kyi rten 'asbol gyi gnad chen po yod pas 'jam zhud ma 'jen cig) kyang ston te/ zab pa skor bdun las dbang dang dngos grub kyi zab pa rta mgrin dbang gi chos sde/ rta mgrin snying po don 'dus las/ thugs kar nyi steng ṭīḥdamar po:sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas mchod: byin rlabs dngo grub rang la bsdus: ma mo mkha' 'gro las la btsud: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub:gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad nas: thams cad dpal gyi sa ru bkod: 'gro ba rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyangs: snang srid dbang gi sku gsung thags: ye shes dkyil 'khor chen por bsam: bhāḥ༄pad+mārnya kro ta badz+ra kro dha tse shrī wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: bsnyen sgrub las gsum rdzogs pa yi: sngags 'di chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du: rta yi 'gros skad sbyar bas bzla: zhes gsungs pas mtshon no/ lung de'i rkang pa tha mas ni rta skad gang gi tshe 'don pa'i dus la'ang sgro 'dogs gcod de/ chos sde de'i rta mgrin yang phyung dmar po las kyang bstod pa'i mthar/ de nas rta skad sgrogs pa ni: hūṃ: ye 83

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6dbang du bsdus/ g.yas kyi rta skad thengs gcig gis srid pa'i saza' klu pho mo dbang du bsdus te/ bka' nyan gsung sdod par bsgom mo/ /mdor na 'jig rten las 'das pa dang ma 'das pa thams cad dbang du bsdu zhing las la gzud do/ /de nas rta mgrin gyi dzab bstod byas la/ karma dang rat+na ho ru gnas bsgyur gyi bzlas pa sogs bya bar gsungs so/ /'di la go rgyu gzhan yang snang bas zhib tu bkod do/ /sngags gang bzla yang 'di ltar shes dgos te/ spyir 'gro ba dang yul tha dad kyi skad gang gi dbang du btang yang / sgra 'dis don 'di ston dang / 'di mi ston gyi rnam gzhag thams cad dang por brda sbyor mkhan gyi brjod 'dod dang / de nas de'i rjes sa ༄'brangs nas tha snyad byed mkhan rnams kyi brjod 'dod kho na'i dbang gis byed pa las rgyu mtshan gzhan ci yang med do/ /de bzhin du sngags kyi tshig rnams kyang dang por rtsom zhing byin gyis rlob pa po gang yin pa de'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'don pa dang zlo ba'i bsam pas bzlas na/ bsam pa de nyid kyi dbang gis lha de dang de'i sngags su 'gyur zhing / sngags kyi de nyid dang / mthu rnams kyang rang rang gi rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin du snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam pa de gsal po med na/ lha de'i sngags bzlas 186

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma nga pa ba bya gdug pa can dang gdul dka' ba gtso bor 'dul ba'i phrin las can no/ /de 'dra ba'i 'bras dus kyi mdzad pa yongs su dag pa thams cad la mkhas pa'i yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa de lam du byas nas gdul bya ma rungs pa gdul dka' ba'i 'jig rten rnams kyi nyes spyod 'bras bu dang bcas pa a bhi tsar+ya'i phrin las kyis rgyun bcad de (bzo shin tu nyes pa bzhi nas bshigs te 'chos pa lta bu)skal pa ji lha ba bzhin du 'dul nus pa dang ('jig rten gsum gyi bde skyid ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas gcig pu rgyal ba'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa mthu stobs kyi dpung bas srung ba dang) sems can rnams kyi chos dang /'dod pa dang / nor dang / thar ba la bgegs med par bya ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs pa'i ched du ting nge 'dzin dang rig sngags kyi rtsal sbyong ba dang / de la brten nas sa/nas skabs su rang nyid kyis lam sgrub pa la dngos sam brgyud nas bar du gcod pa'i los 'dren rnams tshar gcod pa'i ched du drag sngags kyi sgrub pa byed na he ru ka'i gdung 'tshob pa zhes bya yi/ rnyed bkur dang grags pa'i ched du dgra gsod pa dang / 'dre rdung bya ba'i phyir ni ma yin no/ /phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i las tshogs rab 'byams nges par sgrub na ni/ sngon du bsnyen sgrub kyi rjes su zhag bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs par bla ma zhi ba dang yum ka ste thog mtha' gnyis 192

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6las gsungs pa'i las bzhi'i bzlas pa'ang / snga dro zhi rgyas dang /dgong mo dbang sogs legs grub dang sgyu 'phrul las gsungs pa'i dus gnad dang bstun nas bzlas na/ phyis sgrub dus khyad shin tu che'o/ /bsnyen pa song nas sgrub sngags zlo ba na ni mdun rten dgos te/ zur tho ltar ro/ /ci bdag bskyed kho na dang 'brel bar sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi bzlas pa bskyal na mi rung ngam zhe na/ rung mod kyi/ de'i sgrub dang las sbyor ni bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi nang gi bsnyen pa la gsum du phye ba'i sgrub dang las sbyor tsam du 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa mdun bskyed dang 'brel bar gsungs pa nyid kyang ci la dgongs zhe na/ lha dam ye gnyis las ye shes pa la dam tshig pas dngos grub bslang ba'i sgo nas dngos grub sgrub pa'i dbang du mdzad de/ sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir de lta bu'i dngos grub len chog las su rung bar byas nas/ tshogs sgrub tu cho ga des dngos grub chen po la dngos su sbyor ba dgongs so/ /dngos grub sprub pa'i tshul gzhan yang yod na ci'i phyir mdun bskyed ye shes pa la dngos grub slong ba 'ba' zhig gsung zhe na/ brtson 'grus chung ba rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir te/ rang nyid kyi mthus dngos grub rnyed pa ni dka' bas sgrub dgos shing /mthu chen gzhan la slong ba thabs shin tu sba ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /193

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/de'i phyir sgyu 'phral las thabs sla ba de lta khu gsungs pa brtson ra shāka byed dpe'agrus chung ba kho na da na yang / yul mtha' 'khob dang /dus tha mar skyes pa'i sngags kyi gdul bya la de las dka' ba bstan yang don du 'gyur dka' bas gter phyogs nas de sha stag rtsal bton du bshad dam snyam/ thugs rje chen po pad+ma zhi khro la brten nas dpyad pa'i tho yig go /yang las sbyor sngags kyi thad/ spyir ni sde brgyad dam tshig can rnams srog 'phrog pa'i ched du 'di'i dbang sdud kyi las sngags zlos na'ang rung bar mngon mod/ gzhung rang thi dngos bstan ni/dbang drag gi las sngags gnyis sbrel te bzla ba nyid yin cing /des dgug 'dren gzir ba sogs bya yul la/ dgra bgegs dam sri gdug pa can: sogs las dkar phyogs skyong ba la sbyar rung tsam yang mi snang bas/ chos lam la ma 'khod pa'i sde brgyad 'byung po ma rung ba spyi la nan tur bstan pa'i phyir/ khro mtshon me phung dang pho nya'i dmag dpung spros la/ de rnams kyi snying nas bzung / srog nas drang bas rang dbang med par gzir te/bka' sdod dang bran du khas blang zhing bro bor du bcug (bstan dgra'i lha srung 'phrogs shing cham la dbab pa'ang 'di ltar bya'o) pa'i sgo nas te ru ka'i dam 'og tu gzhug des mi thul ba rnams bsad bcad gtum 194

dbang r+ṣa rta skad/ pod/ 6bstab byas nas brlag par byed pa'i mngon spyod shas che ba'i dbang drag sprags sgrub yin te/ gter gsar sems nyid ngal gso'i drag po'i las sbyor gyi dzab dgongs dang ji bzhin mthun no/ /'di'i dbang drag gi mdzad pa 'jug yul gnyis ka 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa ltar gdug cing gtum pa dang / khengs shing dresas pa'i sems can bsdigs nas 'dul ba sha stab/ yin te/'dir dbang gi las kyang yul de drag shul gyi sbyor ba rnon pos gzir nas byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ dper na/ rgyal po chen pos dgra tshan chen 'dul ba na/ pha rol gyi yul khams lung 'og tu gzhug pa dang / cis kyang mi 'dud pa rnams gtan brlag tu gtong ba gnyis ka drag po'i dpung gi thog kho nas btsan thabs su byed pa lta bu'o/ /dgra zhes pa (spu gri'i nang gi sarba sha tru na/zhes pa'angadagra thams cad ces pa'i skad dod de/ gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra zhes pa de'o) 'dis mi'i 'gro ba'ang bstan no/ /de dag ni 'di la dbang drag sprags ma'i gnad de 'dra ba zhig kyang yod pa de bshad kyi/ 'di'i dbang drag sprags lugs gtso bo ni/ dam can mkha' 'gro drag shul can rnams dbang du bsdus nas mngon spyod kyi las la 'gyed pa'i dbang las kyi sgrom nas drag po sgrub tshul nyid yin te/ spyod par dgongs pa'i rta skad kyi thad na rgyas par 196

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba ba b.rab ma ma yod cing / 'di'i/ dam can pho nya las la bskul: zhes pa'ang de yin no/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad la drag mo'i sadong can yang bshad de/ gdong brnyan can 'di ni de las kyang khros pa'i shin tu drag khros kyi gzugs yin la/ 'di 'dra ba'i sku'i rnam 'gyur de'i dgos kyi kun spyod ni drag shul gyi las nyid yin pas sngags pa mngon spyod la sdang bar mi bya ste/ dam can rnams kyi gtso bo'i kun spyod la mi mthun par bltas na phan tshun blo mi mthun par song ba yin pas so/ /des na bsam pa rnam dag gis rgyal ba dgyes pa'i drag sngags la mos slob tsam byas kyang he ru ka'i rnam thar dang phrin las kyi rgyun bskyang ba dang / rdo rje'i dam can rnams dang bsam spyod bsres par 'gyur bas thugs nye zhing /drag po'i lha drag por bsgrubs pas lhag par yang tshan che'o/ /rdo rje phur bar/ smad las dam can nye bar bsnyen pa zhes bshad pa ltar/ dam can la brten nas dbang drag sogs kyi las 'grub pa la/ sngon du dam can las rung gi bsnyen pa gal che la/ de'i tshul ni/ dang por gtso bo'i sgrubs sngags skabs/ dam can pho nya las la bskul: zhes pa'i steng nas dmikas bzlas cung zad re bya zhing / spyi dzab kyi tshe yang / dbang mo rnams la dmibs nas bzlas bsgom 'tshams pa re rgyun bsring bas/ phyis sger sgrub byed 196

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6— na shin tu sgrub sla ba zhig 'byung ngo / /'di'i rgyas bshad ni chu lha'i sprul zhasas su yod/ /sgrub thabs dang bde 'dus tha ram las rta skad rtsal du 'don lugs ma 'dra zhes bris pa de ni mi 'thad de/ tha ram gyis kyang pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa'am sgrub thabs thams cad rta skad kyi dgongs par 'dus par bstan pa zhes sgrub thabs kyi don nyid 'chad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lam 'bras bu thams cad rta skad kyi dgongs par byas pa ni gsung rta skad kyi sgo nas lam 'bras de rnams la phar 'jug tshul yin gyi/ lam 'bras de dag gsung rta skad sgrub lugs su tshur 'gro tshul bstan pa'i ched du de ltar bshad pa ni min te/ dper na gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnad gsang thams cad rdo rje'i de nyid du byas nas gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ mtshon byed rtags kyi rdo rjes rang gi de nyid la 'jug pa'i ched yin gyi/mtshon bya don gyi rdo rje ni mtshon byed dpe'i rdo rje sgrub pa'i don du gsungs zhes go bzlog nas smra mi rung ba bzhin no/ /des na sgrub thabs phrin las dang bcas pa thams cad rta skad kyi dgongs pa'am de nyid dam blo rtser dril nas dngos grub sgrub pa la pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa zhes bya zhing / don de mtshon pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po'i zhal yang rta gdong gis mtshan par byed do/ /97

dbang chen rta skad/ pod1 6ma de sgrub byed kyi byed pa gtso bo yin par 'dod pa bzhin te/ bya byed(las dang byed po zer dgos) gnyis ma 'dzings shig de 'dra ba'i ba/sung rta skad de la tha ram sogs las spyi bo'i de min pa mi gsal 'ing / de tsam gyis phrin las sgrub tshul la nges pa shusas drab skye ba dbang rnon min na dka'/ thugs tis 'dir dzab kyang rta skad du gsungs pa shin tu legs te/ dzab kyis dngos grub sgrubaXpa rnams kyang rta skad kyis dgongs pa byed lugs su 'gro bas rgya che/ de ltar na/ mtshon byed brda'i rta skad la/ spyi bo'i rta skad dang /sngags kyi bzlas pa gnyis yod do/ /'dir sngar dbe byed lo rnga'i zin ris nas sbyar dkos pa mang / dpe'i rta skad kyis thun mong gi dbang las sgrub pa dang / don gyi rta skad kyis thun mchog gi dbang sgyur gyi dngos grub mtha' dag sgrub pa zhes bshad na snyan brgyud phur ba'i thal 'byin bzhi'i lam rim sogs dang 'gros mthun/ mchog gi dbang sdud de las bzhi'i nang gi dbang yin nam zhe na/ min te/ rig pa ye shes kyi phur bu'i gdab kha de drag las min pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang de drag las kyi nges don du bya rung ba ltar/ dbang las kyi nges don du ni bya rung ngo / /gzhung 'di'i bro mnan sgrub thabs dang / las phreng nas 'byung ba gnyis ka'i sngags su hi gsum re yang dang yang du gsungs pa ni rta skad 199
