pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigasamed bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma mda' yis/ /'khor ba'i skyam ling dbyings su ba/dab/ /rta skad thengs gcig rig pa'i lam/ /kun bzang mkha' dbyings klong rdol nas/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi rang sar sbyar/ /gnyis ni thabs dang shes rab ste/ /gsum ni sku gsung thugs su sbyar/ /rta skad bzhi ni phrin las bzhi/ /lnga ni ye shes rnam pa lnga/ /drug ni 'gro drug gnas su sbyong / /bdun ni phrin las drag shul bdun/ /brgyad ni sde brgyad dbang du snyud/ /dgu ni theg pa'i sa dgu brtol/ /bcu ni sa bcu zil gyis gnon/ /dbang phyug rol pa'i phrin las de/ /byed spyod rta yi skad kyis sbyong / /gang ltar spyad kyang chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /dregs pa gnad 'bebs kyi rgyud pad+ma dang kha che a nan+tas bsgyur ba'i le'u lnga ba las/ de nas pad+ma te ru kas dpal gyi rta skad kyis phyogs bcu'i dregs pa can btul lo/ /lo rgyus don gyis phyi rabs yid ches bshad/ /snod kyi 'jig rten lcasas ri nag po'i nang / /phyi yi rgya mtsho zho las dkrugs pa'i mar/ /ri rab srub cing klu sprul srub thag bcas/ /rgyal chen sde bzhis rab tu dkrugs pa las/ /dwangs ma'i bdud rtsi khyab 'jug gza' yis 'thungs/ /phyag rdor 'khor los lus kyang dum bu brgyad/ /snyigs ma dug tu gyur te gnod sel phyir/ /spyan ras sku khros mgur du 206

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6thim pa ni/ /khro bo mdog sngon gdug pa ma lus 'dul/ /tshangs pa'i gsung gis chos 'khor bskrul ma 'debs/ /des 'dul gsung dbyangs drug cu tshangs pa'i skad/ /'jig rten 'khor bar yun ring banas nas kyang / /rta mchog rin chen yid bsring 'gro don mdzad/ /cang shes rta yis myur du bgrod pa ltar/ /'gro drug 'khor ba'i sanas nas 'dren par mdzad/ /de ni 'gro ba lam 'dir gzhug pa'i phyir/ /gdul byar bshad pas 'gro ba 'dul bar byed/ /gti mug can dang nga rgyal can/ /'dod chags can dang phrag dog can/ /zhi ba'i las dang rgyas pa'i las/ /dbang dang drag pos 'dul bar ston/ /ljang gu drag po dmar po dbang / /ser po rgyas pa dkar po zhi/ /rta gdong phrin las bzhi mdzad pas//rta mgo la yang rigs bzhi'i mdog /gdul bya ma lus thams cad kun/ /'dul phyir phrin las dag tu bshad/ /zhal nas rta skad sgra sgrogs pas/ /phe phe tri sobs gsang sngags 'dren/ /rta yi skad ces bya ba yang / /rta zhal gsung du sgrogs pa'o/ /brda dang rta skad 'gying skad gsum/ /rnal 'byor dgongs pas ma shes skyon/ //thugs dam mi 'khul dbang mi 'dus/ /dgra babegs mi thul skyon du 'gyar/ /rnal 'byor gang gis rta skad kyi/ /dbongs pa don ——— ba ba ba ldan shas pa da/ /thugs rjas bzhangs dang khas blangs dran/ /207

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6pa ste/ /'dam med pad+ma gang las skye/ /ri rab rtse ni lha gnas te/ /ri rab khong seng lha min yul/ /gling bzhir mi gnas mtho ris gsum/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho dud 'gro la/ /grong khyer ser skya yi dwags nyid/ /rdo rje gdan 'og dmyal ba'i gnas/ /kun gyi skad du chos ston pas/ /thugs rje'i rta skad rigs drug 'dul/ /lus ngag yid kyi brda sprad na/ /pho mo mthun pa'i dpe bzhin shes/ /dper na khā tas gzan mthong ltar/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro 'grub nas byon//ma mo mkha' 'gro la sogs la/ /mthun pa'i sha khrag gtor ma 'bul/ /las bzhi'i phrin las bcol bar bya/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba dang / /skyon dang yon tan rang bzhin bshad/ /rta yi 'gros dgu bstan pa yang / /dpung lag sgrog 'gros lha dang mi/ /gdos pa lcags bcug nyan thos 'dra/ /pho nya srun 'gros rang sangs rgyas/ /'jab tshe gzengs ni mdo sde nyid/ /gom bu myol(snga mar nyol)'gros kri ya ba/ /spyang mo mdur 'gros yo ga nyid/ /rol mo'i stabs pa ma hā yin/ /'jol mo dkyas 'gro a nu ste/ /dkyas su tshang 'gros a ti la/ /rje'i dka da /certa 'gros dgur bstan pas/ /pad+ma dbang —na rta gdong zhal//rta skad dgongs par 'dus pas gsungs/ /khams gsum dbang du sdud par byed/ /'khor 'das dbang gi skur rdzogs la/ /theg 209

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jibs medabastan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾rta rgyud kha cig tu/ brtson 'grus chung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir dang / mi'am ci'i 'khor rta mabo can rnams 'dul ba'i ched du rta'i glu bro mdzad par bshad de/ mi'am ci de dag ni glu gar gyi pha rol tu son pa yin no/ /kun spyod des 'gro ba gzhan yang 'dul ba ni/ ji lhar srin po ltar khros pa sogs bzhin no snyam ste bsam mo/ /bde 'dus dbang chen 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ e ma 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams nyon: nga yi skru yi ngo bo ni:rang rig byang chub sems las snang: rta mgos skad gsang mthon po yis: bde gshegs gsung gi dngos grub sdud: yang dag nges don chos kyi sku: gzugs su snang ba mtshon pa'i rtags:dper na rta yi 'gros dgu yis: ji ltar smon pa'i sar 'gro bzhin: theg pa'i rim pa ngang gis bgrod: rtsol med rab tu rdzogs par snang: rta skad yon tan mang ba ltar: lam lnga dang ni sa bcu dag: yongs rdzogs de nyid ngang la mnga': dpe dang don gyi rtasas rnams kyis: phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyi:gsang sngags lam gyi bye brag shes: gdul bya'i thabs su sna nga ba yang: chos rnams dkyil 'khor lhun grub cing: snang srid ma lus bsgral ba'i rgyu: bka' sdod phrin las rdzogs par mdzad:sngon gyi tha tshig dbyings nas bskul: brda sprad klong rdol dbang 2 2

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6bsgyur te: ma lus 'dul ba nga yi thabs: ye nas ma bcos nga yi sku: thabs dang shes rab dbyings ye shes: don dam kun rdzob snang dang stong: gnyis med ngo bo'i don yin no: dbang gi rgyal por bsam sbyor bas: khros pa'i phyag rgya gsung gi sgra:'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs chen kunaḥ dbang med skrag pa'i tshul bzung zhing: myur du phrin las gnas bzhin byed:dbyings nas gzugs snang thams cad kun: dbang bsgyur snang ba mnyes mdzad de: 'gal ba de nyid ngang du sbyang: zhes dang /jiḥ dbang gi rta gdong phrin las malhogs pa'i mthu: ye shes myur mgyogs shes rab pha rol phyin: rtsal gyi rlabs kyis sa sa/sum cig char bgrodaḥ 'tsher skad gdangs snyan gsang ba'i thugs dam bskul: rngam pa'i kha rtsal 'khor tshogs dbang du sbud: stabs drug 'gros kyis rgyud drug thabs kyis 'dren:rol pa'i rta bros bdud bzhi thal bar brlab: 'jig rten sgrol mkhas mi bsnyel thabs kyi mchog: rta skad rngam pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bka' bang to// //nga / /gzhung 'di las dbang chen rtsa ba'i sgrub pa la sbyar rgyu'i yan lag gi sgrub lugs bzhi gsungs te/ thun mong drag 213

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾4྾ — —r+yā sngags kyi/ khyad par za/ mchog sgrub byen rlabs kyi sgrub pa ste gur drag dang thun mong ba gsum/ bde chen glu gar gyi sgrub pa ni dgos chos te de ltar bzhi'o/ /dang po la'ang / spu gri'i sngags sgrub dang / btor ma la brten pa'i bsad zlog gnyis bsal bar bstan/ sanyis pa'i skabs su/ za lha bskyed pa/ tshe bcud ba sbu ba/ de las tsho dbang dang dngos grub len pa/ de mi shigs pa'i srog la brtan par bya ba ste bzhi'i sprom nas dngos grub rgyud gsum sgrub lugs shes dgos/ gsum pa 'di la/ dngos grub bsdu ba/ sbyor mtshams su bskyil ba/ gsang sgo dbye ba/ rten la dbab pa/ de nyid dbang du bya ba'am brten par bya ba sogs yon tan bdud rtsi'i rgyud las sasungs pa'i dngos grub sgrub lugs kyi gnad thams cad1 sgrub gzhi phyi rol gyi sman la byed pa dang / nang rtsa this rlung sems la byed pa'i khyad tsam ma gtobs ji lta ba bzhin tshang ngo / /de'ang dkyil 'khor thams cad dang 1dbang bskur dang / sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / rgyud dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / phrin las kyi khyad par ji snyed pa thams cad bde chen lhan skyes kyi ye shes kho na de dang de'i rnam par shar nas gdul bya'i snying la 'jug pa yin pa'i phyir/ tshul de shes nas bde chen byang sems kyi dbang 'di blangs na de dag thams cad 211

྾ dbangachenarta skad/ pod/ 6kyis byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur zhing / lha'am sngags dang sgrub gzhung gang gi ngo bor khyad par du bltas te/ bde chen 'bebs dmigs byas na'ang de dang de'i sgos kyi dbang chog lta bur 'gyur ro/ /nyams chag sogs nang gi rten 'brel log pa sbyong ba'i bya ba khrus mthar thug kyang 'di yin/ khrus kyi lha mchog tu bsngags pa'ang dbang lha yin/ dam ye dbyer med kyi phung khams lha rnams gzi brjid rgyas par byed pa dang dgyes pa skong ba'i tshogs mchod khyad par can yang yin/ ngag la dbang skur ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab sogs bye brag re re 'bur dod du dmigs nas de la dbang skur bar dmigs na'ang de dang de rgyas byed du 'gyur/ grub chen bka' brgyad las dbang skur yon tan rdo rje'i rigs su gsungs pa yo ga dang mthan te/ yon tan rigs rgyas 'i ༄ kyipa rigs su bsngags pas/ sngags — nus pa dang / 'gro don rgyas pa sogs la rang blu ngag dang bya ba sobs la dbang skur ba 'di thabs zab par shes so/ /bzhi ba 'di lha 'di la bye brag tu bsngags pa'i cho ga yin phyir rgyas spros byed par dba' na/ spyir gru gu yang dbang gi rta mgrin dregs sgrol sogs bro rabs rgyas par bzhugs pa'i gzhung 'ga' re yod na'ang / rje grub chen nyid kyi rtsa ba'i thugs dam shangs chos dang byang bter gnyis yin(pa dang / 215

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4྾ ྾ ྾྾ ྾r+yā4gter kha rigs mthun yin pa'i gnad kyis) pas grub chen bka' brgyad dang 'brel che ba'i broXchog ni rang shar gyi bro rdung der snang la/ spyi bka'i rigs pa dgos bka' la sbyar chog pa dang / 'di nyid rang las slob ma sta gon grub chen bka' brgyad la zhal 'phangs pa'i rigs pas 'dir yang de nas blang bar bya'o/ /de dag las gzhan pa myur mgyogs pho nya'i sgrub pa'ang yod mod kyi/ sgrub thabs spyi'i khog tu tshang ba yin gyi zur du yod pa min no/ /'gro 'dul zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi sgrub pa dang / yum ka bden gnyis zhal can ma'i sgrub pa gnyis kyang 'di dang 'brel chags su gsungs pa yin la/ las kyi phreng ba las tshom bu tshogs kyi sprub pa'ang gsal bar gsungs te/ bskyed rim gyi chos skor ro1 /de'i steng du ye shes phreng ba las gsungs pa'i dpe dang don gyi ye shes kyi sgrub pa bcas rgya cher bzhugs te/ de dag re re zhing ngo mtshar ba'i zab gnad du ma dang ldan pa'i tshul la zhib tu spyang dbos so//rje grub thob chen po'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub lugs kyi rnam grangs bkod pa'o/ /dzam bu'i gling 'dir pad+ma gsung gi rig 'dzin ches che ba ni mgon po klu sgrub yin te/ 'di ltar gter kha gong 'og byang gter sogs rtsod bral kun nas gsungs so/ /kha cig gis gter phyogs nas de ltar bshad pa'i klu sgrub de phyis kyi bā li a tsar+ya yin 216

—zad11 ba'icad 11 rtagazad/ bsgocad/ (1zer ba rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas bkag cing / klong snying rtsa rgyud thod dum las/ bai ta'i yul 'khrungs bram ze'i rigs:blo chen na ga rdzu na la: gsung mchog pad+ma'i sgrom bu gtad:ces 'khrungs yul sogs lang gshegs ltar bshad de/ bde 'dus rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud las kyang de bzhin bshad do/ /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ rig pa rma bya chen mo ni/ /bdag nyid chen po des kyang 'grub/ /ces gsungs te/ de'i gleng gzhir rma bya chen mo 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rigs kyi lha mor bshad pas/ lung des kyang pad+ma'i rigs kyi gsang sngags 'grub par bstan no/ /des na mgon po 'dis rma bya chen mo'i rig sngags kyis klu yul du byon par rgya bar pa la grags pa ltar klu rnams btul ba'ang pad+ma gsung gi rig sngags la brten no/ /slob dpon de la bsil ba'i tshal byi mchod rten bde byed brtsegs par pad+ma gsung bi/ zangs sgrom mkha' 'gro mas dngos su phul zhing / he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod du rta mgrin bsgrub pas rdo rje sasung gi dngos grub brnyes/gu ru rin po ches kyang dbang chen gsung gi gdams skor rnams 'di las gsan te satso bor chos rgyal khri srong dang / mchog dbyangs gnyis la bstsal ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i rta mgrin bla brgyud kyi spyo mes de 'di ga'i sgrub gzhung dang 'brel bar thugs 217

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/— — ྾ 4྾྾r+yābagegs su ma zad/ yams nad/ shā 'ud/ dmas 'khrub/ chom rkun/ gcan gzan/ rbab/ sbyogs sogs 'phrul 'khor rigs/sad ser/ kha char/ thog rlung / me/ lo tog za ba'i 'bu sogs gzhan yang srung ste/ dkyil chog rdor phreng las rdul tshon 'byung lnga'i gnod pas mi brdzi ba'i phyir srung 'khor sgo ma par bshad pa lta bu'o/ /bris pa'i 'khor los srung ba ni dkyus su mi gsal yang / byed na skyer sgang lugs 'brel che bas de la/ gzhi dar ras sam shos bu gtsang mar bris rjes su gri kha btang mi dgos pa byas pa la/ ghi haṃ dang ga bur gur gum sogs kyi snag tsha dang / gzugs mo byi thur gyi smyu gus/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa bri/ de'i lte bar trīḥ trī'i steng du oṃ/'og tu phaṭa/ de'i mthar steng nas mgo brtsams te g.yas skor du/bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal pos 'chang ba po la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnod pa thams cad las srung du sasol/zhes 'bri/ rtsibs brgyad la steng nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas/ pad+mā na/ ta kri ta/ badz+ra/ kro dha/ gya/ kṛ ba/ hu lu/ hu lu hūṃ/zhes pa rnams dang / rtsibs mchan la/rtsibs steng ma'i g.yon nas brtsams te/ oṃ/ badz+ra/ dun/ bh+yo/ trig /nan/ dza dza/ sa ma ya stam/ rnams 'god/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ sa ma ya dza/ sa ma 220

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 64 ya zlog /sa ma ya bh+yo/ sa ma ya gtub/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad rngud phaṭa ya/ 'byung po ma ra ya dza dza/ zhes 'bri/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la rten snying dang / rdo ra/ me ri g.yas 'khor bya/ sngags rnams yib mgo phyir bstan g.yas skor kho nar 'bri/ rab gnas byas la gdags/ 'di steng 'khor rkyang pa'i srung ba ste ('di ni gtso rkyang sga srung ba ste gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi 'khor lo ni ma rnyed/ lcags zam lugs kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag cung zad mi 'dra ba'ang yod par bshad pas tshol/ 'khor lo 'dis ni 'jig rten gsum byi bgegs thams cad srung bar gzhung gi steng gdon bza' dang 'og gdon klu: sogs kyis mtshon no) gsang sgrub la mkhas pa thu'u bkan pa'i yig cha ltar bris/ steng 'og sbyar ma'i srung ba sosas 'dir ma bkod/ byed na shangs lugs rang du blta'o/ /'bri gzhi dug rdol/ rtsibs kyi rtsa rtse nu khyud la reg pa/ mu khyud rnams chad pa/ yi ge 'bri 'phro lus pa ltar ma khengs pa/ rtsibs dang mu khyud sogs la thug cing yi ge phan tshun 'dres pa/ ma shong ba/ yig phreng 'khyog gcus/ gong 'og 'khrugs pa/ mig zum/ bris bsub/ lhag chad sogs kyi skyon med par bya/ yig mgo ston phyogs/ srung ba phyi dang zlog pa nang / zhi rgyas phyi dang dbang drag nang du ston par bshad pa ltar ro/ /'khor lo ma grub na/ sngon du byams snying rje bsgom/ srung mdud bhāḥlas rta mgrin du bskyed/ lto 221

po da/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/— ྾ —bar gnod byed thams cad bsdus la thar pa'i skabs med par bsams te gdags pa yang shangs lugs las so/ /las sbyor spu gri la dbang sdud dang / mngon spyod sngagasaXganyis char 'byed rgyu yod pas/ sa gsum dbang sdud kyi bzlas pa dgos su byed na/sa ma ya stam/ yan chad khol byung bzla ba skyer sgang lugs bzhin byed/ dbang sdud sngags 'di grol thig rta mgrin dang / klong snying gi rgyal po lugs kyi nang na'ang snang / sngags don ni/ oṃ zur 'khod ltar/ thun bh+yo rbad pa'i sngags su snying gzer las bshad pas/ khro mtshon me phung gi pho nya 'gyed pa la badz+ra dun bh+yo zhes sbyor ram snyam/ tig nan ni snying gzer las/ trig (shangs lukas su trig nan zhes 'donapa'ang yin) nan gnyis kyis steng nas gzir (mes mar gong ltar gdung bar byed pa'i don) zhes sros (lha srin sde brgyad 'khrugs shing /yul lha nang zhig 'ong ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo gsar skyes kyi 'byung po gdug pa can dang / glo bur du lhags pa'i 'dre srin rnams kyis byed par sasungs pas rgyal khams bange bar 'dod cing nus ldan yin na de das gzir ba gal che) gzir ba'i sngags su bshad/ dzaḥdzaḥ'aphrogs par byed pa'am 'gugs 'dren/ sa ma ya stam/ dam bsgrags sam/ yang na dam bzhag ces 'chad dam dpyad dgos so/ /tshe sgrub byed na gu ru drag po ltar bya zhing /de'ang dkyus kyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi bzlas pa'i mjus tu 222

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/྾ ྾ ྾4 — ྾྾r+shanyer spyad/ zhing khang / skyed tshal/ bud med/ rig pa mkhan/gzhan 'phrul bdag po sogs lha klu gter bdag glegs bam/dge 'dun/ gzhon nu (gang zhis dbang du gyur na bstan 'gro'i don chen po 'grub pa'i mi dbang dang / chos kyi brgyud 'dzin khyad par can lha bu gtso bo yin)sokas dbang byed la 'dod chags rdo rje las 'od dmar/ bya mchu ma sogs bstan pa la gnod pa dang / 'gro ba mang po'i bde skyid 'phrog pa'i mi dang mi min bsad pa dang / bsdig pa dang / myos pa dang / brgyal bar byed cing / stobs gzhom pa sogs la phras dog rdo rje las 'od dus kyi mun pa lta bu spro bsdu bya zhing / yum bka'i skabs kyi sngags sham btags/ 'di ni/ rta bro'i cho ga dang /yum bkar/ dmisas pa'i mde'u kha spyi ltar sbyar: zhes gsungs pa la brten pa ste/ rta rgyud kyi khungs kyang che'o/ /glu gar gyis las bzhi sprub skabs/ rgyas las lta bur mtshon na/ser sna rdo rje 'khor bcas bro rdung ba rnams las yid (rin chen rigs kyi sprul ba gzi brjid 'bar ba'itshogs dpag med spros pas/ tshe bsod sokas dgos 'dod nam mkha' gang bar 'byung bar bsam pa sgrol g.yung gnyis kyis bshad do) bzhin gyi 'od zer gser mdog tshad med pa spros pas 'bru nor longs spyod kyi char gzi ldan zad mi shes par phab ste dmigs bya'i dbul phongs bsal bar bsam pa klong chen rgyud ṭika las so/ / 224

dbang chenarta skad/ pod/ 6nga ra des 'gre/ de bzhin du/ spyi dgos kyi de nyid shes pas rin chen rigs kyi rta glu blangs pas glu sgras gar khyab tu dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi char chen po phab par bsam pa sogs 'gre'o/ /rta skad kyis las bzhi byed pa'i dmigs pa 'di ni dzab kyi skabs su sbyar na'ang rung bar sems te/ rta skad phengs gsum dzab dmigs la sbyor zhing / 'di de lhar mi rung ba'i khyad par ci zhig yod/de'ang zhi ba la sati mug rdo rje nas/ drag po la phrag dog rdo rje'i bar du te ru ka so sos glu so sor blang bar bltas la/ sngags sham sngar ltar 'dog te/ tshul gnyis gang yang rung ngo / /las rim gzhan dang ma sprad kyang nam 'dod du rta glus las skrub pa'ang byar rung ste/ rengs pa la sogs pa'i lta stangs bzhin no/ /las bzhi rab 'byams bros sgrub pa mnan pa dang ma sbyar ba 'di snyan brgyud rta mgrin snying tig na shin tu gsal te zur du bris yod/ yang /yul 'khor srung zhing bkra shis par byed pa/ gdon bgebs dgra gsum sgrod pa dang dbye ba dang rmongs par byed pa (sri'u gso ba/ ma mo rnams byis pa la brtse zhing byis pa skyong ba la balngags/ de'ang glang phrug seng ge mos gso snun byas pa khyu mchog tu 'gyur ba lhar go ba len rgyu yod) kha char dang ser ba gcod 'bebs/ gtad hrul(hril)'byin/ 'dun bshigs/ltas dang cho 'phrul gtong ba/ sayul zlog pa/ sad srung ba/ don 226

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ r+yā ྾r+yāsgrub pa/ longs spyod spel ba/ chom rkun gcan gzan rngon pa sosas kyi kha 'ching ba/ tshal dang khang bzang sogs sanas gzhi phun tshogs sgrub pa/ bcud len dgug pa/ badzun 'grol ba/dbang sdud kyi khyad par mang po sogs las tshogs ches mang po thigadam can pho nya las la bskul: zhes pas byed de/ sgyu 'phrul ba la yongs grags ltar sbyor na/ dbang mo rnams kyi thugs kar bh+yo yig res mtshan par gsal btab ste/ satso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bskul/ de'ang zhi ba la shar gyi ma mo bdun gyi thugs srog la phog pas rgyud bskul te zhi ba'i phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du bsgrub par bsam/ de'i 'gres kyis lho'i bdun gyis rgyas las sogs/ ma mo mkha' 'gro de dag gi thugs dgongs lan cis btad pa tsam res kyang de 'dra dpag med 'grub pa'i phyir te/ gsang rdzogs ma mo'i dzab dgongs las shes so/ /de'i tshe las skrub kyi sngags la'ang rtsa sngags rang gis chog ste/ snga ma de de'i dzab dgongs su bshad pas shes pa'i phyir/ dam can pho nya la klu dang sanod sbyin sogs gzhan yang mang ngo / /'di sogs nam rbod gtong gi las grub pa na sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag dus mi yol bar btang zhing / phyi bcol las kyi gnyer gtod pa ni gal che bar mang du gsungs so/ /lha srin bran du 'khol ba'i 226

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6ba dngos grub bsdu dmigs rtsal du bton pas rab mngon shes/ tha ma 'dod don la mi 'khrul ba'i rmi lam khyad par can 'byung ngo / /'di dang gtor zlog sogs kyi yid nyams gsal ba dang dpa' ngar sogs gang skye ba la yang 'khu 'khrigs re dogs sogs kyi bcos ma shor ba'i shes rig so ma'i steng nas de dang de la dgongs pa gtod rgyu yin no/ /bdag la gzhan gyis byad kha byed pa'i rmi lhas byung na: zhabs g.yas pa'i 'og tu gnod byed kyi sa bon bsam: dgra'i rnam shes bkug la sprul gyis dkris la zhabs kyis mnan par bsam nas sngags bzlas na phyir zlog zab mo yin no: zhes skyer sgang lugs kyi rtsa ga/zhung du gsungs so/ /bro'i las tshogs la/ rab dga'i spyod pa 'di ni dbang gi phrin las la khyad par du bsngags te/ 'jig rten na yang bro gar dang glus 'gro ba'i yid 'phrog par byed pas de dag gar yod na ltad mo ba'i skye bo me tog la bung ba bzhin du dga' nas 'du ba ltar/dbang chen yang gsang bi bro chob las/ rta bro 'khor gsum mam skor bsum gyi/ dang pos steng lha khams/ gnyis pas 'og klu khams/ gsum pas bar gyi lha srin dbang du sdud par bshad cing / gsang rdzogs rtsa rgyud las/ glu bro skor gcig gi gzugs med khams/ gnyis pas gzugs khams/ tha mas 'dod khams zil 229

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i sasung 'bum/—gyis gnon par gsungs pa dang / zhabs g.yas thabs kyi bros khro bo'i tshogs dang / g.yon shes rab kyi bros khro mo'i tshogs dbang du sdud pa dang / g.yas g.yon thabs shes kyi bros bdud dgra dam sri thal bar rlog ces gtso bo che mchog gi bro la sbyar te bshad pa'ang 'dra bar sems/ 'di nyid las kyang / sa kasum ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams: dbang med 'du zhing yid 'phrogs pas:zhes so/ (sa paṇa gyis/ kang na thod dang skra gsar dang / /gar dang rol mo'i sgra yod pa/ /de na mya ngan yod min pas/ /des na rol mo bsngasas pa yin/ /zhes gsungs shing / rol mo gnyis las deralhan skyes rol mo zhes dbyangs la sbyar ba ltaraglu gar 'di mya ngan med pa'i bde ba'i rten 'brel du bsngabs pas byur dang mi shis pa sbyong ba dang bkra shis spel ba la'ang zab)rta mchog rol ba'i tan+d+ra las/ bro ni brtul zhugs chen po ste/ /zhes so/ /lha'i nga rgyal dang / dngos sam mos ngo'i bde stong gi ngang nas gang snang la thog brdzis sam brtul zhugs byas pas/rbab dang / g.yang sa dang / sa g.yo dang / shā 'ud sogs chu bo'i 'jigs pa dang / thog dang / ser ba dang / sad dang / rlung dang / me dang / mtshon cha dang / gcan gzan dang / g.yul gyi stobs dang / dpa' ba dang / chom rkun dang / phyogs ngan dang /lo zla zhagaXdus dang gza' skar dus sbyor ngan pa dang / sri kegs 230

dbang chenarta skad/ pod/ 64bdakyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od gsal bar byas te dbyings su bcug slar yang snying rje'i dbang gis rim gyis sam lhag par mos pas lhar langs te/ bro gar gyi sgo nas bsgrub na dngos grub chen po 'thob bo/ /yang sa gzhi yi ge sgyu 'phrul du bsgoms te/ de la lha ma yin gyi sanas la sosas pa'i lam du brtags nas/ bro gar gyis zhugs nas sa 'og gi dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha' la yang de bzhin du sbyar bar bya ste/ tshul 'dis lha dang klu'i du mo dgug pa sogs kyang byed do/ /lce'i pad+ma la jiḥyig bsgoms te/ de'i 'od zer gyis 'gro ba rnams la so so'i skad du chos sgrogs pa dang / bdud dang nu stegs zil gyis gnon pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsgrubs shing / slar sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung gi yon tan gyi tshogs bsdus te lce la thim par bsgo mas nas glu blang ba la brtson na chos smra ba la dbang thob pa'i dngos grub 'thob pa ni/ glu tshig sgra yi phyag rgya yis/ /chos kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di ni rje rong zom pa'i rgyud 'grel las bshad do/ /bro gar gyi 'gros kyis sa dang nam mkha' thogs med du bcod pa 'di ni ral gri'i dngos grub dang byed las mnyam pa zhig snang ngo / /rta bro ston pa'i rta rgyud du/ngan song gnas 'joms kyi bro zhes mang du gsungs shing / rta 233

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ mchog rol pa'i tan+t+ra'i le'u brgya re banyis par/ 'khor ba ru nas bzlog pa'i bro/ /ngan song gnas nas 'joms par mdzad/ /ces gsungs te/ sdug bsngal thu shos/ rigs drug gi ru ste dang po'i sna la bgrang rgyu ni sa 'og ngan song bi 'jig rten yin te/ de la bde chen gyi spyod pa 'dis bsnun pas gting sprugs par byed par bstan no/ /zur 'khod/ thugs rje'i rta skad risas drug 'dul/ sogs dang / pheg pa rim par bgrod pa'i rta skad kyang / don du/'dir shog dang ngas khyed chos dbyings sgrib pa med pa'i grong khyer du sgro la lo zhes lus can rnams 'bod cing skul bar 'gro bas/nus pa thob pas ni ngan song ba'i sems can la dmigs nas glu bro byas na gnas lung khyad par can du 'gro bar gsal lo/ /rta skad kyis dbang drag rol pa'i las byed tshul ni rdzogs ldan 'dzin ma dbang byed kyi 'khor lo'i skor du lta'o/ /bla ma zhi ba'i gzhung du/ rab gnas sreg blugs skor la sogs: zhes gsungs pa'i rab sanas ni dkyus su mi gsal bas/skyabs rjes spyi la sbyor rgyur mdzad pa'i dge legs char 'bebs bzhin bya ste/ der chos dang zang zing gi 'byor ba rgyas pa'i phyir gtsug lag khang dang / mtsho rdzing lu ma 'bab chu sogs phun sum tshogs par bya ba dang skyed tshal dang ri dang de'u dang nags la 2 34

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6nga ma sos/sa pa gzi brjid spor ba dang bkra shis shing yun du gnas pa'i phyir de dang de dag dang / sa bcud gso ba'i don du gter bum dngaX yul gyi bkra mi shis pa zhi ba'i ched du dril bu dang /sayul gyi nang du brdung bya'i rnga bo che dang / dge 'dun basbu ba'i don du dung dang / nad mtshon gdon dug srung ba'i don du sngags mdud lhag par gnas par bya ba sogs 'di gcig pus kyang dgos pa mang po byar yod do/ /gnas bya bang la rigs gang bis rab tu gnas pa ni/ rje dang mchog gling thun mong gi zab gter mnyam sbyor rab gnas rin dra ltar ram/ gter bdag gling pa sogs kyis spyi'i cho ga phreng ba ltar mdzad pas yang na de ltar bya'o/ /sbyin sreg mdor bsdus ni phag mo'i gzhung ltar bya la/ rgyas par spro na tshar chen gyi yang bsang sbyin sreg lta bu la gzhi byas nas brtsam du rung ste/ rat+na gling pas rang gi rta gsang la yang gsang dang gsang sgrub kyi cho ga las kha bskangs pa dang / gsang sgrub mkhan po mkhas pa du mas yang gsang dang gsang 'dus kyi tshogs mchod dang gtor bzlog sogs nas gsang sgrub la mang du sbyar ba bzhin te/ de 'dra mang ngo / /slob ma sta rgon sgyu 'phrul las len par gsungs pa'i ribs pas/ sgyu dra'i sbyin sreg sbyar na'ang 236

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga 'brel che'o/ /skong bshags ni rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub gzhung ltar bya'o//rta skad kyis grub chen brgyad kyang dbang du byed par zur 'khod kyis shes/ de skrub lugs la 'dir ni/ phrin las bzhi dang grub pa brgyad: ces dngos grub gsol tshig tu 'byung ba las gzhan mi gsal yang / dbang po skal ba'i khyad par bzhin: dman 'bring mchog gi dngos grub 'thob: ('di la dpyad tshul 'di las zhib pa gcig zur du bris yod) ces dngos grub 'bring po skabs 'di'i dngos grub len chog dus 'thob pa zhig kyang bshad do/ /mchog gi dngos grub der 'thob pa ni gzhan las/ mchog la dgongs pa g.yo 'gul med: ces pa ltar btags pa ba tsam la dgongs par mngon/ rgyud sde du mar bskyed rim pas mkha' spyod sogs 'grub pa la/ bskyed rim rags pa tsam mthar phyin pa'i sngasas pas ni/ rdzas dang sreg blugs sogs mang po la brten dgos par gsungs pa yod de/ rang nyid kyis nus pa khyad par can rten pa'i sgo nas de dag sgrub pa la dgongs so/ /de dag gzhan stobs la brten nas 'grub pa la ni de tsam mi dgos te/ mdzod las/rdzu 'phrul gzhan brten ma gtogs pa/ /de das gong ma mthong ba med/ /ces tshul gnyis bshad pa lta bu'o/ /rang nyid kyis nus pa snga ma lta bu ma rnyed par gzhan stobs kyis dngos grub chen po la 236

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6spyod mi srid pa min pa ni/ phyag rdor dbang bskur las/ zhing ba dang / 'khor sgyur dang / dbang phyub/ chen po'i dpe gsungs pa bzhin no/ /klong snying yum bkar/ mkha' spyod la sogs yon tan brgyad: dngos su grub cing / zhes dang / na ro mkha' spyod ma'i mkha' spyod sgrub tshul sogs kyang gzhan stobs la brten pa 'dir snang ngo / /des na lha sngags kyi nus pa cher skyes pa'i mtshams shig nas yi dam dngos la dngos grub len chog gi bslang ba tsam gyis mkha' spyod dang / mi snang ba dang / 'chi med la sosas pa 'thob pa zhig kyang yod par mngon pas/ gzhung 'dir bstan tshod ni de la bya'o/ /lhan skyes kyi rnal 'byor yod na las bzhi'i dngos grub sgrub pa la'ang khyad che ba ni sgyu 'phrul mkhan po rnams la yang ma grags pa min te/ ljon pa dang ni lcugs phran tshal/ /sogs kyi nges don las bzhi'i gzangs ma la bzhed pas shes so/ /༄thun mong bi grub pa chen po sgrub na tshogs spyod sngon du gtong ba yang de dag la grags pa yin te/ bskyed rim pa'i tshom bu tshogs sgrub zla drug sogs byas pa'i mthar 'dod gzugs kyi rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i rnam gzhag gsungs pa de yin pa'i phyir/ dam pa rgyan las/ sa/dug pa srid gsum 'dul ba yi/ /nga rgyal chen po bstan pa'i phyir/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i ting 'dzin sgom/ /zhes pa 237

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba ba ba ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i dngos po shin tu bsgyur nas khro bor mdzad pa'i sgos mdzad ni bdud sde'i dkyil 'khor brlag par byed pa de yin pas (gsang 'dus le'ur/ khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes/ /gsod la rtag tu brtson pa dag /grub pa mchog gi chos can la/ /gsod pa'i don gyis grub par 'grur/ /zhes gsungs te/ grub par 'gyur/ zhes pa ni 'grub par 'gyur zhes pa min gyi/ dngos grub tu 'gyur/ zhes pa'o/ /) shin tu cher khros kyi te ru ka 'di lha bu'i las sbyor la drag po'i phrin las gtso che ste/rgyud kyi bcu bdun par/ smug nag sngo nag ser nag /sogs la so so'i rigs mi 'gyur bas na sngo ser dmar po sogs so so dang /drag po'i las gadzu bor mdzad pas thams cad la nag po 'brel bar bshad pa lta bu dang / sgrub chen bka' brgyad las kyang drag po'i gzer kha kho na las sbyor thams cad kyi rtsa bar gsungs so/ /de ni dzab tu yang 'byung la/ zur du sgrub lugs ni/ gtor zlog gur drag nas sbyor bar gsungs pa de dang / mnan pa dkyus bshad dang / sreg (don du dbang chog na hom mchod kyi las rim sho lo ka gcig bzhugs pa de la rtsa tho byas na smin gling drag mar sogs kyi hom chog dang / sgyu 'phrul lugs kun dang shin tu mthun no/ /) pa zur tho ltar de 'di rnams yin no//de las gtor zlog ni bar chad kyi dmag dpung la rdo rje'i sbyogs(grub thob bka' brgyad du/ drag sngags 'ur zhing skyogs su 'phang ཿ zhes so )238

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/— ྾ dbang byed man chad kyi lha dang mi'i gnas thams cad du sprin dang glob dang char dang 'brug sgra'i rol pa sna tshogs shing tshad med pa gzugs can 'byung ba bzhin te/ 'dir grub pa bzhi'ang dran par bya'o/ /spu gri'i sngags sgrub kyi thad du/ thugs sgrub zhal gdams snying byang las/ dngos grub chen po sgrub pa dang / /gzhan don las la 'jug pa sogs/ /gang la'ang spi yis bar gcod na/ /rnam pa kun tu don nyams shing / /mi mthun kho na'i dbang du 'gro/ /zhes so/ /yang der/ 'gong po 'khrugs byed lo nyes gtong / /mi nad nor nad chag sgo ngan/ /ltas ngan dam nyams dbyen sbyor byed/ /bse rag byed dang dgu bo ni/ /zhes 'khrugs byed kyi 'gong bo spyang mgo ru dar can sogs dgu ste/ ma 'ongs bod khams mtha' dbus kun/ /'gong po spun dgus dbang byas te/ /dus 'khrugs nad yams lo nyes gtong / /kun kyang snying 'phyo yid mi dga'/ /sogs dang / ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /mtha' bzhi'i 'gong pos bod khams khengs/ /dbus kyi dam sri glo dur ldang / /bar chad rlung ltar 'tshub pa'i tshe/ /tshe dang nor dang shes rab sogs/ /yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur kyang / /rlung dmar dbus kyi mar me ltar/ /'gal rkyen du mas glo bur gsod/ /tshe 242

྾ dbangachenarta skad/ ngo da/ zithung nor rgad shes rab 'grib/ /blo sna 'gyur zhing mi rung spyod/ /ces te/ de ltar mtha' bzhi'i 'byung bo dang / /dbus kyi dam sri blo dur bsdong / bod khams chu ltar 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ /zhi ba'i thabs kyis mi 'dul bas/ /zhes mtha' dbus bsdong ba dang /de gdul dka' bar bshad/ de ltar mtha' dbus kyi 'byung bo bsdeb pa'i dbang gis/ mi rnams kyang mtha' dbus 'dres/chas spyod 'gyar/ grub mtha' 'chol/ bod khams sil bur 'thor/༄ cho srilha rgyud chad/ sngas/sa rgyud nyams/ sa —da bang yang rang tshugs shor/ brtan pa bral te/ sdug bsngal gyi mtsho chen rdol bar bshad do/ /dpal 'dus su'ang / ma 'ongs lnga brgya tha ma'i tsheḥ mtha' yi rgya 'dre 'byung po dngaḥ /dbus kyi dam sri glo bur bsdongasaḥchos pa'i snying zhugs mi dge spyodaḥ skye bo'i snying zhugs sdig rgyud spelaḥ rmi lam btsun pa bya sprel rmiḥ bag mi phebs shing snying rlung ldangaḥ zhes dang / ma 'ongs bskal pa'i tha ma laḥ sngags la spyod cing dam tshig bralaḥ de dag 'gong po'i dbang gyur teḥbya ru mi rung sna dgu spyodaḥ de yi rgyu 'bras 'joms pa laḥ gnyen po 'di las gzhan du medaḥ ces bshad de/ de 'dra ba la stong nyid snying rje khros pa'i lha sngags 'di lta bu zhig dgos pa yin no/ /mthu chen gyi 'byung po gcig tsam btul ba la'ang dgos pa mang du 243

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—྾ ྾4 4ba —rigs su bsgrub na dngos grub myur: phrin las mtha' rgyas gzhan snang dbang du sdud: 'gal rkyen mi 'byung byang chub go 'phang nye: zhes gsungs pas gu ru'i rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngasas su pad+ma'i rigs kyi rtsa ba'i yi be nyid ches 'thad pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang 'di'i gtso bo 'od gsal rdo rjer gsungs pa ni/ rigs re re'ang rigs drug ka'i bdag nyid dang / ye shes re re'ang ye shes drug ka'i ngo bo nyid yin pa/ phreng ba las rigs re re'ang lnga lnga'i rang bzhin du bshad pa lta bu ste/ de las 'dir pad+ma'i risas la rigs drug tu phye ba'i rigs thams cad bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /trīḥyib gi bshad pa gzhan yang tshe sgrub ye shes 'od mchog las/ bzhi ba bsnyen pa srog gi bzlas pa ni: thugs kar jiḥgasal jiḥyig mang du bzlas: de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi srog yin no: ha ni rlung yin longs sku kun gyi sngags: de nyid bzlas na rlung sems gnyis med grol: ra ni sprul sku smin byed de yin te: de bzlas drod kyi ye shes skye bar 'gyur: a ni skye med chos kyi sku yin te:i ni don dam ngo bo nyid dang ldan: rtogs shing bzlas pas bde stong mchog tu 'gyur: des na bde kashegs yongs 'dus sngags 'di bsnyen: jiḥ zhes rlung sems thams cad gtum mo'i 246

dbang ra rta skad/ pod/ 6dbyings su zhugs pa las bde stong lhan skyes kyi ye shes 'char zhing /de las rdo rje gsum mam sku gsum dbyer med pa'i bo 'phang la sbyor ba'i rdo rje'i lam gnad ches rmad du byung ba bstan no/ /'di'i dzab mjug bsdu ba'i dngos grub sbul ba dang 'brel bar thugs rje skul chog rgyas par spro na bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum ltar byed btub cing / mchod phreng rgyas spro byed na'ang de nas len no// / /trīḥyig ni ha dang ra dang i gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid kyi yi ge thig les brgyan pa ste/ ye shes thig le'i dka' 'grel las/'dab ma sanyis pa'i bzhi ba'o zhes bya ba ni yiXbe ha'o// /de'i 'og tu me'o zhes pa ni ra dang ldan pa'o/ /dbyangs yig ces pa ni yī'i bdag nyid dang sbyar ba'o/ /rigs pa'i rgyal mo mchog ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying bo yi ge bhāḥ'o/ /thig le steng du ldan pa ni spyo gyi don no/ /de rang dang nye ba ni jiḥste gnyis pa'o//zhes rig sngags kyi rgyal mo yi ge gcig ma'i sngasas btu tshul gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de'ang g.yung drung 'khyil ba gsum gyi zhal gdams las/ trīḥni thig le gsum du bzhugs/ /i ni rlung gi thig le ste/ /ha ni byang chub thig le'o/ /rak+ta'i yi ge ra yig ste/ /zhes pa ltar/ srog 'dzin shin tu phra ba'i rlung dang / khams 247

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/— ྾྾྾྾྾ ྾r+yā—dkar dmar ro/ /tsheg drag gnyis kyis dhu tir byang sems dkar dmar gyi 'du 'phrod mtshon gsungs te/ mdor na khu rdul rlung gsum bde stong du ro gcig 'dres pa'o/ /tsheg drag thig le yin pas bde ba la bshad kyang rung ngam dpyad/ gzhan yang bhāḥyig gis gzhi la khams dkar dmar gyi dbus su rlung sems zhugs pa dang / sgrub pa po'i lus ngag yid gsum/ rtsa thig rlung gsum sogs sbyang sazhi dang / rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor sogs sbyong byed kyi lam dang / sbyangs 'bras sku bsung thugs rdo rje gsum sogs mtshon tshul mang du spros kyang chog ces thu'u bkwan pas so/ /dper na myu gu'i cha shas thams cad rdzogs par skyed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i chos zhig la myu gu'i sa bon zhes 'dogs pa ltar/rta mchog rol pa'i go 'phang skyed pa'i nus pa thams cad trīḥyig la tshang bas sa bon gyi yi ger bzhag par 'chad do/ /'di'i las sngags skabs/ byer gtub sogs bod skad 'dres pas sngags su mi 'thad do zhe na/ dpal ldan lha mo'i sngags bh+yo bdun mar yang /kha la raka chen mo zhes yod pa sogs bshad nas/ mdor na sngags gsungs pa po dang sngags su byin gyi rlob pa pos skad gang dang bang du byin gyis brlabs pa de kho na dbang btsan par byed dgos kyi/ thams cad saṃ skri ta'i skad kho na dang mthun dbos 248

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa kyi gting du 'gro/ bcu bar ye shes lhag ces shes rab de'i 'od zer gyi snang ba'i gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin chos dbyings dang mnyam pa mched/ rgyun mthar shin tu rnam dag gi dbyings la 'bigs pa'o/ /sems can gyi don bya ba la mgyogs pa/ zhes par yang / bdun par thabs kyi phar phyin gyi mthus 'akog pa'i dbyings nas skad cig kho nar sems can gyi don la ldang nus/brgyad par rnam par mi rtog pa la dbang ba dang smon lam gyi phar phyin lhag pas gzhan don la rtsol med du ldang / sa der de ltar ldang ba byang bas dgu ra brtags pa mtha' bzung gi zhi mtha' las 'das tshar ba'i sgo nas gzhan phan la dbang 'byor/ de'i dbang gis bcu bar sems can sgrol ba'i phrin las sangs rgyas dang mtshungs par 'thob/ lar sa dang po nas skad cig gcis la sems can brgya smin par byed kyang phal cher don yod tsam las mi 'jog la/ brgyad pa nas dbang bcu thob pas rnam kun don yod zer te skad cig rer sems can ci tsam 'dul ba'i myur khyad kyang stong gsum gyi rdul tshad la ma gzhal bar bstan mi nus pa de'o/ /'di dag hang 'gros tsam ste/ 'phags pa 'di bar chad med lam gyi rang bzhin du gsungs pa dang / dkyil 'khor nang ma la 'god pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs bsgrigs nas dpyad rgyu yod/ mdor 260

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6pa na blo kun rdzob pa'i spyod yul nas phar don dam pa'i dbyings su mngon sum du sleb myur ba dang dbyings de nas tshur kun rdzob kyi spyod yul sleb myur ba'i shes rab dang thabs kyi rtogs pa ring du song tshul banyis te/ phyi ma 'di ni/ mya ngan 'das la mngon dga'i phyir/ /rtogs pa bul ba yin par 'dod/ /ces pa'i bzlos zla ste/ 'jam pa pad+ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo'i rnal 'byor snying rje'i khyad par ro/ /snga ma yang stong nyid rtogs pa spyi ldog ma byas par sor rtog ye shes la sbyar na pad+ma'i rigs kyi sgos chos su 'grigade ltar na spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan la 'chad tshul gnyis yod pa ltar/ rig pa'i rgyal po rta mgrin gyi mtshan gyi don yang gnyis yod do// / /rta skad skabs/ khams gsum dbang du snyud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa/ zhes mang du 'byung ba ni/ dbang du bsdus nas gdul bar bya ba rnams sdud pa dang / de ltar mi thul ba rnams spa bkong (rgyal po'i mthu dpung gi zil bstan nas pha rol gyi rgol ba spa gong bar byed pa lta bu'i zilaganon ni dbang sdud kyi sngon du 'gro ba yin no) bar byed pa'i khyad dam snyam/ yang na phyi ma/ dbang du bsdus pa de las sbar 'phar ldang mi nus par byed pa'o/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad dru gu 'dzings pa dang / thag 'khrugs pa lta bu rnams 251

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6ba ma ba ma dgra 'dre gcan gzan rngon pa sogs rmongs rengs byed pa/ rang gi nor dang 'khor sogs zil gyis mnan nas gzhan du mi g.yo bar byed pa/ nad pa'i nad sgyugs par byed pa/ lcags sgrogs dang btson ra rdzas (sel dang / gtad dang / pha rol byi gdug pa'i sems dang / lta ba ngan pa dang / mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul sogs) sngags phyag rgya 'phrul 'khor gyi sbyor ba la sogs pa'i rgya bshigs pa/ gzhan gyi sngon gnas kyi dge ba'i bag chags skul zhing sad du gzhub/ pa dpa' bo ḍāk+ki'i chos mdzod dang / gnod sbyin dbang po'i nor g.yang sogs 'bod pa/ gdul bya mchog la rnam g.yeng dang rmongs pa'i g.yogs pa dral nas nang gi te ru ka skul zhing sad par byas te byin rlabs 'bebs pa dam pa'i chos spyi dang bye brag pa'i rang sgras yangs pa'i sa chen po 'gengs pa sogs las tshogs byed tshul zad mi shes te/ dper brjod tsam mo/ /gzir ba'i bsam pas gzir bar 'gro lugs shes nas rta skad kyis gcun na/ ri rab gzir yang ral/ rgya mtsho gzir yang 'phyur thub/ brgya byin gzir na'ang skra zhig gos nyil nas lhung yong nges/ gong smos las yang na khams gsum gyi srog 'dren pa dbang sdud dang / srog de gzir ba zil gnon du bya'o// //'di dag rje nyid nas zin tho lha bur btab yod pa rnams gzhan du 'khyar gyis 263

྾ pod/ 6 ྾༄ /rdo rje rta skad kyi zin bris dngos grub gsum gyi zogs ldan 'jin ma dbang byed lha'i 'khor lo la nye bar mjo ba'i dpyad rten dran tho bathugs/tha ram las gsungs pa'i theg rim dang sbyar ba dang / sa lam dang sbyar ba gnyis kyis rim bzhin gar dang glu'i de nyid du sbyar na'ang rung ngam dpyod//'gros dgu'i theg rim dang sbyar ba sogs rta skad kyi bshad par gsung ba ni/ bka' gdams dpe 'grel las/ a pha'i skad du/zhes pa ltar rta skad byas pas rtar mtshon la/ rta'i mtshon don la de rnams yod pa'i don te/ de dang 'dra bar rta zhal gyis kyang rtar mtshon te/ thags rje chen po'i dab la a mi tā bha dang de'i zhal ༄ ༄gdam nga can du byed pa bzhin no/ /'gros dgu jeg dgu dang sbyar bas ni lam 'og ma thams cad kyi byed las rta mchog gi lam mam lhan skyes kyi bde ba'i chags lam nyid la tshang zhing / de'i byed las mtha' dag par ma tshang bar bstan/ sa lam skad 'gyur dang sbyar bas ni thabs shes phul du byung ba'i lam 'dis sa bcu lam lnga bde myur du bgrod tshul ston par rta rgyud dang tha ram las so//265

pod/ 6 rdo grubaX'ajigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/——4 ྾྾r+yā 4 'gros dgu'i dang po ni/ sgrog gsum lag tu tshud pa'i 'gros/sanyis pa lag gnyis lcags sgros bis bsdam pa'i 'gros/ gsum pa 'ching byed med par rang nyid dal bus 'gro ba/ bzhi ba rta mgo 'phang bsgrim nas cung zad malhogs par 'gro ba/ lnga ba gom pa'i 'gros su malhogs par 'gro ba/ drug pa 'dur 'gros/ bdun pa lding stabs kyis 'gro ba/ brgyad pa shin tu mgyogs par rgyug chung byas te 'gro ba/ dgu ba rgyug rtsal ci yod phyungs te thag thogs med par 'gro ba rnams dang / skad kyi yon tan bsum pa rgyang ring du thos pa/ bzhi ba sgra gzhan dang nag nog med par sang nger thos pa/ lnga ba dbugs sna ring ba/ bdun pa gdangs che chung sog/sa cha stoms par 'brel ba/ brgyad pa skad gtong theb gcig po der sgra bar ma chad par sgrogs pa/ bcu ba skad che chung ji ltar 'byin 'dod pa bzhin bde blag tu 'byin ba'i rtsal yod pa/ bcu gcig pa sgra gdangs che ba zhes bla mas gsungs/ gzhan sba/ skad kyi chos mthun lnga ba thugs rje ngang ring ba ste skyo dub med pa/ bdun pa thugs rje rgyun chags pa/ brgyad pa thugs rje'i mdzad pa rgyun chags /yang skad bcu gsum skabs/ thun mong ltar na/ ye shes thig ler/'di kun dga' ba'i bye brag ste//zhes pa ltar don gyi lhan 266

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ bka' sgo las gsungs pa'i dbye ba rnams gsang sngab/sa la shan dbye ba'i skabs su sbyor/ gsang sngags la shan dbye ba zhes pa ni 'di'i zab lam theg pa dang rgyud sde 'og ma'i skor rnams las 'phags pa'i che ba ston pa ste/ bla med kyi lha sazhan las kyang myur ba yang bshad rung ngam dpyad/ yang snying 'dus par/ rta dbus gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par mtshon zhes gsungs pa'ang de ka'o/ /zhal gsum gyis kyang zung 'jug mtshon pa sgyu 'phrul ltar yin mod/ skabs 'dir rta mabo/sa mtshan pa'i g.yas zhal gyis sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor mtshon/ zhes sogs su sbyar nas/rta mgos mtshan par bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan/ khro zhal gsum gyi nges don nam de kho na nyid gsum po rjes chags kyi rigs las skyes par mtshon pa'i ched yin no/ /dpal gyi rta skad skabs/ snying rje'i 'tsher skad kyi sngags sgra dang po bsgrags pas snang srid thams cad pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du sprul par gsungs pa 'di rta skad kyis dbang sgyur lugs khyad par can te/ gsang rdzogs rang shar gnyis las 'di kho na rta skad thengs gsum du bshad tshul 'byung ngo / /('dir snang srid thams cadazil gyis gnon pa'i dmigs gnad la snang srid thams cad rta mgrin dbang gi dkyila'akhor du sad par bsamatshul 'di ni/ rnal 'byor bla med spyir/ gang du bde chen zhes bya 258

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—3—— ྾ba 4ba bab ba44ba4ba ba ྾ba ba ba ba —tsubabade myur du bgrod pas na rta'i zhal lo/ /'tsher skad ni 'bod cing skul bar byed pa'i chakas skad de/ gang snang brtan sayo thams cad lhan skyes ye shes kyi mdangs su kha dog bsgyur te/ ma rig pa'i gnyid kyis non pa'i 'khrul snang 'di dag lha sngags ye shes kyi 'khor lo nyag gcig tu sad par byed cing / de'i tshu' gyis snang gras rtog gsum bde chen bsam mi khyab kyi thig ler bsdus nas 'od gsal dang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i ltad mo gnyis la rtse bcig tu byed pa'o/ /yul snang gang shar gyi steng du bde ba'i rtsal 'bar ba'am rgyas pa la bde chen bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs su 'jog pa ni/mtshan brjod las/ gad rgyangs ha ha nges par sgrogs/ /sogs dang yang phyogs mthun no//sems can gyi dus na shes pa yul la g.yo ba'am yul bgrod par byed pa la rlung zhes zer la/ de'i rtsa ba mthar btub na 'od gsal gyi bzhon pa'am 'od gsal spro('gro)basbu('ong)byed mkhan gyi rlung mi shigs pa la thug go /'bras dus su de 'dra'i g.yo ba de gtan nas med kyang / de'i dod du ye shes rang gi steng na brtan kayo'i 'jig rten mtha' dag la khyab par zhugs nas de thams cad bde ba'i ro nyams su 'char bar byed pa'i rtsal shugs mthar phyin pa yod pas/ de nyid la sngon gyi rjes su 'brangs pa ste/ rgyu dus 261

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/par la 'jog pas/ rjes chags kyi 'tsher skad du ches 'thad do//mtha' bral stong pa nyid ni chos thams cad kyi gting mthar thug yin te/ sdud par/ shes rab kyis ni brtags na phung po'i gting mi rnyed/ ces dang / mthar thug bden pa/ zhes dang / don dam bden pa ni kun rdzob kyi gnad gsang de phan chad du 'byed rgyu med pa yin pas de rtogs pa la shin tu rnam par phye ba'i blo zhes bshad par sa bcu pa'i dbyig 'grel las gsungs pa rigs pa mtshungs so/ /de lta bu'i gnas lugs kyi sating phigs pa'i rnal 'byor bla med pa'i bde chen gyi rta skad ni rdo rje rta skad ces bya ste/srid zhi'i chos gang la yang thal byung thogs med du 'jug pa'i phyir dang / shin tu tshabs cher 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na dngos po thams cad kyi rang dbang gi rgya gtan nas bshigs te/ gnad srog nas bzung ste 'dren par byed la pha lam gyi kyo bas lcasas 'bisas pa la rtsa'am shing gi go chas srung mi nus pa lhar/ de la bar chad kyi rnam pa gang gis kyang babegs byar med pa yin no/ /bde stong bi/ rnal 'byor gyis yul snang zil gyis banon pa'i nus pa k+kong du gyur pa na/ dbang gi rgyal srid thob pa yin pas thun mong gi dngos grub dam par bsngags shing / rta skad kyi dgongs pa de dang mi mthun pa'i yid byed mnyam rjes thams cad du bkag ste/ lhan skyes kyi 266

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6bde ba'i steng nas de kho na nyid la sems brtan par byed pa ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi rtsa ba dam pa yin pas/ rta skad kyi rnal 'byor dngos grub rgya mtsho'i srog tu gzung ste/ bde 'dus ma tshang kha skong ba'i rgyud kyi le'u dgu ba dbang chen sgrub pa'i kha skong gi le'ur/ rtogs pa'i ri bo sems nyid du: snang ba thams cad dbyer med na: thun mong dngos grub dam pa yin:dbang gi dkyil 'khor rang la snang: rig pa'i rgyal po rang dbang thob: rang rig bde bar gnas pa ni/ dbang gi sgrub pa'i mthar thug ste:mchog gi dngos grub rtsa ba yin:zhes so//snang ba dbang du gyar na snang srid tshur 'du ba'i tshul khyim shar ma ma da paragasum zan ra rdo brgyad dbang sdud la sbyar ba da gzhan rnams 'a 'ang 'dra bas/rang snang dbang du 'dus na bzhan snang zil gyis non ces rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung sgros las 'byung / des na bka' brgyad bsdus 'bring gnyis las gzung 'dzin dbang byed kyi gnad 'di dbang gi rta skad kyi dgongs par gsungs te/ shin tu gces par snang ngo //rje grub thob chen po'i pad+ma sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i gzhung 'dir rta skad bshad tshul ni/ rta skad kyi dbye ba/ de nyid/ mdzad pa dang gsum las dang po ni/ bro chog las rigs drug gi rta skad so sor 267

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 64྾྾ ྾ ྾su rgyud las gsungs pa dang sbyar nas nges pa drang ngo / /dngos grub bsgrubs kyang ma grub na spogs chog bya ba'i skabs su spyod rgyud las/stong nyid sgom pa spogs chog gi mchog tu sa/sungs pa dang / stong nyid sgom byed kyi yul can la lhan skyes kyi bde ba bsngasas pas/ de dang yang snga ma sbyar na dga' ba ster te 'di gzhan nas blangs so// rta skad kyi sasal byed dran tho mkhas pa'i yid 'phrogs 'di la zhar byung gces pa 'di lta bu yod de/ 'jig rten dbang po'i mtshan brgya la/ mchos chen rdo rje'i glu la bstod pa/ zhes gsungs pa dang /kye rdor brtags pa phyi ma'i lnga bar/ klu gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis blang / zhes gsungs la/ khyad par 'tsher skad ni rjes chabs kyi glu dbyangs yin pas 'dod chags rdo rje'i risas so/ /'dus kye sogs las/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi phyag rgya gar mkhan gyi du mo zhes bshad pa dang / 'od dpag med la gar dbang zhes rgyud mang por grags/ rta rgyud rnams su bro kho na rnam grangs du mas yang yang bshad yod pa'ang 'di ltar yin/ gsang rdzogs las/ glu bro gar la/zhes dang / sgyu dra las/ bro gar 'du 'phro'i yo byad/ ces pas bro gar 'dra'o/ /de ltar na pad+ma'i ribs rnams kyi rigs chos kyi las(sgo gaspum gyi bya ba mtha' dag glu gar gyi ting nge 'dzin kho na'i steng nas skyong ba ni/ bde mchog pa'i g.yon pa'i kun spyod lhar 'di'i sngags pa'i bslab pa'i kun spyod bla na med 269

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4྾ — ྾— ྾྾྾ par snang bas pha'i rigs kyi las la bu nges par spyod pa bzhin du yi dam bya'o)ni glu bro'o/ /des na de gnyis kyi sgo nas dngos grub sgrub pa 'di rta rgyud las mang du gsungs la/ gzhung 'dir yang rta bro rigs drub/ dang /de dag gi sgo sa mdzad drug spyi'i che brjod dang bcas pa bsungs so//grol thig rta mgrin dregs 'dul las/ 'khor 'das dbang du sbud pa'i gdeng ni:dbang chen rta mgrin gyi ye shes kyi rol ba chen po gcig las nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i ngang las bang la yang nyam nga ba dang bag tsha ba med par gdon bgegs kyi steng du thog brdzis bya'o:de lta bu'i dgongs pa dang ldan tsa na lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro: dregs pa can rnams las la bkol nas bran bzhin du las byed do: gal te bran du mi khol ba'am las byed du ma 'dod na: oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yoḥsogs/ zhes rtsa sngags la btag nas bro brdung bas bar chad gdon bgegs rdul du brlag par the tshom med do: zhes snang srid thams cad bde chen gyi rol bar lta ba'i sgo nas mi phod pa'i yul du thog brdzis gtong bar bshad de/ 'di ni brtags gnyis las spyod pa'i skabs su/ nges par sngon du lha min gang / /brgya byin lta bu yin na yang / /de la 'jigs par mi bya ste/ /seng ge'i gzugs kyis rnam par rgyu/ /zhes 270

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6gsungs pa lta bu ste gal che'o//de dang 'dra bar rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las kyang / thug phrad kyi dngos po gang la yang mi bzur zhing rbe tshom med par spyon pa'i brtul zhugs kyis rdzi zhing rdeg pa ni sadug pa dang dregs pa can mtha' dag thogs med du 'dul ba la nges par bsten par bya ba'i brtul zhugs su gsungs te/ bar chad kyi rkyen gang dang phrad kyang de ma thag sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i rnal 'byor gyis rdzi zhing 'gro ba dang / de'ang yang dang yang du rdeg pa'am rdzi ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis brtul zhugs byed pa nyid do/ /de dag kun kyang rta bro'i dgongs spyod nyid 'chad par snang ngo / /dang po nas mos sgom tshun chad kyis koms par byas na mthar yul rkyen bzang ngan thams cad zil gyis gnon nus so/ /dus ngan gdon bgegs/ sngon las/ dus kegs sogs gang la'ang bdag gnyis kyi srog dang ldan par mthong ba'i log shes ci tsam shugs che ba de tsam du de'i rang mdangs yul la shar nas bar chad gang yang srog dang ldan pa dang / de'ang rdo rje ltar brling ba'i srog dang ldan pa bzhin du mthu che zhing gzhom dka' bar 'gyur la/ de lta bu'i 'dzin pa phyin ci log gi 'khrul 'khor zhig nas/ bar chad de dag thams cad rang sems kyi gshis la gtan nas ma zhugs pa'i los rtog glo bur ba kho na'i rtsa ba can gyi rgyu rkyen dang cha shas mang po la 27

rta skad zin bris/ po da/ 6 med par bya/ /mnyam par ma bzhag rnal 'byor gyis/ /rtag tu mnyam par 'jog par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs so/ /de ltar glu gar gnyis kyi de nyid gcig yin kyang / rkang stabs dang sngags tshig gi sgo so sor shar nas rim bzhin sku'i mdzad pa dang gsung gi mdzad pa'i sgos dngos grub kyi re ba rdzogs par mdzad pa'o/ /bro phyag rgyar 'jog na'ang rung ste/ (bro gar gnyis kyiXkhyad par ni/rkang pa'i bro dang / lag pa'i gar zhes pa ste/ bros ri brag dang / sa 'og gi 'phrul 'khor sogs la thogasapa med par 'byol laka gar gyis kam makar 'asto kar 'asdir zhes sgyu 'phrul ba rnams gsung ngo / /'di ni rgyu 'phrul las bshad tshul yin gyi rnam pa kun tu 'khyer mi btub snyam/)sgyu 'phrul las/ rkang gnyis chos dang las kyi sems dpar gsungs nas/ yan lag thams cad dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs nas phyag rgya spros pa'i le'u/ zhes gsungs pa sogs kyis rkang ba bsgul bskyod phyag rgyar bya ba bstan cing gsang zhabs kyi lam rim las kyang gsal lo/ /'jig rten na skyid pa'i rkang bro zer ba ltar lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i nyams 'bar ba'i spyod par bro gar byed pa dang spyod pa des kyang nyams de spor bar byed pas de gnyis phan tshun grogs su 'jug pa ste/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i skabs kyi gar dang yang tshul 'dra'o/ /rje dang mchog gling thun mong gi gter kha gar chog rin chen rol ba sogs 'as/'a re 273

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga nga na gsal lo/ /bde chen gcig pu de nyid/ zhi zhing dang ba dang /dga' zhing spro ba dang / chags shing zhen pa dang / khro zhing rnam pa ste las kyi stong sems tha dad du nyams bsgyur ba'i bsam pa'i khyad par bzhin du bro gar gyi spyod pa yang rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan du mdzad nas gzhung 'dir gsungs shing / dngos grub kyang so sor gsungs so/ /bro 'dis snang ba dbang du byed par ma zad dbang du byas pa de las mi 'da' ba'am mi ldang bar zil gyis gnon cing rengs par yang byed do/ /phyag rgyas btab pa'i don du 'gro ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rnam pa gcig tu na/ glu bro'i de nyid kyi khyad par/ glu ni yul snang thams cad bde nyams su myos par byed pa'i bde ba de yin cing / bro ni bde ba de nyid yul gyi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su shar ba'i cha ste/ 'di/ gar mkhan dag dang ri mo bzang lhar snang / /gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ /gcig pus nyams ni du mas sar mdzad do/ /zhes par yang mthun/ de'i tshe blo ngor snang ba thams cad bde ba'i gar du byed pas bros brdzi bya zur du mi 'char mod/ gnas tshod la/ de 'dra'i rnal 'byor kyi bro 'dul byed dang / yul gyi phra men ma 'dul rgyu/ yul gyis rgyud phung bar byed pa'i gdug rtsub bro'i de nyid kyis bcom nas dngos grub kyi grogs su 'khol bar byed pa 'dul lugs su song yod do/ /'di ni rnal 274

za da/ 6 rdo gruba'ajibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/——ba ba ba bab ba ma ma ba ra ma ba ba phan yon 'chad pa na zhing mtha' yas pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa'i lha mor bcas pa rnams dang thabs cig tu 'dug par gsungs pa'ang 'di dang mthun no/ (glu ni 'gro ba'i yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi dbyangs dang / gar ni gdul bya ngo mtshar bar byed pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi spyod pa zhes bshad tshul yang yod 'ong ngam dpyad dgos) slar yang dkyus la 'jug ste/sngags bla med ltar na'ang / skyob 'dod kyi brtse ba dang / sbyin pa sogs dang / ting 'dzin rnam thar gyi sgo mtha' yas pa 'bras dus na yod par ni 'dod la/ sems gzhan ni 'bras dus na med par 'dod pas/ de thams cad rgya che ba/ gya nom pa/ zag pa med pa'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba stong nyid dang spyar ba kho na'i steng nas 'jog bo /des na sgra rtog sel 'jug yin pas sangs rgyas sa'i 'od sasal zhes pre ra tshe khol bu pa zhig ltar snang yang ma 'dres nga1'i chos sum brgya lta bu mdo phal bo che la sogs par rgya gang cher bka' basprul ba thams cad de'i cha shas re yin pas chung chung zhig tu mi gzung ste/ dper na sems rags pa zhes byas tshe 'ol le ba du ma cig ltar snang yang / las dang nyon mongs lam dang dmigs pa sogs kyis phye ba na mtha' klas pa zhig 'ong ba dang 'dra'o/ /des na 'bras dus su/ gang snang bde stong gi rol bar 'char ba na yang /der stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag bzhin pa'i sbyin pa dang snying 276

rta skad zid bris/ pod/ 6ba ba ba ba'i 'tsher skad 'byin par bshad pa'ang 'di dang gcig ste/ dril bu'i brjod pa sgra'i rnam gzhag dang 'dra se zhig snang ngo / /dbangachen gsung gi sngags pa'i nang mdzod chen mo gu tse rgya rgya rgya/ sgyu 'phrul sogs las chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa zhes mang du sasungs pa'i don ni/ der rnam rtog glo bur ba'i dbang gis ma dag pa'i snang ba bskyed par bsungs pa'i shugs kyis glo bur ba'i bslad rkyenaXgyi ba/zhan dbang med na ji lta bu zhika ce na/ sadod ma nas sangs rgyas pa zhes gnyug ma'i sanas tshod bstan pa yin no/ /gnyug ma byas tshad mi shigs pa la go mi dgos te/ sgyu ma'i khang bzang sprul pa na yang khang bzang gi snang cha de blo bur ba dang /snang gzhi'i gnyug ma'i ngo bo nyid rde'u shing sogs su gnas par 'dod pa yin no/ /sngags kyi skabs 'dir gnyug ma'i gnas tshod mthar thug de sgom par byed pas rang bzhin gzhi'i te ru ka sgom pa dang 'bras bu lam byed gnyis kar 'jog pa 'di pha mes kyi kha phor yin no//de la mnyam bzhag tu bshad ma thag pa'i rta skad kyis gnyug ma'am gdod ma'i stong phyogs bzlas pas/ rjes thob tu yang dag pa rab 'byams gnyub ma'i snang phyogs la rig pa bde blag tu 'jug ste/ 'di ltar/ bde stong mkha' ltar dag pa'i ye shes de nyid phung po lngar shar bar snang ba dang /de'i dbang gis phung po lnga yang 279

par/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ lam 'khyer kyis ji ltar gcad dang /de chos sku la ltos te 'bras ba ༄lam byed du 'gyur tshul dang /lha sgom pa dang /lha'i de nyid sgom pa gnyis ka lha'i rnal 'byor yin mnyam yin cing bde stong sbyor ba'i mnyam bzhag lha'i de nyid sgom pa yin zhes pa'ang mnyam bzhag de lha'i de nyid du dmigs pa'i steng nas rtse gcig tu dran par byas sto bas kyis drangs pa'i 'od gsal la dgongs pa yin gyi/ de lha'i de nyid du blo ngor bzung ma bzung ji ltar yang / lha'i de nyid du 'gro rgyu yin pa tsam gyis 'od gsal bsgo ma na lha bsgom pa'i ko chod par 'grub na mi 'grigs pa mang du 'ong ba sogs bsgrigs nas shes par bya'o /stong phyogs kyi rta mgrin nam rta skad de nyid ji ltar shusas che ba de ltar yang rjes thob dbang chen gyi rnal 'byor phul du byung bar 'gyur ba snga ma'i 'gres te/ tshul 'dis rta skad la byang bar byed pa ni rta lam gyi srog go/rje grub chen nyid kyi snyan brgyud kyi gcod yul las phaṭa kyis las rab 'byams byed pa la sngon du phaṭa bsnyen dgos par bsungs pa ltar rta skad kyis dngos grub sdud pa la sngon du de'i bsnyen pa bya dgos la/ de'ang yang gsang gi rta skad gcig mar rta skad jiḥyib tu bshad pa dang / (spyi mdo las kyang / rta mgrin gyi rdo rje sta ma bha na'i stobs kyis khro bo theg chen kun kyang 'dur thag gcod pa'i 'dur glu/ trīḥzhes pa 282

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6྾4 ྾ ྾྾—gdung ba 'bar ba'i nga ro yin pas/ 'dod pa'i sanas su bang 'gros kyi shugs phyungs nas 'gro ba mtshon no/ /thub pas gsungs pa'i theg pa mtha' dag rang rgyud ldan gyi gdul bya dngos sam brgyud nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'khyer ba'i theg pa'am bzhon par gcig kyang / de'i nang nas go 'phang der bde myur du dkri ba'i thabs mkhas kyi shugs gting nas phyungs pa ni/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rta mgrin nam/ bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi rnal 'byor yin pas de ni myur mgyogs kyi mthu phul du byung ba'i mthar thug go/yang gong du/ snang stong zung 'jug dang / ya ga/nyis kyi rta skad gsum gsungs pa de la/ zhal dang skad gnyis so sor bshad pa ni ches mi gsal yang / 'gro sgrol gyi snying rje chen po gcig pu de zhal gsum so so'i glu skad du 'gyur bar 'chad dam/ yang na/ stong phyogs kyi rta skad gong gi rta skad jengs gcig ltar dang / snang phyogs kyi rta skad ni/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung mi shigs nā da'i sgra dbyangs chos phung rab 'byams su 'char ba de dang / zung 'jug gi ni/ snang stong gi rta skad de gnyis gcig tu sbyar ba ste/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad khyab par bzhad pa'i sor rtog ye shes de nyid gsung dbyangs kyi rnam par shar ba/ zhes par 'gyur/ zhal gsum yang / thusas 'od gsal/ sku bzhin lag can/ de gnyis zung 'jug 286

〉pocad / 6 nga rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ nga dang gsum mo/ /'di 'bras dus dang sbyar ba ste/ lam dus la yang bsgre/ gzhan rang bzor 'gro dogs che bas ma bris/ dbang skad du 'gro lugs sba/ 'di'i rtsa ba'i man ngag lta phreng gi brjod bya rta skad kyis 'chad tshal ni/theg dba'i rnam gzhag ni 'gros dgu dang sbyor da da ba bde 'dus tha ram ltar dang / de las khyad par gsang ba sgyu 'phrul gyi lam rim ni rta skad jengs gsum gyis mtshon te/ rta skad dang po ni shes pa'i mtshan nyid de bsgo ma bya'am nyams len gyis sbyor bas 'jug yul shes par byed/ rta skad gnyis pa ni 'jub/ pa'i mtshan nyid de sgom byed nyams len kyi sbyor ba ste/ 'di la lam rim ye shes snying po ltar bskyed rim pa'i sto nga chen dang snying rje sgyu ma sosas lnga dang / rdzosas rim pa'i de lnga dang / bskyed rim nas rdzogs rim du 'pho byed kun tu bzang po'i man ngag sogs gsang thig ltar yod pa sogs spros pas chog mtshan nyid de gnyis ni mngon rtogs rgyan gyi/ 'jus/ yul mkhyen gsum/ nyams len sbyor bzhi zer ba lta bu'i bshad tshul du snang ngo / /rta skad tha ma ni mngon du gyur pa'i mtshan nyid de/ bsgom bya de sgom byed des bsgoms pa las gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu 'grub tshul lo/ /mtshan nyid phyi ma 'di rgyas par ni skad 'gyur bcu gsum dang sbyar nas shes te tha ram bzhin no//tshul 'di ni snyan brgyud rta mgrin la 286

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6brten nas bshad pa ste/ snyan brgyud kyi gzhung de dang sgyu 'phrul gsang thig sogs kyi ye shes kyi sku skrub lugs 'dra bar snang ba'ang yin te/ rags pa tsam la bsams so/ /rdzosas rim pa'i stong chen sogs lnga'i thad nas dpyad na sgyu 'phrul ba'i bzhed pa yang tshul gnyis su song ba 'dra ba zhig snang ngo //'on kyang 'di'i rdzogs rim pa'i snying rje sgyu ma dang / rgya gcig rlung sems kyi lha sku gsungs pa sogs man ngag sde ba'i lubs dang phyogs mthun par rlung gdangs stong gzugs kyi lha sku la bzhed pa 'dra zhig snang zhing sku gsum lam khyer so sor sbyor tshul la'ang dpyad rgyu 'dug pas rtsad gcad par bya'o/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas dang yang cung zad sgrigs chog gam//snang ba dbang sdud kyi gnad mthar thug snying por dril na/thabs mkhas dang mi ldan pa la nang rig pa la ltos med kyi yul nang mako rgyal bar shar nas sems kyi dbang phar 'phrogs pa de thabs mkhas dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor ba la bde chen gcig pu nyid kyis nyams ji ltar bsgyur ba de ltar snang ba'i rang sems kyi gar stabs nyag gcig tu shar nas mi shigs gnyug ma'i rta zhal gzi brjid rgyas byed kyi bcud len dam par 'gyur ba ste/ sgyu 'phrul gsang snying du/ srid zhi'i chos thams cad sems dang ye shes 287

bkang / 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyib gsung 'ab ma/na 'od gsal ngang bzhag gi ting nge 'dzin ma brjed pa'i ngang nas yul gang snang dang blo gang shar la blta ba goms pas/ ji zhig na/bya gar song yang nam mkha' zer ba ltar/ rnal 'byor bas gar bltas kyang rig pa las gzhan med pa zhig 'ong tshul yang yang gsungs pa rnams kyang de ltar yin pa ni/ zer sa gang rnyed nas sra sre byas pa min gyi rtsa ba'i dgongs pa bslad med du snang bas lam gyi gnad 'di ni rje btsun tsong kha pa'i sngar yang rnying phyogs la ma grags pa min no//mang du bshad pa'i bsnyu ba ni/ rta skad kyis dngos grub dngos su sgrub nus pa la ni/ sgrub thabs thun bzhir bsgom pa'i sgo nas rta zhal la reg mthong gi mtshan ma brtan po rnyed cing / rta skad la'ang gsal brtan de 'dra thob pa dang / rta skad kyi de nyid las su rung ba'i dbang gis skad de'i snang zhen gnyis ka ches phul du byung ba'i ngo bo nyid du bobs thon pa gnyis tshogs dgos so/ /de gnyis tshang ba na ni rta skad stobs su gyur pa dang / rta skad la nus pa rnyed pa yin pas/ gsung rta dbyangs kyi nga ro tsam gyis dngos grub rab 'byams byed pa'i dbang dang ldan pa yin no/ /de'ang las kyi phreng ba ltar sgrub thabs kyi sbyor mchod dang / tshogs mchodaXkyi gsang tshogs dang / thun mtshams bro rdung gi skabs sogs su bskyed rim 290

ngo ra/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i sasung 'bum/ba bam ba ྾ba ra ba ba ba —ma ba ba ba ba ba ྾—྾—ma ba 4 ting nge 'dzin gyis bar chad 'dul lugs yin te/ rta mgrin gyi sngags pa ni gdab las sogs la gtso bor mi byed/ 'di kho na byed snyam/ zhi sogs las bye brag pa sgrub pa'i rta skad so sor yod kyang /'di ni las sgrub tsam gyi dbang du byas pa min par rgyun 'khyer du skyong rgyu'i rta skad spyi'i khog tu bar chad 'dul lugs so/ /rta skad rang nyid dbang gi rigs yin kyang / de la brten nas zhi drag sogs las gzhan yang byar yod pa ni sbyin sreg dus dbang thabs las thams cad pa zer ba lta bu'o/ /rnam pa gcig tu na dbang du gyur pa'i dngos grub dang / dbang gi las ni las dang dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba dang srog lta bu yin te/ dngos grub gang yang dbang du ma gyur pa ni dngos grub de las su ma rung ba yin pas/de srid du dngos grub kyi bya ba mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /dbang gi rta skad ces pa'i tshis zur gyi dbang dang / las bzhi'i nang gi dbang las gnyis la rgya mtsho dang ya nu na lta bu'i khyad yod pas/ lha 'di mchog sgrub dang las sgrub kyi lha gnyis las snga ma yin pa dang / 'on kyang las bzhi'i nang nas dbang las la bsngags pa mi 'gal bya ba sogs dpyad dgos/ bshad tshul gcig la/ ji ltar mi bskyod rdo rje zhe sdang gi rigs yin pas mtshan yang zhe sdang rdo rje zhes grags shing 1 de'i gnad kyis las bzhi las mngon spyod la bsnga gas kyang 29 2

rta skad zinajis/ pod/ 6r+yā ྾ ྾྾las tshogs kyi lhar mi 'dod pa ltar/ dpa' bo'i dbang po 'di yang lus can rnams kyi 'dod chags sbyong phyir rjes chags kyi rigs kyi rgyal por bzhengs pa yin pas las sgrub kyi tshe dbang gi las la bsngags kyang mchog sgrub dang las sprub kyi lha gnyis las snga ma yin te/ 'di ni rin po che lta bu'i gang zag rim gnyis kyi lam gyis lha 'di'i gzugs su 'tshang rgya ba'i dbang du mdzad nas rgyud sde chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi rtsa ba'i bdag por bzhengs pa yin gyi/gtso bor las tshogs sgrub pa'i skabs tsam du gsungs pa min pa'i phyir ro/ /rta skad la'ang / lta bar sbyar ba dang / spyod par sbyar ba zhes lam gyi gzhung shing ye shes kyi don la dgongs pa dang /lam gyi cha lag phrin las kyi spyod pa'am mdzad pa la dgongs pa sanyis las/snga ma'i skabs su dbang las dang mi sbyor gyi/ lam gyi snying po rjes chabs lam byed kyi bde stong dang / de'i steng nas sa lam bgrod tshul sogs la sbyor ba tha ram bzhi'i dang po gsum ltar te/ rta skad kyi tha ram don bsdu'i thad dang bsgrigs na gsal lo/ /des na dbang gi rta skad ni rta skad spyod par dgongs pa'i skabs yin no/ /'a di bzang ngam dpyad/ gong 'og na mi mthun pa bas tsam yod de dpyad pa rtsing zhib las byung ngo / /de ltar he ru ka 'di ni bde ba chen po'i rnam 'gyur gsal shos yin pas/ rdo rje phur ba'i skabs 293

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsu nga 'bum/ma ba ma 34 su yang ye shes sems dpa'i srog la lhan skyes ye shes kyis dbang basbur ba zhes rdo rje sems dpa' la rta mgrin gyis dbang skur ba'i tshul bshad do//sangs rgyas gsang bas rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel bar bshad pa'i zla la drang na rta skad kyi don yang / srong btsan bka' 'bum gyi cang shes bā la ha'i thad ltar/ mi 'jigs pa'i gnas su 'gro bar 'dod pa su yod/ ces mthon por sgrobs pa la bshad dgos pa 'dra/rta mgrin dgongs pa lung ston sogs las/ mnyam dang skul dang rtakas tsam 'dzin/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ dbang chen gyi ting nge 'dzin sasal brtan tshad la phebs pas rta skad ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin dngos su thon pa tsam gyi spyi ldog nas dpal khrab 'thung dbang po dngos dang mnyam pa ni dang po ste/ 'di ni dngos grub la gtso bor rang stobs kyis mnga' dbang thob pa ste/ rig 'dzin grub pa'o/ /dngos po la rta skad de ltar mi thon yang / ting nge 'dzin las su rung bas bsam gtan gyi rta skad tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dngos grub la skul ba'i dkos pa dngos su byed nus pa ni gnyis pa ste/ gtso bor gzhan stobs kyis dngos grub mang po la dbang bsgyur ba'i skabs so/ /dbang chen gyi lha sngags ye shes la 294

rtaskad zin bris/ ngo da/ 6 rnal 'byor byed kyang / rta skad kyi drod de 'dra gang yang ma rnyed pa ni gsum pa ste/rnal 'byor ba'i brda skad du 'jog rgyu dngos ni/rta skad dngos su grub pa dang / de ma grub kyang nus pa cung zad rnyed pa'i bzlas pa'am bshug glu sogs dang / nus pa ma thob pa las dang po pa'i rta mchog sga brda skad rnamasate/ rnal 'byor pa'i sasang rdo rje rim pa gsam po 'di ni bskyed rim pa kho na la yang da da yod do//'di ltar bshad rung ngam dpyad dgos// rta skad yi ger brjod na ji ltar yin pa ni/ bka' brgyad bde sasang sogs su bshad tshul sngar bstan zin pas bong 'os sgrigs la ltos/rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel bar/rta mgrin gyi rta skad la ihi hi zhes(snyan brgyud rta mgron gyi'ang skabs gcig na 'di bzhin yod)pa bshad cing / klong snying rig 'dzin 'khrul 'khor las kyang de ltar bshad/ spyir ni/ gzhung 'dir/ ye shes gzi 'bar rngam zhing bzhad pa'i sgrasaḥ zhes rta skad bzhad sgra yin par gsungs te/ gsang sgrub kyi bstod par/ rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ ces sosas de 'dra gzhan yang ches mang ngo / bzhad tshul yang 'di'i bro chog tu/nyi nyi hi zhes pa la yang yang bshad pa snyan brgyud rta mgrin dang yang ji bzhin du mthun no/ /de'ang bsnyen sgrub ci rigs 'ad ba na/de'i skabs rnams su rang gi ngas rlung rdo rje rta skad du 29 du

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6 rig ma dang lag pa'i pad+ma lu gu rgyud du sbrel nas 'khrab cing rtsa ba'i rjes chags kyi spyod pa yin la/ de'ang stoms 'jug gi dga' ba'i ros myos dus kyi chags skad rta mchog 'tsher ba'i nga ro dang sbrags na dga' ba 'bar ba la mthu shin tu che bas/ lus bro gar dang / ngag 'tsher skad/ sems rjes chags te gsum dang ldan pas rig ma la rtse bar bstan te/'dod chags rdo rje'i rigs la ci ste mi bsngags/ mdor na bros bde ba rgyas pa'i grogs su rta skad dkos pa'o/ /rta skad 'don pa dang bro rdung gi dus gcig ni/ mchod pa'i skabs te/ rat+na'i rta mgrin gsang 'dus su/ dbang gi rta bro dang glu'i mchod pa zhes rta rgyud nas bshad pa'i glu drug dang bro drug gis mchod pa (deraglu'i sngags dang / bro'i sngags gnyis tha dad du 'byung ba las/'di ni bro'i sngags su byas nas gsungs so) te na te te'i sngags dang bcas pa gsungs te/ 'di ni rta mgrin gyi thugs dam rtsa ba yin tshul bshad zin ltar mnyes pa'i mchod pa mchog go /de ltar sbyor na ni kha skong phrin las kyi phyag rgya gar mchod la ye shes glu'i mchod pa'ang yod par mchod sngags kyis shes pas/ der rta bro dang 'tsher glu'i mchod pa'i dmigs rim bskyang bas chog pa 'dra la/ de las kyang spro na thugs tig 'di ka'i bka' brgyad kyi glu gar mchod pa'i 297

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skabs su/ ma hā dz+nyā na te na hūṃḥ te na te te hūṃḥ zhes 'byung ba de sadangs 'gyur mtho dman ring thung ji ltar 'dod pas glur len cing / bro gar yid la gang shar bzhin byas nas nyams spar ba yang rung ba 'dra ste/ thang stong snyan brgyud las kyang / te na te te'i sngab/sa kyis bro gar snang ba la gang dran byas pas mkha' 'gro ma kams chasas shing gdung bar 'gyur bar phag mo'i skabs su gsu/ngas so/ /'di ni las sgab kyi rta bro btan min te/ rta bsang 4 du'ang bro mnan gyi tshis lha du ye med do/ /mchod pa'i glu bro ni sgyu 'phrul las/ glu tshig bro gar rol mo yi/ /sprin phung tshogs kyis rab tu mchod/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /('di dag ni/ spyira'adi 'dra'ang rung ngam zhes dpyad ga'ir bkod kyi/ gzhung rang na gsal kha mi snang zhing / bka' brgyad spyi'i khog nas kyang cher ma thon pas/ phyag rgya gar mchod ces pa'i gar gyi don dngos ni lag pa'i phyag rgya sosas sgyu 'phrul pa'i phyag rgya bdun sprags la bya dgos) bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi sgom khog sogs las kyang bshad de/ der ni/ phyag rgya gar mchod la phyag rgya'i mchod pa rgyas par spros nas/ de'i 'og tu glu bro'i mchod pa dz+nyā na te te'i sngags dang bcas pa 'byung ste so sor mdzad do//bde 'dus bro mnan chen mor/ dbus kyi rta skad lhang lhang thengs gcig gis: zhal nas mya ngan 'das pa'i chos kyang ston:298

—rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6g.yas kyi rta skad lhang lhang thengs gcig gis: rnal 'byor yal gam can la dngos grub ster: g.yon gyi rta skad lhang lhang thengs gcig gis: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dbang du snyud: ces gsungs te bskul chen dang mi 'dra'o//spyi mdo'i gsang sngags 'byung ba'i gnas skabs bcu sanyis kyi drug pa/gdul bya'i skabs la babs pa na yang 'byung /zhes pa'i rgyas bshad du/sngon ru tras 'jig rten gsum la dbang bsgyur ba na/kho'i mthus 'gro ba rnams kyi sems dang spyod pa shin tu 'khrugs te phyin ci log tu song zhing / de'i dbang gis snod bcud thams cad ches cher snyigs shing rgud par gyur pa'i tshe/'jib rten dbang phyug rdo rje rta'i gdong ba can sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskul te/ rgya mtsho'i do/lang ka'i grong rdal gyi dbus/ri'i rgyal po ma la ya'i rtser byon nas/ khams gsum yongs sgrol/ dug gsum gtan sprugs pa'i spyod pa mdzad tshul rgya cher gsungs pa'i skabs su rta skad bshad pa'i tshul ni/ ru tra la gdung ba bskyed pa na/ khos rang gi bka' 'og gi 'jig rten gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams dmag sde dang bcas pa/dmod pa grub pa'i mthu 'byung bo thams cad kyis bzod par dka' ba'i ngag gis ram zlar bskul te/ dpung tshogs bye ba dpag med kyi sprin gtibs nas/ bdud kyi sgyu 'phrul gyi drwa ba 299

pod/ 6 no grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma bkram pa na/ rta mchog he ru kas rdo rje sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gnon pa'i 'dur glu blangs par gsungs te/ de'ang trīḥzhes blang bar bshad do/ /'dur glu'i bstan don ni/ dga' rab dbang phyug sogs la 'dod dbang stong las lhag par sgegs pa'i gar dang /gshin rje'i rgyal po sogs la gshin rgyal stong las lhab par 'bar zhing khro ba'i gar dang / tshangs pa sogs la tshangs chen stong las lhag par zhi ba'i gar ram nyams kyi 'gyur ba ste/ mdor na rgyal ba kun gyi sku/ mthun pas mthun pa 'dul ba'i nyams tha dad du shin tu bsgyur ba'i sprul pa'i rgyud kyis 'jig rten gsum rgyas par bkang ste/ ru tra dang / de'i dpung dregs pa'i gtso bo thams cad shin tu zil gyis non cig de dag gi dga' ma'i tshogs rnams drongs shig gam 'gug par gyis shig nyon mongs shin tu shugs drag la spyod pa'i sems can rnams gdul dka' sba'i nges pa la mi ltos par sngags kyi thabs mkhas kyis thul cib ces pa yin par bshad/de ltar 'dur gru blangs pas/ bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams ni rengs te bag 'khum/ mtshon cha'i sprin phung ni stong pa nyid du sangs/ mi snyan pa'i ngag rgya mtsho ni rbeg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sgrar snang bar gyur to zhes bshad do//dge byed lo mjug nas dpyad pa gtsang du so nga ba rnams slar 300

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6yang mthud de bris pa/ lar dogs pa che ba ni/ sgrub sde 'di la pad+ma gsung rta skad kyi sgrub pa zhes grags pas rta skad kyi ting nge 'dzin rgyun ldan du skyong ba zhig la bsnyen sgrub kyi srog 'chol dgos par snang nga / 'di dang snyan brgyud rta mgrin sogs su dzab dgongs spyi khyab ltar las ma bshad pa ci zhes pa ste/ 'di la spyir thun re bzhin rta skad kyi snang zhen skyong rgyu ni dngos bstan la'ang mi gsal ba min te/ spyi gtsug rta gdong rngam ba zhad 'tsheraḥ zhes so/ /'on te rta skad de nyid dzab dbongs su byas nas skyong rgyu bstan ma bstan ni cung dka' bas dpyad na/spyir te ru ka 'di rjes chags kyi ngo bo nyid yin pa dang /'gro sgrol gyi shugs che zhing myur ba sogs kyis rta mchog tu bshad de/ tshul des rang nyid rta mchog yin pa'i mtshon byed du dbu gtsug nas rta gdong zhal gyi phyag rgya phar sprul pa yin gyi/ rta mgo yod pas rta mgrin du tshur bzhas pa ye min no/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das 'di'i sa/sung yang ril gyis rta skad du bshad rgyu yin gyi/ rta skad ces byas tshe rta gdong gi kha las skyes pa 'ba' zhig mi dkos te/ rta bro zhes pa'ang rta mgrin gyi zhabs bro la zer gyi/rta rmig gi rnam pas 'khrab par sgo ma mi dgos pa bzhin no//de ltar 'phags pa 'di'i gsung thams cad rjes chags kyi glu'i rang bzhin gyi rta skad kho na yin pa'i mtshon byed du/ dbu gtsug gi 301

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6phyir ro/ /(mkha' 'gro dam can rnams dgyes nas 'dus pa tsam gyis bdud bgegs bar chad byur dang mi shis pa thams cad drag shul gyi sazi brjid non po can de dag gi mdun du gnas mi nus shing / mephung gi 'khor du grang reg lhar mthu med par 'gyur bas bar chad sel thabs kyang zab pa'i phul phyin yin no) bde 'dus kyi ma tshang kha skong rgyud las rta mgrin gyi sgrub lugs la bsnyen sgrub gsum gyi bzlas dzab gtso bor byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gsung gi sgrub par bshad ces gsungs pa'ang de la dgongs shing / 'di nyid las/ dbang chen rta skad bzhad pa'i sgra: nus pa sngags kyi phreng ba yis:zhes bzlas sngags nyid rta skad du gsungs so/ /de'ang bdas don ye shes sgrub pa stod las kyi dzab kyi tshe/de'i rang rtags sa spyi gtsag da dngagi rta mgos kyang lta bar dgongs pa'i rta skad rtsal bton du sgrogs pa dang / gzhan don phrin las sgrub pa smad las kyi dzab kyi tshe rta mgos kyang de'i rtags su spyod par dgongs pa'i rta skad 'byin te/dzab ji ltar bsgyur ba de ltar de'i sgra brnyan rta mgo'i 'tsher skad kyang 'gyur 'gro'o snyam ste da dung dpyad/ 'o na bde 'dus tha ram sogs las spyi gtsug rta zhal gyi 'tsher skad kho na bshad pa ci zhe na/('di'i lan 'debs tshul/ de kho na bshad pa ma grub ste/ spyi bo'i rta skad bshad pa nyid kyis rta sngags spyir bshad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes zur 'khod ltar dgos kyanga'adir thag cha 'dzings pa lhar song yod) der ni sngon byung he ru ka nyid kyis sgra 303

rta skadazin bris/ pod/ 6nga pa'i tshul dang / de las pad+ma gsung zhes pa'i gsung gi khyad chos thun min de'ang 'grub 'ong zhig bstan nas/ de dang gtso bor sbyar ba'i 'chad tshul la rtsal 'don dgos so/ /des na spyi'i 'chad thabs su spyi bo'i rta skad dang / sprub thabs su bzlas sngags la sbyar nas bshad par shes par bya'o(mdor na dpal ho ru kas sngon spyi bo'i rta skadakyis dam can las la bkye ba'i cho 'phrul mdzad pa ni/ rjes 'jug la dngos grub kyisgo byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ 'di ltar rjes 'jug rnamasarta skadakyi sgo nas khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i srid thob par byaXba'i phyir ro/ /de'i ched du rta skad de nyid bzlas sngags kyi rnam par byin gyis rlob par yang mdzad de/ sngags 'di bzlas pa las rta skad deXthob par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /'di spyir yang mkho rgyu zhig red do)ci ste dbu gtsug gi rta skad kyis lha 'di nyid rang dang / 'di'i sku dang / sngags dang /ye shes thams cad rta mchog dang / rta mchog gi rigs kyi sku dang sngags dang ye shes su bstan nas/ 'di'i lam rim gyi khog thams cad rta mchog gi rigs kyi de nyid kyi sgrom du bcug nas sgrub tshul gsal bar mtshon nus pa ma yin nam/ de'i phyir de thams cad kyi snang zhen brtan pa'i 'dzin phur du spyi gtsug gi rta gdong bzhad pa'i dbyangs de btab nas bsgom pas/ de rnams kyi snang zhen la nus pa thon pa na/ grub rtags su dpal gyi rta skad spyi gtsug nas rang gi ngang gis thon(phur ba'i skabs bsnyen phur 'bar dang bzhad pa sogs kyi 306

par/ 6 rdogrub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dod yin)'ong ba yin pas/ de bzlas brjod kho na la sbyor ba ci ltar rigs she na/de la'ang zhib cha phye na/sku'i snang zhen grub rtags su rta zhal rma bya'i mdog can spyi bo nas dngos su thon pa dang /gsung gi snang zhen grub rtags de las rta skad kyi rol mo 'khrol ba dang / thugs kyi grub rtags bde stong sga nyams tshad bzung med par 'bar ba'i khyad yod pas/ gtso che ba'i dbang du btang ste gsung bzlas pa sngags la sbyar ba 'thad do/ /'on kyang spyir rta mgrin gyi skru dang thugs dang phrin las sogs kyang gsung gi rigs yin pas/ de dag gi mtshon rtags sa rta skad 'jog pa'i rnam ༄gzhag kyang 'dod parani bya ste/ gsang sngags la shan 'byed pa'i rta skad kyis shes/ de'i dbang du na sgrub lugs 'di'i sku phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor sogs kyang gsung rta skad sgrub byed du 'gyur te/ de dag gi rtags tshad mthil gtad sa'ang rta skad la byed pa'i phyir ro//de'i spyir yang sgrub lugs 'di la gsung rta skad kyi sgrub pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /yang na tha ram gyi dgongs pa 'di ltar bshad de/dpal he ru ka'i(sbu phyag rgya'i dang /gsung bzlas pa'i dang / thugs 'od gsal kyi rnal 'byor sogs)lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa dang / lam gyi cha rkyenaphrin las kyi sbyor ba yongs rdzogs rta skad kho na'i steng nas bshad pa 'dis sgrub lugs 'di la gsung dang / de las kyang rta skad gtso 306

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/— ྾྾ ྾྾gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang sbyar ba rnams kyis ni ye shes dag pa'i rta skad sgrub par byed la/ spyod par dgongs(rta skad spyod par dbongs pa'i dgongs pa rnams kyis ni/ zhes zer dgos)pa'i rta skad rnams kyis ni dbang drag las kyi rta skad sgrub bo//spyi bo'i rta skad sgrub tshul 'ba' zhig gi sgrom nas spyir theg dgu'i rtogs rigs dang / sa lam gyi rim pa/ bye brag dbang chen te ru ka'i lha sngags chos gsum gyi rnal 'byor/ phrin las kyi sbyor ba dang bcas pa sgrub lugs tshang bar 'chad pas na pad+ma gsung gi sgrub par brjod ces bshad kyang chog ste gnad 'dra'o/ /byir tshul 'di'i lam rim thams cad rta skad sgrub byed du 'gro ba dang /de'i nang nas kyang rta skad sgrub thabs kyi gtso bo dzab la byed pa gnyis cung zad kyang mi 'gal bas kong gi tha ram la brten pa'i dogs pa chod sla/ dzab rta skad sgrub byed kyi gtso bo yin pa'i khungs ni bde gsang gnyis sogs sngar bris ltar ro//drag po'i smad las ni gzhung rang na rgyas mod/ rta mgrin kyi dkos kyi smad las che mchog gi sman sgrub kyi dod ni dam can dbang sdud kyi dbang las zhig dgos par dbang gi sgrub lugs yin pa nyid kyis shes kyang mi gsal bas ji ltar bya zhe na/'dir ni stod las bdag nyid nus ldan du byed pa dang / smad las ma tshogs 308

྾ rtaskadazinabris/ pod/ 6྾dbang du byed pa gnyis ka gtso bor dzab dang rta skad sbyar ba'i steng nas byed de/ phur pa'i dgra dzab/ che mchog gi sman dzab sobs sgrub sde gzhan la'ang rang rang gi smad las sam de'i dod lta bu'i dgos sgrub kyi khyad par dang 'brel ba'i dzab dgongs bye brag pa re yod mod kyi/ de dag gi las sbyor gyi dngos gzhi de dzab dgongs kyi steng nas mi 'jog gi gdab kha dang rtsi sgrub sogs cho ga gzhan gyi steng nas khog phub pa sha stas yin la/'dir ni rang gi than min gyi ṭīlas sbyor yang gsung bzlas brjod kyi sgrub sde zhes dzab — klong sgrom nas rgya 'bag gi mig ltar 'phrul lugs kho na gtso bor byed pasakhyad par che'o/ /des na stod las kyi dngos gzhi ni rta skad lta bar dgongs pa dang / smad las kyi dngos gzhi spyod par dgongs pa la bya ste/ zhib par na/ spyod par dgongs pa la rtsal du 'don pa smad las skabs yin kyang / spyir stod las kyi sgrub pa'i dus nas lta spyod la dgongs pa gnyis ka byed de/ dam can pho nya las la bsgul:zhes pa'ang spyod par dgongs pa'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang / sgrub pa'i bye brag las sbyor ni:zhes pa ltar yin pas/sgrub pa'i dzab dgongs kyi bye brag cig las sbyor gyi tshe rtsal 'don byed pa ni 'grigs pa yin no/ /de ni lta bar dgongs pa gtso bo dang / spyod par dkongs pa zhar byung tsam du byas nas sgrub pa stod las dang / spyod par 309
