pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba ma ma dargongs pa gtso bo dang / cig shos de'i grobs tsam du byed pa smad las kyi sgrub par shes par 'gyur la/ phyi ma la'ang sngon du bsnyen pa'i ched dang / phyis phrin las dngos su sgrub ched du bya ba gnyis yod/ da dung bshad na rdo rje phur ba la bar chad 'dul ba'i stobs gzhan las lha ga pa zhig yod pa ni gdab kha yin la/ de ni dzab la gtso bor mi 'jog ste/ che mchog sogs la'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /(lam gyi khog ye shes kyi don dang sbyar ba ni lta bar dgongs pa dang / lam gyi cha la phrin las kyi don dang sbyar ba ni spyod par dgongs pa'irta skad do)sgrub sde 'di la mkha' 'gro dam can dbang snyud kyi gnad gzhan las no zhing zab la phul du byung ba zhig yod pa ni gadzu bor dzab la 'jog par gong du brjod zin pas de dag la smad las kyi chog rim zur ba la rtsal du 'don dgos mi dgos sam/ ltos tshabs che chung mi 'dra bar shes so/ /'on kyang rta skad de nyid bro rdung rgo grogs dang sprags nas kyang nyams su blang na rdo la ngar btags ltar 'gyur ba ni srong btsan bka' 'bum sogs kyi lung zur 'khod kyis shes pas gal che'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang / bzhad pa dang bro rdung gnyis ka tshogs pa'i brjid zil dang / nang du brtul zhubs kyi nyams spor ba'i nus pa 'dra ba la re re bar med cing / 'jig rten na yang glu gar gnyis 'dus kyis yid 'phrogs pa lta bu rkyang ba la med pas bar chad la 3/1)

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6 ba ba rdzi ba dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i yid 'phrog pa gang la'ang glu la bros bogs dbyung ba yin/ sgyu 'phrul ltar na bud med dang rtse ba'i gar gyis bde ba'i glu spyi dang khyad par rjes chasas kyi shugs ma bzod pa'i shugs 'byung gi rta skad dam 'tsher gru la grogs byed pa'o/ /de'ang tshogs mchod mthar byed pa ni sngar bris ltar dang / thun mtshams su byed na/ te na te te dang sbyor ba sogs ni rtsa gzhung dang mi 'byor bas/ las phreng gi bro mnan mtha'i/ oṃ badz+ra krodha byu hṝ ba hi hi nyi hūṃ phaṭaḥ ces pa 'di sham med du zlo ba dang sbrags pas 'grub par mngon te nyi sa/sum po ni rta glu yin no/ /yang phur pa'i skabs su las rab 'byams sgrub lugs la/ zhi las dngul lam shing dkar po'i phur bu zlum pos bya ba sogs phur gdab nyid kyis skrub tshul dang / sbyor ba sna tshogs gzhan gyi sgo nas sgrub tshul gnyis yod pa ltar/ 'dir yang las rab 'byams glu bro nyid kyis sgrub pa dang /tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyi rta mgrin brgya rtsa ltar sbyor ba gzhan sna tshogs kyis sgrub tshul gnyis yod cing(las mthun gyi 'od zer la brten nasalas bzhi spub pa'i sngags dang bsam katan gyi sbyor ba rig 'dzin zhi ba nas 'gebs tshul las tshogs brjed zorabakod pa de'ang tshul phyi ma 'di'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa ye shes dag nga 'i dngos grub kyi ched du dbang sdud bya ba ni lta bar dgongs pa'i thad du yin te rngog ma le brgan sogs 311

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4 ྾྾ ྾྾las shesaso/ /)de lta na'ang phur gdab bsngags pa'i las gtso bo mngon spyod yin pa ltar/ rta skad bsngags pa'i las gtso bo dbang drag sbrags ma yin la/gal te rta'i glu bro kho nas las gzhan sgrub na de'i tshul ni/ spyod par dgongs pa'i rta skad kyi dzab tu dam can dbang du sdud skabs/ phan gnod kyi las de dang de gnyer gtad la gtso bor bya zhing /de'i ngar 'dogs su las de dang de'i bro rdung yang ci rigs re bya ba yin te/smad las kyi bshad pa zhig sngar yang yod mod de kha pho ches pa tsam las phal cher bar snang la bsdad par snang //spyi gtsug rta gdong rngam bzhad 'tsher: zhes pa'i skabs su/rta'i zhal dang nga ro tsam gyis lha de ril rta mchog tu mtshon pa'am shes nus pa ni 'jig rten na'ang skyes bu de nyer sbas su shes pa'i sgor de'i rkang lag dang lto ba sogs ni ches mi gsal kyi byad bzhin dang skad kho na las shes par byed do/ /de ltar sngon byung du gdul bya la rjes chags kyi rigs kyi bde ba'i de nyid sogs bstan phyir zhal dang nga ro de ltar mdzad pa ltar rjes 'jug gis kyang de gnyis rang gi sgo gsum rta mchog gi rdo rje gsum las mi 'phyus pa'i gzer bur btab ste bsgo ma pas dpal gyi snang zhen skye sla zhing he ru ka'i 'khor gyi ma tshogs rnams kyis sgrub pa po dang de'i 31 2

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i sasung 'bum/4 ྾ ྾sogs 'bod pa na'ang de dag rjes chags kyi rnam 'phrul du bltas te/ bde ba 'bar ba'i grobs su khyer ba'i steng nas 'bod pa de yin no/ /) de'ang mo rgyud kyi srog 'dod chags yin par yang dang yang du gsungs pa ltar sa gsum gyi ma mo rab 'byams thams cad 'dod chabs kyi rigs kyi srog 'a brten pa sha stag yin pas/ rta skad dang po 'dis 'dod chags chen po'i ngo bo nyid kyi chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs kyis khams gsum ma lus pa 'dod chags rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du sad par byas pa'i sgo nas snang srid las dang ye shes kyi ma mo'i tshogs rnams rjes chags kyi shugs gting nas rang dbang med par bskrul zhing g.yo bar byed pa ni ma mo'i srob bi sgo lcags dbang chen gyi lde mig gis 'byed tshul yin no/ /spyi mdor/ stong khams thams cad rta mgrin gyi gar dgu'i rol pa mtha' yas pas chem mer mnan te/ dbang phyus('di glu gar gyis ma mo mkha' 'gro'i yid 'phrog tshul lo)ma rnams kyi snying 'dod pa bzod med du sayo bar byas pa'i sgo nas drang bar bshad pa'ang de ltar yin pas/ khams gsum bar gyis 'gengs pa'i glu'o/ /'o na 'di la'ang ma mo'i sros gi de nyid shes par byas nas ma mo dbang byed kyi sgrub lugs 'dus pas rbod gtong ma mo'i sgrub par yang thal lo zhe na/ sgrub lugs 'di ni ma mo'i de nyid kyis khog phub pa min zhing ma mo'i de nyid gtso bor 3 4
da zin dro

par/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga //rta skad bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /sam ṭa dpe bshus/ rta skad kyis snang phyogs stong phyogs zung 'jub gi lam gsum ston te/ de rta sngags kyi rang bzhin yin pa gang zhig sngags kyis ye shes de dag skul bar byed pa'i phyir te/sngasas ni snyan gsan 'bebs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skul zhes pa ni dbyug pas rnga brdung ba ltar bskul bya sgul byed ngo bo tha dad pa min gyi/ye shes de dag sngags der shar ba yin pa'i phyir de bzlas pas ye shes de dag bsnyul bar 'gyur ba'o /des na rta sngags kyi dgongs pa'am don de rta skad kyi de nyid kyang yin pas rta zhal dang rta skad kyi de nyid so sor mi byed dam snyam ste/ ye shes de dag rta skad dang rta gdong gi sgra gzugs su mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/theg rim bgrod tshul sogs so//spyod par dgongs skabs/rta skad kyi mtshon don bde 'dus las/ thun mong dngos grub dam pa yin/sosas ltar snang ba bde bar shar ba la byed dam brtags//phongs shing sdug bsngal ba'i sems can skyabs med cing skyob pa med pa/ skyabs tshol zhing rgyug pa rnams/ 'tshe ba dag ni thams cad dang sogs lnga dang / tha mal snang zhen gyi 'jigs pa las bde 3 8

rta skadabasdus pa/ pod/ 6myur du sgrol zhing /thar ba chen po'i grong khyer du phyin par byed pas na rta rgyal bzhon pa'i mchog go /des na gzhan phan phrin las kyi lha khyad par can te/ 'jigs pa med pa'i gnas su 'brel tshad sgro la bas so/ /lam gyis ngal ba srid zhi'i mtha'i g.yang la skrag pa rnams la stobs bcu ldan pa'i bzhon pa 'di 'jig rten dbang pos stsal ba yin no/ /theg pa rim bgrod kyi rta skad dus ya na zhes pa bzhon pa'i skad dod yin pa dang / 'dod pa'i gnas su zhon po 'khyer bar byed pa'i chos mthun gyi sgo nas jeg mchog bi brdar rta mchog bzhag ste/ de la dzeg pa sazhan gyi sgrol shusas sam byed las thams cad rta mchog la sgrog 'gros dang lcags 'gros sogs ltar tshang tshul bshad pas/ theg pa thams cad kyi sgrol shugs rta mgrin la yod tshul bstan te/'gro sgro la gyi shugs che lugs ston no//rta skad dam rta sngags lta bar dgongs skabs/snang phyogs dang stong phyogs kyi'am/ zab rgya che'i byang chub 'a ma gyi rtogs pa myur ba ster ba la bsngags pa'i sngags yin te/dkyus tshang ba'i 'gros dang sbyar ba dang / skad 'gyar dang byir ba'i bde stong ye shes sngags kyi /de/nyi da /de byed da du byas pa la dpyad na 1sa so/ /sngags ba dngos grub sgrub thas nye ba'ang 'dis shes/bsang sngags gnad skad dus/gang las ldog pa'i 'khor ba las sgrol shugs che ba/ gang du 'jug pa'i 3 9

za da/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ra sangs rgyas sar bgrod shugs che ba dang /kha rtsal che zhes pa ni steng du 'thon shugs che ba ste/ gong nas gong du rtogs pa khyad 'jug stobs gsang sngags gzhan bas che ba'o/ /de'ang phyi nang gsang ba'i rta mgrin gsum bshad kyang gtso bor gsang rdzogs dang lde mig ltar chos nyid byang chub sems zhes lhan skyes ye shes la sbyar rgyu yin no/ /'di'i bgrod shugs che ba'ang gsang rdzogs kyi/ sa lam bcad dang 'dra'o/ /de nas sku'i cho 'phrul rta mgrin cir snang yang /mya ngan las 'das tshul sogs ni gsang rdzosas rang shar gnyis las snang stong grag stong sobs dang 'dra ste/ byang chen du bgrod pa la bar du gcod pa'i gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag ye shes chen po'i bang 'gros kyi 'og tu ci bder 'bom nas thag thogs med par 'gro tshul ste/ nang sems la dbang sdud zil gnon byed tshul yang de ka'o/ /'di nges par 'byung ba phyi ma'i rgyud du 'dod chags kyis sgrub par gsungs pa dang bka' sgo las 'dod chags kyis dmar por bstan gsungs pa la brten dgos sam snya ma ste/ snang sems dbang sbud zil gnon ni bde chen gyi gnad la thug cing /lhan skyes kyi bde ba ni rjes chags kyi ribs la khyad par du lhag pas so/ /'khor 'das zil gnon dbang chen dgongs pa yin: zhes dang / de tshe 'khor ba zil gyis gnon: zhes 3 20

rta skad bsdus pa/ — pod/ 6 nga so/ /'das pa zil gnon ni zhor la bstan no/ /'di rta skad kyi mtshon don du byed lugs la/ 'gros dgus pheg rim/ skad 'gyur gyis sa lam/ rta dbus la shan ston par gsungs pas/ khro zhal gyi steng du rta dbu'i rnam pa lhag por yod pas/ phrin las myur mgyogs kyi cha nas sngags kyi lha gzhan las lhag cing 'phags par ston nam/ nga ni sngags gzhan las myur bas che'o zhes 'tsher skad kyis sgrogs sam dpyad dgos//bde gshegs gsung gi dngos grub sdud lugs ni/ spyir bzlas pa gsung rdo rje yin par ma zad 'di'i lha sngags ye shes thams cad gsung rdo rje'i rigs gtsor bton yin pas rta sngags de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje basbus par dmigs nas bzlas pas/ rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung gi dngos grub dbang du sdud pa'i don red/ chos phung sdud par bshad pa'ang de ltar byas pas chos phung rab 'byams la dbang sgyur ba'i don red/ gal che/thugs kar sngags 'khor 'god pa dzab kyi dgongs par bzhag pa ni/ lha de dang de'i thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes rig sngags kyi rnam par yi ger byin gyis brlabs pa nyid thugs ka mi shigs pa'i gnas su bzhag ste/ de nyid skul zhing klog pa'i tshul du zlo ba ste/sngags thog mar byed pa po'i rjes su 'azang ba'i bsam pas bzla 321

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—ma dgos gsungs pa ltar/ lha des bye brag tu byin gyis brlabs pa'i yi ge'i phreng ba khyad par can la sgos su dmigs nas bzla lugs thun min ni 'di ka red pas ngo shes par bya/ bskyod dang bzlas pa bskul ba ste/ /'khul ba rgyas dang 'bar bar 'dod/ /de dag rdo rje sngags phreng la//rim bzhin du ni shes byar brjod//a mtshar/mtshams dam rgya dbos pa'i rgyu mtshan bzlas sgom rtag 'grus gnyis ka'i ched de/ shin tu gnad che/ ri chos zhal gdams las/shes rgyud sngar las sogs kyi shes rgyud la bzang skyed 'thon pa'i gnad kyang / mtshams nang der g.yeng ba'i yul rkyen bsdams nas dge sems rgyun chags su bom/sa pa dang / dbe sems rgyud dang 'dres nges kyi 'grus par bslab pas blo dge ba la lob pa'o/ /der ma zad bzlas rgyun btsugs nas bzlas pa 'dir sngags kyi nus pa skye ba la'ang gtsub shing bar ma chad du brdar ba ltar khyad che ba yod 'dra/ thun bar du'ang mchu dal med du bzla ba dang / bzlas 'phro mdun bskyed la 'chol ba sobs bshad pa ltar dzab kyi rgyun ma chad pa 'di gces shing / khyad par sgrub pa'i dus gal che/sgyu 'phrul zhi ba las khro bo myur ba'i rgyu mtshan/ snga ma gdul bya dag pa rang bzhin bzang ba'i ngor sna nga ba'i sku dang / phyi ma ma dag pa'i ngor btsan thabs su snang ba bstan pa'i sku yin pa dang / shin tu gdul 322

rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6gzhi sgrub pa red dam dang /de nas dzab dgongs lnga ba zur tho ltar byas pas dbang du sdud pa'o snyam dpyad/ yang na myos pa bzhin du song ba'i bar de bzhin la song ba'i mthar ke ta ka'i me tog spos kyi glang po che'i me drod kyis gdung ba'i dbang gis/ gla rtsi lta bu'i khams su 'gyur ba'am/rgya mtsho'i klu mkha' lding gis mer sbyang bas nor bu tog gi blo gros su 'gro ba ltar bdag he ru ka la dga' gus dung gsum gyi rang bzhin kho nar zhu bar bsam/mnyam bzhag gi steng du dran pa mi 'jog par/ dran pa rang mnyam bzhag gi ngo bor rdzogs pa zhe'o/ /de rab yin/ de'i sngon du dran pa rnam rtog tu song tshe yengs pa red la/ slar dran pa slebs nas mnyam bzhag gi steng du thon dus sgom red/ ji zhig na 'du byed kyi dran pa shugs cher song nas rnam rtog skyes/ ci tsam skyes kyang dran pa 'phrog mi thub par rnam rtog dran par cha gsungs/ rtsa ba nang du chod tshe rnam rtog shar yang dres thag mes tshig gi thal ba 'dra gsung / dang por dran pa la mthil bcol dgos/ mthar dran pa rang dag la 'gro dgos pa ni 'dag bzo byed dus dang po 'dam pa gal che/ mthar skam thag chod pa gal che ba lta bu sogs/tha mal gyi snang zhen gnyis sbyong lugs khregs chod dus gang snang ye shes kyi rang snang kho nar shar bas snang ba sbyong / rtsa ba chad pas zhen pa sbyong / thod rgal gyis 331

rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6 las rung du byed pa/ 'od gsal ngang sgo ma brtan nas mnyam rjes kun tu dwangs cha dang gsal cha che chung tsam las 'od gsal ris med du 'char ba'i khyad sosas yod/ āng rtags can la/ bzhan gyi gtum mo dang /rdor bzlas sogs sems 'dzin de tsam mang ba las/rlung sems 'dul ba rig pa rkyang ded cig pu rang rno la mthu che ba ni/ rtsa rlung thig le thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i gnad mthar thug 'od gsal gcig pu yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so//lugs 'dir so rig bzhi dang mngon shes drug sogs mthar thug mngon du nam 'gyur zhe na/ chos zad kyi mthar sgrib pa kun bral byi'am shin tu rnam dag gi ngo bo stong pa'i dbyings mthar thug mngon du gyur pa dang dus mnyam du me long g.ya' dri phyis ma thag gzugs brnyan bkra lam me 'char ba ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mngon gyur du 'ong ste/ de'i dus su rang bzhin gsal ba'i snang cha spro sdud dang / thugs rje'i rig pa spro sdud byed pa'i rlung gi cha ma lus par dag nas/ gdod ma'i gshis la ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i cha ji ltar yod pa mtha' dag 'char nub 'phel 'bri med par lhang la bud pa'i phyir te/ ye shes gcig nyid ye shes rnam pa thams cad par song ba'o/ /ngo bo'i dbyings mngon du byas stobs khoXnas snang phyogs kyi yon tan mtha' dag mngon du 'gyur 336

rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6nga pa'am sprul pas 'jigs pas nyen pa rnams la thugs rje chen po'i shugs lhag par phyungs pa'i rnam 'phrul yin la/ rta mgrin ni thugs rje'i shugs kyis skad phyungs pa'i rnal 'phrul yin pas myur ba'i nang nas kyang mgyogs so/ /des na sems can sgrol ba'i stobs mtshungs med 'phags pa lo ki shā ra ni 'khor sgyur gyi glang po rin chen ltar gzhan phan gyi stobs kyi rtsa ba'i bdag po dang / pad+ma'i rigs kyi lha gzhan yang de'i snying rje'i rtsal shugs las sprul mod kyi/glang po rin chen bang ha cang btang ste gling bzhi ri mtshor bcas pa rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo ltar snang ba'i gnas skabs las kyang brgal nas/ mi g.yo bar lhan ne gnas par snang ba'i gnas skabs su 'dug pa lta bur thugs rje'i shubs phyungs pa'i gnas skabs mthar thug la bzhugs pa ni sgrol ma dang / rta mgrin te/ de las kyang brtse ba'i nyams skad kyi sgor thon pa'i sprul pa phyi ma'o/ /thugs rje'i rtsal shugs ma lus pa rdzogs par phyung ba'i sku'i rnam 'gyur thun min yin pa 'di 'dra'i gnad kyis/ dpung bzang las 'di nyid pad+ma'i rigs te snying rje'i rigs kyi lha thams cad kyi dbang phyug yin par gsungs snyam/ khregs chod du rig cha ngo bo'i dbyings su 'dres pa'i rigs pas/ thod rgal du rig chas gsal dwangs phul byung rang bzhin gyi cha mngon du byed phul che/ de'ang rim bzhin 337

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa rig pa mi rtog pa'i ngo bor skye phul dang / gsal dwangs kyi ngo bor skye phul che ba'am/ mi rtog pa 'thug tshabs dang / gsal cha 'thug tshabs che ba'o/ /de ltar rig cha la rang bzhin gsal ba'i ngar phul byung thogs nga1 'di rig pa'i dwangs ma bsam gtan gyi thig ler 'dus pa'i don te/ rig pa ngo bo'i dbyings su zhugs tshabs che rim ltar gsal mdangs che bas dbyings sgron gyis lug rgyud thig sgron du 'dren 'gro ba red/ rang bzhin gsal ba 'di ni nying nge 'dzin gyi cha'o/ /de ltar na lug rgyud thig sgron du tshud pa ni/rig cha la bsal dwangs kyi ting 'dzin gyi rdzong thob pa ste/ rig cha gsal mdangs su 'bar ba 'di'i dbang gis khregs chod las thod rgal shes rab lhag pa ste/ de la shes rab rang byung sgron ma zhes bya/ rig pas ngo bo'i dbyings rtogs zhes pa ngo bo'i dbyings ngos zin pa de bzhin du rang bzhin gsal ba rtogs pa'ang de ngos zin nas rang nyid der 'dres pa red/rig chas gsal mdangs de rjen la bton nas 'bar bar byed cing rgyas par byed/ gsal cha des kyang rig cha gong 'phel du smin par byed/ de dag gi rtsa ba rig cha gsal mdangs kyi thig ler bcug nas sgom pa la thug ste/ de'i phyir lug rgyud kyis thig sgron rgyas par byed/thig les lug rgyud smin par byed/gnyis ka'i rtsa ba lug rgyud thig ler bcug nas sgom pa'o/ /gsal 338
rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6cha'i bcud rig char smin pa 'di nyams gong 'phel nas dang / ngo bo'i bcud rig par smin pa tshad phebs// —339

rta skad dka' gnad/ pod/ 64 ྾྾྾྾྾྾rtags yin no/ /des na dbang chen he ru kas rang nyid kyi gsung de rang bzhin dang byed las ji lta du zhig yin pa brda rtags kyi sgo nas gdul bya la gsal por ston ched rta skad gtsug bzhad kyi rnam par mdzad pa yin pas spyi bo'i rta skad kyi rang bzhin dang byed las rgya cher bshad pa nyid kyis/ ngag la pad+ma sasung grub ces pa'i gsung de'i ngo bo nyid dang mdzad pa ji lta bu yin pa mtha' dag gtan la 'bebs nus pas spyi bo'i de kho na bshad pa yin pa la/rang bzhin dang byed las de dag spyi bo'i rta skad kho na'i yin par go ba ni mdzub mos zla ba bstan tshe mdzub rtser lta ba dang 'dra'o/ /rta skad kyi don ni rjes chags kyi dbang skad ces pa yin pas tshul 'dis dpyad na rta sngags kyi bzlas pa sogs rta skad du mi shes par rta mgo'i kha nas byung ba kho na rta skad kyi don du bzung na/ rgya mtsho las rlangs 'phyur bar balhas nas chu ni skya rdzas 'di nyid do zhes pa dang 'dra'o/('dir bris pa 'di ltar shes na rta sngags la bsnyen pa btangab nyid rta skadal bsnyen pa btang bar 'gyur bas sngar jiḥbazlas rta skad kyi bzlas par bshad pa'i skor sogs ni byisapa'i gtam mo)dpal te ru ka'i dbang drag gi gsung gi che rtags rdzu 'phrul gyi bzhad sgra spro tshul la ltos te dpal gyi rta skad/bzhad pa'i yul ma mo mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag brnyan chen mo rnams 34/

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4 dbang du 'du tshul gyi rim pa la ltos te ma mo'i 'gying skad/ rjes 'jug rnal 'byor pas rta skad de nyid bsnyen sgrub kyis grub pa'i rim pa la ltos te rnal 'byor brda skad ces byas na rngog ma le brgan sogs la 'grigs sam dpyad/ phyi ma 'di'i thad/ bsnyen pa thems par gyur pa na/ zhes gsungs pas mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rab 'bring tha ma'i tshad kyi khyad par bshad pa ste/bzlas pa la rta skad kyi drod rtags dngos rang thon pa dang / rjes mthun tsam thon pa dang /drod ma thobaXkyang rta skad du mos pa brtan pa tsam la brten nas rta skad du bzhag pa'o/ /phyi ma 'di la rtags tsam 'dzin pa zhes bshad pa'i zlas drang na/ snga ma gnyis rta skad kyi drod thob par gsal lo/ /de'ang dang po ni rta skad kyi dgongs pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa la rtsal thon pa ste/ dgongs pa de mtshan nyid rdzogs par grub pa'i rtags su rta skad dngos su thon pa yin pas so/ /'dir sgu gsum dang mnyam par gsungs pa1 bskyed rim pa'i sku gsum grub pa yan chad la byed rung ngam brtags/ gnyis pa ni de ltar mtshan nyid ma rdzogs kyang rta skad kyi de nyid cha 'dra tsam grub pa'i sto bas kyis sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud 'khul ba sogs rta skad kyi byed las rjes mthun tsam thob pa ste/ 'di'ang lhas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma ci rigs mthong ba'o/ /gsum pa ni rta mchog gi rdo rje 31 2

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/44྾ ྾she྾྾de dang dod thub tu brtson 'grus de sbyangs pas brtul zhugs de 'in tu grub pa na srid zhi'i 'khor lo mtha' dag rtul phod kyi spyod pa des 'dod dgur gnon cing ngo mthon du gnon nus pa'i mthu grub pa ste/ de'i phyir 'dul dka' gdug pa can rnams kyang bshig cing gnon pa'o/// /344

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/44྾྾྾4྾ ྾ bzung / zla 'byung steng nas zhag mgo 'dzin)ba gang yang rung / /zla zhag de yi dgra nas 'dzin/ /zhag gi bu ni dus tshod de/ /dus tshod ma gtogs sprags mar brtsi/ /zla ba'i thog ma sprel gyi zla/ /zhab la pho drug stag sgas tshes/ /de bzhin mo drug sprel gyis te/ /rim bzhin 'brug dang khye yis nya/ /de ltar brtags nas brtsi tshul dngos/ /brtsi bya de nyid lo sosas 'thab/ /srog lus dbang thang rlung rta yi/ /sa mal lo mal kun la dpyad/ /grogs phrad rab la ma bu 'bring / /me lcags shing nang ngan pa la/ /sa chu nang bzang dgra phrad ngan/ /bye brag sazhan yang rab shes bya/ /gtso bor dus tshod la sogs pa/ /rang rang gang la gang bsngags pa/ /de nyid gzhir bzung spar sme yi/ /no khyad 'don pa 'di yi lugs/ /na shi dgra dur gegs rnams dang //bdun zur bzhi bshed dgu mig sobs/ 1rgya cher pabs rus sha sasum gyis/ /brtsi ba don gyi snying rno yin/ /gzhan yang dpyod tshul khyad par ni/ /rus sbal lus la 'byung lnga sbyar/ /de rnams dbyibs mdog grangs phyogs sogs/ /so so'i rnam par blan las shes/ /gnyen phyogs ma phyi 'og rta khye/ /rang dang grobs yin dgra phyogs dgra /de bzhin sgro ni rang dang ma/ /gdon dang rang dang dgra phyogs la'o/ /'di dag blor bzung na 'og nas 'chad pa'i rtsis 'bras rnams kyang yid la 'dzin sba ba yin no/ /346

rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6gnyis pa ni/ nam rten 'brel gyi rtsis bya bar 'dod pa'i dus der/ thog mar skyabs sems sngon 'gros 'byung ba'i lha dang gtsus lag gi ston pa rnams la gtor ma phul/ bden pa bdar/ me tog la/a kar kha yer ya wa yang ur te tai ta/ zhes nyer gcib bzlas te 'thor/ de'i 'og tu skor mgo la 'jug go/ de'ang rtsis kyi skor mabo dngos ni/ gnam lo'i 'byung ba gang yin gyi dgra thog nas zla ba'i skor mgo bya ste/ de'ang 'di'i lugs kyi lo mgo hor zla bcu gnyis pa sprel zlas 'dzin rgyu yin la/ zla ba bcu gnyis po'i nang tshan pho mo'i zla ba phrag gnyis re 'byung ba gcig cing brtsi dus kyang de ༄ltar brtsi'o/ /de ltar zla ba gar sleb kyi steng nas zhag gi skor mgo ni/ sprel sogs zla ba pho drug stag gis tshes shing bya sobs zla ba mo drug sprel gyis tshes rgyu yin pas/ de dag gzhir bzung la/ zhab gi nges 'dzin dngos ni/ gcig bcu gsum nyer lnga zhes pa'i sde tshan gsum po gang rigs skabs bsnyun gyi steng na g.yas su bskor bas rtogs nus/ de la zla ba gnyis ni 'byung ba'i skor mgo dang sbrags mar brtsi lugs gcig tu bya dgos pas/ gcig gnyis rang //gsum bzhi bu/ lnga drub grogs/ bdun brgyad dgra/ dgu bcu ma zhes bgrang ngo //dus tshod kyi skor mgo ni/ zhag gi bu thog nas bya ste nam lang yos/ nyi shar 'brug nyi dros sprul/ nyin gung rta/ phyed yol lug 347

pob/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/— ྾— ྾ — 4dkong chen sprel/ dgong chung bya/ mun rub khye/ srod 'khor phaganam gung byi ba/ nam phyed glang / tho rangs stag ste dus tshod bcu gnyis po'i nang gar bab ngos 'dzin/ 'di la ni 'byung ba rkyang ded bya'o/ /de dag rtsis thang gi spros pa la mi ltos par lag pa'i sor mo 'ba' zhig gi steng nas brtsi lugs blo chung las dang po ba rnams kyi don du gnam lo shing bya khyi'i zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad kyi nyi shar lta bu la dpe brjod byas na/ lag pa'i gung mdzub srin gsum re'u mig dgur phye ba'i shar shing / lho me/ nub lcabs/ byang chu/ lho nub sa sbo che bar dpyad la/ thog mar gnam lo shing bya zhes shing khams su blan nas slar yang lcags sprel gyi zla ba lo mgor bzhag ste nub tu 'phos/ de'i steng nas zla ba'i skor mgo lcags kyi sprel bya/ chu'i khyi zhes snga ma las gnas gcig bgrod pas byang du sleb/ de'i rang thog nas zhag gi brtsi lugs chu'i stag yos/ shing gi 'brug sprul/ me'i rta lug sa'i sprel bya bgrang bas lho nub tu phyin/de'i bu thog nas nam langs lcags yos/ nyi shar chu 'brug ces de nyid du rang sa 'dzin pa bzhin no/ /de ltar mgyogs rtsis kyi rnam gzhag chabs par byas nas da ni bye brag tu/ gzhi phywa lo/ mgron phywa zla ba/ dgra phywa zhag srog chos srid don sogs dus tshod dang sbyar te brtsi lugs rags pa tsam brjod na/3‘18

'byobad/ (1 dzes (1bab ba ——ba/bzhe byedabasgyu bsgyudakached nyidakhyed ba/tsugabasgyu ba (1da /zhing bud med khyim gyi sa mal/ bya glang sprul gsum gyi lo mal/ blo phywa dang don phywa la lhag par gnyan pa yin no/ /rlung rta ni dgra rkun gyi 'jigs pa brtag sa/ ban btsun dang gtso bo rgan rab rnams kyi sa mal/ phag lug yos gsum gyi lo mal/ chos phywa dang lha sa drag zhan dpyod pa'i gnas che sa yin no/ /de rnams re re das 'bras bshad bzang ngan 'bring gsum bshad ma thag pa ltar brtags la/ ngan 'bring gnyis la bcos ka bya ste/ mthun phyogs lo ba yod na de dang bsnyun/ khyad par lo mal gang zhan gyi mi de 'dra khyem der med na/ brtsi bya'am de las gzhan pa'i sa mal dbang btsan du bya zhing / yod na de nyid gtso bor byas te/lo kegs che chang dang spar sme'i 'bras rtsis re re nas bskor la/༄do'i sgo nas 'khyug dpyad kyi sbyor ba gang 'os su dkri ba ni rdo ltangs spar smes gcod do zhes rtsis rig smra ba'i ngag sgros las byung ba'i don no/ /gal te rlung rta'i sa mal lta bu zla zhag dus tshod gsum ngan zhing gnam lo'i rlung skal dang grogs 'phrad lta bu'i dge ltas snang na/ gzhi phywa gnam lo gtso ba dang / bzang ngan gyi phyogs gang na mang ba de nyid dbang btsan dgos pa gnyis ka bshad zin pas de la ji ltar lung du ston zhe na/ de ni gnas skabs su dgra yod kyang nam phugs su dgra'i gzhan dbang can du 350

cis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mapa'ime long / ca da/7 6mi 'gro ba'i ltas dang / rim gro rgya cher byas na bzlog nus pa'i ltas yin gyi/ dgra phywa ha cang 'khrugs pa'i rtags su mi bzung ngo / /'on kyang gtso bor ni rtsis mkhan nyid kyi zhe 'dod la rag las pas/rten 'brel de brtag pa ni/ dang por lo dbang btsan gyi steng nas brtag go snyam na lo nyid gtso che zhing / dus tshod 'ba' zhib dbang btsan du byed par spro na de nyid gtso bor 'gyur ba sogs 'di 'dra'i rigs mang po zhig rtsis pa'i blo'i g.yo ba la thug par bla ma rnams gsungs so/ /yang gzhi phywa'i legs nyes kyi rten 'brel de bas kyang bsnyus te brtag par 'dod na/ banam lo'i sro / sosas bzhi dang brtsi bya'i srog sogs bzhi 'thab pa'i 'os tu dus tshod kyi 'byung ba rkyang ded byas nas dbang thang bi skal ba dang phan tshun 'thab pas kyang / spyir btang dus mal drab zhan dang / dmigs bsal du skyid sdug gang stong rnams legs par shes nus te/de'ang gnam lo'i steng nas spyir btang gi legs nyes 'jal tshul ni gong du bshad pa rnams kyis rtogs par snang bas/ 'dir dus tshod kyi dbang skal nas dmigs bsal ba'i legs nyes brtag lugs tsam zhig 'chad do/ /de ni ma bu dgra grogs nang 'phrad dang lnga'i sgo nas phye ste/ spyir ni ma phrad ni phyi 'jigs tsam dang / ba ༄'phrad 'alhod ngo / grogs 'phrad dge ltas sogs yin pa gzhir 36

pa pobad/ nga rje shā ba pa rje ba ba zungapa ba da zung ma dka ba da nga pa da da /gi gri btsan nam shi gshed gnod/ lha 'khrugs dang byad phur rbod gtong gi ltas/ lho rgyud nas dgra rkun ngo / yang na glo bur gyi 'ur ngo chen po yod/ chu dgra sa 'phrad la/ byang ngam lho nub gtso bor gyur pa'i mtshams bzhi gang rung nas ma dang bu mo sogs bud med kyi rigs 'ga' zhig gi phyir 'brang mo sri gdon/ god ngo dang nad ngo /khyad par du bza' mi nang rtsod dang rkyen ngan glo bur ba/ mya ngan dang snying stong chen po'i ltas/de rnams dgra 'phrad kyi dum bu'o//shing gnyis nang 'phrad la/ pha khu sogs nye du 'am/ shar dang lho'i phyogs kyi gshin lcags rgyal po'am gnyan rigs dang bsdong nas 'tshe ba'i ngo / me gnyis nang 'phrad la/ btsan gshed kyi gdon ngo dang / rta pho grir 'chi ba'i snga ltas/ 'go ba'i nad yams mched ltas sogs yin/ sa gnyis nang 'phrad la/ rgyal gdon dang sa bdag 'khrugs pa'am/ yang na ban bon sngags pas gtad mnan byas pa'i ngo yin/ gtad byed pa'i ngos 'dzin ni/ mtshams bzhi'i dus tshod las dpyad de/ sa glang ri sna dang / sa 'brus brag sna/ sa lug thang chen po'i rngam zhol/ sa khyi chu mig dang mtsho'i 'gram lta bur gtad yod ngo yin/ de 'dra'i byad gtad med na mkhar gyi — las 'ga' zhig nyes zer/ lcags gnyis nang 'phrad la/ phal cher byad phar che ba'i ngo yin zhing / yang na gri btsan 'khri/ de dag gang ༄364

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾4 she ྾ ྾྾nas rkun ma 'jab dogs yod/ srog la chad 'jig 'gro/ lus dgra dang 'phrad na bya glang sprul gsum gyi lo ba la mtshams bzhi'i phyogs nas dgra ngo dang / shar nas rkun ngo yod/ lus la rmas 'gram 'byung / dbang thang dgra dang 'phrad na khye rta stag gsum lo ba la lho nas dgra dang byang nas rkun ngo / snying nor mi lag tu 'gro dogs yod/ rlung rta dgra dang 'phrad na/ phag lug yos gsum lo ba la byang nas dgra ngo dang / mtshams nas rkun ngo dang / khyad par du rang mgo dgra zhabs su tshud nyen che/ des na rlung rta ni shin tu gtso che ba yin no/ /srog sogs bzhi ma'am grogs dang 'phrad na spyir btang bzang / dmigs bsal ma 'phrad mang na phyi 'jigs dang / grogs 'phrad mang na 'ud ngo yin la bu 'phrad snying 'alhod kyi ngo zhes grasas shing / nang 'phrad la/ shing gnyis ni mtshams bzhi'i lo ba yod na/ shar ram nub nas dgra dar ma'i ngo dang / lho phyogs kyi rgyud nas rkun po 'jab pa'i ltas yin/ med na nub nas dmikas bsal can gyi dgra ngo cung zad yod/ de min gzhan du dgra med pa'i ngo / des mtshon te/ me nang la bya'am sprel lo yod na lho 'am byang nas dgra dang / lho nub sogs nas rkun ngo / med na byang phyogs nas dmigs bsal ba'i dgra ngo / de min skyon med/ sa nang la/ byi phag lo ba yod na mtshams bzhi dang shar kyi phyogs nas 368

ngo da/ 6 rdogrub 'jigs med bstananyi'i gsung 'bum/dbang thang gis gcod rgyu yin pas/ de bye brag tu bshad na/ shing bu me 'phrad rims ngo yams ngo dang chung sri kha dmar gyis 'tshe ba'i ltas/ me bu sa 'phrad/ spyir ma la ngan zhing khyad par du sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gdon ngo / sa bu lcags 'phrad/ g.yang sar lhang ba dang btsan thel gyi byur ngan sdang ba'i ltas/ lcags bu chu 'phrad/shi 'dre gnod cing gshin po'i shi rgab ma chod pa'i ngo / chu bu shing 'phrad/ pha mes kyi shi gshed gnod de srid phywa shin tu gzan pa'i rtags so/ /'on kyang pha'i srog sogs bzhi dang dus tshod 'thab na dbang thang yang gtso cher byed mod/ bu chung kho rang gi srog sogs dang 'thab na lus kyi sa mal nyid dbang btsan par mthong ngo / /yang srog sogs bzhi bo dgra dang 'thab na go rim bzhin du/ tshe la bar chad dang / lus kyi na tsha/ bkres ltog gi dbul phongs/ sadon bgegs che ba'i rtags yin/ 'byung ba nang 'phrad la/ rig pas dpag ste gdon ngos 'dzin dang / de dang bsnyun pa'i rim gro lung du ston zhing / nam phugs su skyon med par ltangs gcod byed do/ /bzhi ba ni/ don 'di la dbang thang gi khams 'ba' zhig gtso che bas/ brtsi bya dang dus tshod kyi dbang thang 'thab ste brtsis pas/ma dang 'phrad na lar bzang yang cung zad phyi dal che ba'i ngo yin zhing / bu dang 'phrad na don dang byur gnyis ka med pa'i ngo yin/36 2

—rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6dgra dang 'phrad na bsam pa'i don tshur mi 'ong steng du mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal gnya' bar 'bab pa'i ltas yin/ grogs dang 'phrad na ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos po de nyid myur du 'grub bo zhes lung ston/ nang 'phrad la/ shing myur/ sa dal/ chu mchog me bzang yang 'gyur ldog can/ lcags shol sdod dam dka' las chen pos 'grub pa'i ltas te/ 'di dag ni rags pa tsam mo/ /gzhan du na shing grogs sa dang 'phrad na shar phyoṭa kyi pha khus don sgrub/ grub don 'bring / me grogs lcags dang 'phrad na lho nas zhang nye'i rigs kyis grogs byed/ grub don myur zhing bzang / sa grogs chu dang 'phrad na shag po'am brnya'i rigs kyis grogs byed/ phyi dal chelcags grogs shing dang 'phrad na dme pho'am mgar ba'i rigs kyis grogs byed/ grub don mi 'byung / byur ngo yod/ chu grogs me dang 'phrad na byang gi mgron po dang bud med rigs kyis don sgrub/kha grogs che/ don grogs chung / don myur/ kha 'gyod phran phrin gyi ngo /de sogs mang po zhig rigs pas dpyad de rtogs su yod mod kyi kun kyang rtsis mkhan gyi bsam pa nyid la thug par sngar brjod zin to/ /lnga ba ni/ shing gi dus tshod la bab na nad pa'i lus kyi g.yas phyogs/ glo ba dang / rtsa rgyus mi bde ba las gyur pa/ g.yo zhing bskyod 363

bkacad/ 6 nga rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'ang /pa rlung gi rigs te/ rgyal nad dang sanyan rigs kyi nad/ bcos sla zhing 'tsho sla ba'o/ /me'i dus tshod la bab na/ mgo bo dang byang khog stod kyi nad// snying nad dang khrag mkhris tshad rigs/ gnyan dang btsan grib/ drag cing rtsub pa'i gzer rgod bcos thabs sla ba'i ngo /sa'i dus tshod la bab na/sha lpags chu ser dang /yan lag bzhi/mchin srog pho mtsher sogs don rnod phal mo che'i nad/ yang cham rigs sam sna 'gags/ rgyal po dang sa bdag gi nad ngo / lci zhing 'thib pa/ bcos thabs dka' ba'i khams so/ lcags kyi dus tshod la bab na rtsib ma g.yon phyogs sam/ mchin pa dang rus pa'i nad/grin nam sgyug sbyong gi ngo / bad kan las gyur pa/ gri btsan gdug pa'i rigs kyi gdon/ nad yun ring ba'i ltas/ chu'i dus tshod la bab na/ byang khog smad kyi phyogs/ mkhal ma dang lgang ba'i khams mi mnyam pa las gyur pa'i ngo / khyad par du klu nad/ grang ba dang /dmu chu/ chu 'gag rtsa 'gram chu ser gyi nad rigs/ mo gdon dang dam thel gyi grib/ bcos thabs sba zhing sos lam snyogs pa'i ngo /༄nad slong ba'i zas rkyen ni/ shing gi dus tshod du byung na shing thog dang shing mngar sngo ldum nas sran gro 'bras tshod ma'i rigs gang rung ngam/ shing mkhan bzo bo'i rigs las blang ba'i rkyen byas na de grib/ me'i dus su byung na/ ja sha rngon zas/ stod sha khyi spyang gi 364

cis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6lag lta bu me'i rdzas dang / yang na thab ka'i zur sogs na yod/ sa la bab na/ spyir khyim gyi mtshams bzhi gang rung / khyad par lho nub kyi phyogs/ lus kyi yan lag bzhi/ spra'am khang ba'i zur mchog mal sa'i zur bzhi lta bu'i phyogs/ dngos rdzas gdu bu dang chun 'phyang sogs rdzas snod dam sa rjen la bsten pa/ lcags la khyim gyi nub phyogs/ sbra khang dang lus sam mal cha'i g.yon/ ras sogs dkar po'i snod dam/ khro lcags sogs rin po che'i snod du yod na thang /yang na lcags cha dang lhan cig yod zer/ dngos rdzas 'od can dang phra rgyan can gyi rigs yin/zu la bab na/ khyim gyi byang / spra'am khang ba'i sgo 'gram/ lus kyi smad cha/ mal sa'i rten ma sogs phyogs dang / snod dril sngon po'am chu rlung mi chags pa sgye hrul lta bu/ yang na rdza bum sogs chu snod du yod/ yang na 'byung ba lnga go rim bzhin du/ shing gnyan bcad pa sogs shing gi las/ ri gnyan la me btang ba sogs me'i las/ sa lad dur lad dang sa rko rdo slog sogs sa'i las dang byad kha dang brag gnyan gshig pa/ chu mig gnyan po dkrug pa sogs chu'i nyes pa las gyur pa ste/ de sogs mang po zhig 'byung ba dang spar kha'i skor mgo las rtogs par bya ba ni/ rtsis gzhung baiḍūr dkar po nas zhib tu shes par bya la/shin tu rags pa re gtsug lag pad tshal du'ang ston no/ /367

pa / ( rje (1ma (1sbyorab ba zungabad ma da zung mi da ba da ba dpad zug/ ma bdun pa ni/ stor ba khyem du yod na sgo phug log zur la dpyad lugs sadon rdzas ngos 'dzin gyi skabs su bshad pa 'di nyid las shes shing / phyi rol gyi sa phyogs la dpyod pa ni/ shing gi dus tshod la bab na/ g.yas phyogs kyi ri'am/ri'i g.yas ngos/ shing tshab tshub ci rigs pa'i nang na yod de myur du rnyed/ me'i dus tshod la bab na/ lho phyogs kyi ri mthon po'i rtse'am/ sa shal dmar po'am brag gi rgyud dmar po yod pa'i zhol sogs na yod de rnyed sba/ sa'i dus tshod la bab na/ lho nub gtso bor gyur pa'i mtshams bzhi gang rung ngam/ ma phyogs kyi ri rgyud na yod de dka'/ lcags kyi dus tshod la bab na/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi ri'am/ ri'i srib ngos/ yang na ri bo'i g.yon log gi rdza rgyud na yod/ rkun pos khyer yang thang ste rnyed shin tu dka'/ chu'i dus tshod la bab na/ mdun ri'i zhol sogs ri'i cha'am/ byang phyogs kyi chu rgyud mig mthong gang gi sa na yod de myur du rnyed/ gal te ma rnyed na rkun po'i mi ngos 'dzin bya ste/ shing gi dus tshod la bab na/ mi grangs gcig shar nas 'ong zhing / lus bong ring ba/ blo sna mang po can gyis khyer te shing nang du bskung / bongs kha gru bzhi'i rnam pa can gzuṭa po thung la snying khams che ba'i rigs kyis myur bar btsal na rnyed zer/ me'i dus tshod la bab na/ lho nas rkun po sha rtsa dmar zhing gos dmar can 368

rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6gsum mam gcig sogs kyis khyen te/ lho phyogs kyi rdza dmar po'i nang du sbas pa'am/ yang na bshas te bzhag pa'i ngo / rtsad gcod ma 'gyang na rnyed kyang srid/ sa'i dus tshod la bab na/ lho nub sogs mtshams bzhi'i rkun ma mi grangs bzhi sogs kyis khyer te/ri chen po'i rgyud na sbas yod/ btsal kyang rnyed dka' ba'i ngo /lcags kyi dus tshod la bab na/ rang gi dgra zla'am risas mi mthun pa'i rkun po lnga sogs phye bral gyi rigs grangs ma nges pa sha mdog skya zhing gyong bas nub tu khyer/ rdza'am brag nag po'i khrod du bskungs te rnyed shin tu dka'/ chu'i dus tshod la bab na/ sha mdog sngo zhing rid pa kha chu sna chu dang mig chu mang ba'i rkun ma mi gnyis pa zhig gis byang phyogs kyi chu rgyud nas khrid de song / rnyed ngo chen po yod//brgyad pa ni/ 'dri ba po dang mgron po gang yang rung ba'i srog sogs bzhi dang / dus tshod kyi srog sogs bzhi nang 'thab/ khyad par du mgron po kho rang brtsi byar bzhag pa 'di no tshabs che/ de la srog ma 'phrad dang grogs 'phrad mgron po 'tsho/ lus ma 'phrad lus zungs bde/ dbang thang ma 'phrad don bzang 'grub/ rlung rta ma 'phrad dgra'i nye zho med/ bh+yar ma 'phrad la rang sa ma mnan na phyi dal che ba'i ngo yin/ srog ba 'phrad sngangs skrag gi ngo yin/ lus ༄369

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'abum/ma 'phrad nad ngo che/ dbang thang bu 'phrad gyod god kyi ngo che/ rlung rta ma 'phrad rkun ngo yin/ bu 'phrad myar du sleb min ma nges pa —5 rje'i da dang / slebs kyang kha 'a4da da ngo yin/ sros dgra 'phrad mgron po rang yul du thon dka' ba'i ngo /lus dgra 'phrad nad ngo shin tu che/dbang thang dgra 'phrad nor gyi stor brlag dang pham stong 'byung ba'i ngo / rlung rta dgra 'phrad dgra kha btsan can gyi ngo / dgra 'phrad kyi spyi bshad phal cher bu 'phrad kyi phyogs dang 'dra ba la/ 'dir ni kha 'gyod phran bu tsam zhig min gyi/ de las che ba'i byur ngan 'ga' zhig gi ltas so/ /grogs 'phrad rnams ma 'phrad dang 'dra'o/ /nang 'phrad ni gong du smos pa'i 'byung ba rkyang dpyad kyi skor mgo dang sbyar bas choka de rnams thag ring gi mgron po do gal chen po'i dbang du byas nas bshad la/ thag nye'i mgron po nyi tshe ba yin na ni/dbang thang la brtsis pas 'grub ste ma 'phrad phyi dal/ bu 'phrad kha 'alhod/ dgra 'phrad don med stong pa'am gtam ngan/ grogs 'phrad kha gsal dang don 'grub pa'i ngo / nang 'phrad kyi shing chu me gsum myur/ sa lcags dal ba'am/ yang na rang sa non ngo / 'byung ba rkyang dpyad dang 'phrad kyi 'bras rtsis gang la'ang sbyar du rung ba ni/shing gi dus la bab na mi ljang rta ljang gi mgron po yin na thang ste zhag gcig tshun la sleb par 'dug zer/ me'i dus la bab na/ mi 370

cis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6dmar rta dmar can yod na thang ste zhag gsum nas sleb ngo yin/'on kyang dang po grogs se lang / bar du tsen ner bsdad/ tha ma yul gzhan du song ngam ma song cha med de 'pho 'gyur che zer/ sa'i dus tshod la bab na/ mi ser rta ser can yod na thang ste/ de sngon rang sa ma non na phyi dal che/ yang na zhag bzhi nas sleb zer/lcags kyi dus tshod la bab na/ mgron po mi dkar rta dkar can yod na thang ste phyi dal shin tu che/ yang na zhag grangs lnga'i 'phror sleb zer/ chu'i dus tshod la bab na/ mgron po mi sngon rta sngon can yod na thang ste/ mgyogs ngo yod/ zhag gnyis nas slebs so/ /'byung ba'i kha dog gi dbang du de ltar bshad kyang gzhan du na nag po dang ngang ba la sogs pa 'og rta'i pags mdog tha dad pa rnams kyang kha dog gi sde tshan 'di dag gi khongs su bsdu la/ yang mgron po myur du sleb min la/ shing grogs sa lta bu zhig byung na grogs 'phrad kha gsal dang / sa phyi dal yin pas gtam sasal thos shing mgron po myur du mi 'ong ba'am/ lar dal myur gnyis kyi nang nas myur tshabs che yang / da lta da ltar sleb yong zer rgyu tsam rngo mi thogs pa zhig yin no/ /de sogs rigs pa'i rnam 'phrul gyis dpyad shes par bya'o/ /dgu ba ni/ brtsi bya'i rlung rta dang dus tshod kyi rlung rta 'thab/37

ngo da/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ra ra 'bras bshad ma 'phrad dang rkyang dpyad gnyis su bye ba'i dang po ni/ma 'phrad dang grogs 'phrad bzang / bu 'phrad 'bring / dgra 'phrad ngan/ nang 'phrad rnams kyi rnam gzhag rkyang dpyad ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ shing bab skyes bu dar ma'i chos phywa la bzang zhing /des mtshon te btsun pa'i chos phywar me/ 'phan phyug can la sa/ dme pho sdig can la lcags/ jo mo dang bud med la chu nyid mchog go /gzhan yang 'byung ba'i kha dog mthun sdeb la brten nas tshong nor the/sa pa dang mi shes pa'i shan 'byed bya ba sogs mang po zhig yod de/ bri bar ma nus so/ /de ltar rtsis 'bras gtso bo'i rigs rnams brjod zin nas/ da ni rno ltangs gcod pa'i thor bu'i rikas 'ga' zhig mdor bsdus su bshad par bya ste/ gang gi tshe rten 'brel zhu ba po de'i gnyen 'dun dang 'og rta sogs gar yod kyi phyogs bstan pa la/ dus tshod kyi 'byung ba gar babs de'i ma phyobs sam bu phyogs gang rung gnyen 'dun tha mal ba'i sa dang /grogs phyogs mdza' bo snying dmar can gyi sa yin/ sgo khyi rang phyogs dang 'og rta grogs phyogs/ rta dang khyi'i kha dog dang lus dbyibs rang mthun/ khyem gyi sgo rang ngam ma phyogs/ gdon bgegs rang dang dgra phyogs/ dgra phyogs su mi mthun pa'i dgra yod pa ste/ dper brjod byas na/ 'byung ba shing gi dus su rten 37 2

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs medaXbastan nyi'iXgasung 'bum/ tshul mang po zhika/ bshad pa yod mod kyi/ re zhig de tsam mo/ /dril na sor gsum rtse mo'i 'phrul 'degs te/ /bkral na rten 'brel sgo brgya'i don ston pa/ /'byung rtsis gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long 'di/ /blo gsal blang dor blta ba'i mig kyang yin/ /de slad sngon byung mkhas pa'i man ngag 'dir/ /dasa' dang gus pa'i nyams brgyas 'dar bzhin du/ /chu skyar chu bo mthong ltar zhugs shig dang / /lung ston bden pa'i tshig 'byung bslu ba med/ /zhes pa'ang rang nyid gtsug lag da sgo 'dir bag chags 'jog pa dang / khyad par da lta'i dus nagayo can gyi zoka po phal cher zhib mngon mkhyen du snyad btags pa'i stong zob kho nas snang ba brid de lag cis 'di tsam la'ang dpe mkhyud kyi nyes pa mi bzad par bsog par mthong nas de dag rgo rdzun khungs 'don pa'i phyir rdo shod srin mo'i rdzongaXgi sprang rgan gsal byed kyi nga ro bsum pa'i yi be srob tu zhugs shing / de 'og lnga ba'i dang po dbyangs bcu gsum pa'i snying bo can gyi grags pas bcings pa'i rdu su ku zhib gis sbyar ba dge zhing bkraXshis/ sarba maṅga lo dbe'o// //37sgyu1

pod/ 6ma pa ༄/ /rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying zag gi bka' srung sman btsun ma'i shwa mo dus gsum kun gsal zhes bya ba/na mo gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha be/ 'bum phrag dpa' bo bo ḍak+ki'i ye shes srog /bde stong thig le gcig tu zlum pa'i dbyig /klong chen sgyu ma'i gzugs can 'jigs bral gling / /byang chub bar du rigs kyi bdag por bsten/ /de yang ji skad du o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas/ ma 'ongs lta sgom ting 'dzin gyi: drod tshad med par 'ol tshod kyis: mngon shes cal col sgrogs pa'i tshe: sman btsun sems kyi cho 'phrul lngas: the tshom mdud pa rang sar grol:zhes thos grol rdo rje'i gsung gis rjes su bsngags pa ltar sman btsun mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma'i phrin las kyi kab yig don yod zhags pa'i lugs kyi rno mthong zab mo lag len du bstar ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben zhing nyams dga' bar stegs bu khebs ldan mañdzi dang bcas pa la sman btsun ma'i bla rdo srog 'khor gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin bstar ba'i mdun du 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu'i khar/ dung shā gtsang 375

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i sasung 'bum/྾྾r+yā —ma tshul bzhin bzos pa'i shwa mig can bsham/ mtha' skor phyi nang gi mchod pa spyi dang / bye brag gser skyems/ phye mar/ 'o chol sogs tshar du dngar/ gzhan yang dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ thob mar rig 'dzin yab ka dang yum ka gang rung la brten pa'i bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas phrin las dpab bsam yongs 'du rgyas par btang rjes/ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas/ /'od zer drwa ba rab 'phros pas/ /sman btsun 'khor bcas thugs rgyud basbul/ /'dod don mngon du sgrub par gyur/ /zhes dmigs te rtsa ba'i rigs snga phyi kha skong bcas bzlas brjod bya/ de nas las sbyor gyi tshe/ mdun bskyed thugs ka'i baṃ yig las/ /'od 'phros snang srid gsal bar byas/ /tshur 'dus bdag la thim pa yis//rno mthong dngos grub thob par dmigs/ /tri badz+ra pra mo ha lo ka sarba myu myuXphye phye swā hā/ stong phrag gcig bzla/ stong tshig gis mchod bstod bya zhing spro na tshogs kyi 'khor los kyang mchod/ brtags pa bya tshul dngos ni/ gzhung las/ de nas me long g.ya' bral steng: gang 'dod don smos shā sgril bas:zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dod don la dmod bor bzhin je tshom med pa'i yid kyis shwa sgril bas/ dang po thig le (3)shar na/ bstan pa'i chus phywar/ mi za kyi chus srid ma smin smin 'dra'i a mra/bltas na mdzes/ don rtsa nag sob/sa zhig snang ste/ thabs la mkhas 376

bka' srung sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring ma'i shā mo/ pod/ 6na bzang bor 'ong / khyim phywar/ mi nor la gang stong bag tsam 'ong ste srid pa'i nyi zla 'pho 'chugs 'gro ba mi snang / srog phywar/ gnam gyi 'ju thag chad/ sa'i rtod phar thon te shin tu ngan/ chos phywar/༄dang po chos byed 'dod kyi nges 'byung spu su de nam zhig rang mtshang rdol ba'i dus mchi/ don phywar/ bang gang sga rta brgyug nas/kha gang gi rgyal za ba lta bu'i don gcig yin na mchi ste/ rngams chen mi 'ong / grog phywar/ grog sha dum tsam la dgra bya glag tsam gcig 'ong ba'am yang na lag stong du 'khor/ mgron phywar/ yong kha la btags nas mi yong lag tu len par 'dug dgra phywar/ bdud kyi bla shing la lcags nag gi sta re thebs pas bzang / gnyis pa tshom bu (4shar na/bstan pa'i chus phywar/chos srid sman gyi sdong po gzhi brtan yang 'khor nang 'thab 'ong ba'i sri zhig 'dug pas de 'dul ba la drag po sngags kyi 'phrul 'khor dgos so/ /khyim phywar/gtso bo'i 'dun khang ma mdzes pa'i mkhon 'ga' zhig ldang ba ma gtogs par phywa g.yang longs spyod kyi char ba 'bab pas bzang /srog phywar/ che'i dmu thag dkar po la 'chi med kyi mdud pa dgu yod de shin tu mchog chos phywar/ lha'i rnga sgra dbyangs thag ring /chos kyi mar me 'bar yun ring bas bzang / don phywar/ blo don yod zhags pa'i skor mgo 'di gang du babs kyang dngos grub kho na 377

bka' srungasman btsun bkra shis tshe ring ma'i shā mo/ pod/ 6bstan pa'i gdugs dkar bla nas blar mtho/ khyem phywar/ phyugs kyi g.yang ra ma zhig rtse 'dzin gyi ba gam ma ral bar skyid chi le 'ong /srog phywar/ston brgya'i ltad mo ma mthong /mi brgya'i tshe tshad ma rdzogs bar khyod mi 'chi/ chos phywar/ 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi chos gzugs lto 'bol ba zhig 'ong / don phywar/ lag stong khar bcugagal stong phrag la gzad de skyo gru ring mo zhig len zhing mchi/ grog phywar/ phyug dar ma'i gzhon nu gser rna can des/ dngul dkar gyi bam pa zhig rum nas bton te ston tsug sbed tsug byed de mi ༄brtan 'gyur ldog che ba'i ngo / mgron phywar/ khyod kyi mgron po de — byis pa ltad mo la yengs pa ltar yong snyam yid na med de thang / de min na gtam ngan khur bo gang khyer nas sleb 'ong / dgra phywar/ da res rtswa ltar zhum pa'i dus min snying stobs me ltar sbar ba'i dus yin te/dgra lha'i dbu rmog brtsan/lnga ba rmig pa(2)shar na/bstan pa'i chus phywar/ mthon po'i gnam ral/ yangs pa'i sa grum/ dpal gyi nyi ma thang la lhung bas shin tu ngan/ bdud bzlog dang bsrung ba la rem/ khyim phywar/ phyug po'i g.yang sgo ral/ btsan po'i ru dar chag 'dug pas gsung rab klog sgrogs dang mchod sbyin rgya cher gyis/ srog phywar/ tshe bdud kyi zhags pas btab kyang bsha' gris ma thebs pas da dung 'chi bslu dang srog 'don sogs rim gro rgya cher 379

pod/ 6 nga rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byas na 'tsho tsam/ chos phywar/ skrub rgyud kyi bstan pa nyi ma 'dra ba de mi cad kyi thod la 'char/ don phywar/ thog so brgya ba'i mkhar las ltar brtson 'grus kyi yun ma song bar nyin gcig la hur thag byas pas mi yong / lar 'gyang sa zhig nas 'grub srid/ grog phywar/ nor bdun rgyud 'tsheng nus med de/zas nyin gcig 'grang ba yod zeramagron phywar/ dga' ya le/ 'dzum mu le/ phyi lam thag pa ba'i/na du bsdobs nas sgo rtsa na slebs 'dug dgra phywar/ dpa' bo'i go ral/ sdar ma'i bang zad/ srid pa'i mda' mo sked nas chag 'dug pas dgra brub dang rlung rta bskyed pa sogs bya/ 'di rnams phal cher gzhung gis dngos bstan du byung zhing / de las gzhan du nad phywa dang srog phywa khog gcig nor phywa dang mtsher phywa sogs khyim phywa dang khog sa/cig tshong phywa dang rta phyugs 'phrod min lo legs nyes mdza' bo e rnyed rnams grog phywa dang khog gcib blo phywa dang stor ba rnyed min zhu ba e gnang sman dpyad 'phrod dam sogs don phywa dang khog gcig pa lta bus mtshon te shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ slar yang gtor phud kha gso zhing gtang rag gi mchod bstod phul te phrin las bcol/ gtor ma'i ras ma cung zad dngos grub tu shes pas longs spyad/ tshogs mchod dang 'brel ba yin na mnga' gsol gtor ma bstab pa sogs rjes kyi las rim yongs su rdzogs pas 380

bka' srung smanaXbatsun bkra shis tshe ring ma'i sha mo/ pod/ 6mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ /'di nyid tshul bzhin bsgrubs nas rtag tu gsol kha la brtson pa dang / dung shwa mi lag mi 'grim pa sogs gzhung nas gsungs pa'i spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig ma nyams par bsrung na blang dor bslu med du ston pa ni sangs rgyas pad ma'i lung gis yid ches shing rigs pas kyang grub pa kho na'o/ /rtog ge 'chal ba'i tshig gis ma bslad cing / /ḍāk+ki'i zhal gyi drod rlangs ma yal ba/ /zab don man ngag zil ba 'di rnyed pas/ /sban chad zog po'i ngag la dga' ba spangs/ /de lhar bod yul gyi lhan cig skyes ma rdo rje sman btsun ma'i shā mo 'di ni gzhung 'di la grub dbang byang chub rdo rje'i man ngag gi yig cha yod kyang tshig tshogs mang ches par mthong nas yi ge nyung la ngag don go sla bar kun mkhyen bla ma'i chos sras kyi gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa pad+ma khyab bdag rdo rjes sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // 381

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba / /zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i rme long zhes bya ba bathugs so/ /ba / /bla ma rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /re zhig dang por gnas khang mun pa med cing shin tu gtsang la nyams dga' bar/ gza' skar mig dmar dang / pra nye skag snon sa ga rnams med cing / nya stong brgyad dang / dgu gsum byi ba'i nyi ma dang / ma rig rnam shes sred tshor rga shi'i rten 'brel sogs ma yin pa'i dus bzang po'i snga dro nyi ma rtse shar gyi skabs/ mo gdan phying dkar satsang ma gru bzhi ba'i steng du 'aza tshom lnga bkod de/ dbas rab da ma'i khar me long bsham/ mtha' skor du mchod pa lnga dang / phye mar/skyems phud bcas bkod/ byung na rten 'brel snying po'i gzungs chab kyis khrus bya/ de nas spos dkar sobs gu gul med pa'i spos dang bzang shing gi dud pa gtong zhing / spos me'i pra brtags/ du ba dkar na rgyal po/ dmar na btsan bdud/ sngo na klusman/ ser na mi kha/ sna lnga rgyun ring byung na/'khyilaba'i tshul de zas nor 'phel/ 'tshub pa'i tshul de dar rgud che/ brkyang pa'i tshul de lam ngo yin/ bkug pa'i tshul de dgra ngo yin/ 'chil zhing kun byab dus bde yong /'khril ba'i tshul de 'chi ngo yin/ bslang ba'i tshul de lha ngo mtho/ mchan bu/ rten mchod byin gyis brlab/ mda' dar bayob cing / lha 'bod bden bdar 38 2

zab mo no mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6rgyas par bya/mo nas dang skyems phud gtor/ye rnyarmā mang du bzla'o/ /de nas dung ngam/ lha shing gtsang ma las bzos pa'i shwa/ shar du zla ba/ lhor chu gter/ nub tu mda'/ byang du me/ bla 'og tu mig dang ngo bkod pa zung gcig 'byung lnga'i sngags ā li ka li dang / rten 'brel gyi sngags ye rnyarmā ci mang bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas/gcig brtsi bya dang / cig shos legs nyes lung ston gyi mtshan mar bzung la/ phan tshun mi nor bar byas te/ phywa dkyil du sgril lo/ /de'ang sgril thengs bzhir bskyar ba'i/ mdzod mig dang po klung rta'i rgyal mtshan yin te/ gtso bo yon tan can dang / dgra lha'i sa/ phas lug yos gsum gyi lo mal/ mo'i mig yin/ gnyis pa srog bi ka ba yin te/ mi pho dang rta bong gi sa/ byi 'brug sprel gsum gyi lo mal/mo'i srog yin/ gsum pa dbang thang gi gdung ma yin te/ khyim bdag mo dang gnag phyugs kyi sa/ bya glang sprul gsum gyi lo mal/mo'i snying yin/ bzhi ba lus kyi gtan pa yin te/ rgan byis dang ra lug gi sa/ khye rta stag gsum gyi lo mal/ sgo them phyi nang gi sa mtshams yin/ des na gnas mal dang po bzang na/ bstos chos mgo dang / sngags pas mthu rtsal thon/ mkhas btsun gyi yon tan brin/ gtso bo'i gros phugs legs/ dbang phyug dang snyan grags chen po 'thob/ dgra 'dre'i gnya' brdog pas rdzi/ khyim mi spyi la 383

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—ma btab kyang pha khu che rgan nam/ bla mchod rigs dang / klung rta me khams pa la sgos su bzang zhing / dgra lha'i dadu rmob mtho ba'i ngo yin/ gnyis pa bzang na/ che'i dbang skal mi dman zhing / bar chad kyi rkyen med/ cung zad yod kyang srog gi gser zam mi 'chagam bsgrigs lhun grub kyi ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel mang / che'i srung pa gang byas smin sla/ skyes dar ma dang klung rta shing khams pa/ rta pho'i mo la khyad par du bzang / gsum pa bzang na/ nang gi dkor mdzod dang / phyi'i rmo zhing / bar gyi gnag lhas thams cad phyug dar 'dzom/ nor g.yang blu lha 'go bud med la srid dang / bza' btung la bcud 'chag gsog srung spel gsum gang byas chud mi za/sman dar ma dang / rlung rta chu khams pa/ gnag phyubs kyi mo la khyad par du bzang / bzhi ba bzang na/ lus la nad gdon sogs kyi nyer 'tshe med cing / dbang po gsal/ bkrag mdangs yang rtsal phun sum tshogs/ lto gos sosas 'tsho chas thams cad lus dang 'phrod/ sgo them barming bas dpal 'byor brtan/ gdon dang rkun po'i rgyu srang 'gag rgan byis dang klung rta lcags khams pa/ ra lug khyi gsum gyi mo la lhag par bzang / de bzhin du mdzod mib dang por sdig ltas shar na lha srung gzi byin nyams/ lha 'khrugs song ngam/ pha mes kyi dur sa ldang na'ang thang / gnam sgo ral ba'am 381

zab mo no mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i melong / pod/ 6྾ ྾gnam gyi 'ju thag chad pa yin pas thog ser dang khyim gyi thog rdib/gong ma'i bka' chad la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung / mthon po gnas nas lhung/ btsan po'i kha drag nyams/ bzang byas kyi dge mi thon/ dgra gnyen tshan dang / lhod rdog sne nas lang / yon tan can dang / lo klung me khams pa la rtsub/ gtsug tor dang rgyal mtshan rtse mo/ lha gsol dang bsang mchod/ klung rta ka 'dzugs/ mchod rten chen por gdugs 'dogs pa/ sats+tsha lo grangs/ lha khang mchod rten mang por dkar me snyan shal/ khams dang mthun pa'i dar phyar 'dzugs/ lam 'phrang dang zam pa 'chos pa/ mi kha bzlog gto dang /dgra mnan sogs gnas mal rang dang brdun pa'i bcos chog bya/gnyis par shar na/ srog gi 'khrul 'khor shugs bri bas 'phel chung zhing nyams sla/ bar chad kyi rkyen mang la rgod/ khang sa grum pa yin pas mkhar rdzong 'chor ba'am/ gnas khang bkra mi shis/ bya bzhag gang yang 'dun ma'i khog shing 'chug stag shar dpa' bo'i gra mdangs nyams/ rta bong rngog 'phru can la gzan/ lo klung shing khams pa la rtsub/ gso chos tu/ tshe lha'i sku gzugs bzhengs shing /za mdo gzungs sgrogs pa/ gsung rab rdo la rko ba/ srog bslu nye'u 'don pa/ srog bskyed pa'i 'khor lo bcang ba/ zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sregakhram zlog tshe dbang / bla bslu/ brgya bzhi'i cho ga sogs bya/ gsum 385

zab mo rdo mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6phywa dkyus la bshad ma thag pa ltar mdzod mig bzhi ka dang / chos phywar dang po gtso/ srid phywar gsum pa ma bang dang bzhi ba chung tshang gtso/ bu'i thog mar pho mo gang 'byung la gnyis pa pho sa dang gsum pa mo sa ngo gang mtho blta/ mtho dman mnyam na 'byung ba pho mo'i steng nas bshad/ blo phywa dang don phywa tshong phywa nor phywa lo tog gi mo rnams la gsum pa snying khyem gtso/mdza' bo e rnyed la sgo them dang /rnyed na legs nyes dpyod par snying khyim gtso/ sa cha yul bzung la gsum pa sa sgo gtso/ mtsher phywar gnyis pa khang sa dang gsum pa lhas mal gtso/ dur khang zhing gsum bshad zin/ nad pa 'tsho 'chir srog mkhar gtso/ nad yun ring thung la lus mal gtso/gdon phywar khyim sa ste gsum pa dang lo mal gtso/ le'u sman pa'i mo la dang po rtse 'dzin dang gsum pa sman phor gtso/ sman e 'phrod la lus mal gtso/ zhu ba e gnang la rtse 'dzin dang snying khyim gtso/mgron po e yong la sgo them gtso/ rta phyugs ra lug mor so so'i sa mal gadzu/ sgo khyi dang ra lug gnas mal gcig bor stor mo la snying khyem dang phem pa gtso/ srog chags stor ba la nyer 'tshe e 'byung rang rang gi sa mal gtso/ chang dang zho 'o'i mor skyems lang dang them bu gnyis ka gsum pa yin pas de gtso/ chang 'tshod mkhan pho mo'i sa mal gang dar de shis/ kha char mo la gnam sgo gtso/387

zab mo no mthongaXgi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pob/ 6nga ba shing / ngo rmen can me/ rgur po sa/ mchan khung sme ba can lcags/sho re chu'o/ /las yang zhing g.yo ba shing / tsha bsreg me/ lci 'thib sa/no zur lcags/ rlan gsher chu'o/ /bzo shing mkhan shing / rdza mkhan sogs me/ gyang mkhan dang zhing pa sogs sa/ mgar ba lcags/ gru ba dang lham mkhan sogs chu'o/ /longs spyod ra dang bong bu shing /ras snam kos dar rta sogs me/ zhing dang g.yag lug sogs sa/rin po che dang go mtshon sogs lcags/ spra phyar ja sib/ sogs chu'o//zas shing tog sngo tshod shing / bsreg sha mgo sha khrag tshod me/ khur ba dang rkang lag gi sha sa/ rtsib ma'i sha dang dkar gsum lcasas/ chang dang chu dang dar ba chu'o/ /ro kha ba shing / tsha ba me/ mngar ba sa/bska ba lcags/ skyur ba chu'o/ /bro ba rengs pa shing / skyur ba me/ bska ba sa/ zhim mngar lcags/ sla la bsing pa chur bshad pa'ang 'byung ngo / /nad rtsa rgyus rengs pa dang rlung nad shing / mgo nad dang tsha ba me/ shad dang lngi 'thib sa/ gzer zug rnag dang rus nad lcags/grang ba ro smad na ba chu'o/ /don snod mchin mkhris shing / rgyu snying me/pho mtsher sa/ blo long lcags/ mkhal lgang chu'o/ /sgo mig shing / lce me/mchu sa/ sna lcags/ rna ba chu'o/ /'dre gnyan dang the rang shing /btsan dang gri bo me/ sa bdag yul 'dre sa/ dkor bdas rgyal po lcags/ klu dang ma mo chu ste lcags gri gshed dang / shing rgyal por 391

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4྾྾ ྾yang bshad do/ /lo zla zhag dus ni stag yos shing / rta sprul me/ sprel bya lcags/ byi phag chu/ gshed bzhi sa ste/ srog chags bcu gnyis po yang de ltar sbyar ro/ /de dag kyang / phyogs mdog grangs dbyibs gnas lugs dang / /spru yang sgra tshad pho mo rigs/ /nye du brjod pa sha mtshan las/ /longs spyod zas bro nad 'dre lo/ /zhes sdom du dril nas bzung ngo / /de ltar shes pa na phrad dang 'byung ba rkyang dpyad sanyis sbrags nas ston tshul dngos ni/ re zhig yika tshogs nyung ba'i phyir bshad pa bzang ngan 'bring gsum du rigs bsnyus nas/dgra grogs nang phrad gsum gyis mtshon te brjod par bya'o/ /shing grogs sa phrad du byung na/ khyem phywar srid pa'i ri rab rmang 'gram brtan pas bzang yang mang drags na nyi ma lho nub nas 'byung ba sa khams pa'i phyogs kyi skad cha 'ur zing can yod ngo yin/bstan chus dang chos phywar yang gser gyi sa gzhi la dpag bsam gyi shing skye ba'i ngo yin pas bzang / srid mi nye mi ring ba'i dus su thon/ bu bu pho sa'i mi rigs shig 'byung ltas dang bu tsha ming sring gnyis sam bzhi sogs mnyam pa'i grangs shis skye ngo yod/ mi rabs gcig pa'i spun grangs de 'dra zhig ma byung rung rgyud kyi phyi mtha' de 'dra zhig tu sdud na thang / blo phywa dang don phywa gtan las rigs la shin tu bzang ste/ mtha' bzang la yid brtan nyan pa 39 2

zab rma no mthong gi man ngag zla shel norabu'i melong / pod/ 6྾ ྾ ྾྾྾ ྾ ྾'ong / de min 'phral gyi bya ba la dal ngo dang phugs su dge zhing legs pa'i mtshan ma yin/ de'ang nyi ma lho nub nas rdza mkhan nam phyug po gtso bo'i rigs kyis grogs byas nas sa yul gru gad pa ser po yod pa'am thang chen po'i dkyil du don chod/ tshong phywar longs spyod gzhi brtan cing khe spogs kyi 'phel ka che/ khyad par du rdzas ser po'i rigs las khe skyed chen po 'byung / nor phywa dang lo tog legs nyes la'ang shin tu mchog zhu don gnyer na/ brtan chags kyi las don zhig yin na shin tu 'grub/ de min na phyi dal che/mdza' bo e rnyed na lo kyi mdza' bor 'ong rgyu'i mi de mdog ser ba/ lus po lci zhing bongs thung la sha che ba/ kha nyung ba satam bden pa zhig yod na thang / de med na de lta bu'i mi rigs kyis grogs byas nas nam phugs dbang du 'du ngo dang mdza' ba brtan chags 'ong ba'i ltas/ dur mo dang khang sa mtsher sa'i mo la sa dpal che zhing skyid kyi danu thag yod pas shin tu bzang / zhing sa bzang ngan la zhing gru bzhi ngos mnyam/ khang pa'i lho nub sogs mtshams bzhi'i gang rung zhig tu yod na thang ste gang ltar yang 'azang / nad phywar zhag bzhi tshun chad kha gsal zhig 'dus de ma byung tshe gting cung zad spru yang nam phugs skyon med/ gdon phywar mtshams bzhi'i gang rung nas gzhi bdag dang rgyal po gnod de da lta 'byung pos 393

pa / pa da da nga pa da ba ba ba ma nga da zung ma da ba ba pa pa da ba / pa phyi lam stog pa'i ngo yin pas bzang / le'u sman pa'i mo dang sman bsten na 'phrod min 'debs na/ sa bzang po la shing n+ya gro rnya'i sa bon btab pa dang 'dra ste/ srog lus gnyis ka'i sa na skyed che/mgron phywar/ mgron po mi rig zhwa thod rig pa'i ngo yin yang thang /zhag bzhi'i mtshams tshun chad ma thon na shol 'gyang che/ lar byes bgrod nyezho med cing rdzas spyad ser po'i rigs kyi rnyed pa dang /mngar zhing zhim pa'i bza' btung gi pham phab 'ong / rta phyugs khyi dang ra lug mor srog chags de dang de sha 'thug cing kha dob ser po zhig yod shas che ste/ dge zhing phan thobs 'ong / bor stor mal sadang khyim gyi gru bzhi gang rung zhig tu rdza snod dam sa rjen la brten pa'am gdu bu dang phu dung lta bu'i yan lag gi chas ci yang rung ba'i zur dril thum ser po can zhib na yod/ phyi rol du stor na lung ba'i g.yon phyogs kyi phu lta khur yod dam/ thang chen po dang ri'i mtshams bzhi gang rung nas rnyed ngo yod/ lar rang sa ma bor na ma gtogs rnyed cung zad dka'/ chang dang zho 'o snyo la na phyug po gtso bo'i khyim nas phabs dang zho gta' longs la tshul bzhin snyol dang ro bcud nus pa phul byung 'byung / chang btso mkhan mtshams bzhi'i lo ba dang rdza mkhan lta bus btsos na bzang / la char mo la sprin gyi zo ba la them bu bcug pas re zhig mi 'bab/ 'on kyang 391

zab mo no mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6dus char 'dod na sprin chen po'i mdo klog sgrogs dang gzhan yang 'byung ba chu'i rten 'brel mang po bsgrigs na rnyed ngo 'dug dgra phywar/ lcags ri'i shing rdo ma 'gul bas dgra med/ yod kyang mi mgo lcags las sra bas don pham med do/ /me grogs lcags phrad/ khyim phywar/ mnga' thang stobs kyi 'byor ba rdo rje'i brag ltar sra bas bzang / ha cang mang na nyi ma nub phyogs nas 'byung ba lcags rigs kyi 'ur ngo yin/ bstan chus dang chos phywar/ lha srung bzang pos mgon byed pas bzang / 'on kyang dka' tshegs chen pos 'grub pa'i ngo zhig 'dug srid phywar/bag tsam ring ba'i dus su thon/ bu bu pho lcags khams pa zhig 'byung ltas dang grangs mi mnyam pa skye ngo yin/ bu tsha cung zad gso dka'/ blo phywa dang don phywa dka' las kyis bsgrub rgyu zhig yin na thang / de min na dka' dka' ltar rim gyis 'grub/ lar bzang /de'ang nub phyogs nas byis pa'am stag shar mgar ba bya sprel lo ba lta bus grogs byas nas sa yul zla gam mam mtshon cha'i dbyibs can sa shar dang gad brag dkar po yod sar don chod/ tshong phywar/tshong ra mang po 'grim/ rmed mang po bcol ba'i mtha' zhig na khe spogs 'ong / khyad par du rdzas spyad dkar po'i rigs las rnyed pa 'grub/ nor phywa dang lo legs min la'ang spyir bzang mod kyi lo 39 5

〉pocad nga/ 6 rdo nga ba zang sa med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/tog skye tshan chung / zhu ba e gnang na/ kha sra bzhin don la snying dga' 'ong / mdza' bo 'tshol na/ mi de mdog dkar po/ sha gyong ba/shes pa gsal zhing skad 'thag pa/ khro zhing kha tsha ba zhig yin mchi/༄de min na de 'dra'i mi risas zhig gis grogs byas nas mi rnyed 'dra ba'i ngang la rnyed par 'gyur/ dur mo dang khang sa mtsher sa zhing sa bzang ngan rnams la sa de zla bam zag chung dkar po yod pa zhig yin na thang / mtsher sa'i rtswa 'brog dang zhing nub phyogs na yod de bzang / nad phywar zhag lnga tshun la kha gsal cig 'dus de min na sman dang sman pa bsten 'tshol sogs dka' ba du ma'i mthar nad sos 'khun pa dengs/ gdon phywar/ nub phyogs nas gri bo dang dkor bdag gnod de skyon zung / le'u sman pa'i mo sogs la/ khyod kyi le'u slob dpon dang sman pa de dag mi khub pa'i nyen cig 'dug khug na lcags las me 'byung / sman las nus pa 'thon sngags las byin rlabs 'grub pas ches bzang / mgron po e 'ong na/ mi khyod kyi mgron po de la dka' tshegs mang po'i yus cig 'dug ste don pham mi 'dug rdzas spyad dkar po'i rigs kyi rnyed pa dang / bza' btung ro bska ba zhig kyang gsar rnyed yod/ zhag lnga tshun la ma sleb na bul ngo yin/ rta phyugs khyi dang ra lub mor/ rta rgod dang g.yag rgod/ khye gtum bag can lta bu kha dog dkar shas 396

zab mo no mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6nga che ba yod na thang ste bzang /bor stor mal dang khyem gyi g.yon ngos khro lcags lta bu'i snod nang ngam lcags spyad kyi zur dang dril thum dkar po'i nang du yod/ phyi rol du na lung ba'i g.yon lag nub phyogs kyi ri'am ri'i srib/ rdza brag chen po'i rgyud dang / rdo khrol bu'i khrod sogs na yod/ tshegs chen pos btsal na rnyed mchi/ chang dang zho 'o'i mor/ zhim mngar gyi bro ba bzang dgu 'byung bas rab yin/ chang btso mkhan stag shar bya sprel lo ba lta bus bzang / kha char e 'bab la/ re zhig 'bab dka' yang gnyug bsring na gangs dkar nu tig gi dog pa lta bu 'thor ngo yod/ dgra phywar/dgra lha phrag na bzhugs pas mdzub mos bsnun na mdung dang khu tshur brdeg na tho bar 'gro ste gyen du mi 'bur/sa grogs chu phrad/ khyim phywar srid pa las kyi rgya mtshor phywa g.yang blu nor bu 'du bas shin tu bzang / mang ches na 'byung ba chu khams kyi 'ur ngo yin/ bstan chus dang chos phywar yang bzang / lha srung mo rgyud rigs kyis grogs byed/ srid phywar dbang thang rin po che'i gzhong bar/ srid kyi g.yu mtsho 'khyel bas bzang / dus nye ba'i sa nas thon/ bu bu mo 'ong zhing lar mnyam pa'i grangs 'byung / blo phywa dang don phywa myur du bsgrub rgyu zhig yin na 'grub/ de min na yongs rdzogs 'grub dka' yang cung zad 'grub/ de'ang byang 397

bkar / 6 rdo grub 'ji gas ma da bstaka nyi'i gsung 'ang ma/ phyogs nas gru ba'am bud med bos sngon po can byi phag lo ba dang sho re yod pas grogs byas nas sa yul zlum po gad brag sngon po'am nag po yod pa dang mtsho'am chu bo'i 'gram lta dur don chod/ tshong phywar 'byung ba chu'i mi rigs las tshong spogs myur du 'grub/khyad par du zong sngo nag gi rigs las khe 'byung / nor phywa dang lo lesas nyes la dpal cho sa shes dang nor rgyun ma sogs g.yang lha bud med ribs kyis mgon mdzad pas shin tu bzang / de dag gi sazangs 'don zlos dang zhing dkyil du klu'i gter bum sba/ zhu ༄don 'dod na kha grog che ste don grog gi ngos na mnog che rgyu mi 'dug mdza' bo 'tshol na/ mi de mdog sngo ba/ ku co mang la gtsang sbra chung ba/ 'brog sbra nag can gyi rigs shig yin na thang / de min de lta bu'i mi rigs kyis grogs byas nas myur du rnyed/ dur dngakhang mtsher zhing sa rnams byang gi phyogs na dbyibs zlum po yur srub dang ko mog yod pa'am na spang mang po dang chu'i 'gram lta bur yod na thang / ji ltar yang bzang / nad phywar/ zhag gnyis tshun la ri rtse'i sprug pa yar dengs su 'gro bas bzang / gdon phywar byang phyogs nas mo gdon nam dam sri gnod/ gdon ngo yang bas snying stong mi 'gro/ le'u sman pa'i mo la 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gter rnyed pas shin tu bzang / mgron 'ong ngam zhe na/ mgron po mi nag rta 398

pa pa zab sna da ma thongaji zungazung nga ba ba nga ba da ma da ba ma ma nga/ sgyu ba / nga nag can nor spyad sngon po'i rigs dang bza' btung skyur po'i rigs kyi rnyed pa dang / kha dga' gtam snyan dang bcas te myur bar 'ong / de min yang byang phyogs kyi mi byi phag lo ba'i ngag lam na gtam gsal yod/ rta phyugs khyi dang ra lug mor rgod ma ba 'bri khyi mo sogs sha rid cing bongs chung ba zhig yin shas che/ kha lta bed sbyin 'ong / bor stor khyim mam mal sa'i sgo'am rten ma'i phyogs chu'i nang dang chu snod kyi zur/ sgye nag lta bu chu rlung mi chaṭa sa'i snod dang dril sngon po'i nang na yod/ phyi rol du lung ba'i sgo gzhug dang ri'i byang ngos/ cha 'gram mam/ sa brag sngon po yod pa'i ༄nang du rnyed de mgyoṭa ngo yod/ zho chang mor/ dung g.yu'i skyems bum du bdud rtsi'i g.yang zhag 'khyil bas bzang / chang btso mkhan sman shar byi phag lo ba lta bus badzus na bzang / kha char e 'bab na/ sprin dkar gyi rkyal ba kha ral/ chu'i ka/ter rdol bas shin tu 'bab/kha chas chugachar zon gyis/dgra phywar/rang mgo ri las mtho/dgra mgo chu las dma' ste skyon med do//lcags grogs shing phrad/ khyam phywar/ 'khor 'dab longs spyod n+ya gro rnya'i yal ga ltar rgyas pas shin tu bzang / mang che na shar phyogs nas shing khams pa'i skad cha 'ur can 'ong / bstan chus dang chos phywar legs dgu'i yon tan yar 'phel du 'gyur te rab 399

pa / nga nga da ba ba ji ba sa na ba bad ma nga ba ba da nga ba nga na /stobs yod/ dgra phyir rgol la rgya lcang phra mo'i stobs las med pas rgol ba yong snyam mi dgos/chu grogs me phrad/ khyim phywar/ skye bo che dgu'i rigs kyis 'gram btegs te chus srid btsan dar che ba 'ong / bstan pa'i chus phywa dang chos phywar dge sbyong ngur smrig can dang blo gsal rig pa mkhan rgyun mi 'chad pas rab yin/ srid phywar/ mi ring ba'i dus su thon/bu bu mo 'byung / yang na 'byung ba me khams pa'i bu zhib 'ong / srid mi mnyam pa'i grangs zhig skye ngo yod/ blo phywa dang don phywa gang yin kyang myur du 'grub/ de'ang lho phyogs nas brnya ko/sa dmar can dang gos bzo'am zhang nye rta sprul lo ba lta busagrogs byas nas yul gru gsum sa brag dmar po yod pa/ lung phu lhor bstan zhig tu don 'grub shas che/ tshong phywar/ yul mkhar dmar po'i nang du tshong ya rigs mthon po dang gzhan yang me khams pa'i phyogs shig las khe 'ong / rdzas spyad dmar po'i rigs las khyad par du rnyed/ nor phywa dang lo tog legs nyes la/ khyod kyi phyugs mkhong dang lo zhing de dag nyi ma lho phyogs su yod na thang ste/ phra mo cher smin zhing nyung ngu mang por 'phel bas bzang / zhu ba e gnang gi mo la mchog yin/mdza' bo 'tshol na/ mi de mdog dmar la bongs 'tshams pa kha 'phang mtho zhing blo no la cho rigs btsun pa zhig yin shas che/ de 40 2

zab mo no mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6min na de 'dra'i mi rigs shig gis grogs byas nas myur du rnyed/dur mo dang khang mtsher mor yang bzang / zhing sa bzang ngan la khyod kyi sa zhing de lho phyogs sa dbyibs gru gsam zhig yod na thang dang dngaste/ kha dge bkra shis 'ong / nad phywar/ nad kyi gzhi yang bas skyon med/ zhag gsum nang du kha gsal yod/ gdon phywar/lho phyogs nas bdud btsan dang / bsen mo gnod/ gdon rang lam 'ded pas bzang / le'u sman pa sogs la/ skyid kyi nyi ma lho phyogs nas 'char/pad+ma kha 'bus pa la nyi zer phog pa dang 'dra ste mchog slob dpon le'u ming ga ge mo bya ba gnyis las gang drag zer na/ me khams 'di mi mnyam pa'i grangs shig gi ngo yin pas 'dri byed kyis thos mar smos pa de dasa'/ mgron phywar/ mgron po mi dmar rta dmar can da lta sleb na'ang thang / zhag gsum tshun chad nges par 'ong /de ma thon na rje'u rigs rta sprul lo ba las gtam gsal thos/ byes bgrod kyi rnyed nor rdzas spyad dmar po'i rigs dang bza' btung ro tsha ba 'ga' re 'dug mo 'di babs grangs mang na nyi ma lho phyogs kyi 'ur ngo yod/ rta phyugs khyi dang ra lug 'di bsten na 'phrod dam mi 'phrod ce na/ spu rtags dmar po can mgo cung zad che ba/ me khams pa'i mi lag nas brgyud pa zhig yin na thang / shin tu 'phrod do/ /bor stor khyim mam mal stan khug dang sngas mabo me 403

nga nga / nga nga rdo grub 'jigs med bstananyi'i gsung 'bum/ nga nga thi na rigs yin/ lar shin tu ngan/ rta phyag khyung gsum gyi sngags sgrub sogs rdzas sngags kyi bsrung ba rnon po me lta bu mang du bsten/da lta sad brag gam mchod rten dkar zhing ring ba'i gsham cha ther dkar po lta khu'i nang du gnas bcas yod na thang bas de 'dra na re zhig sdod mi rung / gdon phywar/ zag sanyan bshika pas nyes na thang / de med na dme mgar lta bu'i 'grul sna dang / sgam khom phad sgro sogs snod dkar po/ dar ram snam ras dang rin po che dkar po'i rigs sam/ shing lags sprad ma'i rigs khyim gyi g.yon phyogs can yod rgyu zhig grib/ yang na dang po nub phyogs kyi sa yul zla gam sogs nas byung ba'i 'bru dang shing thog dkar po'i rigs dang / zho dar mar thud khur ba phrum dang bya sprel gyi sha'am srog chags ci yang rung ba'i rtsib ma g.yon phyogs kyi sha sogs kha nub tu bltas nas lcags snod lta bur zos pa de nyes/ rdzas spyad de dag gi phyir 'brang yin na gdon rigs ngos bzung mi dgos kyang / gadzu cher dkor bdag rgyal po dang gri gshed gnod/ de dag la mdos yas thongs/ gri 'dul gnad smin sgrub/ lha srung khros pa'i zur ngo zhig kyang 'dug pas bskang bshags la brtson/ le'u sman pa'i mor/rang rdung gi tho ba yin te shin tu ngan no//mgron e 'ong na/mgron po dgra dang phrad/ ral gri'i kha dbrag dang mda'i so dbrag na yod 406

zab mo rdo mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6྾྾ ྾྾ ྾de/ da dung mi sleb/ rta phyugs khye dang ra lug mor/ gtum bas sogs grogs phrad skabs dang 'dra yang 'di khog ngan pas sgangs/bor dor shin tu rnyed dka'/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi rkun po co skra breg pa khro gtam can sogs sngar bshad pa'i lcags kyi mi rigs lnga la sogs pas rdza khrod lta bur bskung yod na'ang thang / dka' tshegs chen po byas pa'i mtha' zhig tu rtsad chod 'byung srid/ chang dang 'o zho'i mor/ skyems 'dre can du 'dug pas mi zhim pa'am/zhim kyang de'i sna la byur cig 'dug chang btso mkhan me khams pas byas na bzang / kha char 'bab bam zhe na/ mi 'dod na 'bab/'dod na mi 'bab pa'i phyin ci log tu 'byung / dgra phywar/ dgra lha'i ru mtshon chag pas ngan/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi dgra kha btsan can 'ong nas gnod pa byed/ khams dang mthun pa'i dar 'phyar ba dang / lha gsol dgra brub 'byung ba'i rten 'brel sogs bya'o/ /me dgra chu phrad/ khyim phywar/ chu'i 'jigs pa dang 'byung ba chu'i nad rigs skye/ bu tsha ma smad la zub/ grib kyi re sgye nag po mgo la lhon 'dug pas ngan/ zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg ('diramachanabu/ 'byungab me khams pa'i gza' skar tshes grangs 'dzoms dus rta sprul lo bas kos dmar po gyon nas dgra 'ong phyogs su me brab bya/) dang / rnam 'joms byab khrus lha bsang chen po sogs bya'o/ /bstan phywa dang chos phywar/ lha'i nor bu me shel 407

zab mono mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6ba sa sbra nag lta bu'i nang du yod na yul brje gyis/ gdon phywar/ mtsho sman klu dang chu 'dre dam sri gnod/ de'ang chu mig gnyan la phog thug song ba'am/ mi rigs chu khams pa'i 'grul sna dang / sgye phyar sgam khom sogs snod dang spyad pa ngam gnag dbyibs zlum po khyim gyi sgo 'gram na yod rgyu zhig grib/ yang na byang phyogs kyi rgyud nas byung ba'i bza' btung sla la bcud chung ba'i rigs/ nya phag dang byi ba'i sha'am gzhug sha sogs zas spyod nyes/ grib ngo shin tu che bas bsang khrus dang / gzhan yang / rgya chen shugs ldan gyi chu sbyin klu gtor dam sri mnan pa 'dre mo bkar yas sogs gdon rigs dang bstun pa'i rim gros bcos/ le'u sman pa'i mor/ bdud rtsi'i snod du dug 'phyur bas ches ngan/ mgron po 'ong ngam zhe na/ mgron lam kha bas bcad dam/ chu chen brum pas sngun 'gag nas 'dug ste da dung mi sleb/ chu 'am chu khams pa'i dgra bo dang thug nas snying 'alhod chen po 'ong ngo yod/ rta phyugs khyi dang ra lug mor yang ngan te mi 'phrod/ bor stor chu nang du chud zos pa'am/ byang phyogs kyi rkun po ltag skra dang sho re can sha mdog sogs sngar bshad pa'i chu'i mi rigs gnyis la sogs pas chu 'gram dang ri zhol lta bur bskung yod/ chang dang 'o zho'i mor/ skyur zhing sba la bcud chung ba zhig 'ong / chang btso mkhan sa khams pas byas na dga'/ kha char 409

zab mo nomathong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long/ pong /76gnyis kar phyugs glud dang chab gtor sogs mchod sbyin rgya cher sgrub/ zhu ba phul na/ rlung nag 'tshub ma'i nang du sa rdul gtor ba ltar snying po stong thal gyis 'gro/ mdza' bo tshol na/ mi de bsam pa 'gyur ldog che/ rnyed srid kyang rnyed pa la tig tig mi mchi/ dur dang khang mtsher zhing phywa noms la/ dur sa shar bstan na ri sgo klung sgo yod pa dang / khang ba sgo shar bstan sgo nas bltas na ne'u sing ngam ljon pa sngo phyugs se mthong ba dang / zhing nar mo sogs yod na thang ste shin tu ngan/ sa bcos dang rim gro gyis/ nad par/ phyi yul rked pa/ nang yul mchin mkhris ske so mig gang rung gi nad/'on tig smyo 'bog rlung dang rtsa rgyus rengs pa'i rigs sam gzhogs g.yas kyi nad rigs yin yang thang / sman bla'i cho ga dang mdo brgyad brgya pa klog sgrogs sogs spyi 'gro'am/ bye brag nad khams dang bstun pa'i bcos rim bya/ da lta sa yul gas ral dang gad pa hral hrol can nags klung ngam bug pa mang po dod pa dang /ha cang g.yel ba'i shing khyim lta bur yod na gzhan na spes/ gdon phywar/ gnyan dang rgyal po je'u rang gnod/ de'ang shing gnyan bcad pa dang / mi rigs shing khams pa'i 'grul sna'am/ shing spyad dang rdzas sngo ljang rigs cung zad nar ba khyim gyi g.yas logs na 'jog rgyu zhig grib/ yang na byang phyogs kyi rgyud nas 'ong ba'i sngo 11

par nga / 6 rdo grub ba jigs med bstan nyib gsu nga ba bum/tshod shing tog stag dang ri bong gi sha lpags rtsib ma g.yas phyogs kyi sha sogs brngos pas nyen/ rgyal mdos dngas thel bkar sogs gto yas mdos rdzong thongs/ le'u sman pa'i mor yang / 'tshub lhong shin tu che bas stabs gzab dgos/ mgron po 'ong ngam na/ 'ong na thang ste/ kha ngan gtam ngan snying mya ngan phyod de ba 'byung / rta phyugs khye dang ra lug mor/ sna 'dres drangs/ byur gyis rjes ded pas ngan/ bor stor rlung gis khyer ram/ nags klung 'thus por stor te rnyed dka'/ shar phyogs kyi rkun po mgo phrug lba ba can/ smra blo sogs gong smos lta bus khyer te shing nang du bskung na'ang thang /chang dang zho 'o'i mor/ bro ba rengs nyams can shin tu mi zhim pa 'byung / 'gong chings dang dbyub pa me 'bar sogs bsrung ba bsgrub/ btso snyo la mkhan la lcags khams pa bzang / kha char 'byung ngam zhe na/ dus min gyi rlung log 'ong nas gnod pa byed/ rlung non sazab la gyis/ dgra phywar/ nyi ma shar phyogs nas dgra ke re langs pa 'byung / sator bzlos dang 'byung ba lcags kyirten 'brel la sogs pas bzlog/lcags dgra me phrad/ khyim phywar/ me'i 'jigs pa dang tsha rims 'ong / nor grogs dang lha srung rgud pas ngan/ rje btsun 'phags ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi mchod sgrub sogs la 'bad/ bstan chus 1 2

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ 4྾ — shing nang phrad/ khyem phywar/ 'thor zhig dang / 'pho 'gyur mang du 'ong / bstan phywa dang chos phywa rtsa ba g.yo zhing mi brtan pas ngan/srid rgyud chags dka'/ don phywa blo phywa gang yang stong 'ud che ste don la mi 'grub/ tshong phywar/ nor la kha 'thor 'ong bas longs spyod mi chags/ nor phywa dang lo tog mor yang de dang mtshungs/ zhu don la rje 'bangs zhal mi 'cham ste 'grub dka'/ mdza' bo'i mo la 'jen 'khyer 'ong zhing rnyed kyang 'dum mo mi 'ong / dur khang sogs la'ang ngan/ nad phywar/ yang zhing sayo ba'i mo 'tshub nyams can/ gdon sngar bzhin chag sgo smin drug gi rnga tshub lta bu 'ong ngo yod/ le'u sman pa sman dpyad sogs kyis nad nyal bslong nus kyang basbang ba gsod dka'/ mgron phywar/ 'ur zing dang skrag ngo yod de malhogs par sleb/ rta phyugs sogs mi 'phrod/ bor stor myur du btsal na rnyed thang ste cung zad ral grum dang mang por song 'dus sgyur gyi mo la ro ngan/ btso snyol mkhan sngar bzhin/ kha char shin tu dkon/ dgra phywar/ mkhon 'dzing gi ngo yod kyang rgyab bsrung bzang na bsdo thub/me nang phrad/ khyim phywar/ dar rgud zo chun gyi 'khor lo 'dra ste yid rton mi mchi/ bstan phywa dang chos phywa yang de dang phyogs 'dra/srid phywar/ srid chags kyang nges nges mi 'dug blo phywa don phywa'i 1118

zab mo rdo mthong gi man ngag zla shel norabu'i me long / nga nga /7 6rigs la 'grub 'grub 'dra bo yod de 'gyur ldog che/ tshong phya nor phya lo tog rnams la g.yang nyams yod/ zhu don dang mdza' bo rnyed min yang don phywa dang 'dra/ 'di dbang sdud rigs la bzang bar bshad pa'ang yod pas de gnyis gung sgrigs/ dur mo la ngan/ khang zhing gi mor 'bring stod yin/ nad phywa gdon phywar/ 'phral sos sos 'dra yang phugs mi bden/ le'u sman pa sogs la/ phan thogs cung zad yod kyang gcig thog tu sdod dka'/ mgron phywar mgron po krong gis lang tsog ger bsdad de sems thag ma chod par gda'/rta phyugs sogs 'phral bzang yang nam zhig lad ngo yod/bor stor bri gang 'phel 'grib kyi ngo zhig yod de lar rnyed/ sgyur kyi mo dang kha char la ngan/dgra phywar/rma khrag gi ngo cung zad yod//sa nang phrad/ khyim phywar/ brtan chags kyi ngo / bstan phywa chos phywa yang de mtshungs/ srid phywar/ dal 'gyang che/ lar rim gro bsgrub na 'byung thang / blo phywa don phywa tshong phywa rnams la phyi dal che yang khog brtan pas bzang / nor phywa dang lo phywa la rab yin/ zhu ba phul na snyan sra bar 'dug phugs 'grub kyang srid/ mdza' bo 'tshol na rnyed dka'/ de min na bzang / dur khang gi mo sogs la sa bdas gzhan gyis bdag byas na thang bas bcos thongs dang bzang /nad phywa gdon phywa phra mo'i rigs la skyon med/ de min gting li/ca419
