pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'khum/྾ 4 —྾྾4 ྾྾le'u sman pa sogs la/ ngang bsring na phan thogs 'ong / mgron po la nye zho mi 'dug kyang shol sdod che/ rta phyugs sogs bsrel na lebs par 'ong / bor stor rang khyim nas ma rnyed na 'tshol dka'/chang dang 'o zho'i mor bzang / badzu stol mkhan sngar gsal/ kha char re zhig mi 'byung bas chu 'bod kyis/ dgra phywar/ phan tshun sanyis kar la pham cher mi 'gro ste 'bring stod/ /lcags nang phrad/ khyim phywar/ gri kha lta bas ngan/ bstan phywa chos phywa gang la'ang bar chad mang / srid phyar cung zad ngan/ blo phywa don phywa tshong phywa rnams bsgrub dka'/ nor phywa dang lo legs nyes la dgra mang bas bsrung ba bya/ zhu ba phul na mi 'grub/ mdza' bo mi rnyed/rnyed kyang mi dge dur khang sogs kyi mo la gri tshang yin te ngan/nad phywa don phywar 'tshub cha che bas gzab/ le'u slob dpon sman pa sogs mi 'phrod/ mgron po la dka' tshegs chen po byung 'dug da dung mi sleb/ rta phyugs sogs bsrel na mi dge bor stor tshul bzhin mi rnyed pas 'bad pa ma mang / skrur gyi mo la ro bzang yang kha dge mi 'ong / btso stol mkhan gong gis shes/ kha char mi 'bab ser ba 'dra 'byung thang / dgra phywar/ mtshon 'khrugs rwa co brdar ba lta bu yod pas dgra chos gyis/ /chu nang phrad/ khyim phywar/ 'jam zhing zhi ba'i mo ste bzang /120

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4 4das rdzogs/ /zhes pa lta bu'i khyad par cung zad kyis brgyan te bshad pa 'di ni blo gsal rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du kho bos byas so/ /rnam dpyod 'o ma'i chu bter 'khyil ba'i ngogs/ /gtsug lag ngang mo 'dum phrag gar rtsen pa'i/ /dbyangs snyan rgyang glu'i 'gyur ba lhung lhung 'di/ 1blo gsal s+dzawī chung rna ba rab dga'i dpyid//ma mthong mthong rdzu 'phasas pa'i tha snya da dang / /'gal ba'i rdzun tshig byis pa 'drid pa'i zog /spangs nas lkob/ gyur blta ba'i me long 'dir/ /yang dang yang du blo gros mig 'bur satod/ /zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor khu'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni mdo khams shar phyogs kyi brnye 'jam dpal rig pa'i ral gris sngon chad rtsis nag gi gzhung la sbyang goms chung yang skabs thog nyer mkho'i dbang gis bi ro rnyi zhes pa sa mo glang gi lo'i nag pa nya ba'i yar tshes kyi rgyal ba dang po'i nyin rdzogs par byas pa dge zhing shis pa'i snang ba 'bad med du 'jo ba'i rgyur gyur cig maṅga lam /422

pod/ 6pa ba / /shāts+tsha sprub gdab lag len ba'ugs so/ /ra / /'gro 'dul sprug bsngal rang grol la brten pa'i sāts+tsha bsgrub tshul bzhugs/bla ma 'jig rten dbang phyug la na mo/ 'gro 'dul 'phags pa sbug bsngal rang grol gyi sgo nas sāts+tsha bsgrub tshul mdor bsdus ngag 'don du brjod na/ rab tu gnas pa'i sāts+tsha rnams stegs bu kheb ldan la legs par bkod/ de'i mdun du mchod pa rgya cher bsham/bdag bskyed sngon du btang ste mchod pa rnams/ oṃ āḥhūṃḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas ma lus pa: rnam pa rdzas la ngo bo ye shes kyi:bdud rtsi chen po ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin pas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i dpyid du gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pābye puṣ+pe dhubla a lo ke ghadhe nai wi bye shabha sarba pañtsa rak+ta bha libha ma hā su kha pū dza āḥhūṃ:lan gsum gyis brlab: bskyed chog ni/ lha hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā nā badz+ra swā bha wa āt+pa konya haṃ/ chos kun mi dmigs gzhi med rtsa bral ngang: dbyings rig zung 'jug das/ pa chen po'i zhing:rang snang lhun grub ri bo po tā la: de dbus rab yangs pad+ma zla ba'i steng: rin chen mchod rten yangs shing rgya che ba: sāts+tsha'i grangs mnyam rnams kyi bum nang 23

nga da7/ 6 rdo gruba'ajigs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'abum/ nga du: brda rtags mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus: sna tshogs pad+ma stong ldan nyi zla'i stengaX bhāXlas 'gro 'dul 'phags 6 ༷mchog snying rje'i lha:sdug bsngal rang grol spyan ras gzigs dbang sku:zhal gcig phyag bzhi mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs:rtsa ba'i phyag sa/nyis thugs kar thal sbyar tshulaḥ lhag ma rnam gnyis bgrang phreng pad dkar 'chang: longs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin chen mdzes: dkar dmar mdangs ldan rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: zhi tshul dgu dang rgyan cha bcu gsum mdzesaḥdabu gtsug rigs bdag 'od dpag med pas mtshan: phyosas bzhir pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i gdan steng du: shar du rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog dkar: lho ru 'od zer can ma gser gyi mdog: nub tu ku ru kul+le pad rag mdangs:byang du nor rgyun lha mo sbu mdog ljang: kun kyang rang rang rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs: sgo bzhir dbang chen sde bzhi las mdog can: gri gug thod 'dzin dor stabs 'jibs tshul rngams:khro bo'i chas rdzogs me dpung klong na 'gying: bar mtshams sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin dang: dpa' bo ḍāk+ki dam can sprin ltar gtibs:snang stong sgrib g.yogs bral ba'i dbyings na gsal:kun kyang gnas bsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan:de las 'od 42

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6྾ ྾'phros rang bzhin gnas mchog dang: khyad par sprul ba'i zhing khams po tā la: gnas yul nyer bzhi dur khrod brgyad sogs nas:ye shes lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dza: ༅'dren pa ni/ trī: nub phyogs bde chen dbang gi—pho zang nas: mgon po 'od dpag med pa gshebs su gsol: sprul pa'i zhing khams ri bo tā la nas: 'gro 'dul spyan ras gzigs dbang gshegs su gsol: thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dul ba'i pho brang nas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus gshegs su gsol:bdag cag sgrub pa po la byin gyis rlobs:mchog dang thun mong dngos grub tsho du gsol: o lo ki shwa ra gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni sarba sa ma ya dza:dza: bzhugs su gsol ba ni/dī: dmigs med rang grol thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor lhar: gshegs byon bzhugs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang: gnyis snang glo bur dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir:dam ye gnyis med ngo bor brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha ho: phyaga'atshal ba ni/ trī: bcom ldan thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs la:rang shes 'khrul ba bral ba'i brda phyag gar: lha chen 'phrul dga'i rnam 'gyur ji bzhin du: spang blang med pa'i ngang nas btsal bar bgyi: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: mchodapa ni/ bhā: kun tu bzang po'i rnam rol mchod pa'i sprin: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab dang:425

sartso spub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6sgra dang thags rje'i 'od zer dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros ༄dmigs yul gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang la bkod par gyur/ bar dmigs la/ ma ṇi gtso bor bzla zhing mtshams ci rigs par/oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he dun hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga tete dun hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he dun hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba a su ra ka ga te he dun hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ tshirnya tshirnya sarba dz+re ka ga te te dun hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ ji ta ji ta sarba su ra ka ga te te dun hūṃ phaṭa: dmigs bya'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa shirnye ku ru ye swā hā: zhes pas sngags sham sbyar/ thudamajug tu mchod pa ni/ji:kun tu bzang po'i rnam rol mchod pa'i sprin:me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab dang: zhal zas rol mo 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'bul lo bzhes:oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shabha rū pa shabha ghadhe rā sa parnye ma hā sarba pū dza khā hi: bhā: chos dbyings spros pa bral ba'i pho brang nas: lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mnga' dbang can: tshad med snying rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs: sdug bsngal rang grol sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshad med bzhi yis 'gro kun thar lam 'dren: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje rol pa'i gar: cir yang sgyur ba'i mthu 427

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6ba mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du'ang rten 'di la spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rten 'di ji spid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang dmigs bya'i thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib mtha' dag zhi ba dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i legs tshogs thams cad 'byung zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/zhes brjod rten snying bzlas pas me tog 'thor zhing / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/yang bzla/ bdag bskyed nyer bsdu nas shis brjod bar rdzogs par bya'o/ /de ltar zhag bdunaXl sogs par baspub nas sāts+tsha rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdul phra rab tu ༷ balhas la/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klungaXchen por spyan drangs te bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam la sogs pas chu nang spyod pa'i sems can dmas la phan 'dogs par 'gyur ro/ /de lhar bgyis pas phan yon kyang / rgyud las/ de ni nges par daspyal gnas nas/ /de byas pas ni grol bar 'gyur//yi dwags byol song sdug bsngal las//grol te lha yi gnas su skye//zhes sogs rgya cher bsngags pa yin no/ /zhes pa'ang rje bla ma'i smin gling rdor sems cho ga'i kha skong du gsungs pa'i tshig la 'donaXpa cung zad bsgyur nas bris pa mchog tu dge bar gyur cig ces rdo grub gsum pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas so//429

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ba ba / /byang bu'i sāts+tsha gdab pa'i cho ga bzhugs/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rimaXpa la/ rus bu bsdu ba ni/ bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas lag gnyis dpung bar bsnol bas se gol gtogs shing / o badz+ra sa ma ya dza: dza:hūṃ baṃ ho: zhes brjod pas rus du bsdus la/ zangs gzhong sogs su bzhag /gnyis pa rus sbyong ni/de'i steng du mji sman dang dri bzang gis bkang ba'i bum pa dang / nye logs su ba byung dang ga bur gur gum sogs dri bzang gi chu'i snad kyang so sor bshams/ 'a sa gzhung sngar bzhin bsrang ngam min kyang rung ste/ rus bu'am/ byang thal gyi steng du zla ba'i gdan la yi ge a:dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag par gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ trī: na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma:ārla dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na bha yu ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/arta te samyahūṃ budha ya/na ma:sarba ta thā ga te bh+ya:arta de bh+ya: samyahūṃ bud+dhi bh+ya:na ma:ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/bo dhi sa twa ya/ma hā sā twa ya/ma hā kā ru ṇi kwa ya/tar+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/dhu ru dhu ru/er+bhe bibye/ tsa le tsa le/pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su me ba re i li mi li tsi ti dz+wa la mā pa na ye swā hā/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga te pa ri sho dha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyaka saṃ dudha ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne/430

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ rdo rje'i srog thob par bsam la 'jim pa bcad/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa ye swā hā/ ye shes rdo rje 'byung bar bsam la 'ji 'ji bya/ oṃ a ra dze ji ra dze swā hā/ye shes rdul bral du bsam la rdzum byugs/oṃ dharmā dhartu gar+bha swā hā/chos kyi dbyings kyi snying bo rnyed par bsam zhing brkos phor du bcug oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra a ko ṭa ya a ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa: swā hā/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyag rgyas btab par bsam la brdungs/ oṃ sarba jiṅgā swā hā/ ye shes kyi snying po khong du chudapar bsam la gur gum gyis bris pa'i yig drug gam rten 'brel snying po sogs gzungs su gzhuka pa'am/ ma 'byor na sngags de dag gis btab pa'i me tog gzungs kyi rnam par 'bul/ oṃ dharmā ra te swā hā/ chos sku las gzugs skur bzhengs par bsam zhing phyir 'don/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ sangs rgyas thams cad de la brtan par bzhugasaXparabasam la metog 'thor/ rab gnas cung zad rgyas par 'dod na mchod pa dang bum pa 'byor na bshams ma 'byor na yid kyis sprul la rang lhar gsal bas sum+bha nis bgegs sbyangs/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis skru khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shī ye hūṃ/sogs kyis khrus gsol lo/ oṃ swabhā wa shudha sarba dharmā:swa bhāwa shurnyonya haṃ/stong ba'i ngang las rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing zhi zhing 'dzum pa dar 43 2

sartso spub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po mgrin par ā dmar po thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rnam snang ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza/ dza:hūṃ paṃ ho: gnyis su med par thim/ sbar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs khyed rnams kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a dha ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra puṣ+pe dhūbla nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la/ /zhesadang / phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la//zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu/ mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ces mchod cing bstod/ oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa marnya tsak+ṣu bi shwa bha na ye swā hā/ zhesaspyan dbye/oṃ ā:hūṃ/ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed pa rnams 'od du zhu ba las/ mchod rten so so'i rnam par gyur/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du/ rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 433

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ 'da' bar brtan par bzhug su gsol/ bye brag tu'ang rten 'di la spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rten 'di 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub sprul du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog lan gsum gtor/ slar yang gong bzhin/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs mchod bstod rten 'brel snying po dang shis brjod ci rigs bya'o/ /de lta bu'i mchod rten gcig btab pas bye ba snyed btab par 'gyur zhing tshe rabs thams cad du skye ba dran par 'gyur zhing / mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs chog las kyang / 'di'i ming bris pa la gzungs sngags brjod par byed cing / mchod rten 'bum byas pa la gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas legs par mchod nas rgya mtsho chen po'am yang na chu klung du btab na de dmyal ba laXsogs pa lasathar bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na de lhar mchod rten byas nas mjug tu lam gyi bzhi mdor mchod rten chen po byas te sngar bzhin legs par mchod la/ 'phags pa'i gsol nas yon phul te/ legs par mchod nas 'di che ge mo'i dge ba'i rtsa bar gyur cig 'di kho nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ba'am/ yang na rang gi smon lam gyi dbang gis skye bar 'gyur zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin no//ces rdo grub gsu pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas so//434

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6༄ / /klong snying thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas sāts+tsha sgrub pa'i lag len bzhugs/bla ma pad dkar 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klong snying thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas tshe 'das kyiXrus bu'i sāts+tsha bskrub tshul gyi lag len nag 'gros su bkod na/ rus sbyong byed tshul dang / sbyangs nas sāts+tsha gdab tshul dang / de nyid baspub cing mchod pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ tshe 'das kyi rus bu de nyid zangs sogs snod chen po'i kharaXras dkar gyis bkab pa'i steng du blugs shing / de'i steng maspru lta bu'i khar dri bzang gi chu dang / ba byung lnga yang bshams/ gong du bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa sman raka gtor gsum dang /rang gi g.yas ngos nas maka brtsams ste nyer spyod lnga sogs bkod mdzes su bshams/khrus chog dang ṣ+pel na gtso las kyi bum pa bcud ldan yang 'bru'i lnga tshom bkod pa'i steng du bsham/de nas cho ga dngos gzhi la 'jug pa ni/ na mo gu ru we/ 'chi med thog ma'i zhes pa nas/ myur thob shog /bar byi brgyud 'debs dang / dam tshig gsum dran pas/ oṃm hā badz+ra hūṃ/ zhes rdo rje snying gar gsor/ badz+ragan+ḍi ho/zhes dril bu gsil zhing dkur brten/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swā bhā wa at+pa konyahaṃ/ zhes 'khyud rgya bya/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sogs nas/ sa ma dza: zhes thugs kar se gol bsnol mar gtog na mo: mtha' med 'khor ba sogs nas/ skyabs su mchi:bar lan gsum dang / ho: pha ma rigs drug sogasabaskyed par bgyi:lan gsum/ho: dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sogs nas/myur thob shog:lan gcig dza:hūṃ:baṃ ho: tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyar/ thags ra ༄436

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ kar se gol bsnol mar gtog dkar gtor la/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta t+ya spru wa hūṃ phaṭa:rang nyid skad cig gis sogs nas skur gyur/ oṃ t+ya dz+ra wa hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ swā bhā ba shudhe: sogs/stong ba nyid du gyur/stong ba'i ngang las rin po che'i rnod kyi nang du gtsang ldan gyi gtor ma sogs nas/chen por gyur/ oṃ ā:hūṃ/ lan sanyis/ oṃ ā:hūṃ ho/ oṃ a kā ro sogs swā hā: bar lan gsum/sang dag 'dir gnas sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas bsngo/bgegs gtor la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha byu spru wa hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ su bhā wa shudha sogasastong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las rin po che'i snod kyi nang du babegs kyi gtor ma sogasanas/ chen por gyur/ oṃ ā:hūṃ/lan gsum/ oṃ/ sarba budha a kar+ṣa ya dza:lan gsum/ oṃ sarba beghan na ma:sarba sokas kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bar lan kasum/ bhā: nga ni pad+ma dbang sogs nas/ srung 'khor sogs mthar chags su bton te/ bstod pa'i mjug gi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: khrusachog yin na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ bhā: r+ghaṃ bi shwa bi shudzhai phaṭa dza:sa dzab kha dbye ba'am bdag mdun gyi rnam pa tha dad du gsal/ kha cig gis khrus chog bi tshe yang dzab kha mi dbye ba yod de/ bdag mdun gnyis me long gnyis la gzugs brnyan shar baXltar bsgom pa yin na der zad/ gzhan du na bstod pa'i mjug tuX'adzab kha dbye nas de'i bzlas pa sogs kyis mdun bskyed kyi thukasaXrgyud bskul ba med mi rung ba yin pas nges par bdag mdun tha dad du gsal dgos pa 'di nyid 'dor ga laXrung zhes/ mchan no/ /rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i sogs nas thob par 436

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6ba pa dmigs:sogs kyi bsnyen dmigs gsal ba bzhin/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ bhā: ci 'grub dang / 'phags pa'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas: rje btsun sgrol ma'i sogs rtsa sngags la tā zed yi ldanablo na sogs btags pa bdun tsam/ de'i 'gres kyis/'phags pa'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas: 'od zer sogs nas/ rtsa sngags dang / rang sngags dz+rel ba bdun tsam/dum bzlas ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudha sosas nas/ bum pa mi dmigs sogs nas/ spyan drangs gyur/ badz+ra sa mā ya dza:dza:hūṃ baṃ ho: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/shabha a:hūṃ:bar/bstod par 'os sogs phyag 'tshal bstod/ rang srog sngags kyi sogs ro gcig gyur/ ma ṇi ci 'grub dang / bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros dum pa'i lha sogs nas/ yang yang bsgom/ ma ṇi/ yibabargya/ sa twa/ ke ka ni rnams dz+rel ba tshar re'i mthar/ tshe 'das kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad shirnye ku ru ye swā hā/btags pa nyer gcig tsam bzla/las bum du khro rgyal rta mgrin sogs nas gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha t+ya smi wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: lnga bcu tsam bzlas mthar/ nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sogs dbyangs gsal/ rten snying / yigabargya sprel ba lan gsum dang / mchod phreng nas oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ji :ā: lha rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin las sogs gyur cig /na ma:sarba ta thā ga ta sogs lan gsum/ mchod pa'i sprin gzungs dang / pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu'i lang sogs mchod phreng rgyas pa'am/ stong ba'i ye shes dga' ba 'am ma lhogs na/ bhā:kun tu bzang po'i sogs gong gi mchod pa dang /ji:chos dbyings spros pa 437

dzad/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—྾྾ ྾ ྾ ྾sogs nas bstod pa cha tshang / phyag 'tshal bstod/ bhā: rgyal ba kun gyi chos skru sogs kyis las lha'ang bstod/ yig brgya lan gcig oṃ ā:hūṃ zhes dung chos kyi chu mchod yon du phul bas lha rnams bde stong chen po'i ngo bor zhu ba bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur/ lasaXbum gyi lha 'od du zhu ba las khro bo'i rdul phra rab tu gyur/ rigamedor ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya oṃ:ā:badz+ra sogs sngags tshan lnga dang /oṃ ye shes rgyal bo'i sogs sbyor cig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya/ sngags tshan kasum dang / oṃ rdo rje ye shes sogs nas/ 'tshal:dza hūṃ baṃ ho:yig brgya lan gcigade nas rus sbyong dngos ni/ rus bu'i steng du zla ba'i sogs nas/ dag par bsam/ma ṇi/ pardu yuk+ṇi khu/ bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs/ 'khor ba dong sprugs/snang mtha'i rjes dran sogs gzungs sngags gang shes ci mang bzlas shing dri bzang gi chus rus bu rnams dgapar bkru dgos/ khrus chog la rten bskyed ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta byu spru wa hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ swa bhā wa sogasaXstong ba'i sogs gyur/ trī: bdag nyid thugs rje chen po'i sogs nas bstem/ na mo/ mchog gsum rtsa gsum sogs dza: bar lan gsum bhā: 'di snang las thal sogasatiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ bla mas sngar lhar bgegs gtor byin rlabs bton mthar/oṃ sarba bigha nan sogasakhaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum dang / o sum+bha ni sogs lan gsum/ ji: 'khor bar 'khor tshe sogs nas phaṭa: ji: nga ni pad+ma dbang gi sku: log 'dren sobs nas/ma 'da' zhig: bla mas lhobs na bden brjod/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs/ trī: snang 138

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ ngo da/ 6pa srid thams cad rdo rje'i gur: snod bcud sogasahūṃ phaṭa: ho: skyabs gnas kun 'dus sogasadrang du gsol/ bar lan bsum/hūṃ/ nyon cig tshe 'das sogs nas gsol ba thob/ bar lan gsum/ skabs 'dir lha khrus bya/ hūṃ/'di ni byams dang sogs nas shudzhai ye swā hā:'i bar dang / de'i sngags sham bcas lan gsum re gdon/ hūṃ/ma rig rtsal snang sogs swā hā: bla mas rigs drug gtor ma byin rlabs/ oṃ a kā ro sogs mnyam du gsung /hūṃ/ 'dod pa'i yon tan sogs/de mad chad lan gsum re 'dod dgos pa rnams yig chung na gsal/de min ye shes dbab pa'i skabs su/ tshe las 'das pa skad cig bis/ /'phags pa'i skrur sogs nas ro gcig gyur/las byang gibhā: nub phyogs bde chen sogasasprul du gsol/ yig drug dang / ār+ya lo ki spya na 'dren 'dzud dkos pa gcig pu ma gtogs lam bstan par mthar chags su bya/ khrus chog zhag sprel bar mi 'don na/ rtsa sngags mthar/ hūṃ: ka dag spros bral me thab tu/ rang byung sogs kyis byang bu bzhus pa byang thal rus bu dang lhan cig tu bya/ bzang spyod 'don/rjes chog ni/ na raka bskang bshags sam/ ye shes sku mchog sogs/ yika brgya/hūṃ/ bka' bsang sogs nam mkha'i mthar thug sogs/ phyin par shog /gzhung gi hūṃ: bdag nyid thugs las sogs/ hūṃ: 'og min chos dbyings sogs/ spyan 'dren/ hūṃ: rtsa gsum thugs rje sogs phud dang po/ hūṃ/bdab/ gi tshe rabs sorgas phud bar ba/ tshogs 'gugs lan kasum/ hūṃ/ ma rig 39

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6gnyis pa de ltar rus sbyong zin nas sats+tsha gdab tshul ni/ sbyar zin pa'i rus bu rnams zhib par btags la sa gtsang gi spyin dang / rin chen bye ma/ ba byung / sngar baspubs pa'i bum chu rnams lhan cig tu bajis la/ rin po che'i snod du bzhag /las sngags bzla zhing las bum chus bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las 'jim pa sogs brgya bcas/ susmye'i sngags nyer cig /rtsa sngags dang / oṃ dzi na dzika hūṃ: zhesapa dang sbrel ba brgya rtsa bzlas nas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas gzhung gi sngags dang yig chung rnams zhib par ded nas sats+tsha legs par gdab/ gdab zin pa dang /gzhung bzhin rab gnas byas te/ kheb dkar po'i steng du/ 'bruXtshom gyi khar bkod la/ steng du 'phan gdugs sogs dang /mthar phyi nang yi mchod pas bskor/gsum paXgadabs zin sgrub tshul ni/ gdabaXnyin der baspub na mdun bskyed nas 'jug pas chog cing / nyin snga ma lta bu la btab nas nyin phyi ma la bsgrubs pa yin na/sngar bzhin bdag bskyed gsol 'debs nas bzung bstod pa'i bar/ dzab kha dbye mi dgos/ rang nyid thags rje chen po'i thags ka ru: sogs bsnyen dmikas/1 da 1 — da — 1ma ṇi ci 'grub/ rigs bzhi'i sems ma'i las sngags bcas song nas/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ mchod bstod mthar/ yig brgya lan gcig /de nas mdud bskyed bsgrub pa ni/mdun bskyed kyi mchod rdzas rnams la bsang chu 'thor zhing / oṃ ā:hūṃ: phyi nang gsang ba'i sogs/ ā:hūṃ: sngags lan gsum/ oṃ shu n+ya ta sogs/ chos kun mi dmigs sogs nas/ po ta la: de dbus rab yangs pad+ma sogs nas gzhung bzhin bstod pa'i/ phyag 'tshal bstod:nas/ rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i zhal sogs nas gyur/ ma ṇi dang spyo na gzungs sngags gzhan yang ci mang dang / bar skabs rnams su rtsa sngags la/ oṃ da ha da ha sogs/ sngags sham 441

pod/ 6 rdo grubaX'ajigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/— btags pa nyer gcig tsam re bzla/ dgong mo 'jog ran dus/ mchod pa byin rlabs/mchod bstod/yig brgya lan gcig bskang bshags nas bzung tshogs/ chad bstan/ bro mnan/ slar yang mchod pa'i byin rlabs dang / mchod bstod/ gsol 'debs zhal mthong ma/oṃ bcom ldan snying rje chen po'i bdag:sogs gsol:bar lan gsum/ho: thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ sogs/ gsol: yig brgya lan gsum/ mchod rten lha dang bca pa sogs nas gyur: bar/ me tog dam pa phreng ba sogasashālo ka dang / bstod par 'os pa thams cad sogs bstod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs gsol/ bar dbyangs gsal rten snying lan bdun dang / su pra tiṣ+ṭhas me tog 'thor/ho: chu las chu bur sogasadang / ho: dus gsum bsags pa'i sogs lan gsum/ ho:rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i sogs/ de'i 'gres kyis zhag grangs ci tsam bsgrub kyang nyin rer cho ga tshar rer byas pa'i thun mtshams rnams su mchod pa gsar bshams dang /bzang po spyod pa tshar re ma chags par byed/ gzungs 'jug gi sngags la ming spel bya b.raXmi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs mdo las gsungs pas nges par 'grub dgos lha bur 'dug kyang / de 'dra ma grub na ming spel gyi 'dod gsol gdugs sam sats+tsha re la dkris nas bzhab lhong chog gzungs 'jug la ming spel bya tshul thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas bsgrub na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ trī: chegemo'i las ngan bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par grur cig ces bri/ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs sngags bzla bzhin pas rus bu rnams chus yang yang bkrus te sbyang dgos pa dang / sbyangs ba'i rus pa rnams zhib par btags te/ sa gtsang spyin dang / rin chen bye ma sogs dang lhan cig tu yang yang bajis te kha dog phug ron gyi mdog lta bu ma byung 4 4 2

sartso spub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6gi bar du zhun thar sprad dgos par yang gsungs pa dang / de rnams kyang dmigs pa dang sngags dang rdzas phyag rgya sogs thams cad tshang ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs te rgyud sde nas bshad pa lhar gyi lag len byas na ni/ rgyud sde nas gaspengs pa tsam gyi phan yon thob pa yin no//grub chen dgon byi phyag bzhes so////443

ngo da/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams len bzhugs/'dren pa 'od dpag med pa la btud nas/ bde chen zhing khams bgrod pa'i them skas che/ myur lam 'pho ba'i man ngag zab mo'i don/ gsal dang nyung ngu'i tshig gis 'dir bshad bya/ gang zhig gis ngan 'gro'i grong khyer mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi tshong khang chen por thesanas/ bde 'gro'i lus rten rnam par dag pa/ mi khom pa brgyad dang bral ba'i zhing khams kyi 'gro ba bzang por 'khrid pa'i thabs mkhasarmad du byung ba'apho ba'i gdams ngag nyams su bsta ra bar 'dod pas/ thob mar skyabs sems/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs/ sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde dang /sogs tshad med bzhi'i tshig lan gsum brjod/ de nas dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta/ sogs/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ba'i chos nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi rtsal snang brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad dag chen bde ba mchog gi zhing khams ngo mtshar sprul pa'i rol mor rnam par snang ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la baṃ yig 'od du zhu ba las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo sacer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing / phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dgyes pa'i zhal ras 'dzum zhing chags pa'i rnam 'gyur can spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing du ring ba'i tshul gyis gzigs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum shing g.yon brkyangs pas bam ro'i snying gar brdzis pa/ rdo rje sku yi grong khyer du sgyu1 44

zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams len/ pod/ 6rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi gtso bor gyur ba'i dadu ma kha dog mthing ga drang zhing mdangs gsal ba/ mnyen cing dbyibs legs pa/ yar sne spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu gar kha phyes shing mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad kar zug pa/ snying kha'i rtsa spubs pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad kyis bkag pa'i steng du rlung gi thig le ljang skya 'phar ba dang 'phrig pa'i rnam 'gyur can la brten pa'i rnam shes yid kyi thig le dīXyig gi gzugs sa gnas pa/ g.yo ba 15 da dang 'dar ba'i bdag nyid can du gsal bar gyur/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla seng ge'i khri la 'dren pa 'od dpag tu med pa mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyi bdag nyid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/chos gos rnam pa gsum gyis mdzes par klubs pa/ zhabs zung rdo rje'i skyil krung gis gdan gnon pa/ 'od zer gyi rnam rol kun tu 'phro ba/ zhing khams rab 'byams kyi de bzhin gshebs pa sras dang bcas pas bskor ba/ byin rlabs kyi sprin phung thibs se dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal lhag ge bdag sogs mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la brtse ba'i thugs kyis dbo/ngas/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs/ byams pa'i zhal gyis phyogs te bzhugs par gyur zhes brjod cing bsam la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs 445

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba ra ma pa/ sogs/ sangs rgyas mabon po 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdun nam nyer sacig sogs brjod cing mos gus kyi gdung shugs bya/ de nas/ e ma ho/ gnas rang snang / sogs/ zin par shog lan bdun nam gsum sogs brjod mthar/ hika gsum sogs brjod la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan ci rigs brngod mthar/ e ma ho/ zhing bde ldan pad+mo bkod pa'i klong / /skyabs sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma dang / /don dbyer med 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /sku snang stong ye shes dwangs ma'i lus/ /'od ngo mtshar bkod pa'i gzi byin can/ /sras 'phags tshogs rgya mtshos yongs bskor ba/ /blo dang ba'i mos ngor rab bsam te/ /yid khyed shes gdung bas gsol 'debs na/ /lam zab mo 'pho ba'i man ngag gis/ /sems 'od gsal gnyug ma'i ti la ka /gnas mkha' spyod sprul ba'i 'og min du/ /dbyings chos sku'i rgyal sa zin par shog /ces lan ci rigs su brjod mthar/ trī:ji:ji:zhes brjod cing /snying ba'i ji:yig dbu ma'i lam brgyud/rim byis spyi bor song ba tshangs bug nasamagon po 'od dpag med pa'i thugs kar ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam la/ nyikaci rigs brjod nas slar yang 'od dpag med kyi mtshan brgya rtsa sogs brjod la/sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o rgyan pad+ma 'byung sanas la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs//myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis sgyu116

zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams len/ pod/ 6rlobs//'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpab med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gter ston nyi zla sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs//sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshungs med nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs//'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin kyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtogs ldan saṃṅga bha dra la bsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mar lam 'pho ba'i tsamakha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pha rgod dri med blo gros la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis zlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin 147

ra / kyi rje da ba ba ji ba ba ma ba bad ba ma da ba ba nga ba da na / gyis rlobs/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshungs med ma ti'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yongs 'dzin phun tshogs rnam rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpas med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dren mchog karma chos rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin kyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags 4 48

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi pa'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma kun grol rnam rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong par byin gyis rlobs//myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs//'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye ngar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs med phrin las 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs//sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs med phun tshogs 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i 60

zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams len/ pod/ 6pa mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis zlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang bo la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jibs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshal la gsol ba 'debs/ zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs///sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho pa'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs///'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /rnam shes bde chen 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lan bdun nam gsum gdab mthar/ trī:ji:zhes brjod cing / rtsa dbu ma la lam gyi 'du shes/ semasarnam shes kyi thig le la mgron po'i 'du shes/ bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams la 'gro yul gyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes gsumagyi rtsi dang ma bral bar/ spar chog gi dmigs gnad bcas/ hika brjod slar yang mos gus461

zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams len/ pod/ 6ra ma thim par gyur/ oṃ a ma ra ṇa dza badhe swā hā/ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ ces bzla/ marngug tu/ 'khor ba'i sems can gang yang rung / /khyed kyi mtshan tsam 'dzin pa yang / /tshe dang ye shes stsol mdzad pa/ /tshe dpag med kyi bkra shis shog /cesapa brjod/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /sogs kyis smon lam gdab bo/ /don zab thabs kyi lam bzang rmad byung ba/ /ma bsgom 'tshang rgya 'pho ba'i man ngag chos/ /bsnyad las legs byas snang ba gang snyed pa/ /de yis 'gro kun phan dang bde byed shog /ces pa'ang dad ldan kyi slob bu badz+ra a ka ras rin chen gnyis pa'i dngos 'byor dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor/ gzhon nu kun bzang 'jigs med pas bsrel bdage zhing bkra shis paraXgyur cig/ //453

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4— ྾྾ ༄/ /dpyad gzhung mang po las bsdus pa'i sman dpyad thor bu 'ga' zhig bathugs/bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyud dpyad kyi gzhung mang po las sman bcos thor bu 'ga' zhig bsnyu bar bya ste/ sman rnams kyi nus pa bsam kyis mi khyab pas gso ba'i gzhung la ma brten na rtogs par dka' ba dang / 'byor ba chung ngu'i sman pa rnams la phan gdag par bsams so/ /mako bo rlung gis na ba la rdza ma snum can cung dros pa mgor gyon na phan no/ /yang gar chang phul sasum bskol la long gis khol ba dang gu gul nag po ra ril tsam zhig btab la zhag gsum bar bsten na mgo nad shin tu bcos rdugs la phan no/ /yang la ca(cha) gsar ba dang gla rtsi chu 'jam pos phul na mabo nad bcos rdusas rnams zhi'o/ /mgo'i rma la skra 'tshob par 'dod na ba lang sga rwa rus pa rmig pa spu pags pa'i thal ba rnams til mar la sbyar te byug na skye'o/ /mig ma gsal na ra'am lug nad med kyi mchin pa gtub nas mar khur btsos pa'i nang du go snyod kyi spod btab ste rgyun du zos na 'grib rigs mi 'ong zhing mig shed shin tu skye bar bsngags so/ /lcags phye g.ya' med a ru ra'i 464

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ bshad do/ ('di skor ma yig mi gsal bas tshig gcig chad) /mkhal ma ko yu sa rlon du sbangs pa 'gron thal dang sbyar te byugs na so sra zhing dkar ba sogs yon tan che'o/ /so nad rigs la zhun mar rna ba'i nang du byugs na phan no/ /yang so rlung srin gyis na na btsan dug dang pi pi ling gi thum po mar du btsos nas bdug na phan no/ /dkar gong nas tsam brdung ba thun gcig ras su btums la mar khu'i nang du btsos smyug thur gyi rtser bskyon nas so gang na sar bcir ba yun basping na'ang so srin la phan no/ /yang rag sder satsang ma'i nang du chu blugs la dkar gong srin can bsresas pa bzhag de'i steng du rgya thang khrom gyi 'bras bu brdung ba bsregs mgo gos kyis btum la kha sna mig gsum du bas bdug chu nang du kha chu sna chu mang po 'dzag bcug pas so srin dngos su thon yong ngo //rnyil la khrab tshad babs pa'i gzer thi ngas dang rnyil chad pa la dri chur mtshur nag btabs pas mkhur bkang phyir 'pho'o/ /steng grib lta bu'i rlung gis ngag lkugs pa la lcags btsa' dmar can gyi khu ba chu blangs pa bskol te btung ba na phan zhing khong khrag mkhar ba la'ang 'di nyid mchog go /mchu mdze byung na nangs snga rdo ba mo can lta du'i grang mo glan pas sel lo/ /rlung gis mchu gas pa dang spyi gtsug dang sen skyi gas na lte khung du mar byugs pas sel/ ma ne /68

dpyad gzhung mang po las bsdus pa'i sman dpyad thor bu/ pod/ 6'gram rus bud na sug pa'i phye ma snar btab ste sbrid pa byung bas tshud cing rud (dud)rgan snar rngub pa'i sprud pa las kyang tshud do/kha nas khrag sgyugs na rang gi mtshan ma'i spu sran ma drug gi tshad tsam ril bur bsgril ba chus phul bas chad do/ /sbid pa 'don ma thub par gdong pa sbrid na de ma thag nyi ma la bltas pas 'thon no/ /ngo khab (kheb)dang phye ma sel ba la sbrang dang badzud kyi lde gus byugs pa bya'o//sprul nag pags pa nus ldan du bsrebs nas ba ra'i mar dang sbyar ba byugs na sha bkra dang glang shu sel lo/ /gas pas gre ba 'gags na 'khun pa gros 'debs kyi rtsa ba dgun dus su brkos nas rul sungs su ma song bar bskams pa de ngang pa chig thub dang sbyar bas 'joms/ mgul 'gags dang pho thogs la bya rdo bsregs pa chur bzhus te bskol ba'i snyigs ma dor khu ba dwangs bgrung blangs/ sgar yang rdza snod du bskol nas bskam pa par bur bcings la kha dam par bcad/ lo bzhi bcu tshun chad kyi dar mar skar bzhi de phan chad la skar do a rag 'thung gang thub kyis phul/ des srin bu sgyug bshal byung na phan rtags yin/ de ma byung yang nad kyi dbal bcag na phan gal te ma bcag na yang bskyar bya'o/ /mgul 'gags zas ma thar zhing lhag par sgyug pa la bye'u leb dkar chung chang sgyur khar shi ba'i ro de btags pa zho re 469

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/btags te tsha 'khru la chu dang grang 'khru la chang gis phul ba ches cher zab bo/ /sgog skya gcig mar khur gdus nas bsten pa'am ram zan mar khu'i nang du btsos pa zos na'ang phan no/ /gnyan 'brum bu bsrung na dang po 'brum bu tho phyi na yod dus mi rta khyi gsum gyi sha sgo srang la btags pas thub cing mon sran btsos pa skud pa la brgyus te ske la btags kyang srung bar gsungs so/ /lhog rgod thog babs su byung na rta bla'i ro mgo sug ma nyams pa mar gyi dril nas khyur mid byas na shin tu phan no/ /yang lhos pa cis kyang ma zhi na sdom nag la gzhig (bzhib)tu gzhug go /gnyan barba ta'am nag po sum sgril la phur nag gi thang la gla rtsi btab pa kho nas yang yang btang bas 'chos so/ /gnyan 'bar 'bur la nya lcibs me la ser tsam bsrebs pa'i thal ba ba'i zhos gta' byas te thun chen re nyin bdun du btang bas phan no/ /me lce'i 'khor lo la tsan dan dmar po dang btsag zhib btags khong du btang zhing gang na sar byug pas phan no/ /banyan 'bras kyi skrangs 'dur la sgog cig ma ṭi ka gsum brtsegs kyis rngams tsam yod pa gshag nas sbyar ba'i steng du mkhan pa dkar po'i me sum tshom du bsregade nas sgog pa tshur len/ de byas pas zus med la zug skyes pa'am zug yod la zug chag pa byung na phan rtabs yin te nad gsar 462

nga nga nga/ tram̐ng rdo tram̐ng sa med bstang 'i gsung 'ang nga/ ྾nga —྾po sna tha sogs dang spyar nas rngubs pas 'phral du phan zhes zer/srin bshal byed na nad pa'i dri chu bskol bar tshwa thun gcig btab la grang du bcug de btang bas srin thams cad bshal du 'gyur/bshal rjes spyi dang mthun/ yang byi tang ka'i phye zhib btags sbrang gis ril bu dril ba bsten na khong srin sogs srin rigs thams cad la phan no/ /grang nad kyi khams zag pa rkang sked na ba nyams chung ba stod tsha smad grang sogs la sha ba'i kā dor chang la rlangs tshos byas pa skam pa'i phye ma sbrang gis ril bu sran ma tsam dril lnga bcu re 'bras thang gis phul na mchog bo /ha shig cha drug shing mngar dang lde gu gser thig gi thig le gnyis re sbyar ba'i phye ma chang bre gsum nang du blugs nas zhag bsum bzhag pa'i khu ba zho do chu bskol gyi phul na gcin snyi dang rde'u phye ma khrag rnab gis chu 'gags pa la phan/ rta drel la gtong na 'bras khus phul/ gzhan yang 'di'i rtsa nad rde'u rigs kun la phan no/ /dri chen 'gags na dud pa bya bal ma dang bul tog dang bu ram rnams sbyar ba 'phongs su bcug na mi thon mi srid do/ /rdel nad dang chu 'gags la tshwa la mer bsregs pa'i thal ba phye mar byas te gsang gnas kyi nang du cung zad blugs na chu thon zhing thun chung re chu bskol gyi phul re btang bas rdel nad zhi ba zab khyad can no//rtsa 'gags na 64

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/la rta'i lag pa'i se ra rus('dir ni rta'i mig chung ngam rta bon pa ru bya'ong rang mchan)chang gis byug nas mer ser tsam bsregs pa'i phye ma de chang bre gsum nang du blugs la zhag gsum bzhag pa'i khu ba nyin re snyigs dor phor chung gang tsam re bsten pas sel lo/ /spyi zhur brdung ba'i khu ba btung na rtsa 'chus kyi rigs la phan no/ /mu zi dang btsan dug cha mnyam lo brgyad dri chus 'dam btag ril bu yun bsten byas pas za 'phrug sogs chu ser rtsa tshigs dang pags pa la rgyas pa sel lo/ /sga skya dang g.yer ma zhi btabs chur spyar blugs na'ang za 'phrug la phan no/ /yang za 'phrug me dbal byung na glang rog po'i kha chu yang yang byugs na nges par phan no//brag chung zhib btag pa chu'am rang gi dri chus bran la byug na bzod brlag med pa'i srin nad la phan no/ /glang shu la bong ba dkar po dri chur sbyar ba'am yang na 'om bu'i khu ba la byang bul btab nas nan ltar byug go /rma che chung gang yang mi'i mgo rus dang skra dang rus pa rnams kyi phye ma gcin dang sbyar bas bkrus na sbyor ba brgyas mi 'tsho ba'ang 'apa'i/ /khrag gcod na ci yang rung bas rus pa bsregs thal dang nas bsregs pa'i thal ba rdza sa bsregs pa'i sgo mo zhib brdung gsum rma khar btab na chod/ rta spu bsregs thal rma la btab na'ang chod do/ /rma rgan yun ring 'tshor ('tshob)ma 'dod 466

dpyad gzhung mang po las bsdus pa'i sman dpyad thor bu/ pod/ 6ba nga na bya rog gi brun bdug na sos so/ /khyes rmug na ha la bzang po zhib btags chu dang sbyar bas rma kha dag par bkrus na gnyan sogs mi 'byung ngo / /mes tshigs pa'i rma la bul tog chang sbyar ram/li khri chu gtsang dang sbyar bas shin tu phan no//yang khron pa'i 'jim pa sngon po byug na me dang chu tshan gyis tshig pa la phan no/ /rgya thor la bul tog ba bla dud pa gsum po bsngags shing ni la tho ṭha yang zab par snang ngo / /rkang ba'i ser kha ma sos na spyin bzang pos byugs nas skrad dum zhig glan na sos so/ /lug mur skam po dang ka ra'i phye ma btab na rnag sme sha gso ba la mchog go /thar nu nus bsregs byas pa rdol mi rung ba'i rnag mgor byug na myur du rdol lo///mde'u ma thon na bud med kyi dor rta khrag can bsregs pa dang thab gong gi sa tshig pa phul do tsam chu bre phyed kyi nang du bgrungs te dwangs par byas nas blud na phyin to/ /des ma phyin na yang mang du bya'o/ /sdom dang sdig pa khong du song na sran ma dkar po'i rtsa ba dang / ram pa'i rtsa ba cha mnyam zhib btags chang dang byi ra ba btang bas phan no/ /gre bar rus pa dang gra ma zug na ras sam dar gang rung gre bar thar tsam bsdams nas dar skud btags la mid par ldad ngo shas tsam mid nas ske'i mtha' rnams khu tshur gyis ran tsam brdung / rke phar log tshur log bzhi lnga tsam bya/ de nas 467

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—4—4 ྾྾sngar gyi dar skud la 'then pas 'byung ngo/ /rta phyugs sogs kyi khong du kha brgyad pa sogs shor nas sbos na tshwa dang mar bsres pa khar bcug pas kha cag cag byed na mod la 'aྈ/ /phyubs ci sbos kyang mjug snying bsregs pas phan no/ /sbyar dug gtso bor gyur ba'i dug rigs la zhal shes ltar btus pa'i ko ṭha rdog po gsum tshal brdung byas pa dkar yol gang tsam chu la ja yun zhig sbangs/ mthe bong (gis)drag tu bsnur (btsur)ba'i khu ba de btung na dug thams cad sbyang du 'khrid nus pas shin tu zab/ khye dug bi gnyen por rta gseb sngon po'i sbang sa la ma lhung ba blangs te bza ba'i khu ba mar dkar btab ste lhog tsam bskol ba de sna bkag nas blud na dug gsod do/ /btsan dug las gyur ba'i nad tshabs chung na sha mo'i rtsa ba dang yos tshig gi thang btang na phan/ tshabs che na rta sogs kyi gson khrag btang ngo / /chang gi mi myos par byed na mar skya bzhus pa phor chung gang du lan tshwa ro bro tsam zhig btab ste 'thung na ra ro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yang chang ma btung gong lug ru ser po grib skam byas pas thang btang de nas 'thung na chang nad mi 'byung ngo / /sna cham byung phral gzhan la ma brjod gong rtsam pa'i du ba nan cher bdug na phran bu lam nas ldog nus so/ /yang ri bong ril ma bdun dang char nyis khyer ba'i dres ma mtho gang sgog 168

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/— 4 ྾྾nyung ma'i khaṇ+ḍa chu bskol gyis phul na nyin re'i dub srung zhing mchin pa'i dug babs sel lo/ /zwa tshod kyi khasnye dang sbrang rgod spyar bas tsha ba med pa'i dreg nad la phan no/ /kyi lce'i rtsa lo'i khasnye chu grang mos phul na tsha ba'i rigs la phan zhing mkhris pa snod lhung rnams 'khru'o/ /brag zhun chu grang mos phul na pho mchin dang mkhal ma'i tsha ba sel lo/ /yan lag gi rtsa rgyus 'khums tshad gsar rnying rma dang bud med btsas rjes sked pa na ba sogs la brag zhun thang btang bas phan no//byis pa mtshan ru byed na mar me'i sdong bur chags pa'i dud ril te slar yang bsregs pa'i phye ma ma'i nu rtser byugs te bsgrun na phan no/ /dar ma'am byis pa'i sgyugs mer dang skrugs pa kacod na la phug gi lo ma brdung btsur byas pa'i khu ba btang na chod do/ /byis pa mtshi ba(mtshul ba yin nam)lugs la sngo chu srin sder mo'i phye ma btab na phan no/ /byis pa bad kan gyis ske 'gags nas ngar na dan rog rdog gcig pags pa bshu nang tshil brdung nas ril bu bya/ de srin bal gyi dril nas pho g.yas mo g.yon pa'i snar brdzangs na phan/ byis pa'i nad mngal dug gis dmar thig mched nas snying gar slebs na 'chi bas/ de la sman bul tog chur bskol ba'i gar chus bran/ tshabs shin tu che na lug rgod rwa bsregs thal dang sgong chu dkar pos byugs nas zhi'o/ /dpyad la ‘17 2

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba te kha bsdams du ba ma shor bar nus bsregs bya/ de ltar bgyis pa'i phye ma de ga'u sogs rlan mi 'chor ba'i snod bzang por bcug ste dbos dus su me sbar na lo dang zla bar yang mi 'chi'o/ /rta'i sa bon las skyes pa'i sha mong de rgya yul nas byung ba yin tshwa khu dang chang bis bkrus pa rgya thur gyi srang so gnyis chang bzang bre nyi shu'i nang du sbangs nas de'i khu bcud rim par 'thung na ro tsa bar 'gyur ro/ /rtswa dur ba la rten 'brel snying po bzlas te byin gyis rlabs nas zos na srog ring por 'tsho ba'i dga' sto na chen por 'gyur ro/ /de la sogs pa'i phan byed kyi rigs pa mang la rgya che bar yod pa rnams dkyus gcig tu rdzogs par dka' bas mtha' dag ni gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /sman bcos nyer mkho sna tshogs phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa 'di ni rdo rol gyi sa'i cha 'chi med sman ljo ngas su 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis/ /171

paracad nga nga rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ nga nga nga nga can bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag chen por gyur ba dag dang / gzhan yang mkhas pa'i khyu mchog mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho/ grub pa'i dbang po satsang ba byams pa chos 'dzin/ smra ba'i dbang phyug rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gtsug lag rtsis kyi nyin byed phyag mdzod byams pa gsung rab/ sman rgyal g.yu thog gnyis pa lha rje stag bla nor bu/lo rgyus smra ba'i dbang po gyi lung sras po sku mched/ rtsod rigs smra ba'i seng chen 'gya ba a lags mdo sngags/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po khra dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyas/ yongs 'dzin chen po 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros/ bstan pa'i nyin byed a rig dge bshes chen mo/ gsang chen bka' babs shar yod grags pa bzang po/ mdo rgyud smra ba gyang sprul don yod rdo rje/ nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta sku phyogs shing bza' sku phreng / rtsod bral dus babs kyi gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa/ rab 'byams gzhung brgya smra ba'i mkhan chen a skong blo bzang rdo rje/ rbeg mchog smra ba'i bka' babs kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo sokas mkhas dbang nor du'i phreng ba zam ma chad par yul 'dir sku 'khrungs pa'am dus yun ring por bzhugs te mdzad phrin rgya cher bskyangs pa dang /dgon gnas dang dge 'dun gyi 'dus sde dag smra ma dbos/ khyim pa spra nag pa dag gi khrod du'ang yig tshang lo rgyus gleng ba'i dge 2

pod 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/— rdo 'i ri ྾rang khyad na pa sa gnas ga gnas shul bzhag myur skyob dang dar spel byed pa'i kun slong gis bskul te/ nged las khungs nas 'tshol bsdu sgrig gsum gyi bya ba yun ring spel mthar dpe rnying mi nyung ba zhig lag son byung ba las bdams pa brgyud/ 4(mgo log sa khul mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs〉〉zhes pa zhig bsgrigs nas rim par dpe deb skor zhig par du skrun par rgya che'i klog pa po dab gi gdeng 'jog legs po dang 'brel yod sde khag gi gzengs bstod thob/ rting skul de dag gi rmang gzhi'i steng((krung go'i grangs nyung mi rig gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i go skabs dang bstun te nga tshos rim pa sngar las spags te/ slar yang((mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs))kyi par skrun jus gzhi gsar ba zhib bzos nas khul srid gzhung dang 'brel yod mgo khrid la yar zhu byas pas rgyab skyor dang khas len legs par thob par brten da lta jus gzhi dngos su lag star byed pa'i skal ba legs po thob/de la 'dir〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid 'tshol sbud dang dag sgrig rtsom sgrig par skrun bcas kyi skor gsal bshad du 'os pa 'ga' zhig zhu ba 'di lta ste/ 1 nga tshos bya ba 'di spel ba la mgo log khul u dang / khul 4

bab/skyebakab dpeb /) ba/da zug/ dbabad bkakun dmangs chen/ khul srid gzhung / khul srid gros bcas 'go khrid tshan skor che bzhi dang 'brel yod sde khag gi 'gan 'khur ba las grub pa'i ched don 'go khrid tshan chung btsubs thog 'brel yod don bya gang ci'i thad bka' skor snyan seng zhus pa'i dgongs don ltar bsgrubs pa yin la/ ched dmigs bya ba'i jus gzhi yib thos nas khul mi dmangs srid gzhung la zhus te chos mchan thob cing brgyud spel gnang ba dang bstun pa sha stag yin/ dus mtshungs su ma phyi'i yig rnying yod tshad so so'i 'brel yod gnyer bdas dang chos bdag dbon bdag sogs brgyud de tshul ldan lugs mthun sgos 'tshol sdud byas shing / khong tshor gros zhu byas te par skrun byed par thubs mthun yid 'thad byung ba yin la/ rgyun srol lam sasang ba sngags dang 'brel ba sogs kyi dbang gis bka' dog dgos min dag kyang khong tsho'i dgongs 'dod bka' 'khrol dang bstun pa ma gtogs nged cag gi lag tu gang son ltar gzu lum sger gcod byas pa gcig kyang med/2 mthan rkyen 'byor ba'i gnas bab 'og gsung 'khum ༄gcig la'ang bris ma dang par ma'i ma phyi ci rnyed cig nye bar bsdus te phan tshun bsdur gshib sgos gang rgyas shos kyi rmang kazhi'i steng gzhan las kha bskangs shing / dmangs khrod du kha 'thor du 6

n+d+ran+d+ra ྾ rdo ཿ s+dzawī 11mi ༵ 'bum/ ྾—mjupy-i mthar ngh+rud du zhu sbyo ni/ nga ༵ gna' rtsodh+ri rtsom sbyog par skrun nyams nga zhan nga / dab ga par zhu da pa chu tsha tshokyi ba — che so brkyed byema' ༵/tshodus rdo sa gtu~X cangayo lasange zalayi ba gas kya na sa da gas la ra 'gal 4 cha da sa na pas/ rgya che'i zi po brephyiphyi gags ༵ yo rnadī par shaṃgs dkrugs dwangs dzhai dadī 'al tshar sman pa bas dngas 'char la'ang ba ba da par 'al//zhes mako log khul gna' rtsom bya ༵༵ gzhung ༵sa khang nas/0 2003 zla10sa8la/

dpe sgrib 'gan 'khur ba/ rin chen tshe ring /mdun shog 'char 'god pa/ karma tshe ring /rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pod drug pa/mako log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i 'bo khrid tshan chung ga(1nga las khang gis bsdu sgrig byas/si khronami rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun nas bkram/lho nub lcags bzhu sa gshis par 'debs bzo grwas dpar/2003lo'i zla10par par bzhi dang po bsgrigs/ 2003lo'i zla10par par phengs dang po dpar/par grangs/ 000 nga 1300dpe rtasas/ 1ci3ma7—5 09—2739—970 1deb bdun po la rin sgor/ 50 00

〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dag sgrig dpe spun bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gi ming tho/tshan gartso/ pad ma rnam rgyal/tshan gartso gzhon pa/byis tshe ring / rdo rje bkra shis/bstan chos/ 'jigs med/ rdo rje/gces ma/ klu skyabs/ nor sde/khongs mi(ming rim bod yig ka mad ltar bsgrigs pa)klu skyabs/ dge legs/ mgon lha/cin nor bu/ gces ma/ 'ju skal bzang /'jigs med/ bstan chos/ thub bzang /dung gces/ rdo rje/ rdo rje bkra shis/nor sde/ nor bu/ pad ma rnam rgyal/byis tshe ring / tshul khrims/ tshe ring skyabs/
